methods.en: Fly, salt water, ice and travel

buying.en: Buying, brands, gifts and old gear
buying.zh: 购买、品牌、礼物和老装备

items.question: How do rod power and rod action differ, and which should weigh more when choosing a rod?
items.question_zh: 竿的硬度和调性有什么区别？选竿时哪一项应该更优先考虑？
items.short: Power is how much force it takes to bend the rod; action is where along the rod it bends. Choose power first.
items.body: Power has to match the lure weight and line you will use, and the rod's label prints that range. Then use action to fine-tune. A fast rod bends mostly near the tip, recovers quickly and drives single hooks home, which suits jigs and Texas rigs. A moderate or slow rod bends farther down and absorbs shock, which helps keep treble-hooked crankbaits pinned and protects light line. If you can own only one, a medium-power, fast-action rod covers the widest range. Power labels are not standardized, so one maker's medium can feel like another's medium-light. Compare the printed lure and line ratings rather than the word.
items.short_zh: 硬度是把竿压弯需要多大的力，调性是竿从哪个位置开始弯。选竿时先看硬度。
items.body_zh: 硬度要和你用的饵重、线配得上，竿上印的范围就是依据。然后用调性做细调。快调的竿主要在靠近竿尖处弯曲，回弹快，单钩容易刺入，适合铅头钩和德州钓组。中调或慢调的竿弯到更靠下的位置，能吸收冲击，用三本钩的 crankbait 时不容易脱钩，也更护细线。只能有一根的话，中等硬度、快调的竿覆盖面最广。各品牌的硬度叫法没有统一标准，这家的 medium 可能只相当于那家的 medium-light，所以要比较竿上印的饵重和线号，不要只看这个词。

items.question: If a lure weighs more than the maximum printed on a rod, what can go wrong?
items.question_zh: 如果饵的重量超过竿上标注的上限，可能会出什么问题？
items.short: A little over usually just feels sluggish. Well over the limit, the rod can break on the cast.
items.body: The blank is being loaded past what it was built for, and a sharp snap or a hard swing is when it is most likely to fail. Even without a break, accuracy and distance suffer because the tip can't recover cleanly, and the rod has less left for setting the hook. The rating assumes a normal cast, so if you must go slightly over, use a smooth lob rather than a snap. Check the warranty too, since overload damage may not be covered. Going below the range isn't dangerous; the rod just won't load and the lure won't travel far. German angling exams define the rating as the lure weight at which the rod works best, and they teach keeping to it so the blank isn't overloaded on the cast.
items.short_zh: 略微超出通常只是抛起来发闷。超出很多时，竿可能在抛投时折断。
items.body_zh: 这时竿身受力已经超过设计范围，猛甩或大力抡的时候最容易出事。就算没断，竿尖回弹不利落，精度和距离都会变差，提竿时也没有多少余力。标称是按正常抛投来定的，如果确实要略微超出，就用平顺的抛送，不要猛甩。也要看看保修条款，超载造成的损坏不一定在保修范围内。低于下限没有危险，只是竿弯不起来，饵抛不远。德国的钓鱼考试把这个标称定义为竿子状态最好时的饵重，并要求遵守，以免抛投时竿子过载。

items.question: Can a rod safely use line heavier than its printed rating, and when does that become a real risk?
items.question_zh: 竿能否安全使用比标称更粗的线？什么情况下这样做会有实际风险？
items.short: Usually yes, within reason. The real risk starts when the line is strong enough to let you pull harder than the rod can take.
items.body: The line rating is a guide to casting and to how much load the rod is built for. A few pounds of extra mono mostly costs some casting distance. Braid is different: 20 lb braid is about as thin as 6 to 8 lb mono, so it usually fits fine. The danger comes when the line no longer breaks first. Hauling on a snag, tightening the drag too far or lifting the rod too high against a fish can snap it. Set the drag for the rod, not the line, and free snags by pointing the rod at them and pulling straight.
items.short_zh: 一般可以，但要有分寸。真正的风险是线太强，你用上的力超过了竿能承受的范围。
items.body_zh: 线号标称用来参考抛投和竿能承受的负荷。尼龙线粗几磅，通常只是抛投距离差一点。编织线要另算：20 磅编织线大约只有 6 到 8 磅尼龙线那么细，一般都能用。真正危险的是断的不再是线。硬拉挂底、卸力拧得太紧，或者把竿抬得太高去顶鱼，都可能把竿折断。卸力要按竿的承受力来设，不要按线来设；挂底时把竿尖对准挂点，顺着线直拉。

items.question: Does a longer rod always cast farther, or do lure weight and casting technique matter more?
items.question_zh: 竿越长就一定抛得越远吗？还是饵重和抛投技术的影响更大？
items.short: Not always. A longer rod helps only when the lure, line and casting stroke suit it.
items.body: Length adds tip speed, so a properly loaded long rod does cast farther. A lure too light to bend the rod gains nothing, though, and a long rod with a poor release can cast shorter than a well-used short one. The biggest gains usually come from a lure inside the rod's range, thinner line, a spool filled to the right level and a smooth stroke. Extra length matters most in surf fishing and when you need distance from the bank. Under trees it just gets in the way.
items.short_zh: 不一定。只有饵、线和抛投动作都合适时，长竿才有优势。
items.body_zh: 竿长能提高竿尖的速度，所以受力充分的长竿确实抛得更远。但饵太轻、压不弯竿，长度就没有用；出手不好的长竿，也可能比用得好的短竿抛得近。提升最大的通常是这几项：饵在竿的范围内、线更细、线杯上线量合适、动作平顺。长度最有用的场合是海滩投钓和需要从岸上抛远的时候。头顶有树时，长竿反而碍事。

items.question: How does a fiberglass rod feel different from a graphite rod, and which lures suit each material?
items.question_zh: 玻纤竿和碳素竿的手感有什么不同？两种材质分别适合哪些饵？
items.short: Fiberglass is slower, heavier and more forgiving. Graphite is lighter, stiffer and tells you more about what the lure is doing.
items.body: A glass rod bends deep into the blank and recovers slowly. That gives a fish time to take the lure and keeps treble hooks from tearing out, so glass suits crankbaits and other moving lures. It is also hard to break, which helps with kids and rough use. Graphite is lighter for its power and carries small taps up to your hand. That suits jigs, Texas rigs and other lures where you need to feel the bottom and set a single hook quickly. Composite rods blend the two and make a good middle ground.
items.short_zh: 玻纤竿反应慢、较重、容错高。碳素竿更轻、更硬，也更能传递饵的动静。
items.body_zh: 玻纤竿会弯到竿身深处，回弹也慢。这样鱼有时间把饵吃进去，三本钩也不容易撕脱，所以适合 crankbait 和其他靠收线游动的饵。它也不容易断，适合孩子使用和粗放使用。碳素竿在同样硬度下更轻，轻微的点动能传到手上，适合铅头钩、德州钓组，以及需要感知水底、快速刺入单钩的饵。复合材料竿介于两者之间，是不错的折中选择。

items.question: What rod length makes sense for bank fishing compared with fishing from a kayak?
items.question_zh: 岸钓和皮划艇钓鱼分别适合多长的竿？
items.short: From the bank, about 6½ to 7½ feet. From a kayak, about 6 to 7 feet.
items.body: On the bank a slightly longer rod adds distance and helps keep line off weeds and rocks, though trees overhead can push you toward something shorter. In a kayak you sit low and fish close to the boat, so a shorter rod is easier to handle, especially when landing a fish or steering it around the bow. If one rod has to do both jobs, a spinning rod of 6½ to 7 feet is a good compromise. Whichever you fish from, the bank and the water should decide the length more than your height does.
items.short_zh: 岸钓大约 6½ 到 7½ 英尺，皮划艇大约 6 到 7 英尺。
items.body_zh: 岸钓时竿稍长一点，能抛得更远，也更容易让线避开水草和岩石；不过头顶有树时，就要选短一些的。在皮划艇上人坐得低，鱼也在船边，短竿更好操作，收鱼或把鱼从船头绕过去时尤其如此。如果一根竿要兼顾两种场合，6½ 到 7 英尺的直柄竿是不错的折中。无论在哪里钓，决定竿长的主要是岸边条件和水域，而不是身高。

items.question: How much do the length and handle of a rod change how tiring it is over a full day?
items.question_zh: 竿的长度和手把设计，会在多大程度上影响钓一整天的疲劳感？
items.short: Quite a lot, mostly through balance rather than total weight.
items.body: A long rod puts weight far from your hand, so it feels heavier than the scale says. A longer rear handle lets you brace the rod against your forearm or use two hands, which spreads the load with heavy lures. A short handle is lighter and easier for one-handed jigging, but it tires the wrist sooner with heavy lures. Try the rod with your reel mounted. If the tip dives when you hold it at the reel seat, it will tire you over a long day, and a slightly heavier reel or a shorter rod usually fixes that.
items.short_zh: 影响不小，主要来自平衡，而不是总重量。
items.body_zh: 长竿把重量放在离手很远的地方，所以手感比实际重量更重。后把长一些，可以把竿抵在前臂上或用双手，抛重饵时能分散负荷。短把更轻，单手操作铅头钩方便，但用重饵时手腕更容易累。把你的轮装上再试。如果握住轮座时竿尖往下沉，钓一整天就会累，换稍重一点的轮或短一点的竿，通常就能解决。

items.question: Which power and action suit bottom-contact lures such as jigs and Texas rigs?
items.question_zh: 铅头钩和德州钓组这类贴底的饵，适合什么硬度和调性？
items.short: Usually medium-heavy power with fast or extra-fast action.
items.body: A stiff lower section drives a single hook through plastic and into the jaw, and a sensitive tip lets you feel the bottom and light bites. Around cover, jigs and Texas rigs often call for medium-heavy or heavy power and 7 feet or more of length for leverage. Lighter plastics on small jig heads, including Ned rigs, do better on medium or medium-light spinning gear.
items.short_zh: 通常选中硬、快调或超快调。
items.body_zh: 竿的下半段够硬，才能把单钩穿过软饵、刺入鱼嘴；竿尖灵敏，才能感觉到水底和轻微的咬口。在障碍区用铅头钩和德州钓组时，常用中硬或硬竿，长度 7 英尺以上，便于发力。小铅头钩配轻软饵，包括内德钓组，用中等或中轻硬度的直柄竿更合适。

items.question: What should a rod dedicated to crankbaits offer?
items.question_zh: 专门用来打 crankbait 的竿应该具备哪些特点？
items.short: A moderate action, usually medium or medium-heavy power, at about 7 feet.
items.body: The softer bend keeps treble hooks from tearing out and gives a fish time to take the lure fully. It also absorbs the pull of a deep-diving bait. Glass or glass-composite blanks are the traditional choice. A rod of about 7 to 7½ feet casts crankbaits well and helps them run deep; shallow, light baits can use something shorter. Match the lure rating to the bait, because big-billed crankbaits pull much harder than their weight suggests.
items.short_zh: 中调，硬度通常是中等或中硬，长度约 7 英尺。
items.body_zh: 较软的弯曲能防止三本钩撕脱，也让鱼有时间把饵吃实，还能吸收深潜饵的拉力。传统上多用玻纤或玻纤复合竿身。7 到 7½ 英尺的竿抛 crankbait 顺手，也有助于饵潜得更深；浅潜的轻饵可以用短一些的竿。饵重标称要和饵相配，大唇 crankbait 的拉力比它的重量大得多。

items.question: How should a rod for large swimbaits be chosen, and how should its lure rating be read?
items.question_zh: 大型 swimbait 用的竿该怎么选？它的饵重标称应该怎么理解？
items.short: Choose the rod by the real weight of the bait, and stay within the rating.
items.body: Large swimbaits can run from about 2 ounces to well over 8 ounces, and a rod built for 1 ounce can break when one is cast hard. Look for a heavy or extra-heavy rod of about 7½ to 8 feet with a long handle for two-handed lobs. Weigh your bait, since the package figure is not always right, and compare it with the rating. The rating assumes a normal cast, so use a smooth lob. A moderate-fast action helps keep the hooks pinned during a long fight.
items.short_zh: 按饵的实际重量选竿，不要超出标称范围。
items.body_zh: 大型 swimbait 的重量大约从 2 盎司到远超 8 盎司，为 1 盎司设计的竿，用力抛这种饵可能会断。选硬或超硬的竿，长度约 7½ 到 8 英尺，后把要长，便于双手平稳抛送。自己称一下饵的重量，包装上的数字不一定准，再和标称比较。标称是按正常抛投来定的，所以要用平顺的抛送。中快调有助于在长时间搏鱼时让钩不脱。

items.question: Which rod features help when working topwater lures and jerkbaits?
items.question_zh: 操作水面系饵和 jerkbait 时，竿的哪些特性有帮助？
items.short: A shorter rod with a moderate-fast tip, so the rod doesn't pull the lure out of the strike.
items.body: You twitch these lures with the rod tip pointed down, so a length of about 6½ to 7 feet stops the tip from hitting the water. A slightly soft tip lets the lure dart without yanking it off line and gives a fish time to take it. Too stiff a rod pulls treble hooks out at the strike, and too soft a rod won't move the lure crisply. Medium or medium-light power suits most jerkbaits and small poppers. Large walking baits and big topwaters need medium-heavy.
items.short_zh: 选稍短的竿，竿尖中快调，这样鱼咬口时竿不会把饵拉走。
items.body_zh: 这类饵是竿尖朝下抖动的，6½ 到 7 英尺的长度可以避免竿尖碰水。竿尖略软，饵能灵活窜动而不被拽偏，鱼也有时间咬实。竿太硬，三本钩容易在咬口时被拉脱；竿太软，饵的动作就不够利落。多数 jerkbait 和小型 popper 用中等或中轻硬度。大型水面饵要用中硬。

items.question: How can I tell whether a rod and reel are balanced before buying them?
items.question_zh: 购买之前，怎样判断竿和轮是否平衡？
items.short: Mount the reel on the rod and hold the outfit at the reel seat.
items.body: An outfit is balanced if the tip stays about level or dips slightly when you rest it on one finger just ahead of the reel seat. If the tip dives, the reel is light for the rod; if the butt drops, it is heavy. Most shops will let you try this. Buying online, compare total weights and remember that a slightly heavier reel on a long rod often balances better than a very light one.
items.short_zh: 把轮装到竿上，在轮座处托起来试。
items.body_zh: 用一根手指托在轮座前方，如果竿尖大致水平或略微下沉，就是平衡的。竿尖明显下沉，说明轮对这根竿来说偏轻；竿尾下沉，说明轮偏重。多数渔具店都可以让你这样试。网上购买时，比较一下总重量，并记住长竿配稍重一点的轮，往往比配很轻的轮更平衡。

items.question: What rod specifications should I start from if I already own the reel?
items.question_zh: 如果已经有了轮，选竿时应该先看哪些参数？
items.short: Start from the line and lures the reel is set up for, then choose power and length.
items.body: A 2500 or 3000 spinning reel with 6 to 10 lb mono suits a medium-light or medium spinning rod of about 6 to 7 feet. A baitcaster with 12 to 20 lb line suits a medium or medium-heavy casting rod. Check the rod's line and lure ratings against what you plan to fish, and match reel type to rod type, because a spinning reel needs the large guides of a spinning rod.
items.short_zh: 先看轮上的线和要用的饵，再定硬度和长度。
items.body_zh: 2500 或 3000 号纺车轮配 6 到 10 磅尼龙线，适合 6 到 7 英尺的中轻或中等硬度直柄竿。水滴轮配 12 到 20 磅的线，适合中等或中硬的枪柄竿。把竿上的线号和饵重标称，和你打算用的线、饵对照一下。轮和竿的类型也要对应，纺车轮需要直柄竿那种大导环。

items.question: Is it a problem to put a spinning reel on a casting rod, or a baitcaster on a spinning rod?
items.question_zh: 把纺车轮装在枪柄竿上，或把水滴轮装在直柄竿上，会有问题吗？
items.short: Yes. They can be made to fit, but the guides work against the reel.
items.body: A spinning reel throws line off in large coils, so spinning rods have a big first guide under the rod. On a casting rod's small guides those coils choke and slap, which costs distance. A baitcaster pulls line off the top of the rod. On a spinning rod the guides hang underneath, so the line presses against the blank on every hook set and can strain the guides or twist the rod. Either way can work in a pinch for light use, but a matching rod is cheap compared with a broken one.
items.short_zh: 会有问题。装是装得上，但导环和轮是互相冲突的。
items.body_zh: 纺车轮出线时线圈很大，所以直柄竿在竿下方有一个大的第一导环。换成枪柄竿的小导环，线圈会被卡住并拍打导环，抛投距离就短了。水滴轮的线从竿的上方出来；装到直柄竿上，导环朝下，每次提竿线都会压向竿身，可能拉伤导环或把竿扭转。临时轻度使用还勉强可以，但配一根合适的竿，比弄断一根便宜得多。

items.question: Does a heavier reel on a light rod hurt performance, or only comfort?
items.question_zh: 轻竿配较重的轮，影响的是性能，还是只影响舒适度？
items.short: Mostly comfort, unless the balance is so far off that you lose feel.
items.body: A slightly heavy reel can actually improve the balance of a long rod. A reel far too heavy makes the outfit butt-heavy, so you feel fewer bites as your wrist tires and cast less smoothly. A large reel's stronger drag can also exceed what a light rod can take, so don't set the drag above the rod's limit.
items.short_zh: 主要影响舒适度，除非平衡差到影响手感。
items.body_zh: 稍重一点的轮，其实能改善长竿的平衡。轮太重，整套钓具就会尾重，手腕累了以后感觉到的咬口会变少，抛投也不够顺。大轮的卸力更强，可能超过轻竿的承受范围，所以卸力不要设得超过竿的上限。

items.question: What reel size usually suits a light-power rod, and what size suits a medium-heavy rod?
items.question_zh: 轻硬度的竿通常配多大的轮？中硬竿又通常配多大的轮？
items.short: A light rod usually takes a 1000 to 2500 spinning reel. A medium-heavy spinning rod usually takes a 3000 to 4000.
items.body: Light rods for 2 to 8 lb line balance best with small reels, often 1000 to 2000. A medium-light rod takes a 2500 or 3000. Medium-heavy rods for 10 to 20 lb line need a 3000 to 4000 to hold enough line and give a stronger drag. Casting reels are sized differently, with a 100 to 200 size common on medium and medium-heavy rods. Sizes vary by brand, so check weight and line capacity as well.
items.short_zh: 轻竿通常配 1000 到 2500 号纺车轮，中硬直柄竿通常配 3000 到 4000 号。
items.body_zh: 用 2 到 8 磅线的轻竿，配 1000 到 2000 号的小轮最平衡。中轻硬度的竿配 2500 或 3000 号。用 10 到 20 磅线的中硬竿，需要 3000 到 4000 号，才能容下足够的线，卸力也更强。水滴轮的型号另有一套，中等和中硬竿常配 100 到 200 号。各品牌型号不一，还要看重量和容线量。

items.question: Is it worth spending more on the rod or on the reel when the total budget is fixed?
items.question_zh: 总预算固定时，把钱多花在竿上还是轮上更值得？
items.short: On a tight budget, lean toward the reel.
items.body: A cheap reel with a rough drag or a weak bail is what usually fails first, while a modest rod can still catch fish well. Once the reel is decent, a better rod gives more feel and less weight. The exception is lures that depend on feel, such as jigs and worms, where some of the budget should shift to the rod. Fresh, decent line is cheap and often makes more difference than either.
items.short_zh: 预算紧张时，偏向把钱花在轮上。
items.body_zh: 便宜的轮卸力发涩、线臂不牢，往往最先出问题；而普通的竿照样能钓到鱼。轮够好之后，更好的竿能带来更好的手感和更轻的重量。例外是靠手感的饵，比如铅头钩和软虫，这时要把一部分预算转到竿上。新鲜、质量过得去的线很便宜，效果常常比换竿换轮还明显。

items.question: Which rod features matter most for a high-end low-profile baitcaster?
items.question_zh: 高端低轮廓水滴轮配竿时，竿的哪些特性最重要？
items.short: A rod that is light, well balanced and matched to the lure range you actually fish.
items.body: A low-profile reel is light and sits in the palm, so a light rod of about 7 feet lets it work at its best. A high-end reel won't gain distance from a rod that is too stiff or too soft for the lure. Look for a reel seat that fits your palm, good guides with smooth inserts if you fish braid, and sensitivity if you fish lures on the bottom. Spending far more on the reel than the rod usually wastes the difference.
items.short_zh: 选一根轻、平衡好，并且和你实际用的饵重相配的竿。
items.body_zh: 低轮廓水滴轮很轻，可以握在掌中，配约 7 英尺的轻量竿最能发挥。竿对饵来说太硬或太软，再好的轮也抛不远。轮座要贴合手掌，用编织线时导环内衬要光滑，钓贴底的饵时要有足够的灵敏度。轮比竿贵太多，多花的钱通常发挥不出来。

items.question: What rod suits a large saltwater spinning reel in the 8000 to 10000 size range?
items.question_zh: 8000 到 10000 号的大型海水纺车轮适合配什么竿？
items.short: A heavy rod rated for the line class you will use: about 5½ to 8 feet on a boat, 9 feet and longer from shore.
items.body: Reels this size usually carry 50 to 80 lb braid for tuna, large jacks, tarpon and similar fish, so the rod must be rated for those lines and drag settings. Boat rods for jigging are often under 6½ feet and popping rods 7 to 8 feet, while shore rods run 9 feet and longer. Look for heavy-duty guides, a strong reel seat and a rating that covers your lure weight. Keep the drag below the rod's limit.
items.short_zh: 选能承受你所用线号的硬竿：船钓约 5½ 到 8 英尺，岸钓 9 英尺以上。
items.body_zh: 这种大小的轮通常上 50 到 80 磅编织线，用来钓金枪鱼、大型鲹和大海鲢等鱼，所以竿要能承受这样的线和卸力。船上用的铁板竿常短于 6½ 英尺，水面 popping 竿 7 到 8 英尺，岸钓竿 9 英尺以上。要选重型导环和结实的轮座，标称要覆盖你用的饵重。卸力不要超过竿的上限。

items.question: What actually improves as rod prices go up: sensitivity, weight, durability or something else?
items.question_zh: 竿的价格升高后，真正提升的是什么：灵敏度、重量、耐用性，还是别的？
items.short: Mostly lower weight, better sensitivity and better parts. Durability does not always improve.
items.body: Higher-grade graphite lets a maker use less material for the same power, so the rod is lighter and transmits more. Better guides, reel seats and finish come with it. Thin, high-modulus blanks can be more brittle, though: they bend well but can break if knocked. Warranty service and quality control also tend to improve with price. Returns shrink at the top end, where you are paying for small weight savings and a nicer finish.
items.short_zh: 主要是更轻、更灵敏、配件更好，耐用性不一定提高。
items.body_zh: 高等级碳素让厂家用更少的材料达到同样的硬度，所以竿更轻、传递更好，导环、轮座和做工也随之提升。但高模量的薄竿身可能更脆，弯曲性能很好，磕碰后却容易断。保修服务和品控通常也随价格提高。到了最高端，提升就小了，多花的钱主要买的是一点点减重和更好的做工。

items.question: How can I compare two rods at the same price when their specifications look nearly identical?
items.question_zh: 两根价格相同、参数几乎一样的竿，应该怎么比较？
items.short: Hold both with your reel mounted, then compare warranty, guides and reel seat.
items.body: Specifications hide a lot. In a shop, check the balance, how much the tip keeps vibrating after a shake, and whether the handle fits your hand. Look for smooth guide inserts, guides that line up and neat wraps. Then compare warranty length and whether a broken rod is replaced free or for a fee. If the two still feel the same, buy the one with the better warranty.
items.short_zh: 把轮装上，两根都握一握，再比较保修、导环和轮座。
items.body_zh: 参数说明不了全部。在店里看看平衡，抖一下竿尖看余振多久，手把是否合手。检查导环内衬是否光滑、导环是否对齐、绑线是否整齐。然后比较保修期限，以及竿断了是免费换还是要收费。如果两根手感还是差不多，就买保修更好的那根。

items.question: How much do warranty terms matter when choosing between rod brands?
items.question_zh: 在不同品牌的竿之间选择时，保修条款有多重要？
items.short: They matter most if you break rods through ordinary accidents.
items.body: Most rods are broken in car doors, trunk lids and tailgates, or by being stepped on. So check whether the warranty covers accidents or only manufacturing defects, whether it applies only to the original buyer, whether you need a receipt and what shipping or handling fee applies. A lifetime warranty with a high fee can cost nearly as much as replacing a budget rod.
items.short_zh: 如果你平时容易把竿弄断，保修条款就很重要。
items.body_zh: 大多数竿是被车门、后备箱盖、尾门夹断的，或者是被踩断的。所以要看保修是否包括意外损坏，还是只包括制造缺陷，是否仅限原购买人，需不需要收据，以及运费和手续费多少。终身保修如果手续费很高，修一根便宜竿的花费可能和买新的差不多。

items.question: Are direct-to-consumer rod brands a good value compared with long-established brands?
items.question_zh: 和老牌子相比，线上直销的竿品牌性价比如何？
items.short: Often yes on paper, but judge each brand by its warranty, return policy and independent reviews.
items.body: Selling directly removes the retailer, and some of those savings can reach you. The trade-offs are that you usually can't handle the rod first, warranties vary and a young company may not be around to honor one. Some brands relabel a blank sold elsewhere. Before buying, find out how long the company has existed, whether returns are free and how claims work. Then look for reviews from people who have used the rod for more than a season.
items.short_zh: 账面上常常划算，但要看每个品牌的保修、退货政策和独立评价。
items.body_zh: 直销省去了零售商，部分差价可能让利给你。代价是通常没法先上手试，保修条件不一，年轻的公司也可能撑不到你需要保修的时候。有些品牌只是给别处也在卖的竿身贴牌。购买前看看公司成立多久、退货是否免费、理赔怎么走，再找用了一个季节以上的人写的评价。

items.question: Is a durable fiberglass-composite rod like an Ugly Stik a better first choice than a lighter graphite rod at a similar price?
items.question_zh: 同等价位下，Ugly Stik 这类耐用的玻纤复合竿，作为第一根竿会比更轻的碳素竿更好吗？
items.short: For most first-timers, kids and rough use, yes.
items.body: A glass-composite rod tolerates being dropped, stepped on and bent hard, and it forgives mistakes such as a drag set too tight. It gives up some sensitivity and weighs more. At a similar price, cheap graphite tends to be less durable without being much more sensitive. If your first fishing will be bait under a bobber or simple lures, the composite is the safer buy. If you plan to fish mainly plastics or jigs and handle gear carefully, a budget graphite rod may suit you better.
items.short_zh: 对多数新手、孩子和粗放使用的人来说，是的。
items.body_zh: 玻纤复合竿经得起摔、踩和大幅弯曲，卸力拧得太紧之类的失误也不容易出事。代价是灵敏度差一点，重量大一点。同等价位下，便宜的碳素竿往往不够耐用，灵敏度也强不了多少。如果一开始主要用浮漂钓天然饵或用简单的饵，复合竿更稳妥。如果你主要钓软饵或铅头钩，也爱惜装备，入门碳素竿可能更合适。

items.question: At what point does paying more for a rod stop making a noticeable difference for a weekend angler?
items.question_zh: 对周末钓鱼的人来说，竿的价格到什么程度之后，再多花钱就感觉不出明显差别了？
items.short: Often somewhere around $100 to $200.
items.body: Below that range, quality rises quickly with price through better blanks, guides and reel seats. Above it, gains in weight and sensitivity are real but small, and casual anglers seldom notice them in a few days of fishing a year. The exceptions are techniques where feel matters a lot, such as finesse plastics in deep water, and heavy specialized rods, which cost more to build well. Prices change, so treat this as a rough range and compare rods in your hand.
items.short_zh: 通常在 100 到 200 美元左右。
items.body_zh: 低于这个区间，价格上去，竿身、导环和轮座的质量提升很快。高于这个区间，重量和灵敏度的提升确实有，但幅度小，一年只钓几天的人很少能感觉到。例外是特别依赖手感的钓法，比如深水软饵微物钓，以及做工成本更高的重型专用竿。价格会变，这只是大致范围，最好亲手比较。

items.question: What is realistic to expect from a rod under $50?
items.question_zh: 低于 50 美元的竿，能现实地期待什么水平？
items.short: A working rod that catches fish, with more weight and simpler parts.
items.body: At this price expect fiberglass, composite or low-grade graphite, basic guides and a plain reel seat. The rod will be heavier and less sensitive than better ones, and cheap guide inserts can crack. It is fine for bait fishing, casual lure fishing, kids and spare outfits. Check that the guides line up, the reel seat tightens firmly and nothing rattles. Treat it kindly, because the warranty is often limited.
items.short_zh: 一根能用、能钓到鱼的竿，只是更重，配件也更简单。
items.body_zh: 这个价位通常是玻纤、复合材料或低等级碳素，导环和轮座都比较基础。竿比好一些的更重、更不灵敏，便宜的导环内衬也可能开裂。用来钓天然饵、休闲用拟饵、给孩子用或当备用竿都没问题。买的时候看看导环是否对齐，轮座能否拧紧，有没有松动的声响。用的时候爱惜些，这类竿的保修往往有限。

items.question: What can a rod costing $50 to under $100 do better than a cheaper one?
items.question_zh: 50 美元至不足 100 美元的竿，比更便宜的竿强在哪里？
items.short: It usually weighs less, feels more and has better guides and a better reel seat.
items.body: This is the range where graphite gets good enough to feel bottom contact and light bites, and where you start to choose a specific power and action instead of one general model. Guides and inserts are usually better, which helps with braid. Many come with a limited warranty. For most people fishing a few times a month, a rod in this range does everything needed.
items.short_zh: 通常更轻、手感更好，导环和轮座也更好。
items.body_zh: 到了这个区间，碳素已经能让你感觉到触底和轻微的咬口，也开始能选择具体的硬度和调性，而不是只有一款通用型号。导环和内衬通常更好，用编织线时更放心。很多还带有限保修。对大多数一个月钓几次的人来说，这个价位的竿已经够用了。

items.question: What should a buyer prioritize in the range of $100 to under $200?
items.question_zh: 100 美元至不足 200 美元这个区间，买竿应该优先看什么？
items.short: Prioritize the right length, power and action for your main technique, then weight and warranty.
items.body: There is real variety in this range, so choose by what you actually fish rather than by brand. Check the balance with your reel, the sensitivity and the handle style. Look for guides that suit braid, a comfortable reel seat and a warranty with a clear process. At this level, reliable warranty service is worth more than a small weight saving.
items.short_zh: 优先选适合你主要钓法的长度、硬度和调性，其次才是重量和保修。
items.body_zh: 这个价位选择很多，要按实际的钓法来选，不要只看品牌。装上轮看平衡、灵敏度和手把样式。导环要适合编织线，轮座要舒服，保修流程要清楚。在这个价位，可靠的保修服务比省下一点重量更有价值。

items.question: What justifies spending $200 to under $500 on a rod?
items.question_zh: 什么情况下，值得花 200 美元至不足 500 美元买一根竿？
items.short: Frequent use, and a technique where weight and sensitivity really matter.
items.body: You get lighter blanks, finer tapers, better parts and often an excellent warranty. These show most when you cast all day or fish finesse plastics where you need to feel subtle bites. It is harder to justify for occasional fishing or for bait under a float. High-modulus rods are also more fragile if banged around, so think about how you transport them. Try a shop's rod before spending this much.
items.short_zh: 经常钓鱼，而且钓法真的依赖轻量和灵敏度。
items.body_zh: 多花的钱换来更轻的竿身、更细致的锥度、更好的配件，保修也往往很好。整天抛投，或者钓需要感觉细微咬口的软饵时，差别最明显。如果只是偶尔钓，或者用浮漂钓天然饵，就很难说值得。高模量竿磕碰后也更容易断，要想好怎么运输。花这么多钱之前，先在店里试试。

items.question: How much performance is really lost with a two-piece rod compared with a one-piece rod?
items.question_zh: 和一节式的竿相比，两节竿实际损失多少性能？
items.short: Very little on a modern rod from a good maker.
items.body: A joint adds a small amount of stiffness and weight, which you may detect in a side-by-side test of high-end finesse rods but will rarely notice while fishing. A two-piece rod is also far easier to store and carry. The main risk is a loose joint, which can crack. On cheap rods the joint may be poorly fitted, so check that the sections seat firmly and the guides line up.
items.short_zh: 好厂家的现代竿，损失很小。
items.body_zh: 接口会增加一点硬度和重量，在高端微物竿的对比测试中也许能察觉，实际钓鱼时很少感觉得到。两节竿存放和携带都方便得多。主要风险是接口松动，可能导致开裂。便宜的竿接口做工可能不好，要检查两节能否插紧，导环是否对齐。

items.question: Are telescopic rods strong enough for real fishing, or are they only for emergencies?
items.question_zh: 伸缩竿的强度够正常钓鱼用吗，还是只适合应急？
items.short: Good ones are fine for light to moderate fishing. Cheap ones are mainly for convenience.
items.body: Telescopic rods have many joints, so they are generally less sensitive and often bend unevenly. Strength varies greatly with price. A decent one handles trout, panfish and small bass without trouble. Sand and grit in the sections are the usual problem, so wipe them clean and pull sections straight out rather than forcing them. For larger fish or heavy lures, a multi-piece rod is the better choice. When collapsing one, slide the thick sections in first and the tip last, and never knock the butt on the ground to close it.
items.short_zh: 好的伸缩竿足够应付轻度到中度的钓鱼，便宜的主要图个方便。
items.body_zh: 伸缩竿接口多，一般不够灵敏，弯曲也常常不均匀。强度随价格差别很大。质量不错的，钓鳟鱼、小型淡水鱼和小鲈鱼都没问题。常见的问题是节间进沙，要擦干净，打开时直着拉，不要硬拧。钓较大的鱼或用重饵，多节竿更合适。收竿时先收粗节，竿尖最后收，不要用竿尾撞地来收竿。

items.question: How can I stop the sections of a two-piece rod from loosening while casting?
items.question_zh: 怎样防止两节竿在抛投时接口松动？
items.short: Seat the joint firmly with a slight twist, and check it often.
items.body: Push the sections together with the guides slightly out of line, then rotate them into alignment. A clean joint holds better, so wipe both surfaces, and a little paraffin or candle wax on the male end helps. Check the joint during the day, because a loose one can crack the blank when you cast. Pull the sections straight apart after fishing, since a joint left together for weeks can stick.
items.short_zh: 插紧时带一点旋转，并且经常检查。
items.body_zh: 先让导环略微错开，把两节插到位，再旋转对齐。接口干净才牢固，两个面都要擦干净，公头上抹一点石蜡或蜡烛蜡也有帮助。钓鱼过程中要检查接口，松动的接口可能在抛投时把竿身撑裂。钓完直着拔开，接口连着放几周可能会卡住。

items.question: What should I look for in a compact rod that fits in a backpack for hiking to remote water?
items.question_zh: 徒步去偏远水域时，能放进背包的短节竿要看哪些方面？
items.short: Four or more pieces, a packed length that fits your bag, and a hard tube.
items.body: Aim for a packed length under about 24 inches for most daypacks. Four-piece and five-piece rods usually bend better than telescopic ones. A light or ultralight rating with a small 1000 to 2000 reel covers trout and panfish. Carry the rod in a hard tube, because a snapped tip miles from the car ends the trip. Keep the rest small: one box of spinners, spoons and hooks, and spare line. Read the regulations for that water before you hike in.
items.short_zh: 选四节或更多节、收纳长度放得进背包的竿，再配一个硬管。
items.body_zh: 多数日用背包，收纳长度最好在 24 英寸以内。四节和五节竿的弯曲通常比伸缩竿好。轻或超轻硬度配 1000 到 2000 号小轮，就能应付鳟鱼和小型淡水鱼。竿要放进硬管里，离车几英里时断了竿尖，这趟就白走了。其他东西也要精简：一盒亮片和钩，再加备用线。徒步进去之前，先查好那片水域的规定。

items.question: Which travel rod setup works for flying with fishing gear in carry-on luggage?
items.question_zh: 乘飞机把渔具放进随身行李时，什么样的旅行竿组合比较合适？
items.short: A multi-piece rod in a hard case is the usual approach, but the airline has the final say on size.
items.body: In the US, TSA allows fishing poles in both carry-on and checked bags, and tells travelers to check that the rod fits the airline's carry-on limits. Small tackle such as flies can go in a carry-on, while large or sharp hooks belong in checked bags, sheathed and securely wrapped. A four-piece rod that packs under about 24 inches is the easiest to carry on. Keep expensive reels with you and put pliers and knives in checked bags. Officers at the checkpoint make the final decision.
items.short_zh: 常见做法是多节竿放硬管，但尺寸最终由航空公司决定。
items.body_zh: 在美国，TSA 允许钓竿放在随身行李和托运行李里，并提醒旅客确认钓竿符合航空公司的随身行李尺寸。毛钩这样的小型钓具可以随身带，大钩或锋利的钩要包好套好放进托运行李。收纳长度在 24 英寸左右以内的四节竿最方便随身带。贵重的轮随身带，钳子和刀放托运。安检现场的工作人员有最终决定权。

items.question: Which travel rod is suitable for light saltwater fishing from shore?
items.question_zh: 岸上轻型海钓适合什么旅行竿？
items.short: A multi-piece spinning rod of about 7 to 9 feet, rated for 10 to 20 lb line.
items.body: Four-piece rods in this range pack small and cast lures of ½ to 1 ounce far enough for shore fishing. Choose corrosion-resistant guides and a saltwater-rated reel of about 3000 to 5000. Braid with a fluorocarbon leader gives distance and abrasion resistance. Rinse everything gently with fresh water afterward and clean the joints, since salt and sand can seize them.
items.short_zh: 选 7 到 9 英尺的多节直柄竿，标称 10 到 20 磅线。
items.body_zh: 这个长度的四节竿收纳小，抛 ½ 到 1 盎司的饵，岸钓距离够用。导环要耐腐蚀，轮选厂家标明可用于海水的 3000 到 5000 号。编织线加碳线前导，既能抛远又耐磨。钓完用淡水轻轻冲洗，接口也要清理，盐和沙会把接口卡死。

items.question: Can a multi-piece rod handle heavier lures when fishing from a boat?
items.question_zh: 在船上钓鱼时，多节竿能承受较重的饵吗？
items.short: Yes, if it is rated for them.
items.body: A well-made multi-piece rod has joints strong enough for its rating, and the number of pieces matters less than the build. Follow the printed lure weight. Heavy jigging and big-game fishing do put large loads on the joints, so one-piece or two-piece rods are the safer choice there. Check the joints often during the day, because a joint working loose under load is the most likely point of failure.
items.short_zh: 可以，只要标称范围包括这些饵。
items.body_zh: 做工好的多节竿，接口强度足以匹配标称，节数不如做工重要。按竿上印的饵重使用。重型铁板和大物钓对接口的负荷很大，这时一节或两节竿更稳妥。钓鱼时要经常检查接口，受力时松动的接口是最容易出问题的地方。

items.question: When is a technique-specific rod worth buying instead of using one all-around rod?
items.question_zh: 什么情况下值得买专用竿，而不是只用一根通用竿？
items.short: When you fish that technique often and your general rod is holding you back.
items.body: The signs are that you can't cast the lure well, you keep losing fish because of the wrong bend, or you can't feel the bottom. Dedicated rods help most with crankbaits, frogs in heavy cover, drop shots and large swimbaits. If you use a technique only a few times a year, a general medium or medium-heavy rod will do. Buy the second rod to cover a range the first doesn't, rather than a slightly different version of the same thing.
items.short_zh: 经常用这种钓法，而且通用竿已经限制了你的时候。
items.body_zh: 迹象包括饵抛不好、弯曲不合适老是跑鱼，或者感觉不到水底。专用竿最有用的是 crankbait、重障碍区的青蛙饵、倒吊钓组和大型 swimbait。一年只用几次的钓法，一根通用的中等或中硬竿就够了。第二根竿要覆盖第一根做不到的范围，不要买一根差不多的。

items.question: What makes an ultralight rod enjoyable for panfish, and what is its practical limit on fish size?
items.question_zh: 超轻竿钓小型淡水鱼的乐趣在哪里？它能应对的鱼体大小实际上限是多少？
items.short: It lets small fish bend the rod and casts tiny lures. A few pounds is a practical limit.
items.body: An ultralight rod suits lures of about 1/32 to 1/8 ounce and 2 to 6 lb line, so a half-pound bluegill puts up a real fight. With a smooth drag and open water, a skilled angler can land much larger fish, but a long fight exhausts them, which is hard on a fish you plan to release. Treat a few pounds as the practical upper limit, and go heavier around cover or in warm water, when a fish needs to come in quickly.
items.short_zh: 小鱼也能把竿压弯，还能抛很小的饵。实用的上限大约是几磅。
items.body_zh: 超轻竿适合 1/32 到 1/8 盎司的饵和 2 到 6 磅的线，半磅重的蓝鳃太阳鱼也能拉出真正的搏斗感。卸力顺滑、水域开阔时，熟练的人能拉上大得多的鱼，但搏斗时间太长会把鱼累坏，对要放流的鱼不好。把几磅当作实用上限，在障碍区或水温高时要用更重的装备，让鱼尽快上来。

items.question: How should a rod for bait finesse fishing differ from a standard light casting rod?
items.question_zh: BFS 微物钓法用的竿，和普通轻型枪柄竿应该有什么不同？
items.short: It is softer in the tip and built to cast very light lures, often 1/8 ounce or less.
items.body: A bait finesse rod is usually 6 to 7 feet with a soft, quick-recovering tip that loads under very little weight, and small guides that reduce friction. A standard light casting rod has a stiffer tip and needs more lure weight to load. The rod is generally paired with a shallow, low-inertia spool, because a standard spool won't start with such light lures. Expect to use 6 to 10 lb line.
items.short_zh: 竿尖更软，专门用来抛很轻的饵，通常是 1/8 盎司或更轻。
items.body_zh: BFS 竿通常 6 到 7 英尺，竿尖柔软、回弹快，很小的重量就能带动，小导环还能减少摩擦。普通轻型枪柄竿的竿尖更硬，需要更重的饵才能带动。它一般要配浅线杯、低惯量的轮，因为普通线杯带不动这么轻的饵。常用 6 到 10 磅线。

items.question: What should a rod for heavy musky lures be able to handle?
items.question_zh: 钓马斯基的大型饵用竿，需要能承受什么？
items.short: The full weight of the lure, repeated all day, plus the strain of a big fish.
items.body: Musky lures commonly run from 2 ounces to well over 8 ounces, and big rubber baits pull hard when retrieved. Choose a heavy or extra-heavy rod, often 8 to 9 feet, rated for your lure weight, with a long handle for two-handed casting. A longer rod also helps with figure-eights at the boat. Use strong braid and a bite-proof leader, and carry long pliers, strong hook cutters and a big net, which protects both the fish and you.
items.short_zh: 要能承受饵的全部重量，整天反复抛，还要能对付大鱼的拉力。
items.body_zh: 钓马斯基的饵常见 2 盎司到远超 8 盎司，大型软胶饵收线时拉力很大。选硬或超硬的竿，长度常在 8 到 9 英尺，标称要覆盖饵重，后把要长，便于双手抛投。长竿也方便在船边画“8”字诱鱼。用高强度编织线和防咬前导，带上长柄钳、结实的断钩钳和大抄网，这对鱼和人都更安全。

items.question: What rod characteristics matter for vertical jigging from a boat?
items.question_zh: 在船上做垂直铁板钓，竿的哪些特性重要？
items.short: Light rod weight, a strong backbone and an action matched to the jig.
items.body: You work the rod all day, so short rods of about 5½ to 6½ feet are easiest. The backbone has to lift a heavy jig and a fish from deep water, and the rating should cover the jig weights you plan to use. Slow-pitch rods are softer and use the bend to make the jig flutter, while speed-jigging rods are stiffer. Braid has less stretch and less drag in deep water, so use it with a fluorocarbon leader.
items.short_zh: 竿要轻，腰力要强，调性要和铁板相配。
items.body_zh: 一整天都要抖竿，所以 5½ 到 6½ 英尺的短竿最省力。竿腰要能把重铁板和鱼从深水拉上来，标称要覆盖你用的铁板重量。慢摇铁板竿较软，靠弯曲让铁板飘动；快抽铁板竿较硬。编织线延展小，在深水中阻力也小，再配一段碳线前导。

items.question: Is a drop-shot rod meaningfully different from a regular medium-light spinning rod?
items.question_zh: 倒吊钓组专用竿和普通中轻硬度直柄竿有实质区别吗？
items.short: A little, mainly in a softer, more sensitive tip and a length of about 7 feet.
items.body: The tip has to show small movements and let you shake the bait without moving the weight. A longer rod keeps more line off the water and absorbs head shakes on light line. A regular medium-light fast rod does the job well enough for most people, so buy a dedicated rod only if you use the drop shot regularly.
items.short_zh: 有一点区别，主要是竿尖更软更灵敏，长度约 7 英尺。
items.body_zh: 竿尖要能反映细小的动静，还要能抖动饵而不带动铅坠。竿长一些，更多的线离开水面，用细线时也能吸收鱼的甩头。多数人用普通的中轻硬度快调竿就够了，只有经常用倒吊钓组时，才值得买专用竿。

items.question: How do the size numbers on spinning reels relate to line capacity and fish size?
items.question_zh: 纺车轮上的型号数字和容线量、适用的鱼体大小有什么关系？
items.short: The number is a rough size class: bigger means a larger spool, more line and a stronger body and drag.
items.body: As a rough guide, 1000 to 2000 suits panfish and trout on light line, 2500 to 3000 suits bass, walleye and general freshwater, and 4000 and up moves into inshore saltwater and larger fish. The number doesn't state capacity or strength, and it isn't a shared standard: a 3000 from one maker can be closer to a 2500 from another, and some brands use two-digit sizes such as 30. Compare the line capacity, spool diameter and maximum drag on the spec sheet. Fish size matters less than the line you plan to use and how much of it a fish can pull off.
items.short_zh: 这个数字大致代表尺寸级别：数字越大，线杯越大、容线越多，机身和卸力也更强。
items.body_zh: 大致来说，1000 到 2000 号适合用细线钓小型淡水鱼和鳟鱼，2500 到 3000 号适合鲈鱼、大眼梭鲈和一般淡水钓，4000 号及以上就进入近岸海钓和更大的鱼了。数字本身并不等于容线量或强度，也不是通用标准：这家的 3000 可能只相当于那家的 2500，有些品牌还用 30 这样的两位数。选轮时要比较规格表里的容线量、线杯直径和最大卸力。比起鱼有多大，更要看你打算用什么线，以及鱼可能拉走多少线。

items.question: Are size numbers comparable between brands, or does a 3000 from one brand differ from a 3000 from another?
items.question_zh: 不同品牌的型号数字可以直接比较吗？一个品牌的 3000 和另一个品牌的 3000 会不一样吗？
items.short: Only roughly. The same number can mean different sizes across brands.
items.body: Some makers use 1000 to 5000, others use 10 to 50 or labels such as C3000, and even one brand's older and newer series can differ. The number reflects spool size within that company's range, not a shared measurement. Compare the listed line capacity, spool diameter, weight and maximum drag, and if you can, set the reels side by side in a shop.
items.short_zh: 只能粗略比较。同样的数字，在不同品牌可能代表不同大小。
items.body_zh: 有的厂家用 1000 到 5000，有的用 10 到 50，或者 C3000 这样的标记，同一品牌的新旧系列也可能不同。这个数字只反映该公司产品线内部的线杯大小，并不是通用的度量。要比较标注的容线量、线杯直径、重量和最大卸力，有条件的话，在店里把轮放在一起比一比。

items.question: What spinning reel size is the best all-around choice for freshwater?
items.question_zh: 淡水综合使用，纺车轮选多大最合适？
items.body: That size holds enough 6 to 10 lb mono or light braid for most lake and pond fish. It balances a medium-light or medium rod of about 6 to 7 feet and has enough drag for bass, walleye and trout. Go down to a 1000 or 2000 for panfish and trout on very light line. Go up to a 4000 if you target pike or fish in heavy current.
items.body_zh: 这个大小能容下足够的 6 到 10 磅尼龙线或细编织线，应付多数湖泊和池塘的鱼；能平衡 6 到 7 英尺的中轻或中等硬度竿；卸力也够钓鲈鱼、大眼梭鲈和鳟鱼。用很细的线钓小型淡水鱼和鳟鱼，可以降到 1000 或 2000 号。钓白斑狗鱼或在急流中钓，可以升到 4000 号。

items.question: When should I choose a shallow spool over a standard spool?
items.question_zh: 什么时候应该选浅线杯，而不是标准线杯？
items.short: Choose a shallow spool when you fish thin braid and don't need much line.
items.body: A shallow spool holds less line and needs little or no backing, which saves money and weight, and it suits light braid in finesse fishing. A standard spool is better for thicker mono and whenever a fish could run a long way. If you buy a shallow spool for thin braid, make sure there is still enough line for the water you fish.
items.short_zh: 用细编织线、又不需要太多线时，选浅线杯。
items.body_zh: 浅线杯容线少，几乎不需要底线，省钱也减重，适合细编织线的微物钓法。线较粗的尼龙线，或者鱼可能跑出很远时，标准线杯更合适。如果为细编织线买浅线杯，要确认容线量对你钓的水域仍然够用。

items.question: Does the number of ball bearings say anything reliable about reel quality?
items.question_zh: 轴承数量能可靠地说明轮的质量吗？
items.short: Not by itself.
items.body: A reel with ten cheap bearings can feel worse than one with five good ones placed well. What counts is bearing quality and placement, along with the gears, frame stiffness and drag. Stainless or shielded bearings matter more in salt water. Treat the number as marketing. Turn the handle under load if you can, and read independent reviews on how the reel holds up over time.
items.short_zh: 单看数量不能说明问题。
items.body_zh: 十个便宜轴承的轮，手感可能还不如五个好轴承、位置又合理的轮。关键在于轴承的质量和位置，以及齿轮、机身刚性和卸力。不锈钢或带防护的轴承在海水中更重要。轴承数量基本是营销用语。有条件的话，在线受力时转转手把，再看看独立评价，了解这只轮用久了怎么样。

items.question: What features separate a mid-range spinning reel from an entry-level one?
items.question_zh: 中端纺车轮和入门款的差别体现在哪些方面？
items.short: A stiffer body, smoother gears and a more consistent drag.
items.body: Mid-range reels tend to use better materials for the frame and rotor, so the gears stay aligned under load and the reel stays smooth longer. The drag starts and runs more evenly, which protects light line. Better line lay reduces tangles and helps casting. Parts and service are usually easier to get as well. Saltwater sealing varies, so check the listing.
items.short_zh: 机身更硬，齿轮更顺，卸力更稳定。
items.body_zh: 中端轮的机身和转子用料通常更好，受力时齿轮能保持对正，顺滑度也维持得更久。卸力启动和出线更均匀，对细线有保护作用。排线更好，缠绕更少，也有助于抛投。配件和维修通常也更容易解决。海水密封性各款不同，要看具体说明。

items.question: What size suits trout and panfish on light line?
items.question_zh: 用细线钓鳟鱼和小型淡水鱼，适合多大的轮？
items.short: A 1000 or 2000 for line from 2 to 6 lb.
items.body: These reels are light, they balance an ultralight or light rod of 5 to 6½ feet, and their small spools suit small lures. The drag should be smooth at low settings. For stocked trout on 4 to 8 lb line, a 2000 or 2500 is fine as well.
items.short_zh: 用 2 到 6 磅线时，选 1000 或 2000 号。
items.body_zh: 这类轮很轻，能平衡 5 到 6½ 英尺的超轻或轻竿，小线杯也适合小饵。卸力在低设定下要顺滑。用 4 到 8 磅线钓放流鳟时，2000 或 2500 号也可以。

items.question: What size suits bass and walleye with 8 to 15 lb braid?
items.question_zh: 用 8 到 15 磅编织线钓鲈鱼和大眼梭鲈，适合多大的轮？
items.short: A 2500 or 3000, and a 4000 if you want extra line or drag.
items.body: Braid of 8 to 15 lb is thin, so a 2500 holds plenty, especially with a mono backing. A 2500 or 3000 also balances a medium spinning rod of 6½ to 7 feet. A shallow spool saves on backing. FishEye's walleye guide adds a length of clear monofilament as a leader when you fish braid.
items.short_zh: 2500 或 3000 号，想要更多容线或卸力就选 4000 号。
items.body_zh: 8 到 15 磅编织线很细，2500 号就能容下足够的线，加尼龙底线更是如此。2500 或 3000 号也能平衡 6½ 到 7 英尺的中等硬度直柄竿。浅线杯可以省下底线。FishEye 的大眼梭鲈指南建议，用编织线时接一段透明尼龙线作前导。

items.question: What size suits inshore saltwater species from shore?
items.question_zh: 在岸上钓近岸海水鱼，适合多大的轮？
items.short: Usually a 3000 to 5000.
items.body: A 3000 or 4000 with 10 to 20 lb braid covers redfish, speckled trout, flounder and similar fish. Move to a 5000 or larger where you need more distance or expect bigger fish such as large snook or bluefish. Choose a reel the maker says suits salt water, and rinse it after each trip.
items.body_zh: 3000 或 4000 号配 10 到 20 磅编织线，可以钓红拟石首鱼、斑点海鳟、比目鱼和类似的鱼。需要抛得更远，或者可能遇到大型锯盖鱼、蓝鱼（bluefish）这类大鱼时，换 5000 号或更大。选厂家标明可用于海水的轮，每次钓完都要冲洗。

items.question: How do magnetic and centrifugal brake systems feel different for someone learning to cast?
items.question_zh: 对正在学抛投的人来说，磁力刹车和离心刹车的感觉有什么不同？
items.short: Magnetic brakes feel steadier and are easy to adjust. Centrifugal brakes feel freer once the spool is up to speed.
items.body: Magnets brake through the whole cast and are controlled from an outside dial, so a beginner can simply dial up more. Centrifugal brakes use small weights that press outward when the spool spins fast, so they brake hardest at the start of a cast and fade quickly. They allow long casts but often require opening the side plate to change settings. Both still need a thumb to stop the spool at the end. A magnetic reel set high is usually the easier start.
items.short_zh: 磁力刹车感觉更稳定，也好调。离心刹车在线杯转起来之后感觉更自由。
items.body_zh: 磁力刹车在整个抛投过程中都起作用，用外部旋钮调节，新手只要把它调高就行。离心刹车靠小滑块在线杯高速旋转时向外压，所以抛投开始时制动最强，随后迅速减弱。它能抛得很远，但改设置常常要打开侧盖。两种刹车最后都要靠拇指停住线杯。刚开始学，磁力轮调到高档通常更容易。

items.question: What should a first baitcaster have so it is forgiving to learn on?
items.question_zh: 第一只水滴轮需要具备什么，学起来才比较不容易出错？
items.short: A simple, easy-to-reach brake, a medium spool and a moderate gear ratio.
items.body: Choose a low-profile reel from a known brand with an external brake dial and a clear spool tension knob. A ratio of about 6:1 to 7:1 suits most lures. Use 12 to 15 lb mono, which is thick enough to lift out of a tangle, and lures of about 3/8 to 1/2 ounce, which load the rod well. Set the brake high at first and lower it as your thumb learns. Avoid very light spools designed for experienced casters.
items.short_zh: 刹车简单好调，线杯中等，速比适中。
items.body_zh: 选知名品牌的低轮廓轮，带外部刹车旋钮和清晰的线杯张力旋钮。速比 6:1 到 7:1 左右，能应付多数饵。用 12 到 15 磅尼龙线，线够粗，缠住时好挑开；用 3/8 到 1/2 盎司的饵，容易带动竿。刹车先调高，等拇指熟练了再调低。不要选给熟手用的超轻线杯。

items.question: Can one baitcaster cover both heavy cover and lighter lures, or do those need separate reels?
items.question_zh: 一只水滴轮能同时应付重障碍区和较轻的饵吗，还是需要分开用两只？
items.short: One reel can cover a wide range, but not both extremes well.
items.body: A standard reel handles lures from about 1/4 to 1 ounce. Heavy cover calls for strong gears, a strong drag and thick line, and that thick line makes a light lure hard to cast. Choose by the weight you use most, and rely on a spinning rod for lighter lures. If you often fish both extremes, two outfits work better: one with heavy braid and one with lighter line.
items.short_zh: 一只轮能覆盖较宽的范围，但两头都顾不好。
items.body_zh: 普通水滴轮能用大约 1/4 到 1 盎司的饵。重障碍区需要强齿轮、强卸力和粗线，而粗线又让轻饵很难抛。按你最常用的饵重来选，更轻的饵交给直柄竿。如果两头都常用，准备两套更好：一套上粗编织线，一套上细一些的线。

items.question: What is the lightest lure a standard baitcaster can cast well, and when is a finesse model needed?
items.question_zh: 普通水滴轮能顺利抛投的最轻饵大约多重？什么时候才需要微物专用款？
items.short: About 1/4 ounce for most people. Go to a finesse model below that.
items.body: A standard spool is heavy enough that a light lure can't start it turning easily, so casts come up short and backlashes are more likely. A skilled caster can go a little below 1/4 ounce with the right rod and thin line. Bait finesse reels have shallow, light spools that start easily with lures of about 1/16 to 1/4 ounce. If you fish that range often, a finesse reel or a spinning rod is the practical choice.
items.short_zh: 多数人大约能用到 1/4 盎司，再轻就要用微物专用款。
items.body_zh: 普通线杯较重，轻饵不容易带动，抛不远，也更容易炸线。技术好的人配合适的竿和细线，可以用到略低于 1/4 盎司。BFS 轮的线杯浅而轻，1/16 到 1/4 盎司的饵也能轻松带动。如果经常用这个重量范围，选 BFS 轮或直柄竿更实际。

items.question: Is a digitally controlled braking system worth the extra cost?
items.question_zh: 电子控制的刹车系统值得多花这笔钱吗？
items.short: It can make casting more consistent, but most anglers don't need it.
items.body: Digital brakes use electronics to control spool speed during the cast, which helps with long casts and reduces overruns, especially for people who throw the same lures all day. They cost much more than similar reels with standard brakes, and you still need to learn thumb control. On a limited budget, a good magnetic or centrifugal reel plus practice gets you most of the way.
items.short_zh: 它能让抛投更稳定，但多数人并不需要。
items.body_zh: 电子刹车通过电路控制抛投时的线杯转速，有助于抛远、减少炸线，整天抛同样的饵时尤其明显。它比同级普通刹车的轮贵很多，拇指控制也还是要学。预算有限时，一只好的磁力或离心轮加上练习，已经能达到大部分效果。

items.question: Which reel weights feel noticeably different over a day of casting?
items.question_zh: 轮的重量差到多少，抛一整天时会有明显的感觉？
items.short: Differences of about an ounce are usually noticeable over a full day.
items.body: Most people won't notice a quarter-ounce change in the first few casts, but over hundreds of casts an ounce shows up in the wrist. Balance matters as much as weight: a slightly heavier reel on a long rod may feel better than a very light one that leaves the rod tip-heavy. Try the reel on your rod before buying.
items.short_zh: 差一盎司左右，抛一整天通常能感觉出来。
items.body_zh: 前几次抛投，多数人感觉不到四分之一盎司的差别，但抛几百次之后，一盎司的差别手腕就能感觉到了。平衡和重量一样重要：长竿配稍重的轮，可能比配很轻的轮更舒服，因为轮太轻竿尖就显得重。买之前把轮装到你的竿上试试。

items.question: What are realistic expectations for a baitcaster under $50?
items.question_zh: 低于 50 美元的水滴轮，能现实地期待什么水平？
items.short: It can catch fish, but expect a rougher feel and a shorter life.
items.body: These reels often have plastic frames or side plates, simple brakes and a drag that can be jerky under load. They can do for learning and for catfish and other bait fishing, where casting isn't demanding. Don't expect smooth, long casts with light lures. Make sure the brake is easy to adjust and put on fresh line. If you are serious about learning, saving for a better reel can spare you some frustration.
items.short_zh: 能钓到鱼，但手感较粗糙，寿命也短。
items.body_zh: 这类轮常用塑料机身或侧盖，刹车简单，受力时卸力可能一顿一顿。用来学习、钓鲶鱼或其他天然饵钓法还可以，这些场合对抛投要求不高。不要指望它能顺畅地把轻饵抛远。买的时候确认刹车好调，再换上新线。如果真想学好，多攒点钱买好一些的轮，能少受不少气。

items.question: Which features are worth prioritizing in a baitcaster costing $100 to under $200?
items.question_zh: 100 美元至不足 200 美元的水滴轮，哪些功能值得优先考虑？
items.short: A smooth, strong drag, a stiff frame and an effective brake.
items.body: At this price look for a rigid metal frame that keeps the gears in line, a brake you can adjust without tools and a spool that starts easily. A good drag is more useful than a high drag number. Choose a gear ratio that suits the lures you use most, and check that replacement parts and service are available. Weight and finish are secondary at this level.
items.short_zh: 卸力顺滑有力，机身刚性好，刹车有效。
items.body_zh: 这个价位要选金属机身，能保持齿轮对正；刹车不用工具就能调；线杯启动轻松。卸力好比最大卸力数字高更有用。速比按你最常用的饵来选，并确认有配件和维修渠道。在这个价位，重量和外观是次要的。

items.question: What do you gain from a baitcaster costing $200 to under $500?
items.question_zh: 花 200 美元至不足 500 美元买水滴轮，能多得到什么？
items.short: Lighter weight, smoother running and longer casts with less effort.
items.body: Better materials, tighter tolerances and better bearings make the reel feel solid and stay smooth longer. You often get more refined brakes and a spool designed for a specific lure range. The gain in fish caught is small. Spend here if you cast all day, and look for a spool and brake system suited to your main lures rather than assuming the most expensive reel suits everything.
items.short_zh: 更轻、更顺，用更少的力抛得更远。
items.body_zh: 更好的材料、更高的精度和更好的轴承，让轮的手感扎实，顺滑度也保持得更久。刹车往往更精细，线杯也针对特定饵重设计。多钓到的鱼其实不多。如果你整天抛投，这笔钱才花得值，并且要选适合你主要用饵的线杯和刹车，不要以为最贵的什么都适合。

items.question: When is a baitcaster truly better than a spinning reel, and when is that just preference?
items.question_zh: 什么情况下水滴轮确实比纺车轮好，什么情况下只是个人偏好？
items.short: It is better with heavy lures and heavy line, and when accuracy and cranking power matter.
items.body: A baitcaster handles heavy line and lures well, lets you stop a cast with your thumb for accuracy, and pulls better on big crankbaits or fish in cover. A spinning reel is better for light lures and light line, and for casting into wind. In the middle, about 1/4 to 1/2 ounce, the choice is mostly preference.
items.short_zh: 用重饵、粗线，以及看重精准度和收线力量时，水滴轮确实更好。
items.body_zh: 水滴轮能很好地应付粗线和重饵，可以用拇指控制落点，拉大型 crankbait 或从障碍物里拉鱼也更有力。纺车轮更适合轻饵、细线和逆风抛投。在 1/4 到 1/2 盎司这个中间范围，基本就是个人偏好了。

items.question: Is there still a good reason to choose a spincast reel?
items.question_zh: 现在还有充分的理由选择卡式轮吗？
items.short: Yes, for children, first-timers and simple bait fishing.
items.body: A spincast reel is the simplest to cast: press the button, swing and let go. The closed cover keeps tangles to a minimum, which means less time spent fixing problems. It holds less line and has a weaker drag, so it isn't the best choice for larger fish or long casts. Its sealed housing is a drawback in salt water, because cleaning the inside means taking the reel apart. It is still a sensible way to get a child or first-timer fishing.
items.short_zh: 有，适合孩子、第一次钓鱼的人和简单的天然饵钓法。
items.body_zh: 卡式轮抛投最简单：按住按钮，挥竿，松开。封闭的外壳把缠线减到最少，也就少花时间处理问题。它容线少、卸力弱，不太适合大鱼或远投。封闭的外壳也不适合海钓，因为要清洁内部就得把轮拆开。对孩子和刚入门的人来说，它仍然是很合理的选择。

items.question: When comparing two reels at similar prices, which differences matter in daily use?
items.question_zh: 比较两只价格相近的轮时，哪些差异在日常使用中才真正重要？
items.short: How smooth the drag is, how well line lies on the spool and how the reel feels under load.
items.body: In a shop, turn the handle slowly to check for roughness, pull line against the drag to see whether it starts smoothly, and check that the bail closes cleanly. On spinning reels, look at how evenly the line is wound. On baitcasters, check that the brake and tension controls are easy to reach. Weight, gear ratio and parts availability come next. Bearing counts and top-speed figures usually matter less.
items.short_zh: 卸力是否顺滑、排线好不好，以及受力时的手感。
items.body_zh: 在店里慢慢转手把，感觉有没有发涩；拉线试卸力，看启动是否平顺；看线臂能否干脆地翻回。纺车轮要看线绕得是否均匀，水滴轮要看刹车和张力旋钮是否好够到。然后才是重量、速比和配件供应。轴承数量和最高速度这类数字通常没那么重要。

items.question: How much does a newer model year improve on the previous generation of the same reel?
items.question_zh: 同一系列的新款，比上一代实际改进多少？
items.short: Often only a little.
items.body: Yearly updates are usually small: a new color, a slight weight saving or a revised drag. Every several years a series may get a real redesign with new gearing or a stiffer body. You can often get good value by buying last year's model on sale. Check whether anything you care about actually changed, and be wary of marketing terms that don't state a measurable difference.
items.short_zh: 通常只有一点点。
items.body_zh: 每年的更新一般很小：换个颜色、减点重量或调整卸力。每隔几年，某个系列才可能有真正的改款，比如新齿轮或更硬的机身。买打折的上一代，常常更划算。看看你在意的地方是否真的有变化，对说不出可测量差异的营销用语要留个心眼。

items.question: Are Japanese-market reels worth importing instead of buying the domestic version?
items.question_zh: 日本内销版的轮值得专门进口，而不是买本地版本吗？
items.short: Only if the specific model, spool or gear ratio isn't sold at home.
items.body: Japanese domestic models sometimes have lighter spools, different sizes or finishes that suit finesse fishing. Import fees, shipping and limited warranty can erase the savings, though, and the local warranty usually won't cover a reel bought abroad. Parts may also have to come from Japan. Confirm the handle side, model code and total landed cost before buying.
items.short_zh: 只有当地买不到你要的型号、线杯或速比时才值得。
items.body_zh: 日本内销款有时线杯更轻，或者有更适合微物钓的尺寸和做工。但进口费、运费和有限的保修可能把省下的钱都抵消，本地保修通常也不管海外购买的轮。配件可能也要从日本买。下单前确认手把方向、型号代码和到手总价。

items.question: Is using only spinning gear a real limitation for bass fishing?
items.question_zh: 钓鲈鱼只用纺车轮，会构成实际的限制吗？
items.short: Not for catching bass, only in some situations.
items.body: Spinning gear handles most techniques, especially light plastics, drop shots and small crankbaits. It becomes limiting with very heavy lures, thick braid in heavy cover, and when you flip or pitch into tight spots, where a baitcaster is easier to control. Plenty of bass can be caught without ever owning a baitcaster, and a 7-foot medium or medium-heavy spinning rod covers a lot.
items.short_zh: 对钓到鲈鱼来说不算限制，只在部分场合有影响。
items.body_zh: 纺车轮能应付大多数钓法，尤其是轻软饵、倒吊钓组和小型 crankbait。用很重的饵、在重障碍区用粗编织线，或者要精准投进狭窄位置时，它就有局限，这时水滴轮更好控制。不用水滴轮照样能钓到很多鲈鱼，一根 7 英尺的中等或中硬直柄竿能覆盖很大范围。

items.question: What does gear ratio actually change while fishing?
items.question_zh: 速比在实际钓鱼时到底改变了什么？
items.short: It changes two things: how fast line comes in and how hard each turn of the handle feels.
items.body: Gear ratio is how many times the spool (or a spinning reel's rotor) turns for one turn of the handle, so 7.1:1 means 7.1 turns. A low ratio, about 5:1 to 6:1, brings line in slowly but with more leverage, so deep-diving crankbaits are easier to pull. A high ratio, about 7:1 and up, picks up slack quickly, which helps when a fish takes a jig and swims toward you. The ratio doesn't change drag strength or how much load the line can take. Line picked up per turn also depends on spool size, so two reels with the same ratio can differ. If inches per turn is listed, compare that.
items.short_zh: 它改变两件事：收线有多快，以及每摇一圈有多费力。
items.body_zh: 速比是手把转一圈时，线杯（纺车轮则是转子）转多少圈，7.1:1 就是转 7.1 圈。低速比大约是 5:1 到 6:1，收线慢但省力，拉深潜 crankbait 更轻松。高速比大约是 7:1 以上，收松线快，鱼咬了铅头钩朝你游过来时很有用。速比不会改变卸力，也不会改变线能承受多大的负荷。每圈收线长度还取决于线杯大小，所以速比相同的两只轮也可能不同。如果标了每圈收线长度（inches per turn），直接比较这个。

items.question: Which gear ratio is the most versatile if I can only own one reel?
items.question_zh: 如果只能有一只轮，哪个速比最通用？
items.short: About 6:1 to 7:1.
items.body: A ratio in that range is quick enough for jigs and worms and not so high that crankbaits get tiring. You can always reel a little faster or slower to adjust the lure's speed. Spinning reels run a little lower, so look for about 5:1 to 6:1 there.
items.body_zh: 这个范围的速比，用铅头钩和软虫时够快，用 crankbait 也不会太累。收线快一点或慢一点，就能调整饵的速度。纺车轮的速比略低，选 5:1 到 6:1 左右即可。

items.question: Why do line-retrieve figures matter more than gear ratio alone?
items.question_zh: 为什么每圈收线长度比单看速比更有参考价值？
items.short: Because they tell you how much line actually comes in on each turn.
items.body: Retrieve depends on both the ratio and the spool diameter. A larger spool at 6:1 can pick up as much line as a small spool at 7:1. Makers list this as inches per turn, which makes comparison easy. The figure also shrinks as the spool empties, so a reel low on line retrieves less than its listing.
items.short_zh: 因为它直接告诉你每摇一圈收回多少线。
items.body_zh: 收线量取决于速比和线杯直径。大线杯 6:1 的收线量，可能和小线杯 7:1 一样多。厂家会标出每圈收线长度（inches per turn），比较起来很方便。线杯上的线变少时，这个数字也会减小，所以线不足的轮收线量比标称少。

items.question: Should a right-handed angler reel with the left hand or the right hand?
items.question_zh: 惯用右手的人应该用左手摇轮，还是右手摇轮？
items.short: Most right-handers reel with the left on spinning gear, so the stronger hand holds the rod.
items.body: That keeps the strong hand on the rod for casting, hook sets and working the lure, with no need to switch hands after the cast. Baitcasters have long been popular with right-hand retrieve, and left-retrieve models are now widely available too. Try each and go with what feels natural. Being comfortable matters much more than following a rule.
items.short_zh: 用纺车轮时，多数惯用右手的人用左手摇轮，让力气大的手握竿。
items.body_zh: 这样力气大的手负责抛投、提竿和操作饵，抛完也不用换手。水滴轮过去流行右手摇，现在左手摇的型号也很常见。两种都试试，用顺手的。舒服比遵守什么规则重要得多。

items.question: How do I tell whether a reel listed as left-hand retrieve has the handle on the left?
items.question_zh: 标为 left-hand retrieve 的轮，怎么确认手把是在左边？
items.short: Left-hand retrieve means you turn the handle with your left hand, and the handle sits on the left when you look from behind the reel.
items.body: Hold the reel as you would when fishing and look from behind it, with the spool facing forward. Many spinning reels let you move the handle to either side, so the listing matters mostly for casting reels, which are sold as left or right retrieve. Check the product photo or the model code, since left-hand models often end in an L. If you're unsure, ask the seller before buying.
items.short_zh: left-hand retrieve 指用左手摇，从轮的后方看，手把在左边。
items.body_zh: 按钓鱼时的方式拿着轮，从后方看，线杯朝前。很多纺车轮的手把可以换边，所以这个标注主要对水滴轮有意义，水滴轮分左手和右手款。看产品照片或型号代码，左手款的型号常常以 L 结尾。拿不准就先问卖家。

items.question: Which gear ratio suits slow-moving crankbaits?
items.question_zh: 慢速收的 crankbait 适合什么速比？
items.short: A low ratio, about 5:1 to 6:1.
items.body: You get more leverage against the pull of the lure and a slower, even pace that's easier to hold at depth. Deep-diving crankbaits pull hard, and a low ratio saves your wrist over a day. A higher ratio can still work if you slow down. Just try to reel at an even rate.
items.short_zh: 低速比，大约 5:1 到 6:1。
items.body_zh: 低速比能更省力地对抗饵的拉力，慢而均匀的节奏也更容易让饵保持在深处。深潜 crankbait 拉力大，钓一整天，低速比能保护手腕。高速比慢慢摇也可以，只要尽量保持匀速。

items.question: Which gear ratio suits lures that need fast slack pickup, such as jigs and topwater?
items.question_zh: 铅头钩和水面系这类需要快速收松线的饵，适合什么速比？
items.short: A high ratio, about 7:1 and up.
items.body: When you fish a jig, most of the line you reel in is slack, so picking it up quickly is what matters. The same is true when a fish swims toward you or when you work a walking topwater lure. Retrieve also depends on spool size, so compare inches per turn.
items.short_zh: 高速比，大约 7:1 以上。
items.body_zh: 用铅头钩时，收回来的大多是松线，所以收得快最重要。鱼朝你游来，或者操作走狗式水面饵时也一样。收线量还和线杯大小有关，要比较每圈收线长度。

items.question: What is the step-by-step way to set spool tension and brakes when changing lures?
items.question_zh: 换饵时，调整线杯张力和刹车的步骤是什么？
items.short: Set the tension with the lure tied on, then adjust the brake with test casts.
items.body: With the lure on, hold the rod out level and press the thumb bar. Tighten the tension knob until the lure doesn't move, then loosen it until the lure falls slowly and the spool stops when the lure lands. Start with the brake high, make a few casts, then lower it one step at a time until you start getting loops, and go back one step. Reset whenever you change to a lure of a different weight or the wind picks up.
items.short_zh: 绑好饵后先调线杯张力，再通过试抛调刹车。
items.body_zh: 绑好饵，把竿水平伸出，按下拇指杆。拧紧张力旋钮，直到饵不动；再慢慢松开，直到饵缓缓下落，落地时线杯能停住。刹车先调到高档，抛几次，再一档一档调低，直到开始出现松线，然后退回一档。换了不同重量的饵，或者风变大了，都要重新调。

items.question: How should I clear a bad backlash without damaging the line?
items.question_zh: 严重炸线时，怎样清理才不会损伤线？
items.short: Work the loops out gently and cut out any section with a sharp kink.
items.body: Free the spool and pull off what comes easily, then pin the tangle with your thumb, crank a few turns and pull again. Pick out stubborn loops with your fingers or something blunt. Never pull with force, because braid can dig into the layers below and mono can pinch and weaken. Once it clears, run the next few feet through your fingers, feeling for flat spots or kinks, and cut off anything rough.
items.short_zh: 轻轻把线圈解开，有明显折痕的那段要剪掉。
items.body_zh: 让线杯自由转动，把能拉出的线先拉出来，再用拇指压住线团，摇几圈手把，然后继续拉。顽固的线圈用手指或不尖的东西挑开。千万不要用力拽，编织线会陷进下层，尼龙线会被勒伤变弱。解开之后，让接下来几英尺线从手指间过一遍，摸摸有没有压扁或折痕，粗糙的部分都剪掉。

items.question: Why does a reel backlash even when the brakes are set high?
items.question_zh: 为什么刹车调得很高了，轮还是会炸线？
items.short: Because the spool can still outrun the line, especially late in the cast or in wind.
items.body: Brakes mainly slow the spool at its fastest. They don't fully stop it when a lure slows in a headwind or hits the water, so you still need your thumb. Other causes are a lure too light for the reel, an overfull spool, a sudden snap instead of a smooth cast, old line, or spool tension set too loose. In wind, cast sidearm rather than overhead, keep your thumb light on the spool and press down firmly as the lure lands.
items.short_zh: 因为线杯仍然可能转得比出线快，抛投后段或有风时尤其如此。
items.body_zh: 刹车主要在线杯转得最快时起作用。逆风让饵减速，或者饵落水时，刹车并不能完全停住线杯，所以还是要用拇指。其他原因包括：饵对这只轮太轻、线上得太满、猛甩而不是平顺抛投、线太旧，或者线杯张力太松。有风时用侧抛，不要过肩抛，拇指轻搭在线杯上，饵落水时用力按住。

items.question: What is a sensible practice routine for learning to thumb a baitcaster?
items.question_zh: 学习用拇指控制水滴轮线杯，有什么合理的练习方法？
items.short: Practice in an open space with a heavy practice weight and short, smooth casts.
items.body: Use a 1/2-ounce practice plug or sinker, thick mono and a high brake setting. Start with easy sidearm casts of 10 to 15 yards, keeping your thumb resting lightly on the spool and pressing down to stop as the lure lands. Do this for 15 minutes a few times a week. Lower the brake one notch at a time only when you stop getting overruns. Grass is fine, but avoid pavement, which scrapes line.
items.short_zh: 在空地上用较重的练习坠，做短距离、平顺的抛投。
items.body_zh: 用 1/2 盎司的练习塞或铅坠，配粗一点的尼龙线，刹车调高。先从 10 到 15 码的轻松侧抛开始，拇指轻搭在线杯上，饵落地时按下去停住。一周几次，每次 15 分钟。只有不再出现炸线时，才把刹车调低一档。草地可以，不要在水泥地上练，线会被刮伤。

items.question: What do the numbers on a brake dial or tension knob mean, and do they match across models?
items.question_zh: 刹车旋钮或张力旋钮上的数字代表什么？不同型号之间是一致的吗？
items.short: They are relative settings, not a measure, and they don't match between models.
items.body: On a brake dial a higher number means more braking, but the amount varies by reel and system. The tension knob generally has no scale at all, and one reel's 5 can feel like another's 3. Use the numbers only as a record of what works with a given lure on that reel, and reset whenever you change lures.
items.short_zh: 它们只是相对档位，不是度量单位，不同型号之间也不一致。
items.body_zh: 刹车旋钮的数字越大，制动越强，但具体强度因轮和系统而异。张力旋钮一般根本没有刻度，这只轮的 5 档可能只相当于另一只的 3 档。这些数字只用来记录某个饵在这只轮上好用的设定，换饵时要重新调。

items.question: Does line type or line diameter make backlash more likely?
items.question_zh: 线的种类或线径会让炸线更容易发生吗？
items.short: Yes. Stiff, slick or very thin line generally makes backlash more likely.
items.body: Fluorocarbon and stiff mono hold coils and can spring off the spool. Thin braid can dig into itself, which makes tangles harder to clear, even though braid casts smoothly. Thick line needs more lure weight to start the spool. For learning, a supple 12 to 15 lb mono is the easiest. Keep the line fresh, because old line coils more.
items.short_zh: 会。偏硬、偏滑或很细的线，一般都更容易炸线。
items.body_zh: 碳线和偏硬的尼龙线会保留卷曲，容易从线杯上弹开。细编织线抛起来很顺，但会陷进自身，炸线后更难解开。粗线需要更重的饵才能带动线杯。学习时，用柔软的 12 到 15 磅尼龙线最容易。线要保持新鲜，旧线卷曲更严重。

items.question: Can a freshwater reel be used in saltwater if it is rinsed afterward?
items.question_zh: 淡水轮如果事后冲洗，可以用于海水吗？
items.short: Yes for an occasional trip, but rinsing reduces the damage rather than removing the risk.
items.body: Reels not built for salt usually have less corrosion-resistant metal and less sealing, and salt can reach places a rinse won't. Clean the reel soon after the trip, because Texas Parks and Wildlife notes that corrosion starts right away. Daiwa's routine is a good one: tighten the drag to keep water out of the drag stack, use a fine mist of fresh water, wipe it, and air-dry it out of the sun. Daiwa also says hot water can loosen the grease inside, so use cold. Don't use pressure, and back the drag off before storing it. If you fish salt regularly, buy a reel the maker rates for it. If any reel goes fully under in salt water, Daiwa recommends servicing it right away, since internal damage can begin within days.
items.short_zh: 偶尔用一次可以，但冲洗只能减轻损害，不能消除风险。
items.body_zh: 不是为海水设计的轮，金属件的耐腐蚀性和密封通常都差一些，盐分还可能进到冲不到的地方。钓完要尽快清洁，德克萨斯州公园与野生动物部提醒，腐蚀是马上就开始的。Daiwa 的做法可以照着用：先拧紧卸力，防止水进入卸力片组，用细雾状的淡水冲洗，然后擦干，放在避开阳光的地方晾干。Daiwa 还提到热水可能使内部润滑脂松动，所以要用冷水。不要用高压水，存放前把卸力松开。经常钓海水的话，就买厂家标明可用于海水的轮。无论哪种轮，只要整只掉进过海水，Daiwa 都建议马上送修，因为内部几天内就可能开始受损。

items.question: What makes a reel truly saltwater-rated?
items.question_zh: 什么样的轮才算真正适用于海水？
items.short: Corrosion-resistant materials, and sealing that keeps salt out of the gears and drag.
items.body: Look for stainless or coated bearings, a sealed drag, and a body and spool of anodized aluminum or a composite designed for salt. Some reels also seal the gearbox. The maker's own description counts for more than a general claim of corrosion resistance. Sealing slows salt intrusion but doesn't stop it, and Daiwa itself says its Magsealed reels are not completely waterproof, so rinsing and service still matter.
items.short_zh: 耐腐蚀的材料，加上能把盐分挡在齿轮和卸力之外的密封。
items.body_zh: 要选不锈钢或有涂层的轴承、密封卸力，机身和线杯用阳极氧化铝或专为海水设计的复合材料。有些轮的齿轮箱也有密封。厂家的具体说明，比一句笼统的“耐腐蚀”更有参考价值。密封只能延缓盐分进入，不能完全挡住，Daiwa 也明确说它的 Magsealed 轮并非完全防水，所以冲洗和保养仍然必要。

items.question: Does a sealed reel still need regular cleaning after saltwater trips?
items.question_zh: 密封结构的轮，在海钓之后仍然需要定期清洁吗？
items.short: Yes. Sealing reduces contamination but doesn't eliminate it.
items.body: Daiwa says its Magsealed reels aren't fully waterproof or dustproof and shouldn't be submerged or left out for long. Clean the outside after every trip: tighten the drag, use a light spray of fresh water, wipe it down and let it air-dry out of the sun. Daiwa's Scandinavian site suggests a full service at least twice a season for saltwater use.
items.short_zh: 需要。密封只能减少污染，不能杜绝。
items.body_zh: Daiwa 说它的 Magsealed 轮并非完全防水防尘，不应浸水或长时间放在外面。每次钓完都要清洁外部：拧紧卸力，用淡水轻轻喷洗，擦干，放在避开阳光的地方晾干。Daiwa 斯堪的纳维亚网站建议，用于海水的轮每季至少全面保养两次。

items.question: Is a hose rinse helpful or harmful for a reel after a day in saltwater?
items.question_zh: 海钓一天后用水管冲洗轮，是有帮助还是有害？
items.short: A very light spray helps. A strong jet from a hose does harm.
items.body: High pressure can drive salt and grit inside the reel. Texas Parks and Wildlife says never to use water pressure on a reel. Daiwa suggests a hose or spray bottle set to a fine mist, with the drag tightened first. Wipe the reel down and let it air-dry out of the sun, and back off the drag before you store it.
items.short_zh: 轻轻喷洗有帮助，水管的强水流则有害。
items.body_zh: 高压水可能把盐和沙子冲进轮里。德克萨斯州公园与野生动物部明确说，绝不要用水压冲轮。Daiwa 建议把水管或喷壶调成细雾，并先拧紧卸力。洗完擦干，放在避开阳光的地方晾干，存放前把卸力松开。

items.question: Can the same reel be moved between freshwater and saltwater, and what precautions are needed?
items.question_zh: 同一只轮可以在淡水和海水之间换着用吗？需要注意什么？
items.short: Yes, if it is cleaned after each saltwater trip.
items.body: Use it in salt only if you are willing to clean it soon afterward. Give it a light freshwater spray with the drag tight, air-dry it, then apply a thin coat of lubricant suitable for salt water on the outside moving parts. Clean the rod and tackle as well, since one salty lure can rust a whole box. Before moving on to other waters, clean, drain and dry your gear so you don't carry invasive species.
items.short_zh: 可以，但每次钓完海水都要清洁。
items.body_zh: 只有愿意在钓完后尽快清洁，才适合带去海水里用。拧紧卸力，用淡水轻轻喷洗，晾干，再在外部活动部位薄薄地涂一层适合海水的润滑剂。竿和渔具也要清洁，一个带盐的饵就能让整盒渔具生锈。换到别的水域之前，要清洁、排水、晾干装备，以免带去入侵物种。

items.question: Which saltwater spinning reels are worth considering under $100?
items.question_zh: 低于 100 美元的海水纺车轮，哪些值得考虑？
items.short: Look for a reel the maker rates for salt, from a brand with parts and service.
items.body: FishEye doesn't name models here, because lineups and prices change. In this range look for a sealed or at least protected drag, stainless bearings and a stiff body. A 3000 to 5000 size suits most inshore use. Read recent reviews from people who have used the reel in salt for more than a season. Expect to rinse and service it more often than a pricier reel, and expect it to wear out sooner with regular use.
items.short_zh: 选厂家标明可用于海水、有配件和维修渠道的品牌。
items.body_zh: 这里不点名具体型号，因为产品线和价格都会变。这个价位要找有密封或至少有防护的卸力、不锈钢轴承和较硬的机身。多数近岸海钓选 3000 到 5000 号。看看在海水中用了一个季节以上的人写的近期评价。这个价位的轮要比贵的轮更勤于冲洗保养，经常使用的话，寿命也会短一些。

items.question: What does a saltwater reel gain from a price of $200 or more?
items.question_zh: 价格达到 200 美元或更高的海水轮，能多得到什么？
items.short: Better sealing, stronger gears and a smoother, more powerful drag.
items.body: More of the body and rotor is metal or stiff composite, so the gears stay aligned under heavy drag. Sealing around the gearbox and drag is usually better, and service parts are easier to find. You'll feel the difference with strong fish and over years of regular saltwater use. For occasional inshore trips, a reel around $100 that is rinsed properly can be perfectly adequate.
items.short_zh: 密封更好，齿轮更强，卸力更顺滑有力。
items.body_zh: 机身和转子更多采用金属或高刚性复合材料，大卸力下齿轮也能保持对正。齿轮箱和卸力的密封通常更好，维修配件也更容易买到。遇到力量大的鱼，或者常年在海水中使用时，差别才明显。如果只是偶尔近岸钓，100 美元左右的轮，冲洗得当也完全够用。

items.question: What are the practical differences between braid, monofilament and fluorocarbon?
items.question_zh: 编织线、尼龙线和碳线在实际使用中有什么区别？
items.short: Mono is the easy, forgiving choice. Fluorocarbon is hard to see and abrasion resistant. Braid is thin, strong and has almost no stretch.
items.body: Monofilament is cheap and stretchy and sinks slowly. Its stretch dulls bites at long range, and cheap mono holds coils from the spool. Fluorocarbon is hard to see underwater, resists abrasion and sinks faster, but it is stiffer and costs more, so it is often used as a leader. Braid floats, is far thinner than mono of the same strength, casts far and transmits small bites. It is also easy for fish to see, wears faster against rock and wood, and can slip on a bare spool. For a beginner on a spinning reel, 6 to 10 lb mono is the simple choice. Move to braid with a short leader when you want more sensitivity or distance.
items.short_zh: 尼龙线省事、容错高。碳线在水下不显眼，而且耐磨。编织线细、强度高、几乎没有延展。
items.body_zh: 尼龙线便宜，有弹性，下沉慢。它的弹性会让远距离的咬钩信号变钝，便宜的尼龙线还容易保留线杯上的卷曲。碳线在水下不显眼，耐磨，下沉快，但偏硬、价格高，常用作前导线。编织线会浮在水面，同样强度下比尼龙线细得多，抛得远，轻微的咬钩也能传到手上；但鱼容易看见，碰到岩石和木头磨损更快，在光滑的线杯上还可能打滑。新手用纺车轮的话，6 到 10 磅的尼龙线最省事。想要更好的手感或更远的距离时，再换成编织线加一段短前导。

items.question: Is fluorocarbon a good choice as a full main line on a spinning reel?
items.question_zh: 碳线适合在纺车轮上全部用作主线吗？
items.short: Usually only on small reels with lighter line.
items.body: Fluorocarbon is stiffer than mono and holds coils from the spool, so thick line on a spinning reel tends to jump off in loops. In 4 to 8 lb on a properly filled reel it works well for finesse fishing. For most spinning setups, braid with a fluorocarbon leader is easier to manage. If you do use straight fluorocarbon, choose a limp version, don't overfill, and replace it when it starts to coil.
items.short_zh: 通常只适合小轮和细线。
items.body_zh: 碳线比尼龙线硬，容易保留线杯上的卷曲，粗一些的碳线在纺车轮上常常成圈跳出。上线量合适时，4 到 8 磅的碳线很适合微物钓。多数纺车轮配置，用编织线加碳线前导更好打理。如果确实要全部用碳线，就选柔软型号，不要上太满，开始卷曲就换。

items.question: Can straight braid be tied directly to a lure, or is a leader needed?
items.question_zh: 编织线可以直接绑饵，还是需要前导线？
items.short: It can be tied directly, and that is often fine in heavy cover or dirty water.
items.body: A palomar knot holds braid well. Add a leader if the water is clear, if the line will rub against rock or wood, or if the lure needs some shock absorption. Braid has no stretch, so a fish that makes a sudden run can pull the hooks free if the drag is too tight. With toothy fish, use a wire or heavy fluorocarbon leader.
items.short_zh: 可以直接绑，在重障碍区或浑水里通常也没问题。
items.body_zh: 帕洛马结绑编织线很牢。水很清、线会摩擦岩石或木头，或者饵需要一点缓冲时，再加前导线。编织线没有延展，卸力太紧时，鱼突然发力可能把钩扯脱。钓利齿鱼要用钢丝前导或粗碳线前导。

items.question: Does braid damage rod guides or reels?
items.question_zh: 编织线会损伤导环或轮吗？
items.short: Not on modern guides in good condition.
items.body: Old or low-quality guides with soft inserts can groove over time, and braid can cut into a damaged insert. Check a guide by running a cotton swab or a piece of nylon stocking around the ring: fibers that snag show a crack or groove. Braid can also slip on a smooth spool, so start with a mono backing or tape. It doesn't harm the reel's gears.
items.short_zh: 状况良好的现代导环，不会被损伤。
items.body_zh: 老旧或低档的导环内衬较软，时间长了可能被磨出沟槽，破损的内衬也可能被编织线切得更严重。检查时，用棉签或一小块尼龙丝袜在导环内圈转一圈，纤维被挂住就说明有裂纹或沟槽。编织线在光滑线杯上可能打滑，所以先上一段尼龙底线或贴胶带。它不会损伤轮的齿轮。

items.question: How does cheap monofilament differ from premium monofilament in memory and strength?
items.question_zh: 便宜的尼龙线和高端尼龙线，在记忆性和强度上有什么不同？
items.short: Cheap mono usually holds coils more, and its strength and diameter vary more.
items.body: Premium lines tend to be more consistent, more supple and closer to their rated strength. Cheap line can still work well if it is fresh and changed often, especially for bait fishing. Compare the listed diameter as well as the pound test. Line that has sat on a shelf for years weakens whatever it cost, so buy from a busy store and replace it every year.
items.short_zh: 便宜的尼龙线通常更容易卷曲，强度和线径的波动也更大。
items.body_zh: 高端线一般更稳定、更柔软，实际强度也更接近标称。便宜的线只要新鲜、勤换，照样好用，钓天然饵时尤其如此。比较时除了磅数，也要看标注的线径。在货架上放了多年的线，不管多贵都会变弱，所以要去周转快的店买，并且每年更换。

items.question: Which line type is the easiest for a beginner to manage?
items.question_zh: 哪种线对新手来说最容易驾驭？
items.short: Monofilament, about 6 to 10 lb.
items.body: Mono is cheap and easy to tie, it stretches enough to forgive a hard hook set or a tight drag, and it doesn't slip on the spool. Braid needs different knots and is prone to wind knots on spinning reels. Fluorocarbon is stiffer and costs more. Once you've fished a while and want more feel, try braid with a leader.
items.short_zh: 尼龙线，大约 6 到 10 磅。
items.body_zh: 尼龙线便宜、好打结，有足够的弹性，提竿过猛或卸力太紧时都有缓冲，也不会在线杯上打滑。编织线需要不同的结，在纺车轮上容易出风结。碳线偏硬，价格也高。钓一段时间、想要更好的手感时，再试试编织线加前导。

items.question: Which line is best for learning on a baitcaster?
items.question_zh: 学水滴轮用哪种线最合适？
items.short: Supple monofilament of about 12 to 15 lb.
items.body: Thick mono stays on top of the spool, is easy to lift out of a tangle and forgives a clumsy thumb. Braid can dig into itself and is harder to clear, and fluorocarbon is stiffer. Use a fresh spool of line and load it under some tension. Once your thumb has learned, switch to whatever line your technique calls for.
items.short_zh: 柔软的尼龙线，大约 12 到 15 磅。
items.body_zh: 粗尼龙线不容易陷进下层，炸线时好挑开，拇指控制不好也有余地。编织线会陷进自身，更难解开；碳线偏硬。用新线，上线时保持一点张力。等拇指熟练了，再换成钓法需要的线。

items.question: Which line behaves best on a small spinning reel?
items.question_zh: 小型纺车轮用哪种线表现最好？
items.short: Limp monofilament, or thin braid with a leader.
items.body: On a small spool, stiff lines hold tight coils and leap off in loops. Light 4 to 6 lb mono is forgiving. Braid of 6 to 10 lb casts farther but needs a leader and care to keep tension. Use fluorocarbon only in light sizes. Fill to just below the rim and replace the line once it starts coming off in curls.
items.short_zh: 柔软的尼龙线，或者细编织线加前导。
items.body_zh: 小线杯上，偏硬的线卷得很紧，容易成圈跳出。4 到 6 磅的细尼龙线容错高。6 到 10 磅编织线抛得更远，但需要前导，也要注意保持张力。碳线只用细号。上线到杯沿下方一点，线开始一圈圈卷着出来时就要换。

items.question: Which line suits topwater lures that float?
items.question_zh: 会浮在水面的水面系饵适合用哪种线？
items.short: Braid or monofilament, because neither drags a floating lure down.
items.body: Fluorocarbon sinks and pulls the nose of a small topwater down, which spoils the action. Braid floats, has no stretch and gives a strong hook set on long casts, so it is the usual choice for frogs and large walking baits. Mono also sits well for smaller poppers, and its stretch gives a fish a little more time to take the lure. A short mono leader on braid adds some stretch.
items.short_zh: 编织线或尼龙线，因为它们不会把浮水饵往下拽。
items.body_zh: 碳线会下沉，把小型水面饵的头拉低，动作就不对了。编织线会浮在水面，没有延展，远距离也能有力地提竿，所以青蛙饵和大型走狗饵通常用它。尼龙线也适合较小的 popper，它的弹性还能给鱼多一点咬实的时间。在编织线上接一段短尼龙前导，可以增加一些弹性。

items.question: Which line suits crankbaits when depth matters?
items.question_zh: 对泳层有要求时，crankbait 适合用哪种线？
items.short: Thin line. Fluorocarbon runs deepest for a given strength.
items.body: Thick line drags in the water and makes a crankbait run shallower. Fluorocarbon is dense and sinks, which helps the lure reach depth, and 8 to 12 lb is common. Mono runs a little shallower, and its stretch cushions treble hooks. Braid is very thin and can reach good depth but has no stretch, so use it with a softer rod.
items.short_zh: 线要细。同样强度下，碳线能让饵潜得最深。
items.body_zh: 粗线在水中阻力大，会让 crankbait 潜得浅一些。碳线密度大、会下沉，有助于饵到达目标深度，常用 8 到 12 磅。尼龙线会浅一点，但它的弹性可以缓冲三本钩。编织线很细，也能潜得不错，但没有延展，要配软一些的竿。

items.question: How should line strength be chosen from the target fish and the rod rating?
items.question_zh: 线的强度应该怎样根据目标鱼和竿的标称来选择？
items.short: Start with what the rod is rated for, then adjust for the fish and the cover.
items.body: The rod's printed range is your guide. Within it, match the fish: 4 to 8 lb for bluegill and perch, 8 to 12 lb for bass, and 6 to 10 lb for most other freshwater fishing. Go heavier around rock, wood or heavy weeds and lighter in clear, open water. Braid is measured differently, so choose it by the diameter it matches.
items.short_zh: 先看竿的标称，再根据鱼和障碍物调整。
items.body_zh: 竿上印的范围就是依据。在这个范围内按鱼来选：蓝鳃太阳鱼和河鲈用 4 到 8 磅，鲈鱼用 8 到 12 磅，其他多数淡水钓用 6 到 10 磅。岩石、沉木或水草多的地方用粗一点的线，清澈开阔的水域用细一点的线。编织线的计算方式不同，要按对应的线径来选。

items.question: Why does braid of the same pound test have a much thinner diameter than monofilament?
items.question_zh: 为什么同样磅数的编织线，线径比尼龙线细得多？
items.short: Its fibers are far stronger for their thickness.
items.body: Braid is woven from ultra-high-molecular-weight polyethylene, whose long, highly aligned molecules carry much more load for their size than a single strand of nylon. That is why 30 lb braid can be about as thin as 8 lb mono. The thin diameter reduces water drag and fits more line on the spool, but it also cuts into wet fingers and can dig into itself.
items.short_zh: 因为它的纤维在同样粗细下强度高得多。
items.body_zh: 编织线由超高分子量聚乙烯纤维编成，分子链长且排列整齐，同样粗细下承载能力比单根尼龙强得多。所以 30 磅编织线大约只有 8 磅尼龙线那么细。线径细，水阻就小，线杯也能容下更多的线；但它容易割伤沾水的手指，也会陷进自身。

items.question: Is it a problem to use braid rated well above the rod's line rating?
items.question_zh: 使用磅数远高于竿标称的编织线，会有问题吗？
items.short: Usually not because of the diameter. The risk is what that strength lets you do.
items.body: Rod line ratings were written mainly with mono in mind, and heavy braid is thin enough to fit and cast fine. The danger is that the line won't break before the rod when you haul on a snag or lift a fish too high. Set the drag within the rod's limit, and free snags with the rod pointed at them, not bent.
items.short_zh: 线径通常不是问题，风险在于这么大的强度让你用力过头。
items.body_zh: 竿的线号标称主要是按尼龙线写的，粗编织线其实够细，抛投也没问题。危险在于硬拉挂底或把鱼抬得太高时，线还没断竿就先断了。卸力要设在竿的承受范围内，挂底时把竿尖对准挂点，不要弯着竿硬拉。

items.question: How thin can braid go before wind knots and breakage become a bigger problem?
items.question_zh: 编织线细到什么程度，风结和断线会变成更大的问题？
items.short: Below about 8 to 10 lb, tangles and break-offs become more common on normal gear.
items.body: Very thin braid has little body and can loop and catch on the spool or guides. It also cuts and frays easily. On finesse gear with a 1000 or 2000 reel, 6 to 8 lb can work with careful line management, but 10 to 15 lb braid is easier for general fishing. Keep tension on the line, avoid overfilling and use a leader.
