items.short_zh: 细到 8 到 10 磅以下，在普通钓具上缠线和断线就会明显变多。
items.body_zh: 很细的编织线没什么挺度，容易成圈并挂在线杯或导环上，也容易被割断、磨毛。微物钓配 1000 或 2000 号轮，小心控线的话可以用 6 到 8 磅；一般钓法用 10 到 15 磅更省心。收线保持张力，不要上太满，再加前导线。

items.question: Do line ratings from different brands mean the same real strength?
items.question_zh: 不同品牌标称的磅数，代表相同的实际强度吗？
items.short: Not exactly.
items.body: Some lines break well above the label and others close to it. Lines sold to IGFA class standards are made to break at or under the label, which is why they can look weaker in comparisons. Mono is generally weaker when wet, and knots reduce strength further. If strength really matters, compare diameter and test the same knot on a scale.
items.short_zh: 不完全相同。
items.body_zh: 有的线实际强度远高于标称，有的接近标称。按 IGFA 级别销售的线，断裂强度要等于或低于标称，所以比较时可能显得较弱。尼龙线吸水后一般会变弱，打结还会进一步降低强度。如果强度真的重要，就比较线径，并在秤上测试同一种结。

items.question: What line strength suits panfish and trout?
items.question_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼和鳟鱼用多少磅的线合适？
items.short: About 4 to 8 lb monofilament.
items.body: Go down to 2 to 4 lb for small trout or very clear water, which also helps small lures move naturally. For stocked trout, 6 to 8 lb is a good middle. Use lighter line with smaller hooks, and go heavier around wood or where larger fish are likely.
items.short_zh: 大约 4 到 8 磅尼龙线。
items.body_zh: 钓小鳟鱼或在很清的水里，可以降到 2 到 4 磅，也有助于小饵动作自然。钓放流鳟时，6 到 8 磅比较折中。钩小就用细线，木头多或可能有大鱼的地方，线要粗一些。

items.question: What line strength suits bass around heavy cover?
items.question_zh: 在重障碍区钓鲈鱼用多少磅的线合适？
items.short: Usually 15 to 20 lb mono or fluorocarbon, or 50 to 65 lb braid.
items.body: Around wood or light weeds, 15 to 20 lb is common. For thick or matted weeds, FishEye's largemouth guide lists 65 lb braid or stronger on a casting rod of 7-foot-6 or longer. Strong line lets you pull a fish out quickly, keeps the hooks in and avoids leaving a lure behind in the cover.
items.short_zh: 通常用 15 到 20 磅尼龙线或碳线，或者 50 到 65 磅编织线。
items.body_zh: 在木头或稀疏水草附近，常用 15 到 20 磅。在茂密或成片的水草区，FishEye 的大口黑鲈指南列的是 65 磅或更强的编织线，配 7 英尺 6 英寸或更长的枪柄竿。线够强，才能快速把鱼拉出来，钩也不容易脱，饵也不会留在障碍物里。

items.question: What line strength suits pike and other toothy fish?
items.question_zh: 钓白斑狗鱼和其他利齿鱼类用多少磅的线合适？
items.short: Braid of at least 15 lb, plus a bite-proof leader.
items.body: FishEye's pike guide uses 15 lb or heavier braid with a foot-long steel or fluorocarbon leader. Line strength matters less than the leader, because teeth cut through ordinary line. Heavier braid of 30 to 50 lb suits large lures and heavy cover. Bring long pliers and a net.
items.short_zh: 至少 15 磅的编织线，再加防咬前导。
items.body_zh: FishEye 的白斑狗鱼指南用 15 磅或更强的编织线，加一段一英尺长的钢丝或碳线前导。线的强度不如前导重要，因为鱼牙能切断普通的线。大饵和重障碍区可以用 30 到 50 磅编织线。带上长柄钳和抄网。

items.question: When is a leader worth using on braid, and when is it unnecessary?
items.question_zh: 在编织线上，什么时候值得加前导线，什么时候不需要？
items.short: Use a leader when fish can see the line or the line will rub on something. Skip it in heavy cover and dirty water.
items.body: In clear water a few feet of fluorocarbon hides braid, which is easy to see. Around rocks, docks and wood it takes the abrasion braid handles poorly. If the leader is rated a little lighter than the braid, it breaks first on a snag, so you lose only the hook and lure. A leader is usually unnecessary in dense weeds or lily pads, in muddy water, or with topwater frogs, where braid's strength matters most and fish have little time to inspect the line. Toothy fish such as pike are a separate case: use a wire or heavy fluorocarbon leader whatever the main line.
items.short_zh: 鱼看得见线，或者线会摩擦到东西时，就加前导线。在重障碍区和浑水里可以不加。
items.body_zh: 清水里，几英尺碳线可以把显眼的编织线藏起来。在岩石、码头和沉木旁边，前导线可以替编织线承受磨损。前导线比编织线略细时，挂底时先断的是前导线，只损失钩和饵。在很密的水草或睡莲叶里、浑水里，或者打水面青蛙饵时，通常不需要前导线，这时编织线的强度最重要，鱼也没有时间细看线。白斑狗鱼这类利齿鱼是另一回事：无论主线用什么，都要用钢丝前导或粗碳线前导。

items.question: How long should a fluorocarbon leader be for general freshwater fishing?
items.question_zh: 一般淡水钓法中，碳线前导应该多长？
items.short: About 2 to 6 feet.
items.body: Two to three feet is enough for most fishing and keeps the line-to-line knot out of the reel when casting. In very clear water or with wary fish, 4 to 6 feet gives more separation from the braid. A long leader can make casting harder if the knot runs through the guides, and a slim knot reduces that. Retie whenever the leader feels rough.
items.short_zh: 大约 2 到 6 英尺。
items.body_zh: 多数情况下两三英尺就够了，抛投时线结也不会卷进轮里。水很清或鱼很警觉时，4 到 6 英尺能让鱼离编织线更远。前导太长，线结要穿过导环，抛投会受影响，打一个细小的结可以减轻这个问题。摸起来粗糙就重新绑。

items.question: Should a leader be connected with a knot or with a swivel?
items.question_zh: 前导线应该用线结连接，还是用转环连接？
items.short: Usually a knot. Use a swivel when you need to stop twist or stop a sliding sinker.
items.body: A line-to-line knot is slim, weighs nothing and passes through the guides. A barrel swivel is easy to tie and strong, and it stops a sliding sinker and reduces twist with spinning baits and bottom rigs. It can't pass through the guides, so keep it outside the rod tip when you cast. Snaps can affect the action of small lures.
items.short_zh: 通常用线结。需要防止线扭或挡住游动铅坠时，用转环。
items.body_zh: 线对线的结细小、几乎没有重量，还能穿过导环。桶形转环好绑、强度高，能挡住游动铅坠，也能减少旋转饵和底钓组造成的线扭。它过不了导环，抛投时要让它留在竿尖外面。别针可能影响小饵的动作。

items.question: Should a leader always have a lower breaking strength than the main line?
items.question_zh: 前导线的断裂强度应该总是低于主线吗？
items.short: No. It depends on whether you want the leader to break first or to take abrasion.
items.body: A lighter leader breaks first on a snag and saves most of your main line. That is the usual setup on a bait rig with mono, and with braid the leader is lighter anyway because braid is so strong. A heavier leader is used when the fish or the cover would cut lighter line: toothy fish, rocks, oysters or pier pilings. In that case the knot or the main line becomes the weak link.
items.short_zh: 不一定。要看你希望前导线先断，还是希望它耐磨。
items.body_zh: 前导线较细时，挂底会先断，主线大多能保住。尼龙线的天然饵钓组通常就是这样；用编织线时，前导线一般也更细，因为编织线太强。如果鱼或障碍物会切断细线，比如利齿鱼、岩石、牡蛎或栈桥桩，就要用更粗的前导，这时线结或主线就成了薄弱环节。

items.question: Which line-to-line knot is reliable and still passes smoothly through the guides?
items.question_zh: 哪种线对线的结既可靠，又能顺利穿过导环？
items.short: A double uni is easy and reliable. An FG knot is the slimmest.
items.body: The double uni is the easiest to learn and strong enough for most fishing. The surgeon's and blood knots work well for mono and fluorocarbon. For braid to fluorocarbon, the FG knot is very thin and casts best, but it takes practice. Wet any knot before tightening, test it with a firm pull, and trim the tags close without cutting them flush.
items.short_zh: 双 uni 结简单可靠，FG 结最细。
items.body_zh: 双 uni 结最容易学，强度也足够应付多数情况。外科结和血结适合尼龙线和碳线。编织线接碳线时，FG 结很细，抛投最顺，但需要练习。任何结收紧前都要润湿，打好后用力拉一下测试，线头剪短，但不要贴着结剪。

items.question: Is a wire or heavy fluorocarbon leader needed for pike?
items.question_zh: 钓白斑狗鱼需要钢丝前导或粗碳线前导吗？
items.short: Yes, some form of bite-proof leader.
items.body: A pike's teeth can cut ordinary line. FishEye's guide lists a foot-long steel or fluorocarbon leader. Wire is the most secure. Heavy fluorocarbon of about 40 to 80 lb is less visible and works with lighter gear, but a large fish can still cut it. Check the leader for nicks after every fish. Replace wire as soon as it kinks.
items.short_zh: 需要，要用某种防咬的前导。
items.body_zh: 白斑狗鱼的牙能切断普通的线。FishEye 的指南列的是一英尺长的钢丝或碳线前导。钢丝最保险。40 到 80 磅的粗碳线不那么显眼，也适合较轻的装备，但大鱼仍可能咬断。每钓到一条鱼，都要检查前导有没有咬痕。钢丝一旦打折就要更换。

items.question: What leader setup works for inshore saltwater fishing?
items.question_zh: 近岸海钓适合什么样的前导线配置？
items.short: A 2 to 4 foot fluorocarbon leader of about 15 to 30 lb.
items.body: A braid main line of 10 to 20 lb with a fluorocarbon leader works for redfish, speckled trout and flounder. Use 15 to 20 lb in open water and clear shallows, and go to 25 to 30 lb near oysters, docks and mangroves or for snook. Join the two with a double uni or FG knot. A loop knot at the lure gives small lures more action.
items.short_zh: 用 2 到 4 英尺、15 到 30 磅的碳线前导。
items.body_zh: 10 到 20 磅编织线主线加碳线前导，可以钓红拟石首鱼、斑点海鳟和比目鱼。开阔水域和清澈浅滩用 15 到 20 磅；靠近牡蛎、码头和红树林，或者钓锯盖鱼时，用 25 到 30 磅。两段线用双 uni 结或 FG 结连接。绑饵时打一个活圈结，小饵的动作会更好。

items.question: How full should a spinning reel spool be, and how full should a baitcaster spool be?
items.question_zh: 纺车轮线杯应该上到多满？水滴轮线杯又应该上到多满？
items.short: Fill a spinning reel to about 1/16 to 1/8 inch below the rim. Fill a baitcaster close to full, leaving a small gap.
items.body: On a spinning reel, too little line has to climb over the lip on every cast, which costs distance, and too much jumps off in loose coils and tangles. A baitcaster doesn't throw line off the lip. Aim for nearly full with a small gap below the rim, commonly around 1/8 inch, and check that the line can't touch the frame or level-wind when it's wound tight. On either reel, load line with some tension, then check after a few casts and take some off if loops appear. A spincast reel is full at about 100 yards.
items.short_zh: 纺车轮上到离杯沿大约 1/16 到 1/8 英寸。水滴轮上到接近满杯，留一点空隙。
items.body_zh: 纺车轮的线上得太少，每次出线都要爬过杯沿，抛不远；上得太满，松线会成圈跳出来，造成缠绕。水滴轮的线不是从杯沿甩出去的，可以接近满杯，但边缘下方要留一点空隙，常见做法是 1/8 英寸左右，并确认线绕紧后碰不到机身或排线器。无论哪种轮，上线时都要保持一点张力，抛几次后再检查，如果出现线圈，就放掉一些线。卡式轮大约 100 码就算满了。

items.question: Why might braid slip on the spool, and how can a mono backing prevent it?
items.question_zh: 编织线为什么可能在线杯上打滑？尼龙底线怎样防止这种情况？
items.short: Braid is slick and thin, so it can spin around a smooth spool. Mono grips it.
items.body: When braid goes directly on a bare spool, a hard pull can make the whole layer rotate even though the drag isn't slipping. Mono has enough grip to stay put and hold the braid. Tie on a few turns to a full layer of mono with an arbor knot, then join the braid with a double uni. Many modern spools are braid-ready and have a grip surface, in which case backing isn't needed.
items.short_zh: 编织线又滑又细，会在光滑的线杯上打转，尼龙线能抓住它。
items.body_zh: 编织线直接绕在光滑线杯上时，用力一拉，整层线可能一起打转，而卸力其实没有滑动。尼龙线的摩擦力足够，能固定住，也能抓住编织线。用线杯结绑上几圈到一整层尼龙线，再用双 uni 结接编织线。很多现代线杯有防滑面，可以直接上编织线，这时就不需要底线。

items.question: How can I estimate how much backing to put on before adding a set length of braid?
items.question_zh: 在上固定长度的编织线之前，怎么估算需要多少底线？
items.short: Use the reel's printed capacity for a first estimate, then adjust after a trial.
items.body: If a spool holds 150 yards of your braid and you have 100, mono needs to fill about a third of it. The inner turns of a spool are shorter, so this is only a rough start. Wind on the backing, add the braid and see how close you are to the rim. If you are off, take the line off and change the backing a little. A cheap spool of mono makes a few tries easy.
items.short_zh: 先用轮上标的容线量估算，再试一次并调整。
items.body_zh: 如果线杯能装 150 码你用的编织线，而你只有 100 码，底线大约要占三分之一。线杯内圈周长短，所以这只是粗略的起点。先绕底线，再上编织线，看离杯沿还有多远。差得多就把线放掉，增减一点底线。便宜的尼龙线多试几次也不心疼。

items.question: How should line be loaded onto a spinning reel to avoid twist?
items.question_zh: 给纺车轮上线时，怎样避免线扭？
items.short: Have the line come off the filler spool the same way it goes on the reel, and keep tension on it.
items.body: Open the bail, tie on with an arbor knot and close the bail. Lay the filler spool flat on the floor so line leaves it in coils. Reel a few turns, then lower the rod tip and look at the slack line: if it twists, flip the filler spool over. Keep light tension by letting the line pass between your fingers. Most line packages give directions for this. Stop about 1/16 to 1/8 inch below the rim.
items.short_zh: 让线从大卷上出来的方向和绕上轮的方向一致，并保持张力。
items.body_zh: 打开线臂，用线杯结绑好，再合上线臂。把线卷平放在地上，让线一圈圈出来。摇几圈，然后放低竿尖，看松下来的线：如果扭在一起，就把线卷翻个面。让线从手指间穿过，保持轻微的张力。多数线的包装上都有说明。上到离杯沿约 1/16 到 1/8 英寸时停下。

items.question: How often should line be replaced if it is used only a few times a year?
items.question_zh: 如果一年只用几次，线应该多久更换一次？
items.short: Replace it at least once a year, even with light use.
items.body: Sunlight and time weaken all line, and old mono turns brittle. Change it sooner if it snaps during knot tying, comes off in tight curls or the last few feet are nicked. Braid lasts longer if it isn't sun-bleached and can be cut back, but check it for frays or fading. Store rods out of the sun.
items.short_zh: 即使用得少，也至少每年换一次。
items.body_zh: 阳光和时间会让所有的线变弱，旧尼龙线还会变脆。打结时容易断、放出来一圈圈卷着，或者最后几英尺有划痕，就要提前更换。编织线只要没有被晒褪色，可以用得更久，还能剪短继续用，但要检查有没有起毛或褪色。竿要存放在晒不到太阳的地方。

items.question: Can braid be reversed on the spool to use the unworn section?
items.question_zh: 编织线能否调头上线，以使用没有磨损的那一段？
items.short: Yes, if the inner section is in good condition.
items.body: Braid wears mostly in the outer layers, and the line deep on the spool is often almost new. Pull all of it off and stretch it across a lawn or wind it between two posts. Tie the old outer end to the spool and wind it back on, so the fresh line ends up on the outside. Check it with your fingers for frays or fading. Don't bother if it is faded all the way through.
items.short_zh: 可以，只要内层的线状况良好。
items.body_zh: 编织线的磨损主要在外层，线杯深处的线常常几乎是新的。把线全部放出来，拉开铺在草地上或绕在两根柱子之间，把原来外面的线头绑到线杯上，重新绕回去，新鲜的一段就到了外层。用手指摸一遍，看有没有起毛或褪色。如果整条线都褪色了，就不必这么做。

items.question: What causes wind knots on a spinning reel, and how can they be reduced?
items.question_zh: 纺车轮上的风结是什么原因造成的？怎样减少？
items.short: Wind knots start when a loose coil gets wound onto the spool and comes off with the next cast.
items.body: The usual causes are reeling in slack line, an overfilled spool, and thin, limp braid. To reduce them, flip the bail over with your hand rather than cranking it shut, so the line seats on the roller. After the cast, lift the rod to take up slack before you start reeling. For the first few turns let the line run between your thumb and finger, especially with a light lure in wind. Don't overfill. When you see a loose loop, stop and pull it off rather than casting again. If they keep happening, strip off the top layer and put it back on under tension.
items.short_zh: 风结的起因，是一圈松线被卷到线杯上，下一次抛投时又跟着出来。
items.body_zh: 常见原因是收了松线、线上得太满，以及细编织线太软。减少风结的办法：用手翻回线臂，不要靠摇手把带回，这样线才能落到导线轮上。抛出后先抬竿带紧松线，再开始摇。开始几圈让线从拇指和食指之间穿过，在大风里抛轻饵时尤其要这样。不要把线上得太满。看到松线圈就停下来拉掉，不要接着抛。如果还是经常发生，就把最上面一层线放出来，带张力重新收回去。

items.question: How can twisted line be fixed without replacing all of it?
items.question_zh: 线扭了以后，怎样不必全部换线就能修复？
items.short: Let the line untwist under low tension, or cut off the twisted section.
items.body: Take off the lure and let 30 to 50 yards trail behind a slowly moving boat or in a river's current, then reel it in under slight tension. On the bank, walk the line out across a lawn and pull it through your fingers. Cut off the worst section. Then find out why it twisted: reeling while the drag is slipping and spinning lures without a swivel are common causes. If twist keeps coming back, it is time for new line.
items.short_zh: 在低张力下让线自己解开，或者把扭得厉害的一段剪掉。
items.body_zh: 取下饵，让 30 到 50 码线拖在慢速行驶的船后，或者放进河流的水流中，再带着一点张力收回来。在岸上，可以把线拉开铺在草地上，再让线从手指间穿过。扭得最厉害的一段剪掉。然后找原因：卸力滑动时还在摇轮，或者旋转饵没有转环，都是常见原因。如果线扭总是复发，就该换新线了。

items.question: Why does line keep breaking at the knot?
items.question_zh: 为什么线总是在线结处断？
items.short: Usually a poor knot, damaged line or a tight drag.
items.body: A badly tied knot can lose half the line's strength or more, while a good one keeps over 90 percent. Friction heat from tightening a dry knot weakens it. Check that the knot was wet and pulled tight slowly, and that the end wasn't nicked when trimmed. Rough guides, a sharp hook eye or rocks can weaken the last few feet, so cut back and retie. If it breaks when a fish runs, loosen the drag.
items.short_zh: 通常是结打得不好、线有损伤，或者卸力太紧。
items.body_zh: 结打得不好，线的强度可能损失一半甚至更多；打得好的结能保留 90% 以上。干着收紧时，摩擦热也会让结变弱。检查打结前有没有润湿、是不是慢慢拉紧、剪线头时有没有划伤。粗糙的导环、锋利的钩眼或岩石，都可能让最后几英尺线变弱，要剪掉重绑。如果是鱼发力时断的，就把卸力松一些。

items.question: Does line color make any real difference to how many fish bite?
items.question_zh: 线的颜色对鱼的咬钩数量有实际影响吗？
items.short: It can matter in clear water, but the effect is generally small.
items.body: In clear water, thin low-visibility line and a fluorocarbon leader may draw more bites from wary fish. In stained water it matters little. High-visibility line helps you see light bites, which can outweigh any disadvantage, especially with a leader. Controlled evidence is limited, so don't spend much time on color when location, depth or bait size may be the real problem.
items.short_zh: 在清水里可能有影响，但一般影响不大。
items.body_zh: 在清水中，细而不显眼的线和碳线前导可能让警觉的鱼更愿意咬。浑水里差别很小。高可见度的线能帮你看到轻微的咬口，这个好处可能超过它的缺点，加上前导时更是如此。严格对照的证据不多，所以位置、水深或饵的大小才可能是真正的问题时，不要在线的颜色上花太多心思。

items.question: How can stiff line memory be reduced on a cold day?
items.question_zh: 天冷时，怎样减轻线的卷曲记忆？
items.short: Stretch the line, and use a limp line.
items.body: Cold makes mono and fluorocarbon stiffer. Before fishing, let out a few yards and pull it between your hands, or pull it steadily against the drag. A line conditioner can help for a while. Keep the spool full so the line comes off in larger coils. For cold-weather fishing, limp lines or braid with a short leader have much less memory. Replace old line, which coils the most.
items.short_zh: 把线拉伸一下，并换用柔软的线。
items.body_zh: 低温会让尼龙线和碳线变硬。开钓前放出几码线，用双手拉一拉，或者顶着卸力稳稳地拉。线油可以暂时起作用。线杯要上足，线出来时线圈才大。冷天钓鱼，柔软的线或编织线加短前导，卷曲要少得多。旧线卷曲最严重，要及时换。

items.question: How can I check whether line has become weak from age or abrasion?
items.question_zh: 怎样检查线是否因老化或磨损而变弱？
items.short: Feel the last few feet and test it by hand.
items.body: Run the line between your fingers and look for rough or flattened spots, nicks or fading. Tie a knot and pull: if it snaps easily or feels brittle, replace it. Check after fishing around rock or wood, and after every fish. Cut off the last few feet regularly.
items.short_zh: 摸一摸最后几英尺，再用手测试。
items.body_zh: 让线从手指间穿过，看有没有粗糙或压扁的地方、划痕或褪色。打一个结用力拉，如果很容易断或者手感发脆，就换线。在岩石或木头附近钓过之后，以及每钓到一条鱼之后，都要检查。定期把最后几英尺剪掉。

items.question: What details on a lure, such as hook hangers, lip shape or markings, help identify its maker?
items.question_zh: 饵上的哪些细节，比如挂钩件、唇舌形状或刻印，有助于判断厂家？
items.short: Hook hangers, lip shape, eye style, body material and any stamped marks.
items.body: Older lures can often be dated by their hook hardware and the shape of a metal lip. Stamps on lips or spoons, and names molded under the belly, can give the maker directly. Glass eyes and wooden bodies usually point to older production. Compare what you see with catalogs or collector references. Even without marks, these details narrow down the maker.
items.short_zh: 挂钩件、唇舌形状、眼睛样式、饵身材料，以及所有刻印。
items.body_zh: 老式饵常常可以根据挂钩五金件和金属唇舌的形状判断年代。唇舌或勺片上的刻印、腹部压制的名称，可以直接说明厂家。玻璃眼和木质饵身通常是较早的产品。把看到的细节和旧目录或收藏资料对照。即使没有刻印，这些细节也能缩小范围。

items.question: What should a photo show to give others the best chance of identifying a lure?
items.question_zh: 想让别人帮忙辨认饵，照片应该拍到哪些部分？
items.short: Take clear, close shots of the top, side, belly, lip and any markings.
items.body: Use daylight and a plain background, and include something for scale such as a ruler or a coin. Show hook hangers, eyes, propellers and any stamped letters up close. Note the weight, where it was found and how old it might be. Don't clean it before taking the photo, because a paint pattern or stamp can disappear.
items.short_zh: 拍清楚饵的顶部、侧面、腹部、唇舌和所有标记的近照。
items.body_zh: 在自然光下用素色背景拍摄，放一把尺子或一枚硬币作比例。挂钩件、眼睛、螺旋桨和刻字都要拍近景。记下重量、发现地点和大概年代。拍照前不要清洗，涂装花纹或刻印可能会被洗掉。

items.question: How can I work out how to fish a lure when I do not know what it is?
items.question_zh: 不知道一个饵是什么时，怎样判断它该怎么用？
items.short: Look at its shape, then test it in clear water.
items.body: A lip means it dives. A flat or cupped face means it rides near the surface. Blades spin, and a hook with a weighted head sinks. Tie it on, drop it in clear water and reel at different speeds while you watch how it moves. Its weight shows how deep and how fast it can be worked. Try a steady retrieve first, then twitches and pauses.
items.short_zh: 先看形状，再放到清水里试。
items.body_zh: 有唇舌的饵会下潜。头部平或内凹的饵贴近水面。有叶片的会旋转，带配重头的钩会下沉。绑上饵，放到清水里，用不同的速度收线，观察它怎么动。饵的重量说明它能在多深、多快地工作。先匀速收线，再试试抖动和停顿。

items.question: How can I find a replacement when a favorite lure has no visible brand?
items.question_zh: 喜欢的饵没有明显的牌子时，怎样找到替代品？
items.short: Measure it, photograph it and search by type, size and color.
items.body: Note the length, weight, lip style and how it moves. Take the lure to a tackle shop or show clear photos to someone who knows lures. Search for the lure type and weight rather than a guess at the brand. You may not find the exact one, but lures of similar size and action usually do the same job.
items.short_zh: 量尺寸、拍照片，再按类型、大小和颜色搜索。
items.body_zh: 记下长度、重量、唇舌样式和动作。把饵带到渔具店，或者把清晰的照片给懂行的人看。搜索时用饵的类型和重量，不要瞎猜品牌。不一定能找到一模一样的，但大小和动作相近的饵，效果通常差不多。

items.question: What is the correct name for a small terminal tackle part I cannot identify?
items.question_zh: 认不出来的小型终端配件，正确的名称怎么查？
items.short: Work out what it does, then compare it with a terminal tackle chart.
items.body: Most small parts are one of a few kinds: swivels, snaps, split rings, beads, bobber stops, hook keepers, sinker slides or crimps. Take a close photo next to a ruler and bring it to a tackle shop. If you know what it was attached to, that often gives it away. Searching for what the part does is often more effective than guessing the name.
items.short_zh: 先弄清它的用途，再对照终端配件图表。
items.body_zh: 小配件大多是这几类：转环、别针、开环、小珠、浮漂止挡、挂钩器、铅坠滑扣或压管。放在尺子旁边拍张近照，带到渔具店问。如果知道它原来连在什么上面，往往就能认出来。按用途搜索，通常比猜名字更有效。

items.question: Which small set of lure types covers most freshwater situations?
items.question_zh: 哪几类饵组合起来，能覆盖大多数淡水场景？
items.short: A soft plastic on a jig, a crankbait, a spinnerbait, a small spinner or spoon, and a topwater lure.
items.body: Soft plastics work near the bottom and at slower speeds. A crankbait covers water at a set depth. A spinnerbait comes through weeds and wood and flashes in murky water. A small inline spinner or spoon works for trout and panfish. A topwater lure covers low-light times. Pick two sizes of each for your main fish, and add colors only after you've learned the range.
items.short_zh: 铅头钩配软饵、crankbait、spinnerbait、小型旋转亮片或勺形亮片，再加一个水面饵。
items.body_zh: 软饵适合贴底和慢速。crankbait 能在固定水层大范围搜索。spinnerbait 能穿过水草和木头，在浑水里也有闪光。小型旋转亮片或勺形亮片适合鳟鱼和小型淡水鱼。水面饵用在光线弱的时段。按主要目标鱼，每种选两个大小，熟悉之后再增加颜色。

items.question: How should lure choice change between clear water and stained water?
items.question_zh: 在清水和浑水中，选饵应该怎样调整？
items.short: Use natural colors and flash in clear water, bright colors in stained water, and dark colors with vibration in muddy water.
items.body: In clear water with two feet or more of visibility, try natural or flashy baits such as spoons, spinners, jerkbaits and soft plastics. In stained water, use bright colors such as chartreuse, and gold or copper blades. In muddy water, use dark colors and vibration: bladed swim jigs, rattling crankbaits and Colorado-blade spinnerbaits.
items.short_zh: 清水用自然色和闪光，浑水用亮色，泥水用深色加振动。
items.body_zh: 能见度两英尺以上的清水里，试试自然色或有闪光的饵，比如勺形亮片、旋转亮片、jerkbait 和软饵。微浑的水里用亮色，比如荧光黄绿，以及金色或铜色叶片。泥水里用深色和振动：带叶片的游泳铅头钩、带响珠的 crankbait 和科罗拉多叶片的 spinnerbait。

items.question: How should lure size be chosen when the baitfish in the area are small?
items.question_zh: 当地饵鱼体型较小时，饵的尺寸该怎么选？
items.short: Start by matching their size, and go up only if you need to stand out.
items.body: A small lure usually gets more bites when fish are feeding on small prey. Check what is there by watching the shallows or asking a shop. If you're catching only small fish, or the water is murky, a larger lure can bring in bigger fish or be easier to find. If active fish are near the surface, use bigger lures and reel faster. If they are near the bottom, slow down and go smaller.
items.short_zh: 先按饵鱼的大小来选，需要更显眼时再加大。
items.body_zh: 鱼在吃小饵鱼时，小饵通常咬口更多。可以观察浅水，或者问问渔具店。如果只钓到小鱼，或者水比较浑，大一点的饵可能引来大鱼，也更容易被发现。活跃的鱼靠近水面时，用大一点的饵，收快一点；鱼靠近水底时，放慢速度，换小饵。

items.question: What lures can be fished through grass without constantly fouling?
items.question_zh: 在水草区，哪些饵可以穿行而不容易挂草？
items.short: Weedless soft plastics, frogs, spinnerbaits, and lipless crankbaits ripped free.
items.body: A Texas rig buries the hook point in the plastic so it slides through weeds. Frogs and spinnerbaits resist snags naturally. A lipless crankbait can be reeled fast over grass, then allowed to fall and ripped free. Fish the edges and openings first, which also keeps your line out of the weeds.
items.short_zh: 防挂的软饵、青蛙饵、spinnerbait，以及可以扯脱水草的无唇 crankbait。
items.body_zh: 德州钓组把钩尖埋在软饵里，可以穿过水草。青蛙饵和 spinnerbait 本身就不容易挂。无唇 crankbait 可以在水草上方快速收线，再让它下落，碰到水草时猛地扯开。先钓水草边缘和缺口，这样线也不容易缠草。

items.question: Is live or dead bait more effective than lures for pike?
items.question_zh: 钓白斑狗鱼时，活饵或死饵比拟饵更有效吗？
items.short: Either can work. Bait is better in slow, cold conditions, and lures cover more water.
items.body: A sucker or other baitfish fished along a weed edge can tempt a pike that won't chase, especially in cold water. Lures let you search water quickly. Some states limit live bait, so read the rules first. Set the hook soon to avoid deep hooking, and use a steel or fluorocarbon leader.
items.short_zh: 两者都有效。慢节奏和低水温时天然饵更好，拟饵能搜索更大的水域。
items.body_zh: 沿水草边缘放亚口鱼或其他饵鱼，能吸引不愿追逐的白斑狗鱼，水温低时尤其如此。拟饵能快速搜索水域。先查好规定，有些州限制活饵。咬钩后尽快提竿，避免吞钩，并使用钢丝或碳线前导。

items.question: Which lures work best from the bank where casting angles are limited?
items.question_zh: 在抛投角度受限的岸边，哪些饵效果较好？
items.short: Compact lures you can pitch underhand, such as small jigs and spinners.
items.body: Choose lures that are dense and cast easily on a short motion. A roll cast or underhand pitch works around overhead branches. Jig heads with soft plastics and small inline spinners stay accurate. Casting parallel to the bank keeps your lure where fish hold for more of the retrieve.
items.short_zh: 小巧、能用下手抛的饵，比如小铅头钩和旋转亮片。
items.body_zh: 选密度大、动作幅度小也能抛的饵。头顶有树枝时，用滚抛或下手抛。铅头钩配软饵和小型旋转亮片落点准。沿着岸边平行抛，收线的大部分时间，饵都在鱼待的位置。

items.question: Which lures suit saltwater surf fishing?
items.question_zh: 海滩投钓适合哪些饵？
items.short: Heavy metal spoons, jigs and long-casting swim plugs.
items.body: You need weight to reach fish beyond the breakers, so casting spoons and metal jigs of about 1 to 3 ounces are common. Bucktail jigs with soft plastic trailers work near the bottom, and swimming plugs cover the shallows near cuts and sandbars. Rinse lures and hooks with fresh water afterward and replace hooks that show rust.
items.short_zh: 重型金属勺、铁板，以及能抛远的游泳型硬饵。
items.body_zh: 要抛过碎浪才能到鱼所在的地方，所以常用 1 到 3 盎司的抛投勺和金属铁板。鹿毛铅头钩加软胶尾饵适合贴底，游泳型硬饵用来搜索沙洲和水道附近的浅水。钓完用淡水冲洗饵和钩，生锈的钩要换掉。

items.question: Which lures work in a small creek?
items.question_zh: 小溪流中适合用哪些饵？
items.short: Small inline spinners, small jigs and small crankbaits.
items.body: In a small creek, lures of 1/32 to 1/8 ounce are common. Cast upstream or across and reel just fast enough to keep the blade turning. Use a small soft plastic on a light jig for pockets and pools. In shallow water a small floating crankbait runs above snags and can be twitched over logs. Keep your distance, because fish in small water are easily spooked.
items.short_zh: 小型旋转亮片、小铅头钩和小型 crankbait。
items.body_zh: 小溪里常用 1/32 到 1/8 盎司的饵。往上游或横向抛，收线速度只要能让叶片转起来就行。水窝和小潭用轻铅头钩配小软饵。浅水里，小型浮水 crankbait 能从障碍物上方游过，也能抖动着越过木头。保持距离，小水域的鱼很容易受惊。

items.question: How should a buzzbait be retrieved so it stays on the surface?
items.question_zh: 怎样收线才能让 buzzbait 保持在水面？
items.short: Start reeling as soon as it lands, with the rod tip up.
items.body: The blade lifts the lure by spinning, so it needs steady speed. Reel fast at first to bring it to the surface, then slow down until it is just churning. Hold the rod higher to keep it up, and speed up if it starts to sink. A buzzbait is a shallow-water lure that works in low light and over cover.
items.short_zh: 饵一落水就开始收线，竿尖抬高。
items.body_zh: buzzbait 靠叶片旋转把饵托起来，所以速度要稳定。开始时快收，让它浮到水面，然后放慢到叶片刚好翻动水面。竿抬高一点能让它不下沉，如果开始下沉就加速。buzzbait 用于浅水，适合光线弱的时候和障碍物上方。

items.question: How does a lipless crankbait differ from a lipped crankbait in where and how it is fished?
items.question_zh: 无唇 crankbait 和有唇 crankbait，在使用位置和操作方式上有什么不同？
items.short: A lipless crankbait sinks and can be fished at any depth. A lipped one dives to a set depth when reeled.
items.body: A lipless bait is flat-sided, casts far and works well over grass: reel it fast, then let it fall. A lipped crankbait floats or suspends at rest, and its lip sets its running depth. It also deflects off rocks and wood, which can trigger strikes. Pick lipped baits for a known depth, and lipless baits to search flats and open areas.
items.short_zh: 无唇 crankbait 会下沉，可以钓任何水层。有唇的在收线时潜到固定深度。
items.body_zh: 无唇饵侧面扁平，抛得远，在水草上方很好用：快收，再让它下落。有唇 crankbait 静止时上浮或悬停，唇舌决定下潜深度。它碰到岩石和木头会弹开，这也能引起鱼的攻击。已知水深时用有唇饵，搜索浅滩和开阔水域用无唇饵。

items.question: What trailers suit a bladed jig, and how does trailer choice change its action?
items.question_zh: bladed jig 适合哪些尾饵？尾饵的选择会怎样改变它的动作？
items.short: Swimbaits and craw-shaped plastics are common.
items.body: A small paddle-tail swimbait adds thump and bulk. A straight-tail or grub adds less drag, so the blade vibrates faster. Thicker trailers make the jig run higher and slower. Match the trailer's size to the jig and rig it straight so the blade still kicks side to side. If the blade stops thumping, the trailer is too big or too long.
items.short_zh: 常用 swimbait 和螯虾形软饵。
items.body_zh: 小型桨尾 swimbait 能增加振动感和体积。直尾或卷尾软饵阻力小，叶片振动更快。尾饵越粗，饵游得越高越慢。尾饵的大小要和 bladed jig 相配，挂直，叶片才能左右摆动。如果叶片的振动消失了，就是尾饵太大或太长。

items.question: How do I choose a jig head weight for a given soft plastic and depth?
items.question_zh: 针对特定的软饵和水深，铅头钩的重量怎么选？
items.short: Use the lightest head that lets you feel the bottom and keeps the lure where it belongs.
items.body: A common range is 1/32 to 1/16 ounce for crappie and 1/8 to 1/4 ounce for tubes, Ned rigs, walleye and bass. In wind, current or deeper water, go heavier. A rough start is 1/8 ounce down to about 10 feet and 1/4 ounce from 10 to 20 feet. If you can't feel it touch bottom, go heavier. If it falls too fast or snags constantly, go lighter. Bulky plastics sink more slowly.
items.short_zh: 用能感觉到水底、又能让饵留在目标水层的最轻铅头。
items.body_zh: 常见范围是：莓鲈 1/32 到 1/16 盎司，管状软饵、内德钓组、大眼梭鲈和鲈鱼 1/8 到 1/4 盎司。有风、有水流或水深时加重。粗略的起点是：约 10 英尺以内用 1/8 盎司，10 到 20 英尺用 1/4 盎司。感觉不到触底就加重；下落太快或总挂底就减轻。体积大的软饵下沉更慢。

items.question: What rod and line setup makes very light lures castable?
items.question_zh: 什么样的竿线配置能把很轻的饵抛出去？
items.short: A light or ultralight spinning rod, thin line and a small reel.
items.body: The rod has to bend under the lure's weight, so look for a soft-tipped rod rated at about 1/32 to 1/8 ounce. Thin line of 2 to 4 lb mono or 4 to 6 lb braid comes off easily and adds distance. Fill the spool to just below the rim. A longer rod of about 7 feet helps a little, and a smooth forward sweep beats force.
items.short_zh: 轻或超轻直柄竿、细线和小轮。
items.body_zh: 饵的重量要能把竿压弯，所以要选竿尖柔软、标称约 1/32 到 1/8 盎司的竿。2 到 4 磅尼龙线或 4 到 6 磅编织线出线顺畅，能抛得更远。线上到杯沿下方一点。约 7 英尺的竿稍有帮助，平顺地向前送比用蛮力好。

items.question: Why do some soft plastics melt when stored together with other lures?
items.question_zh: 为什么有些软饵和其他饵放在一起会熔化？
items.short: Soft baits are not all the same material, and some react when they touch.
items.body: Most are PVC-based plastisol softened with a plasticizer. Very stretchy baits are TPE or Z-Man's ElaZtech. Mix the types and they can soften, stick or fuse, and heat and sun speed it up. Keep each kind in its original bag, away from hot cars and direct sun, and keep ElaZtech and other stretchy baits away from regular plastics. Texas Parks and Wildlife gives the same advice about separate, original packaging. Some tackle trays may be affected too, but the reports conflict, so a bag inside the tray is the safe choice. Colors can also bleed between baits.
items.short_zh: 软饵并不都是同一种材料，有些放在一起接触后就会发生反应。
items.body_zh: 多数软饵是加了增塑剂的 PVC 溶胶（plastisol），弹性很强的软饵则是 TPE 或 Z-Man 的 ElaZtech。不同材质混放，可能变软、粘连甚至熔成一团，高温和日晒会加快这个过程。每种软饵都放在原包装袋里，不要放在闷热的车里或阳光下，ElaZtech 和其他弹性软饵要和普通软饵分开。德克萨斯州公园与野生动物部也建议分开放、保留原包装。有些渔具盒隔板也可能受影响，但说法不一，所以稳妥的做法是连袋放进盒子。不同颜色的软饵放在一起还可能串色。

items.question: Which kinds of tackle box material are safe for stretchy TPE-type soft plastics?
items.question_zh: 哪些材质的渔具盒可以安全存放 TPE 类的弹性软饵？
items.short: Keep them in their own bags rather than relying on any box material.
items.body: Reports conflict on which plastics react with TPE or ElaZtech baits. Some tackle box makers sell trays described as safe for soft plastics, but that doesn't always cover TPE or ElaZtech. Keep baits in original packaging or a dedicated bag, even inside a box, and keep boxes out of hot vehicles. If you really want them loose, test a single bait in a new tray for a few weeks.
items.short_zh: 放在各自的袋子里，不要依赖渔具盒的材质。
items.body_zh: 哪些塑料会和 TPE 或 ElaZtech 软饵反应，说法并不一致。有些厂家的隔板写着可放软饵，但不一定包括 TPE 或 ElaZtech。即使放在盒子里，也要留在原包装或专用袋中，盒子也不要放在闷热的车里。如果真想散放，先在新隔板里放一个饵，试几周。

items.question: Do fish attractant scents make a measurable difference?
items.question_zh: 鱼类诱引气味剂有可测量的效果吗？
items.short: Sometimes, but the evidence is limited and it depends on the fish.
items.body: Scent matters for fish that feed by smell and taste, such as catfish. Less is known about bass and other sight feeders, though scent may keep a fish holding a bait a moment longer. Few controlled comparisons are available, so treat claims with caution. It is cheap to try, but it won't replace getting depth and location right. Wash sunscreen and bug spray off your hands, because those smells can put fish off.
items.short_zh: 有时有，但证据有限，也要看是什么鱼。
items.body_zh: 鲶鱼这类靠嗅觉和味觉觅食的鱼，气味确实重要。鲈鱼等靠视觉的鱼了解得少一些，不过气味可能让鱼多含饵一会儿。严格对照的比较不多，对宣传要谨慎。试一试花不了多少钱，但它代替不了选对水深和位置。手上的防晒霜和驱虫剂要洗掉，这些气味可能把鱼吓走。

items.question: How can soft plastics be kept from drying out or losing their shape?
items.question_zh: 怎样防止软饵变干或变形？
items.short: Keep them flat in their original bags, away from heat and sun.
items.body: Plastics lose oil and stiffen when left out, and heat warps them. Store them flat in original packaging in a cool place, and don't leave them on a boat deck or a car dashboard. If a bait has bent, warm water can relax it. Salt Strong suggests that a little oil-based attractant in the bag can help keep baits slick.
items.short_zh: 平放在原包装袋里，远离高温和日晒。
items.body_zh: 软饵放在外面会失去油分而变硬，高温会让它变形。平放在原包装里，放在阴凉处，不要留在船甲板或汽车仪表台上。软饵弯了，用温水泡一下可以恢复。Salt Strong 提到，在袋子里加一点油性诱引剂，有助于保持软饵润滑。

items.question: Are there practical ways to reduce the amount of soft plastic left in the water?
items.question_zh: 有哪些实用的方法可以减少遗留在水中的软饵？
items.short: Use durable baits, retire torn ones and take used plastics home.
items.body: Buy baits that hold up and rig them properly so fewer tear off. Swap torn baits before they fall off, and keep used ones in a bag rather than dropping them over the side. A hook with a bait keeper helps. Biodegradable baits are an option, though they don't always last as long on the hook.
items.short_zh: 用耐用的饵，破了就换，用过的带回家。
items.body_zh: 买结实一点的饵，挂法正确，就不容易撕脱。破了的饵在掉下去之前换掉，用过的放进袋子，不要丢到水里。带挂饵器的钩也有帮助。可降解的饵也是一种选择，不过在钩上不一定撑得久。

items.question: How can I find a discontinued lure or a close substitute?
items.question_zh: 怎样找到已停产的饵，或与之相近的替代品？
items.short: Search by exact name and model number, then by shape, size and action.
items.body: Look on secondhand sites, in collector groups, in the clearance sections of tackle shops and on auction sites. The maker's customer service may know whether it was replaced under a new name. For a substitute, choose a similar length, weight, depth rating and color. Keep one original for comparison, and buy a few spares when you find it.
items.short_zh: 先按准确的名称和型号搜索，再按形状、大小和动作找。
items.body_zh: 可以看二手网站、收藏爱好者团体、渔具店清仓区和拍卖网站。问问厂家客服，它可能换了名字继续卖。找替代品时，选长度、重量、潜深和颜色相近的。留一个原饵用来对比，找到后多买几个备用。

items.question: How can I judge whether an online tackle seller is trustworthy?
items.question_zh: 怎样判断一家线上渔具商是否可靠？
items.short: Check its contact details, return policy and independent reviews.
items.body: A real street address, a phone number, clear return and shipping terms and a secure checkout are good signs. Be careful with deep discounts on popular reels, unfamiliar sites with pushy countdown offers, or payment only by wire transfer. Ask whether it is an authorized dealer, since that can affect the warranty. Pay by credit card where possible for buyer protection.
items.short_zh: 看联系方式、退货政策和独立评价。
items.body_zh: 有真实的街道地址和电话，退货和运费条款清楚，结账安全，这些都是好迹象。对热门轮的超低折扣、不熟悉的网站上催促下单的倒计时、只收电汇的卖家，都要小心。看看它是不是授权经销商，这可能影响保修。尽量用信用卡付款，有消费保障。

items.question: Is it worth ordering directly from Japanese tackle sites, considering shipping and import costs?
items.question_zh: 考虑运费和进口费用后，直接从日本渔具网站下单值得吗？
items.short: Only for items you can't find locally, or when the total price is still lower.
items.body: Add shipping, duties and possible handling fees to the listed price, and allow for slower delivery and difficult returns. Warranty usually doesn't transfer. It can make sense for models or colors not sold at home. Compare with importers in your country, whose prices may be higher but include service. Customs rules change, so check the current thresholds.
items.short_zh: 只有本地买不到，或者总价仍然更低时才值得。
items.body_zh: 在标价上加上运费、关税和可能的手续费，还要考虑发货慢、退货难。保修通常不能转移。如果是本地没有的型号或颜色，可以考虑。也比较一下本国的进口商，价格可能高一些，但包含售后。海关规定会变，要查当前的免税额度。

items.question: Which details should be checked before buying fishing gear from overseas?
items.question_zh: 从海外购买渔具前，应该核对哪些细节？
items.short: Total cost, compatibility, warranty and whether it can legally be brought in or used.
items.body: Confirm the model code and handle side, the units used for line and weight, and shipping and duty costs. Check whether the maker's warranty applies in your country and who pays for return shipping. Rules on items such as lead sinkers and live or preserved bait vary by place, so check them before ordering.
items.short_zh: 总成本、兼容性、保修，以及能否合法带入和使用。
items.body_zh: 确认型号代码和手把方向、线和重量的单位，以及运费和关税。看厂家保修在你的国家是否有效，退货运费由谁出。铅坠、活饵或腌制饵这类物品，各地规定不同，下单前要查清楚。

items.question: Where should anglers in Canada look for online tackle retailers?
items.question_zh: 加拿大的钓鱼人可以在哪里找线上渔具零售商？
items.short: Start with Canadian retailers, so prices include Canadian shipping and duties.
items.body: Large national sporting-goods chains and regional tackle shops often sell online and ship within Canada. Buying domestically avoids border fees and makes returns easier. FishEye doesn't list specific stores here because they change. Ask a local shop or a provincial angling association which retailers they trust, and compare the total price with tax and shipping. Provincial rules on items such as barbless hooks are worth reading before you buy.
items.short_zh: 先找加拿大本土的零售商，价格里已包含当地的运费和关税。
items.body_zh: 大型全国性体育用品连锁店和地方渔具店，很多都在网上销售，并在加拿大境内发货。在境内买可以省去边境费用，退货也方便。这里不列具体店名，因为变化很快。可以问问当地渔具店或省级钓鱼协会信任哪些零售商，再比较含税和运费的总价。购买前查一下所在省对无倒刺钩等物品的规定。

items.question: Where should anglers in the EU look for online tackle retailers?
items.question_zh: 欧盟的钓鱼人可以在哪里找线上渔具零售商？
items.short: Start with retailers based in the EU, which avoids customs charges.
items.body: Buying inside the EU generally avoids customs duty and gives you EU consumer rights, including a withdrawal period on most online purchases. Buying from outside the EU, including from the UK, may add VAT and customs fees. National angling federations and local shops can recommend reputable stores. Compare the total delivered cost and check that returns are clear.
items.short_zh: 先找欧盟境内的零售商，可以避免海关费用。
items.body_zh: 在欧盟境内购买，一般不用交关税，还享有欧盟的消费者权利，包括多数网购的撤销期。从欧盟以外购买，包括从英国购买，可能要加增值税和海关费用。各国钓鱼协会和当地渔具店可以推荐可靠的店。比较到手总价，并确认退货条款清楚。

items.question: What is the minimum gear a new angler needs for a first trip to a local lake?
items.question_zh: 新手第一次去附近湖泊钓鱼，最少需要哪些装备？
items.short: A spooled rod and reel, small hooks, split shot, a bobber, bait, pliers, and a license if you need one.
items.body: That means a spincast or spinning outfit already spooled with 6 to 10 lb mono, a pack of No. 6 to 8 hooks, a few split shot, two or three bobbers and a tub of nightcrawlers. Add needle-nose pliers, a small tackle box, and a life jacket if you'll be on or near deep water. Lures, a net and a second rod can wait until you know what you like to fish for.
items.short_zh: 上好线的竿和轮、小钩、咬铅、浮漂、饵、钳子，需要的话还有钓鱼证。
items.body_zh: 也就是一套已经上好 6 到 10 磅尼龙线的卡式轮或纺车轮钓具，一包 6 到 8 号钩，几粒咬铅，两三个浮漂和一盒蚯蚓。再加尖嘴钳、一个小渔具盒；如果要在深水上或靠近深水，还要有救生衣。拟饵、抄网和第二根竿，等你知道自己喜欢钓什么再买。

items.question: Should a beginner buy a rod-and-reel combo or choose the rod and reel separately?
items.question_zh: 新手应该买竿轮套装，还是分别选竿和轮？
items.short: Buy a combo for your first setup.
items.body: It's cheaper, the rod and reel are already matched, and many come with line on the reel, so you can fish the same day. Look for a spinning or spincast combo with a medium-light rod of about 5½ to 6½ feet, suited to 4 to 12 lb line. If the factory line comes off in coils, replace it. Buy the rod and reel separately once you know what you like to fish for and can name what you want to improve, such as a lighter rod or a smoother drag.
items.short_zh: 第一套建议买竿轮套装。
items.body_zh: 它更便宜，竿和轮已经配好，很多还带着线，当天就能去钓。选纺车轮或卡式轮套装，竿选中轻硬度，长度约 5½ 到 6½ 英尺，适合 4 到 12 磅的线。如果原厂线放出来一圈圈卷着，就换新线。等你知道自己喜欢钓什么，也说得出想改进什么，比如更轻的竿或更顺滑的卸力，再分开买。

items.question: Which single setup is the most versatile for someone who does not yet know what they will fish for?
items.question_zh: 还不确定要钓什么鱼的人，哪一套配置最通用？
items.short: A 6 to 7 foot medium-light or medium spinning rod with a 2500 or 3000 reel.
items.body: Load it with 6 to 10 lb mono. It handles bait under a bobber, small jigs, spinners and light crankbaits, and it can land panfish, bass, trout and walleye. If you are setting up for a child, a spincast combo is simpler.
items.short_zh: 6 到 7 英尺的中轻或中等硬度直柄竿，配 2500 或 3000 号轮。
items.body_zh: 上 6 到 10 磅尼龙线。它能用浮漂钓天然饵，也能用小铅头钩、旋转亮片和轻型 crankbait，小型淡水鱼、鲈鱼、鳟鱼和大眼梭鲈都能应付。给孩子配的话，卡式轮套装更简单。

items.question: What should go into a basic tackle kit, and what can wait?
items.question_zh: 基础渔具盒里应该放什么？哪些可以以后再买？
items.short: Hooks, split shot, bobbers, pliers and a few simple lures first.
items.body: Start with hooks in sizes 6 to 8, split shot, a couple of bobbers, a small egg sinker and swivels, clippers and needle-nose pliers. Add a few soft plastics on jig heads, one small spinner and one crankbait. Specialty lures, electronics and extra rods can wait until you know what you like.
items.short_zh: 先买钩、咬铅、浮漂、钳子和几个简单的饵。
items.body_zh: 先准备 6 到 8 号钩、咬铅、一两个浮漂、小橄榄铅和转环、剪线钳和尖嘴钳。再加几个铅头钩配软饵、一个小旋转亮片和一个 crankbait。特殊的饵、电子设备和更多的竿，等你知道自己喜欢什么再说。

items.question: Is a spinning setup always the right first choice?
items.question_zh: 第一套钓具一定要选纺车轮吗？
items.short: No. A spincast reel can be a better first choice for children and casual bait fishing.
items.body: A spinning setup is the most versatile and the natural first choice for adults who plan to stick with it. A spincast reel is simpler and avoids tangles at the start. A cane pole is simplest of all: no casting, no reeling, and it catches panfish well along a bank. A baitcaster is not the reel to learn to cast on. Connecticut's fishing course goes further and recommends spincast for any beginner, while noting that spinning gear is the better tool once you've practiced.
items.short_zh: 不一定。对孩子和偶尔钓天然饵的人来说，卡式轮可能更好。
items.body_zh: 纺车轮最通用，打算长期钓鱼的成年人，自然可以先选它。卡式轮更简单，一开始不容易缠线。手竿最简单：不用抛投也不用摇轮，沿岸钓小型淡水鱼很好用。水滴轮不适合用来学抛投。康涅狄格的钓鱼课程更进一步，建议所有初学者都从卡式轮开始，同时也说练熟之后纺车轮更好用。

items.question: What can a complete starter setup include for under $50?
items.question_zh: 低于 50 美元的完整入门配置可以包括什么？
items.short: A spincast or basic spinning combo, hooks, sinkers, bobbers and bait.
items.body: A simple combo usually costs about $25 to $40 and comes with line. Add a pack of hooks, split shot, bobbers, a pair of pliers and a tub of worms, which keeps you under $50. Look for hooks in sizes 6 to 10 and line of 4 to 8 lb, the range beginner guides from federal and state agencies suggest. That kit is enough to catch panfish, small bass and stocked trout. License costs are separate in most states. Prices vary, so choose function over features at this level. A casting plug costs little and lets you practice at home. Discount and hardware stores often sell all of this.
items.short_zh: 一套卡式轮或基础纺车轮套装，加上钩、铅坠、浮漂和饵。
items.body_zh: 简单的套装一般 25 到 40 美元，带线。再买一包钩、咬铅、浮漂、一把钳子和一盒蚯蚓，总共可以控制在 50 美元以内。钩子选 6 到 10 号，线选 4 到 8 磅，这是联邦和州机构入门指南建议的范围。这已经够钓小型淡水鱼、小鲈鱼和放流鳟了。多数州的钓鱼证要另外花钱。价格会变，这个价位以实用为主。练习塞很便宜，可以在家练抛投。折扣店和五金店通常也卖这些。

items.question: What is the best way to spend $50 to under $100 on a first setup?
items.question_zh: 第一套配置有 50 美元至不足 100 美元时，怎么花最好？
items.short: Buy a decent spinning combo, then spend the rest on terminal tackle.
items.body: Put about $40 to $70 into the combo, and look for a smooth drag and a comfortable rod. Spend the rest on hooks, split shot, bobbers, pliers, a small tackle box, a few lures, and fresh line if the factory line is old. If you'll be on or near deep water, a life jacket comes first.
items.short_zh: 买一套不错的纺车轮套装，剩下的钱买终端配件。
items.body_zh: 套装花 40 到 70 美元，要选卸力顺滑、竿握着舒服的。其余的钱买钩、咬铅、浮漂、钳子、小渔具盒和几个拟饵；如果原厂线太旧，再买新线。如果要在深水上或靠近深水，救生衣要排在最前面。

items.question: What does a budget of $100 to under $200 add for a beginner?
items.question_zh: 100 美元至不足 200 美元的预算，能给新手多带来什么？
items.short: A better rod and reel, a landing net and a more complete tackle box.
items.body: You can buy a rod and reel separately for about $60 to $100 together, with a better drag and a lighter rod. Add a net, a small selection of lures, polarized sunglasses and a comfortable bag. If you need a life jacket, buy that first. Avoid specialty gear at this stage. A second rod for a different technique will serve you better than an expensive first one.
items.short_zh: 更好的竿和轮、一把抄网，以及更齐全的渔具盒。
items.body_zh: 竿和轮可以分开买，合计 60 到 100 美元，卸力更好，竿也更轻。再加抄网、少量拟饵、偏光镜和一个舒服的包。如果需要救生衣，先买救生衣。这个阶段不要买专用装备。与其买一套昂贵的第一套，不如再配一根用于不同钓法的竿。

items.question: What is a good first setup for bass and panfish?
items.question_zh: 钓鲈鱼和小型淡水鱼，第一套配置怎么选？
items.short: A 6 to 7 foot medium-light or medium spinning rod with a 2500 or 3000 reel and 6 to 10 lb line.
items.body: For panfish, use a small hook, split shot and a bobber with a piece of worm. For bass, use a plastic grub on a 1/8 to 1/4 ounce jig head, or a small spinnerbait. FishEye's beginner bass setup is a medium-action spinning rod with 6 to 8 lb line and that same jig. Bring pliers, and a net for bigger fish.
items.short_zh: 6 到 7 英尺的中轻或中等硬度直柄竿，配 2500 或 3000 号轮和 6 到 10 磅线。
items.body_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼时，用小钩、咬铅和浮漂，挂一小段蚯蚓。钓鲈鱼时，用 1/8 到 1/4 盎司铅头钩配软胶卷尾，或者小型 spinnerbait。FishEye 给新手的鲈鱼配置，是中等调性的直柄竿配 6 到 8 磅线和同样的铅头钩。带上钳子，钓大一点的鱼还要带抄网。

items.question: What is a good first setup for trout in streams?
items.question_zh: 在溪流钓鳟鱼，第一套配置怎么选？
items.short: A light or ultralight spinning rod with 4 to 6 lb line and small hooks.
items.body: Use a short rod, hooks of size 10 to 14, and just enough split shot to get down in fast water. Half a nightcrawler or a small spinner works well. Cast upstream and let the bait drift back. Wear dull colors and walk quietly. Many trout streams have special rules, so find out whether bait or lures are allowed on that water.
items.short_zh: 轻或超轻直柄竿，配 4 到 6 磅线和小钩。
items.body_zh: 用短竿、10 到 14 号钩，咬铅的重量刚好能在急流中沉下去就行。半条蚯蚓或小旋转亮片都很好用。往上游抛，让饵顺水漂回来。穿暗色衣服，走路要轻。很多鳟鱼溪流有特别规定，出发前确认那里是否允许用天然饵或拟饵。

items.question: What is a good first setup for saltwater fishing from shore?
items.question_zh: 岸上海钓，第一套配置怎么选？
items.short: A 7 to 9 foot spinning rod, a 3000 to 5000 saltwater reel and 10 to 20 lb line.
items.body: A simple bottom rig or a jig is enough at first, and shrimp or cut bait is an easy start. Around oyster beds and pilings, begin with a float about 2 feet above the hook in water under 10 feet, or a sliding ½-ounce egg sinker on a 2-foot leader. A sand spike, pliers, a knife and a bucket are useful. Rinse your gear gently with fresh water after each trip. Find out the saltwater license requirements and size limits where you plan to fish. On open beaches a rod of 8 to 12 feet reaches past the breakers, but the deeper troughs right off the sand often fish best, and lighter gear works there.
items.short_zh: 7 到 9 英尺的直柄竿、3000 到 5000 号海水轮和 10 到 20 磅线。
items.body_zh: 一开始用简单的底钓组或铅头钩就够了，虾或切块饵最容易上手。在牡蛎礁和桥桩附近，水深不到 10 英尺时先用浮漂，钩子放在浮漂下约 2 英尺；或者用 ½ 盎司的游动橄榄铅，配 2 英尺前导。沙地插竿器、钳子、小刀和水桶都很有用。每次钓完用淡水轻轻冲洗装备。出发前了解当地对海水钓鱼证和尺寸的规定。开阔海滩上，8 到 12 英尺的竿能抛过碎浪区，但紧贴沙滩的深水沟往往更好钓，那里用轻一点的装备就行。

items.question: What has changed enough in fishing gear over the past decade or two to be worth buying new?
items.question_zh: 过去一二十年里，渔具有哪些变化大到值得买新的？
items.short: Braided line, lighter graphite rods, and better reel drags and brakes.
items.body: Modern braid is thin, strong and easier to handle than older versions. Lighter graphite has made rods much better at lower prices. Reels are smoother and lighter, with more consistent drags and better brakes on baitcasters. Fish finders have become far more capable and cheaper. Good older gear can still work fine, so replace what actually limits you.
items.short_zh: 编织线、更轻的碳素竿，以及更好的卸力和刹车。
items.body_zh: 现在的编织线细、强度高，也比以前好打理。更轻的碳素材料，让竿在较低价位上就好了很多。轮更顺更轻，卸力更稳定，水滴轮的刹车也更好。探鱼器功能强了很多，价格也更便宜。好的旧装备仍然可以用，只换真正限制你的东西就好。

items.question: Which piece of gear should be upgraded first to get the biggest improvement?
items.question_zh: 先升级哪件装备，提升最明显？
items.short: Line first, then the reel's drag, then the rod.
items.body: Fresh line is cheap and solves many problems. After that, a smoother reel with a reliable drag saves fish and frustration, and a better rod gives you more feel. If you mainly fish lures on the bottom, the rod might come first. Polarized sunglasses are a low-cost addition that can change how you fish.
items.short_zh: 先换线，再升级轮的卸力，然后才是竿。
items.body_zh: 新线便宜，能解决很多问题。接下来，一只卸力可靠、转动顺滑的轮，能少跑鱼、少生气；更好的竿能带来更好的手感。如果你主要钓贴底的饵，也可以先换竿。偏光镜花费不多，却可能改变你的钓鱼方式。

items.question: Is old gear still usable after many years in storage, and what should be replaced first?
items.question_zh: 放了很多年的旧装备还能用吗？应该先更换什么？
items.short: Usually yes. Replace the line first, then clean and lubricate the reel.
items.body: Old mono is brittle, so strip it off. Inspect the rod guides for cracks and looseness, and check the reel's drag, which can stick if it was left tight. Clean and oil the reel according to the maker's instructions. Old soft plastics may have melted into a mess and hooks may be rusty, so replace those. Most rods stored out of the sun are fine.
items.short_zh: 一般还能用。先换线，再清洁、润滑轮。
items.body_zh: 旧尼龙线已经发脆，要全部放掉。检查导环有没有裂纹或松动，再看卸力，如果长期拧紧存放，可能会卡住。按厂家说明清洁和上油。旧软饵可能已经熔成一团，钩也可能生锈，这些都要换。避开日晒存放的竿，多数都没问题。

items.question: How can I build a second rod setup that complements the first rather than duplicating it?
items.question_zh: 怎样配第二套钓具，使它和第一套互补，而不是重复？
items.short: Pick a second outfit for what your first can't do.
items.body: If your first is a medium-light spinning rod, a medium-heavy baitcaster will handle heavier lures and heavy cover. If your first is a medium spinning rod for bass, add a lighter rod for panfish or finesse plastics. Line matters too: lighter line on one and braid on the other extends your range more than a second similar rod would.
items.short_zh: 第二套要选第一套做不到的。
items.body_zh: 如果第一套是中轻硬度直柄竿，第二套可以是中硬枪柄竿，用来应付重饵和重障碍区。如果第一套是钓鲈鱼的中等硬度直柄竿，就加一根轻竿钓小型淡水鱼或用微物软饵。线也很重要：一套用细线，一套用编织线，比再买一根差不多的竿覆盖面更广。

items.question: What are safe gift ideas for an angler when you do not know their gear?
items.question_zh: 不了解对方装备时，给钓鱼的人送什么比较稳妥？
items.short: Useful tools and clothing that work with any setup.
items.body: Good pliers, line clippers, polarized sunglasses, a quality hat, a soft tackle bag, a gift card from a tackle shop or a fishing magazine subscription are all safe choices. Avoid rods, reels and specific lures unless you know what they use. Consumables such as hooks are safe only if you know the kinds they prefer.
items.short_zh: 实用的工具和衣物，什么装备都能配。
items.body_zh: 好钳子、剪线钳、偏光镜、质量好的帽子、软质渔具包、渔具店礼品卡或钓鱼杂志订阅，都比较稳妥。除非知道对方用什么，否则不要买竿、轮和特定的饵。钩这类消耗品，也只有知道对方偏好时才合适。

items.question: Which fishing accessories are useful to almost everyone regardless of technique?
items.question_zh: 哪些钓鱼配件几乎对所有钓法的人都有用？
items.short: Pliers, line clippers, polarized sunglasses, a hook file and a net.
items.body: A bag or small tackle box, sunscreen, a first-aid kit and a headlamp are also useful. Waterproof bags help on any boat or kayak. A hook file keeps points sharp. A net matters if they fish for trout or larger fish.
items.short_zh: 钳子、剪线钳、偏光镜、磨钩锉和抄网。
items.body_zh: 包或小渔具盒、防晒霜、急救包和头灯也很有用。防水袋在任何船或皮划艇上都用得上。磨钩锉能让钩尖保持锋利。如果对方钓鳟鱼或大一些的鱼，抄网就很重要。

items.question: What information should be gathered quietly before buying someone a rod or reel?
items.question_zh: 给别人买竿或轮之前，应该先悄悄了解哪些信息？
items.short: What they fish for, what they already use, and which hand they reel with.
items.body: Look at their current setup: rod length and power, reel size and line. Note whether they use spinning or baitcasting gear and which side the handle is on. Find out what fish and what water they fish. A photo of the label on their favorite rod tells you a lot. A gift receipt helps if it doesn't suit them.
items.short_zh: 他们钓什么鱼、现在用什么装备，以及用哪只手摇轮。
items.body_zh: 看看对方现有的配置：竿长、硬度、轮的大小和线。注意是纺车轮还是水滴轮，手把在哪一边。了解他们钓什么鱼、在什么水域钓。给对方最常用的竿拍一张标签照片，能知道很多信息。万一不合适，礼品收据能派上用场。

items.question: Are subscription tackle boxes a good gift?
items.question_zh: 按月寄送的渔具盒适合当礼物吗？
items.short: They are fun for beginners and casual anglers, less useful for experienced ones.
items.body: Monthly boxes bring surprise lures and can introduce new techniques. For an experienced angler they may be duplicates or not suit their water. Pick a box matched to the fish they target, check whether the subscription renews automatically, and consider a fixed-term gift.
items.short_zh: 对新手和休闲钓友来说很有趣，对有经验的人用处不大。
items.body_zh: 每月一盒，有惊喜，也能带来新的钓法。对有经验的人来说，可能重复，或者不适合他们的水域。要选和目标鱼相配的盒子，确认是否自动续订，最好选固定期限的礼品订阅。

items.question: What is a thoughtful fishing gift under $50?
items.question_zh: 低于 50 美元，有什么用心的钓鱼礼物？
items.short: A good pair of pliers, polarized sunglasses or a small lure assortment.
items.body: A quality hat or sun hoodie, a small waterproof bag or a book on their favorite fish also works. If you know the line they like, give a spool of it, and a fillet knife suits someone who keeps fish. A gift card to their usual shop is also welcome.
items.short_zh: 一把好钳子、偏光镜或一小套拟饵。
items.body_zh: 也可以选质量好的帽子或防晒连帽衫、小防水袋；如果知道对方喜欢的线，可以送一卷好线；常留鱼吃的人可以送片鱼刀；或者一本讲对方最喜欢的鱼的书。对方常去的渔具店的礼品卡也很受欢迎。

items.question: What is a good fishing gift for $50 to under $100?
items.question_zh: 50 美元至不足 100 美元，有什么好的钓鱼礼物？
items.short: A landing net, a tackle bag or good polarized sunglasses.
items.body: Other choices are a quality fillet knife kit, a rod case, a wading belt or a deposit toward a guided day. A rod only works if you know what they already own. A gift card toward something they really want often beats a guess.
items.short_zh: 抄网、渔具包或好的偏光镜。
items.body_zh: 也可以选质量好的片鱼刀套装、竿包、涉水腰带，或者向导一日游的订金。只有知道对方已经有什么时，才适合送竿。与其瞎猜，不如送张礼品卡，让对方买真正想要的东西。

items.question: What should be checked on a used reel before paying for it?
items.question_zh: 购买二手轮之前，应该检查什么？
items.short: Turn it under load, test the drag and look for corrosion.
items.body: Turn the handle slowly and feel for grinding or play. On a spinning reel, check that the bail closes cleanly, the line roller turns and the anti-reverse holds. On a baitcaster, test free spool, brakes and the level-wind. Look for white or green corrosion around screws and the foot, and check the foot for cracks. Ask whether it was used in salt, and confirm that parts are still available.
items.short_zh: 受力时转一转，测试卸力，并查看有没有腐蚀。
items.body_zh: 慢慢转手把，感觉有没有摩擦或旷量。纺车轮要看线臂能否干脆地翻回、导线轮是否转动、防逆转是否有效。水滴轮要测试自由出线、刹车和排线器。看螺丝和轮脚周围有没有白色或绿色的腐蚀，轮脚有没有裂纹。问问是否在海水中用过，并确认还能买到配件。

items.question: What should be checked on a used rod before paying for it?
items.question_zh: 购买二手竿之前，应该检查什么？
items.short: Inspect the whole blank, every guide and the joints.
items.body: Look for cracks, especially near the joints and just above the handle. Run a cotton swab around each guide to check for grooves or chips. Check that the reel seat tightens and the handle isn't loose. Sight down the rod for a bend, flex it gently and listen for clicks. Ask whether the warranty transfers, since many apply only to the original owner.
items.short_zh: 检查整根竿身、每个导环和接口。
items.body_zh: 看有没有裂纹，尤其是接口附近和手把上方。用棉签在每个导环内转一圈，看有没有沟槽或缺口。确认轮座能拧紧，手把没有松动。顺着竿看是否弯曲，轻轻弯一下，听有没有咔嗒声。问问保修能否转移，很多保修只限原购买人。

items.question: How can I estimate a fair price for used fishing gear?
items.question_zh: 怎样估算二手渔具的合理价格？
items.short: Look at completed sales, not asking prices.
items.body: On auction sites, filter by sold items and compare condition, age and included parts. A common starting point is about half of the current new price for clean gear, lower for older models or cosmetic damage, and higher for sought-after or collectible items. Consider shipping and the cost of a service or new line. Popular discontinued models sometimes hold their value.
items.short_zh: 看实际成交价，不要看挂牌价。
items.body_zh: 在拍卖网站上筛选已售出的商品，比较成色、年代和配件。常见的起点是：成色好的按当前新品价的一半左右，老款或有外观损伤的更低，抢手或有收藏价值的更高。还要算上运费、保养和换线的费用。热门的停产型号有时很保值。

items.question: What is the best way to sell or give away fishing gear that is no longer needed?
items.question_zh: 不再需要的渔具，最好怎么卖掉或送出去？
items.short: Sell good gear through local listings or auction sites, and donate the rest.
items.body: Clean it, photograph it clearly and describe any wear honestly. Sell valuable items on auction sites and simple gear locally. Youth programs, schools, scout troops and some conservation agencies accept donated tackle. Old line goes in a recycling bin where one is available. Keep rusty hooks and damaged tackle out of donations.
items.short_zh: 好装备通过本地信息或拍卖网站卖掉，其余的捐出去。
items.body_zh: 清洁干净，拍清楚，如实说明磨损。值钱的放到拍卖网站，普通的在本地出售。青少年项目、学校、童子军和一些保护机构接受捐赠的渔具。旧线有回收箱的话就放进回收箱。生锈的钩和损坏的渔具不要捐。

items.question: How can I tell whether a store discount is a real deal?
items.question_zh: 怎样判断商店的折扣是不是真的划算？
items.short: Compare it with the price history and with other sellers.
items.body: Check what the item has sold for over several months, not just the list price. Retailers often discount models about to be replaced. Compare the same model code, because some sale items are made specifically for the sale and have different specifications. Consider return terms and warranty. A discount on something you don't need isn't a saving.
items.short_zh: 和历史价格、其他卖家比较。
items.body_zh: 看这件商品几个月来的实际售价，不要只看标价。零售商常常给即将换代的型号打折。比较时型号代码要相同，有些促销品是专门为促销生产的，规格不一样。还要看退货条款和保修。用不上的东西，打折也不算省钱。

items.question: How can the production year of an old reel be worked out from its markings?
items.question_zh: 怎样根据刻印判断一只旧轮的生产年份？
items.short: Use the model name, patent dates, serial number and the maker's catalogs.
items.body: Look for patent dates and serial numbers stamped on the reel. Some makers stamped date codes on the reel foot. A patent date gives only the earliest possible date. Compare details with catalogs and collector guides, such as logo styles and materials. Collector clubs can often narrow a date from clear photos.
items.short_zh: 根据型号名称、专利日期、序列号和厂家目录来判断。
items.body_zh: 找轮上刻的专利日期和序列号。有些厂家把日期代码刻在轮脚上。专利日期只能说明最早可能的年份。再和旧目录、收藏指南对照，比如标志样式和材料。收藏协会常常能根据清晰的照片缩小年代范围。

items.question: Where can old catalogs or collector information about vintage tackle be found?
items.question_zh: 老式渔具的旧目录或收藏资料可以在哪里找到？
items.short: Collector clubs, archives and scanned catalogs online.
items.body: The National Fishing Lure Collectors Club and the Old Reel Collectors Association are two North American groups that publish material on old tackle. The Internet Archive and similar digital libraries hold scanned catalogs and sporting magazines. Manufacturer histories, antique tackle shows and specialist books round out the picture. Many public libraries can borrow older titles through interlibrary loan.
items.short_zh: 收藏协会、档案馆和网上的目录扫描件。
items.body_zh: National Fishing Lure Collectors Club 和 Old Reel Collectors Association 是北美两个发布老渔具资料的团体。Internet Archive 和类似的数字图书馆有扫描的目录和运动杂志。厂家历史、古董渔具展和专业书籍可以补充更多信息。很多公共图书馆可以通过馆际互借借到旧书。

items.question: How can an old reel be cleaned without harming its finish or collector value?
items.question_zh: 怎样清洁旧轮，才不会损伤表面或收藏价值？
items.short: Clean it gently, and don't polish, repaint or replace original parts.
items.body: Wipe off dirt with a soft cloth and a little mild soap and water, then dry it right away. Use a small brush for crevices, and a little light reel oil on moving parts to prevent seizing. Avoid metal polish, abrasive pads and solvents, which can strip plating and markings. Patina is part of the value. If it might be valuable, ask a collector before taking it apart.
items.short_zh: 轻轻清洁，不要抛光、重新上漆或更换原件。
items.body_zh: 用软布蘸少量中性皂水擦去污垢，马上擦干。缝隙用小刷子，活动部位加一点轻质渔轮油防止卡死。不要用金属抛光剂、百洁布和溶剂，它们会去掉电镀层和刻印。旧物的包浆也是价值的一部分。如果可能值钱，拆开之前先问问收藏者。

items.question: Is it better to keep using an old reel, restore it, or sell it untouched?
items.question_zh: 旧轮是继续使用、修复好，还是原样卖掉更好？
items.short: It depends on whether it is worth more as a collectible or as a fishing tool.
items.body: Check its value first. A scarce reel in original condition is often worth more untouched, while common reels are fine to fish. Fishing a common reel is a good way to keep it in use; just keep it lubricated and put on fresh line. Restoration that replaces parts or refinishes metal usually lowers collector value. A family reel may be worth keeping whatever the market says.
items.short_zh: 要看它作为收藏品更值钱，还是作为钓具更有用。
items.body_zh: 先查查价值。稀有的轮保持原样通常更值钱，常见的轮尽管用来钓鱼。常见的轮继续用下去是好事，保持润滑，换上新线就行。更换零件或重新处理金属表面的修复，通常会降低收藏价值。家里传下来的轮，不管市场价多少，都值得留着。

items.question: What are the signs that an old rod is too weak to fish with?
items.question_zh: 旧竿有哪些迹象说明它强度不足，不能再用来钓鱼？
items.short: Cracks, soft spots, loose joints or brittle guides.
items.body: On bamboo, look for loose wraps, separating strips and sets, which are bends that remain. On fiberglass, look for fine cracks and crushed or splintered sections. Flex it gently and listen for cracking, and check the guides for grooves and rust. A rod with a slight set can often still fish, but a cracked one may break suddenly under load. Keep a valuable or fragile rod for display.
items.short_zh: 裂纹、发软的地方、松动的接口或发脆的导环。
items.body_zh: 竹竿要看绑线是否松脱、竹片有没有分离，以及有没有定型（弯了回不去）。玻纤竿要看细裂纹，以及压扁或裂开的地方。轻轻弯一下，听有没有开裂声，再看导环有没有沟槽和锈蚀。轻微定型的竿常常还能钓，但有裂纹的竿可能在受力时突然断掉。贵重或脆弱的竿，还是留作展示吧。

items.question: Which household cleaning products should never be used on vintage reels?
items.question_zh: 哪些家用清洁剂绝对不能用在老式渔轮上？
items.short: Avoid bleach, ammonia, abrasive cleaners, acetone and spray penetrants.
items.body: Strong chemicals can strip bluing, lacquer and printed markings, and abrasive pads scratch soft metals. Acetone and similar solvents can damage plastics and old finishes, and aerosol penetrants can wash lubrication out of bearings and gears. Daiwa also warns against spraying penetrants directly on its reels. Use a mild soap and a soft cloth.
items.short_zh: 不要用漂白剂、氨水、研磨型清洁剂、丙酮和渗透喷剂。
items.body_zh: 强化学品会去掉发蓝层、清漆和印字，研磨型的百洁布会划伤软金属。丙酮这类溶剂会损伤塑料和老式涂层，气雾型渗透剂会把轴承和齿轮里的润滑冲掉。Daiwa 也提醒不要把渗透喷剂直接喷在它的轮上。用中性皂和软布就好。

items.question: How can I evaluate a little-known tackle brand before buying from it?
items.question_zh: 在购买前，怎样评估一个不太知名的渔具品牌？
items.short: Look for a real company, a clear warranty and independent, long-term reviews.
items.body: Check how long the company has been selling and whether it provides contact details. Read reviews that describe months of use, and beware of reviews that use the same wording or appeared on one day. See whether the product is sold under other names, and compare the specifications with a known brand. If possible, buy from a store with easy returns and test the gear right away.
items.short_zh: 看是不是真实的公司、保修是否清楚，以及有没有独立的长期评价。
items.body_zh: 看公司卖了多久，有没有联系方式。多看描述用了几个月的评价，对措辞雷同或集中在同一天出现的评价要警惕。查查同样的产品有没有用别的名字卖，再和知名品牌比较规格。尽量在退货方便的店买，拿到后马上试用。

items.question: How much should online reviews count when deciding on a rod or reel?
items.question_zh: 选竿或轮时，网上评价应该占多大的参考比重？
items.short: Use them to spot repeated problems, not to rank products.
items.body: Repeated complaints about the same failure, such as a broken bail or a bad drag, tell you more than star ratings. Prefer reviews that say what the person fished for, how often and for how long. Reviews posted soon after purchase say little about durability. Treat sponsored content with caution, and look at how the reviewer got the gear.
items.short_zh: 用来发现反复出现的问题，不要用来给产品排名。
items.body_zh: 同一个故障被反复提到，比如线臂断了或卸力不好，比星级更说明问题。优先看写明钓什么鱼、多久钓一次、用了多久的评价。刚买不久发的评价，说明不了耐用性。对赞助内容要谨慎，也要看评测者的装备是怎么来的。

items.question: Which warning signs suggest that a brand is relabeling generic products?
items.question_zh: 哪些迹象说明一个品牌只是在贴牌通用产品？
items.short: Identical product photos or specifications under several brand names.
items.body: Other signs are vague technical details, no named designers or service center, and a warranty that runs only through a single online store. Search the reel or rod image and see whether the same product appears under other names. Relabeling isn't always bad, since some generic products are good, but you should pay the generic price.
items.short_zh: 同样的产品照片或规格，出现在好几个品牌名下。
items.body_zh: 其他迹象包括：技术细节含糊，没有具体的设计者或维修中心，保修只能通过某一家网店办理。用图片搜索这只轮或这根竿，看看同样的产品是否用别的名字在卖。贴牌不一定不好，有些通用产品质量不错，但价格应该是通用产品的价格。

items.question: Has a well-known brand's quality actually dropped, and how could that be checked?
items.question_zh: 某个知名品牌的质量真的下降了吗？怎样才能核实？
items.short: It's hard to prove, so look for something measurable.
items.body: Compare current specifications, materials and place of manufacture with earlier models. Look at how many repeated failures appear in reviews of the current model. Service technicians see many reels and can tell you what is failing. Complaints alone can mislead, because unhappy buyers write more. Also compare the price after inflation, since a cheap item today may simply be a lower-level product.
items.short_zh: 很难证明，所以要找可以衡量的东西。
items.body_zh: 把现在的规格、材料和产地，和早期型号比较。看看当前型号的评价里，同样的故障出现得多不多。维修技师见过很多轮，能告诉你什么最容易坏。只看投诉会有偏差，因为不满意的买家更愿意写评价。也要按通胀比较价格，现在便宜的产品，可能本来就是更低档的产品。

items.question: What rod length and reel size are a sensible start for surf fishing?
items.question_zh: 海滩投钓从多长的竿和多大的轮开始比较合理？
items.short: A 9 to 11 foot rod with a 4000 to 6000 spinning reel.
items.body: That length casts bait beyond the first trough and holds line above the waves. Use 15 to 25 lb line or 20 to 30 lb braid and sinkers of 2 to 4 ounces, more in heavy surf. Pyramid sinkers hold on sand. A shorter rod of 7 to 9 feet works on calm beaches and for casting lures, and it is easier for a shorter person to manage. Published ranges run longer in Europe: Irish guidance suggests about 12 feet and 3 to 6 ounces for most beach fishing, or 11 feet and 2 to 4 ounces in estuaries.
items.short_zh: 9 到 11 英尺的竿，配 4000 到 6000 号纺车轮。
items.body_zh: 这个长度能把饵抛过第一道水沟，也能让线高出浪头。用 15 到 25 磅的线或 20 到 30 磅编织线，铅坠 2 到 4 盎司，浪大时要更重。金字塔形铅坠在沙底抓得住。风平浪静的海滩或抛拟饵时，用 7 到 9 英尺的短一些的竿，个子不高的人也更好驾驭。欧洲常用的竿更长：爱尔兰的资料建议大多数海滩用约 12 英尺、抛重 3 到 6 盎司的竿，河口用 11 英尺、2 到 4 盎司。

items.question: How does a pier setup differ from a surf setup?
items.question_zh: 栈桥钓的配置和海滩投钓有什么不同？
items.short: A pier rod is usually shorter, because you don't need to cast as far.
items.body: A rod of 7 to 9 feet is plenty, and fish are often right below you. Use a heavier leader where pilings or barnacles can rub the line. Bottom rigs and light jigs work well. The pilings hold fish themselves, so try close to them before casting far out, and a drop rig fished straight down suits this. Bring a drop net for lifting fish from a height, since line often breaks when you lift over a rail. Some piers limit the number of rods and restrict casting, so read the posted rules.
items.short_zh: 栈桥竿通常短一些，因为不用抛那么远。
items.body_zh: 7 到 9 英尺就够了，鱼常常就在脚下。桥桩或藤壶可能磨线的地方，要用粗一点的前导。底钓组和轻型铅头钩都好用。桥桩本身就聚鱼，可以先贴着桥桩钓，再往远处抛，从栈桥垂直放下的串钩钓组很合适。带一个吊网，从高处把鱼提上来，直接越过栏杆提鱼常常会断线。看看栈桥的规定，有些限制竿数，也限制抛投。

items.question: How can a large fish be landed from a high pier?
items.question_zh: 在较高的栈桥上，怎样把大鱼弄上来？
items.short: Use a drop net made for piers, and ask for help.
items.body: A pier net is a hoop net on a rope, lowered to the surface so the fish can be led into it. Don't lift by the line, which can break under the weight of a fish out of water. Walk the fish to a low spot or to shore if you can. If a fish is going back, a net is gentler than a gaff. Gaffs aren't allowed everywhere, and you should never use one on a protected or undersized fish.
items.short_zh: 用栈桥专用的吊网，并请人帮忙。
items.body_zh: 吊网是系在绳子上的圆环网，放到水面，把鱼引进去。不要靠线提鱼，鱼离水后重量全在线上，容易断。能走到低一点的地方或岸边更好。要放流的鱼，用网比用手钩（gaff）温和。手钩不是到处都允许用，受保护或尺寸不足的鱼绝不能用。

items.question: Which essentials are often forgotten on a first surf-fishing trip?
items.question_zh: 第一次海滩投钓时，哪些必备物品常被忘记？
items.short: A sand spike, pliers, a knife, a towel, sunscreen and a bucket.
items.body: Also bring spare rigs and sinkers, a headlamp if you'll fish at dusk, a first-aid kit and plenty of water. Sand gets into everything, so keep your reel off the beach and use a rod holder. Check a tide chart, and find out whether you need a saltwater license. Rinse your gear gently with fresh water afterward. If you plan to keep fish and can't haul a cooler down the beach, carry a little ice in a burlap bag and keep it in the shade or buried in damp sand.
items.short_zh: 沙地插竿器、钳子、小刀、毛巾、防晒霜和水桶。
items.body_zh: 还要带备用钓组和铅坠、傍晚钓鱼用的头灯、急救包和足够的水。沙子无孔不入，轮不要放在沙滩上，要用竿架。查好潮汐表，确认是否需要海水钓鱼证。钓完用淡水轻轻冲洗装备。如果想留鱼又没法把保温箱带到海滩上，可以用粗麻袋装一点冰，放在阴凉处或埋进潮湿的沙里。

items.question: How much of freshwater tackle can be reused for fishing from the beach?
items.question_zh: 在海滩钓鱼时，淡水渔具有多少可以继续使用？
items.short: Hooks and small jigs can often be reused for light surf. The rod and reel may need an upgrade.
items.body: A medium spinning rod can work on calm days and for small fish close in. Reels not built for salt corrode more quickly, so rinse them soon. Most freshwater hooks and swivels rust quickly, so switch to corrosion-resistant ones. Braid and leaders transfer fine. You will need heavier sinkers to hold the bottom in surf.
items.short_zh: 轻度海滩投钓时，钩和小铅头钩常常可以继续用，竿和轮可能要升级。
items.body_zh: 风平浪静、鱼又不大又近时，中等硬度的直柄竿也能用。不是为海水设计的轮更容易腐蚀，要尽快冲洗。多数淡水钩和转环很快就会生锈，要换耐腐蚀的。编织线和前导线可以照用。在有浪的海滩上，要用更重的铅坠才能稳住。

items.question: What is a workable surf setup under $100?
items.question_zh: 低于 100 美元，可用的海滩投钓配置是什么？
items.short: A basic 9 to 10 foot rod with a saltwater 5000 reel, often sold as a combo.
items.body: A combo at this price works on sand beaches with moderate surf. Add 15 to 20 lb mono or braid, a selection of pyramid sinkers and pompano or fish-finder rigs. Rinse the reel carefully, since a budget reel corrodes quickly. A rod holder helps keep the reel off the sand.
items.short_zh: 9 到 10 英尺的基础竿配 5000 号海水轮，常以套装出售。
items.body_zh: 这个价位的套装，可以应付沙滩上中等的浪。再买 15 到 20 磅的尼龙线或编织线、几种金字塔铅坠，以及 pompano 钓组或 fish-finder 游动铅钓组。平价轮腐蚀很快，要仔细冲洗。用竿架可以让轮不沾沙。

items.question: What does a surf setup gain from a budget of $200 or more?
items.question_zh: 预算达到 200 美元或更高时，海滩投钓配置能提升什么？
items.short: A lighter rod, a stronger sealed reel and longer casts.
items.body: Better graphite blanks make a long rod less tiring and cast farther. A better reel has stronger gears, better sealing and a stronger drag for big fish. Spend on the reel first if you fish salt often. Better line and terminal tackle are a low-cost gain. On most beaches, technique and finding the right spots matter more.
items.short_zh: 更轻的竿、更强且密封的轮，以及更远的抛投距离。
items.body_zh: 更好的碳素竿身，能让长竿不那么累人，也抛得更远。更好的轮齿轮更强、密封更好、卸力更大，适合大鱼。经常钓海水的话，先把钱花在轮上。更好的线和终端配件花费不多，效果却明显。在多数海滩上，技术和找对位置更重要。

items.question: How can I find out what gear and bait work in a region I have never fished?
items.question_zh: 去从未钓过的地区，怎样了解当地适用的装备和饵？
items.short: Check the state agency's fishing reports and ask a local tackle shop.
items.body: State fish and wildlife agencies publish fishing forecasts and stocking reports, and bait shops know what is biting now. Look up the main fish and seasons, and consider a guide for a day as a quick way to learn. Buy a few local favorites when you arrive, and check the rules on live bait and moving fish between waters.
items.short_zh: 查州政府的钓况报告，再问问当地渔具店。
items.body_zh: 各州的鱼类和野生动物机构会发布钓况预报和放流报告，饵料店知道现在什么鱼在咬。查清主要的鱼种和季节，请一天向导也是快速了解的办法。到了之后买几个当地常用的饵，活饵和跨水域运鱼的规定也要弄清楚。

items.question: Which items from a freshwater bass kit transfer to inshore saltwater fishing on a short trip?
items.question_zh: 短途旅行时，淡水钓鲈鱼的装备有哪些可以用于近岸海钓？
items.short: Soft plastics, jig heads, braid and medium spinning rods all transfer well.
items.body: Paddle tails and shrimp-shaped plastics on 1/4 to 1/2 ounce jig heads catch redfish and speckled trout. Bring a fluorocarbon leader of 15 to 20 lb. Rinse everything with fresh water afterward, because freshwater hooks and reels corrode quickly in salt, and don't put salty lures back in your main box.
items.short_zh: 软饵、铅头钩、编织线和中等硬度的直柄竿都能直接用。
items.body_zh: 1/4 到 1/2 盎司铅头钩配桨尾或虾形软饵，可以钓红拟石首鱼和斑点海鳟。带上 15 到 20 磅的碳线前导。钓完要用淡水把所有东西冲洗一遍，淡水钩和轮在海水里腐蚀很快，带盐的饵也不要放回主渔具盒。

items.question: What should be packed for a chartered boat trip?
items.question_zh: 包船出海钓鱼应该带什么？
items.short: Usually only food, water, sun protection and your own license, if one is needed.
items.body: Ask what the charter provides. Most supply tackle, bait and ice. Bring a hat, polarized sunglasses, sunscreen, layers, rain gear, soft-soled shoes, seasickness medication, a small cooler and a bag for fillets. Confirm who holds the license, and bring cash for tips.
items.short_zh: 通常只需要带食物、水、防晒用品，需要的话还有自己的钓鱼证。
items.body_zh: 先问清楚包船提供什么。多数会提供钓具、饵和冰。带上帽子、偏光镜、防晒霜、多层衣物、雨具、软底鞋、晕船药、小保温箱和装鱼片的袋子。确认钓鱼证由谁负责，再带些现金付小费。

items.question: What is different about preparing gear for night fishing?
items.question_zh: 为夜钓准备装备时有什么不同？
items.short: Prepare everything in daylight and keep your gear simple.
items.body: Bring a headlamp and a backup, ideally with a red-light mode that preserves night vision. Pre-tie rigs and keep tools in the same pockets. Stick to one or two lures. A bell or glow stick on the rod helps you notice bites, and heavier line makes tangles easier to handle. Know your footing and tell someone where you'll be. On a boat after dark, you need proper lights.
items.short_zh: 在白天把一切准备好，装备尽量简单。
items.body_zh: 带头灯和备用灯，最好有红光模式，不破坏夜视。提前绑好钓组，工具放在固定的口袋里。只用一两种饵。在竿上挂铃铛或荧光棒，容易发现咬口；线粗一点，缠线也好处理。要清楚脚下的情况，并告诉别人你在哪里。夜间行船要有合规的灯光。

items.question: Should local rules be checked before bringing lures with treble hooks?
items.question_zh: 携带三本钩的饵之前，需要先查当地规定吗？
items.short: Yes. Some waters ban or limit them.
items.body: Some special-regulation waters restrict hooks to single points, and some forbid barbed hooks or bait. The way hooks are counted also differs: Connecticut counts each point as a hook, while Michigan counts a treble on a manufactured lure as one hook. Read the rules for the specific water before you fish, and carry pliers and a few single hooks in case you need to swap.
items.short_zh: 要查。有些水域禁止或限制三本钩。
items.body_zh: 有些特别规定的水域只允许单钩，有些禁止倒刺钩或天然饵。钩的算法也不同：康涅狄格州每个钩尖算一个钩，密歇根州把商品拟饵上的三本钩算作一个钩。钓之前读一读该水域的规定，并带上钳子和几个单钩，以备更换。

items.question: Can one setup reasonably cover bass and trout, or do they call for separate gear?
items.question_zh: 一套配置能兼顾鲈鱼和鳟鱼吗，还是应该分开？
items.short: Yes. One medium-light spinning setup can cover both, within limits.
items.body: A 6 to 7 foot medium-light rod with a 2500 reel and 6 to 8 lb line handles stocked trout and small bass. For big bass around heavy cover you'll want heavier gear, and for wary stream trout, lighter. Change the line or add a leader to adapt. It will do well with fish of typical size and less well at the extremes.
items.short_zh: 可以。一套中轻硬度的直柄配置，在一定范围内能兼顾。
items.body_zh: 6 到 7 英尺的中轻硬度竿，配 2500 号轮和 6 到 8 磅线，可以钓放流鳟和小鲈鱼。重障碍区的大鲈鱼要更重的装备，警觉的溪流鳟鱼要更轻的。可以换线或加前导来调整。对常见大小的鱼表现不错，到了两头就差一些。

items.question: How much heavier does a setup need to be for pike compared with bass?
items.question_zh: 钓白斑狗鱼的配置，要比钓鲈鱼重多少？
items.short: About one step heavier, plus a bite-proof leader.
items.body: A 7-foot rod of moderate to medium-heavy power with braid of at least 15 lb handles most pike. The leader is the main difference from a bass setup. Larger lures need a heavier rod. Bring long pliers and a net, because lifting a big pike by the line can break the rod tip.
items.short_zh: 大约重一个档位，再加防咬前导。
items.body_zh: 约 7 英尺、中等到中硬的竿，配至少 15 磅编织线，能应付多数白斑狗鱼。和钓鲈鱼最大的区别是前导。饵大就要用更硬的竿。带上长柄钳和抄网，靠线提大鱼可能把竿尖拉断。

items.question: What is the simplest effective setup for catfish?
items.question_zh: 钓鲶鱼最简单有效的配置是什么？
items.short: A sliding sinker bottom rig with a circle or bait hook.
items.body: In ponds, use a spincast or spinning combo, 8 lb line or heavier, a 1/4 to 1/2 ounce egg sinker, a swivel, an 18-inch leader and a No. 4 or 6 hook with worms or liver. For bigger fish, use 15 to 20 lb line, a 1 ounce sinker, a 2-foot leader and a 4/0 to 6/0 hook. Use only enough weight to hold bottom, and move if you get no bite in 15 minutes.
items.short_zh: 游动铅底钓组，配圆形钩或饵钩。
items.body_zh: 池塘里用卡式轮或纺车轮套装、8 磅或更粗的线、1/4 到 1/2 盎司橄榄铅、转环、18 英寸前导和 4 号或 6 号钩，挂蚯蚓或鸡肝。钓大一些的鱼，用 15 到 20 磅线、1 盎司铅、2 英尺前导和 4/0 到 6/0 的钩。铅的重量够稳住水底就行，15 分钟没有咬口就换地方。

items.question: How long should a river rod for salmon and steelhead be?
items.question_zh: 河流中钓鲑鱼和硬头鳟的竿应该多长？
items.short: Usually about 8 to 10 feet, and longer for float fishing.
items.body: A long spinning rod of 8 to 10 feet, light to medium, for 6 to 12 lb line suits steelhead. It keeps line off the water and gives more control over the drift. For big salmon, 9 to 10½ feet of medium-heavy is typical. Float anglers sometimes use rods of 11 to 13 feet to get long drifts.
items.short_zh: 通常约 8 到 10 英尺，浮漂钓法还要更长。
items.body_zh: 钓硬头鳟用 8 到 10 英尺、轻到中等硬度、适合 6 到 12 磅线的长直柄竿。竿长能让线离开水面，更好地控制漂流。钓大鲑鱼常用 9 到 10½ 英尺的中硬竿。用浮漂钓时，有时会用 11 到 13 英尺的竿，以获得更长的漂流距离。

items.question: Which setup suits redfish and speckled trout from shore or a small boat?
items.question_zh: 在岸上或小船上钓红拟石首鱼和斑点海鳟，适合什么配置？
items.short: A 7-foot medium or medium-light spinning rod, a 3000 reel and 10 to 15 lb braid.
items.body: Add a 15 to 20 lb fluorocarbon leader of 2 to 3 feet. Soft plastics on 1/4 to 1/2 ounce jig heads, live shrimp under a float and small topwater plugs all work, and a float rig does best in water under about 10 feet. Use a heavier leader near oysters and mangroves. Rinse your gear with fresh water, and check current size and bag rules for your state.
items.short_zh: 7 英尺的中等或中轻硬度直柄竿、3000 号轮和 10 到 15 磅编织线。
items.body_zh: 再加一段 2 到 3 英尺、15 到 20 磅的碳线前导。1/4 到 1/2 盎司铅头钩配软饵、浮漂钓活虾、小型水面硬饵都有效，浮漂钓组在水深约 10 英尺以内效果最好。靠近牡蛎和红树林时要用更粗的前导。钓完用淡水冲洗装备，尺寸和限额以本州当前的规定为准。

items.question: Is a walleye setup better on spinning gear or casting gear?
items.question_zh: 钓大眼梭鲈用纺车轮好，还是水滴轮好？
items.short: Spinning gear is the usual choice for jigs, slip bobbers and live-bait rigs. Casting gear is common for trolling.
items.body: FishEye's guide lists medium-action spinning rods with 6 to 10 lb mono or braid for jig-and-minnow, slip-sinker and slip-bobber fishing. For trolling it lists a 7 to 9 foot medium-heavy rod with a baitcasting reel and 10 to 12 lb line. If you are only buying one, go with spinning.
items.short_zh: 铅头钩、活动浮漂和活饵钓组通常用纺车轮，拖钓常用水滴轮。
items.body_zh: FishEye 的指南里，铅头钩配小鱼、游动铅和活动浮漂钓法，都用中等调性的直柄竿，配 6 到 10 磅尼龙线或编织线。拖钓用 7 到 9 英尺的中硬竿、水滴轮和 10 到 12 磅线。如果只买一套，就选纺车轮。

items.question: What setup prioritizes versatility across several freshwater species?
items.question_zh: 如果看重在多种淡水鱼之间通用，该选什么配置？
items.short: A 6½ to 7 foot medium spinning rod, a 2500 or 3000 reel and 8 to 10 lb line.
items.body: It handles bass, walleye, catfish of moderate size and larger trout, with bait or lures. Change the leader or hooks rather than the rod. Small fish can still be caught on small hooks. For bigger pike or catfish, add a heavier second outfit.
items.short_zh: 6½ 到 7 英尺的中等硬度直柄竿、2500 或 3000 号轮和 8 到 10 磅线。
items.body_zh: 用天然饵或拟饵，都能钓鲈鱼、大眼梭鲈、中等大小的鲶鱼和较大的鳟鱼。要调整时换前导或钩，不用换竿。用小钩照样能钓小鱼。钓更大的白斑狗鱼或鲶鱼，再加一套更重的配置。

items.question: What setup prioritizes the fight and feel of small trout?
items.question_zh: 如果看重小鳟鱼的搏斗手感，该选什么配置？
items.short: An ultralight spinning rod or a light fly rod.
items.body: An ultralight rod of 5 to 6 feet with 2 to 4 lb line and a small reel lets a small trout bend the rod. A 3 or 4 weight fly rod is even more direct, if you fly fish. Don't overplay fish, especially in warm water, and use a net.
items.short_zh: 超轻直柄竿或轻型飞钓竿。
items.body_zh: 5 到 6 英尺的超轻竿，配 2 到 4 磅线和小轮，小鳟鱼也能把竿拉弯。如果飞钓，3 号或 4 号飞钓竿的手感更直接。不要把鱼拉得太久，水温高时尤其如此，并且要用抄网。

items.question: How do hook size numbers work, and why do larger numbers mean smaller hooks up to a point?
items.question_zh: 鱼钩的号数是怎么编的？为什么在一定范围内号数越大钩子越小？
items.short: Plain numbers get smaller as they get larger, and aught sizes go the other way.
items.body: A No. 12 is far smaller than a No. 2. After No. 1, sizes change to 1/0, 2/0 and so on, getting bigger. The numbering isn't tied to one standard measurement, so the same size can differ between brands and hook styles. Compare actual hooks if you need to match something exactly. Published ranges run from about No. 32, the smallest, to 19/0 or 20/0, the largest.
items.short_zh: 普通号数越大钩越小，1/0 这类号数正好相反。
