items.body_zh: 12 号比 2 号小得多。1 号之后，变成 1/0、2/0 等，数字越大钩越大。这套号数没有统一的度量标准，同样的号在不同品牌和钩型之间可能不一样。需要精确匹配时，要拿实物比较。资料中常见的范围从最小的 32 号，到最大的 19/0 或 20/0。

items.question: When are circle hooks better than J hooks, and how should the hook set change?
items.question_zh: 什么情况下圆形钩比 J 型钩更好？提竿方式需要怎样改变？
items.short: Circle hooks are better when fishing bait and releasing fish. Don't jerk to set them.
items.body: A circle hook slides to the corner of the mouth and is rarely swallowed, which makes it useful for catfish and for fish you'll release. J hooks are better with lures and when you want to set the hook quickly. To set a circle hook, reel steadily or pull slowly, because a sharp jerk pulls it out of the fish's mouth. If the rod is in a holder, let it bend over before you lift it out.
items.short_zh: 钓天然饵并打算放流时，圆形钩更好。提竿时不要猛拉。
items.body_zh: 圆形钩会滑到嘴角，很少被吞下，适合钓鲶鱼和要放流的鱼。用拟饵，或者想快速提竿时，J 型钩更好。圆形钩要匀速收线或慢慢拉紧，猛地一提会把钩从鱼嘴里扯出来。如果钓竿插在竿架上，等竿子弯下去再拿起来。

items.question: Is it worth replacing the treble hooks that come on a factory lure?
items.question_zh: 原厂饵上的三本钩值得更换吗？
items.short: If they are dull, weak or rusty. Otherwise it's optional.
items.body: Many quality lures come with good hooks already. On budget lures, upgrading can help you hook fish more reliably. Heavier trebles add weight, which can change how a lure runs or suspends, so keep to the same size and similar weight. Split-ring pliers make it easy, and it is worth checking the rules where you fish.
items.short_zh: 钝了、软了或生锈了就换，否则可换可不换。
items.body_zh: 很多质量好的饵，原装钩已经不错。平价饵换钩能让中鱼更可靠。粗一些的三本钩会增加重量，可能改变饵的游动或悬停，所以要保持同样的大小和相近的重量。用开环钳换钩很方便，也要看看当地的规定。

items.question: Will a change from treble hooks to single hooks affect how a lure swims?
items.question_zh: 把三本钩换成单钩，会影响饵的游姿吗？
items.short: It can, mainly because of the change in weight and drag.
items.body: A single hook is usually lighter and has less drag, so a suspending jerkbait may float and a crankbait may run a bit differently. Test it in clear water, and if needed add a small adhesive lead strip or go up one hook size. Single hooks can reduce snags and make release easier, and some waters require them.
items.short_zh: 可能会，主要是重量和阻力变了。
items.body_zh: 单钩通常更轻、阻力更小，悬停型 jerkbait 可能变成上浮，crankbait 的游动也可能有点变化。在清水里试一下，必要时贴一小片铅皮，或者把钩换大一号。单钩还能减少挂底，放流也更方便，有些水域也要求用单钩。

items.question: Should rusty hooks be cleaned, sharpened or thrown away?
items.question_zh: 生锈的鱼钩应该清洁、磨利，还是扔掉？
items.short: Throw away badly rusted hooks. Clean and sharpen only light surface rust.
items.body: Rust weakens the metal and can cause a hook to break. If it is just light surface rust, remove it, sharpen the point and test it against a fingernail. Hooks are cheap compared with losing a good fish. To prevent rust, dry everything and leave the tackle box open until it is dry. A silica gel packet helps, and one salty lure can rust the rest.
items.short_zh: 锈得厉害就扔掉，只有轻微的表面锈才值得清理、磨利。
items.body_zh: 锈蚀会让金属变弱，钩可能会断。如果只是轻微的表面锈，把锈去掉，磨利钩尖，再在指甲上试一下。比起跑掉一条好鱼，钩便宜得多。要防锈，所有东西都要弄干，渔具盒打开放到完全干燥。放一包硅胶干燥剂也有帮助，一个带盐的饵就可能让其他的都生锈。

items.question: How can hook points be tested for sharpness?
items.question_zh: 怎样检查钩尖是否锋利？
items.short: Drag the point lightly across your thumbnail.
items.body: A sharp point catches and digs in at a shallow angle, while a dull one slides. Do this gently and keep your skin clear of the point. Sharpen with a small hook file, stroking toward the point along the outside of the hook. Retest after a snag, rock contact or a fish, and replace hooks that have been bent.
items.short_zh: 把钩尖轻轻划过拇指指甲。
items.body_zh: 锋利的钩尖在小角度下也能挂住指甲，钝的会滑开。动作要轻，别碰到皮肤。用小磨钩锉，沿钩的外侧朝钩尖方向磨。挂过底、碰过石头或钓到鱼之后都要再试一下，弯过的钩要换掉。

items.question: How should hook size be matched to bait size for small panfish?
items.question_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼时，钩的大小怎样和饵的大小匹配？
items.short: Use a hook small enough to fit in the fish's mouth, about size 6 to 10.
items.body: Bluegill and perch have small mouths, and FishEye's guides give sizes from 6 to 14 for sunfish. A long-shanked No. 6 or 8 is easier to remove. Use a piece of worm or a single mealworm just big enough to cover the hook. If fish steal bait without getting hooked, go a size smaller.
items.short_zh: 钩要小到能进鱼嘴，大约 6 到 10 号。
items.body_zh: 蓝鳃太阳鱼和河鲈的嘴很小，FishEye 的指南里，太阳鱼用 6 到 14 号。长柄的 6 号或 8 号更容易摘钩。饵用一小段蚯蚓或一条黄粉虫，刚好盖住钩就行。如果鱼偷饵却钓不到，就换小一号。

items.question: In what conditions does a Ned rig outperform larger soft plastics?
items.question_zh: 在什么条件下，内德钓组比更大的软饵效果好？
items.short: In clear or cold water, or under heavy fishing pressure, when fish won't chase.
items.body: A short stick worm on a small jig head is subtle. It is built for deep, clear water around rocks when fish are not chasing: a 3 to 4 inch stick worm on a 1/8 to 1/4 ounce mushroom head. Let it sit for 2 to 5 seconds, drag it a few feet and pause. In dirty water or heavy cover, a larger bait is easier for fish to find.
items.short_zh: 水清、水冷，或者钓压大、鱼不愿追逐时。
items.body_zh: 短棒状软饵配小铅头钩，动静很小。它适合鱼不追逐时，在清澈的深水岩石区使用：3 到 4 英寸棒虫配 1/8 到 1/4 盎司蘑菇头。让它在水底停 2 到 5 秒，拖动几英尺，再停。水浑或障碍物多时，大一些的饵更容易被鱼发现。

items.question: How can the plastic be kept from sliding down the hook on a Texas rig?
items.question_zh: 德州钓组怎样防止软饵沿钩下滑？
items.short: Use a hook with a bait keeper, or peg the plastic to it.
items.body: A hook with a wire keeper or a barbed shank helps. Make sure the hook goes through the center of the head and the plastic lies straight. Tougher plastics hold better, and a drop of soft-plastic glue can hold the head in place. Pegging the weight with a bobber stop also reduces wear on the head.
items.short_zh: 用带挂饵器的钩，或者把软饵固定在钩上。
items.body_zh: 带钢丝挂饵器或倒刺钩柄的钩比较有用。钩要从软饵头部的正中穿过，软饵要摆直。质地韧一些的软饵更牢，滴一点软饵专用胶也能固定头部。用浮漂止挡把铅固定住，也能减少对软饵头部的磨损。

items.question: When is a swivel helpful, and when does it get in the way?
items.question_zh: 什么时候用转环有帮助，什么时候反而碍事？
items.short: It helps with sliding sinkers and spinning baits. It can hurt small lures.
items.body: A barrel swivel stops a sliding sinker and prevents line twist with inline spinners or bottom rigs. In clear water, keep the rig small and avoid big snaps and swivels, because trout see well. A snap can also weaken a crankbait's action, so tie straight to small lures when you can.
items.short_zh: 用游动铅和旋转饵时有帮助，用小饵时可能碍事。
items.body_zh: 桶形转环能挡住游动铅，也能防止旋转亮片或底钓组造成线扭。清水里钓组要小，不要用大别针和大转环，鳟鱼的视力很好。别针还可能削弱 crankbait 的动作，所以小饵尽量直接绑。

items.question: What type and size of float suits fishing small baits at a set depth?
items.question_zh: 把小饵固定在某一水深钓，适合什么类型和大小的浮漂？
items.short: Use the smallest float that holds the bait up and can still be seen.
items.body: Slender floats are more sensitive, and the smallest bobber that floats the bait shows the most bites. A fixed float works down to about rod length. Go deeper with a slip float. Add just enough split shot so that a fish can pull it under easily.
items.short_zh: 用能浮住饵、又看得清楚的最小浮漂。
items.body_zh: 细长的浮漂更灵敏，能浮住饵的最小浮漂，看到的咬口最多。固定浮漂的深度大约不超过竿长，更深的用活动浮漂。咬铅的量刚好够，让鱼能轻松把浮漂拉下去。

items.question: How can floating corn or bread be presented so it stays where carp feed?
items.question_zh: 怎样让漂浮的玉米或面包留在鲤鱼觅食的位置？
items.short: Anchor it on a light hair rig, or use a float near the surface.
items.body: Floating baits drift with wind and current. A controller float with a short hook length lets you cast and keep bait in place. On the bottom, a buoyant kernel on a hair with a small weight a few inches below it keeps the bait above the mud. Feed a few handfuls to attract carp, and check whether chumming is allowed where you fish.
items.short_zh: 用轻型头发钓组固定，或者用靠近水面的浮漂。
items.body_zh: 漂浮的饵会随风和水流移动。用控制浮漂配短脑线，可以抛出去并让饵留在原处。在水底，把会浮的玉米粒挂在头发线上，下方几英寸放一个小铅，饵就能悬在淤泥之上。撒几把饵吸引鲤鱼，也要确认当地允许打窝。

items.question: Is a running sinker on a soft-plastic rig useful or redundant?
items.question_zh: 软饵钓组上加游动铅坠有用，还是多余？
items.short: It can be useful for fishing deeper or in wind, as on a Carolina rig.
items.body: On a Texas rig, a sliding bullet weight gets the lure down and lets the plastic move independently, while a pegged weight helps in heavy cover. On a Carolina rig, a sinker above a swivel and leader lets the bait drift free behind it. For shallow bites you don't need one, since an unweighted plastic falls more naturally.
items.short_zh: 水深或有风时有用，比如卡罗来纳钓组。
items.body_zh: 德州钓组用可滑动的子弹铅，能让饵沉下去，软饵也能独立摆动；在重障碍区，把铅固定住更好。卡罗来纳钓组把铅放在转环和前导的上方，饵可以在后面自由漂动。浅水区不需要加铅，无铅的软饵下落更自然。

items.question: Which knot is the most reliable all-purpose choice for tying on a lure?
items.question_zh: 绑饵时，哪种结是最可靠的通用选择？
items.short: The palomar, unless the lure has several hooks.
items.body: It is easy, strong and works with both braid and mono. With lures carrying many hooks it is awkward, because the lure has to pass through the loop, and the improved clinch is the common alternative with mono. A loop knot leaves small lures free to move.
items.short_zh: 帕洛马结，除非饵上有多个钩。
items.body_zh: 它简单、强度高，编织线和尼龙线都能用。饵上钩多时不方便，因为整个饵要从线圈穿过，这时用尼龙线常打改良克林奇结。打活圈结能让小饵动作更自由。

items.question: Does braid need a different knot from monofilament?
items.question_zh: 编织线需要和尼龙线不同的结吗？
items.short: Yes. Braid slips in some knots designed for mono.
items.body: Use a palomar, or add extra wraps to a uni knot, because slippery braid needs more turns than mono. Test any knot with a firm pull. Braid can also slip on a bare spool, so use a mono backing or a braid-ready spool. Cut braid with sharp scissors or braid clippers. A dedicated braid knot also exists: run a doubled loop through the eye, wrap it 8 times, pass the loop back between the eye and the coils, and pull evenly.
items.short_zh: 需要。有些给尼龙线用的结，编织线会滑。
items.body_zh: 用帕洛马结，或者给 uni 结多绕几圈，编织线很滑，圈数要比尼龙线多。打好后都要用力拉一下测试。编织线在光滑线杯上也可能打滑，所以要加尼龙底线，或者用防滑线杯。用锋利的剪刀或编织线专用剪来剪线。也有专门的编织线结：把线对折成双股穿过钩眼，绕 8 圈，再把双股线圈从钩眼和线圈之间穿回，均匀收紧。

items.question: How should a knot be wetted and tightened to keep its strength?
items.question_zh: 打结时应该怎样润湿和收紧，才能保持强度？
items.short: Wet it with water or saliva, then draw it tight slowly and evenly.
items.body: Wetting reduces the friction heat that weakens mono and fluorocarbon. Pull both ends steadily rather than jerking. Seat the knot fully before trimming, and leave a short tag of about 1/4 inch so it doesn't slip. Nail clippers do the job well. Take care that clippers don't nick the main line. If the knot looks curled or crossed, retie it.
items.short_zh: 用水或唾液润湿，然后慢慢、均匀地拉紧。
items.body_zh: 润湿可以减少摩擦热，摩擦热会让尼龙线和碳线变弱。两端要稳稳地拉，不要猛拽。结完全收紧后再剪线头，留约 1/4 英寸，以免滑脱，用指甲钳剪很方便。剪线时别划伤主线。结看起来卷曲或交叉，就重打。

items.question: How can knot strength be tested at home?
items.question_zh: 在家里怎样测试线结的强度？
items.short: Tie the knot to a spring scale and pull slowly until something breaks.
items.body: Attach a hook or ring to a scale, tie the knot on it and pull steadily on the line. Compare the result with the line's rated strength. Wet the knot first and test several of each, so you don't draw conclusions from one pull. Wear eye protection. A badly tied knot can lose half or more of the line's strength, so the comparison shows how well you tie each one.
items.short_zh: 把结绑在弹簧秤上，慢慢拉到断为止。
items.body_zh: 把钩或圆环挂在秤上，在上面打结，然后稳稳地拉线。把结果和线的标称强度比较。打结前先润湿，每种结多测几次，不要凭一次结果下结论。要戴护目镜。结打得不好，线的强度可能损失一半甚至更多，比较之后就知道每种结你打得怎么样。

items.question: Which reel noises are normal, and which point to a real fault?
items.question_zh: 轮的哪些声音是正常的，哪些说明确实有故障？
items.short: Soft clicks from an anti-reverse or drag are usually normal. Grinding or knocking is not.
items.body: A light clicking from the drag or anti-reverse is often normal. A gritty, grinding or knocking noise under load usually means dirt, worn gears or a bad bearing, and squeaks usually come from dry spots. Check for sand or salt first, then try a drop of oil on the line roller or handle knob. If the noise gets worse, stop using the reel and have it serviced.
items.short_zh: 防逆转或卸力发出的轻微咔哒声通常正常，摩擦声或敲击声就不正常了。
items.body_zh: 卸力或防逆转的轻微咔哒声往往是正常的。受力时有沙沙的摩擦声或敲击声，通常说明有脏东西、齿轮磨损或轴承损坏；吱吱声一般是缺润滑。先检查有没有沙子或盐分，再在导线轮或手把旋钮上滴一滴油。如果声音越来越大，就停用，送去保养。

items.question: What should I check first if a new reel feels rough out of the box?
items.question_zh: 新轮开箱就发涩，应该先检查什么？
items.short: Check whether it is rough with no line on it and with the handle fitted correctly.
items.body: A tight handle screw, spool tension or the line itself can cause roughness, so turn it with no load and then with line. Thick factory grease can feel stiff until the reel has been used a little. If it is still rough or the gears have play, return it under warranty before trying to open it, since taking it apart may void the warranty.
items.short_zh: 看看不上线、手把装好的情况下是否还发涩。
items.body_zh: 手把螺丝太紧、线杯张力或线本身都可能造成发涩，所以先空转，再带线转。出厂润滑脂较稠，用一段时间才会顺。如果还是发涩，或者齿轮有旷量，就在打开之前按保修退换，拆开可能导致保修失效。

items.question: How can a clicking sound during the retrieve be traced to its source?
items.question_zh: 收线时的咔哒声，怎样找到来源？
items.short: Isolate each moving part, then test each one.
items.body: Remove the spool and turn the handle. If the noise stops, it comes from the spool or line lay. Spin the line roller. If the click keeps time with the handle, suspect the gears or rotor; if it keeps time with the up-and-down movement of the spool, suspect the oscillation gear. Check for loose screws and sand first. A slight click at the same spot each turn often points to a bent or damaged part.
items.short_zh: 把活动部件逐个分开，一个一个测试。
items.body_zh: 取下线杯，转动手把。声音消失，问题就在线杯或排线上。转动导线轮。咔哒声和手把同步，多半是齿轮或转子；和线杯上下移动同步，多半是往复齿轮。先检查螺丝是否松动、有没有进沙。每圈同一位置都有轻微咔哒声，常常说明有零件弯曲或损坏。

items.question: What should be done right after a reel has been dunked in saltwater?
items.question_zh: 轮掉进海水后，应该马上做什么？
items.short: Rinse it with fresh water and get it serviced soon.
items.body: Daiwa's US page says to spray a dunked reel with fresh water from a hose. Its Scandinavian FAQ says to send it for service right away, because salt water can start damaging internal parts within days. If you service reels yourself, strip, clean, dry and re-lubricate it promptly. Don't just leave it to dry.
items.short_zh: 用淡水冲洗，并尽快送去保养。
items.body_zh: Daiwa 美国网站建议，轮掉进水后要用水管喷淡水冲洗；它的斯堪的纳维亚网站则说要马上送修，因为海水几天内就可能开始损伤内部零件。如果你自己保养，就要尽快拆开、清洁、干燥并重新润滑。不要只是放着晾干。

items.question: Should a noisy new reel be returned or adjusted at home?
items.question_zh: 新轮有异响，应该退货还是自己调整？
items.short: Return it while the store or warranty still covers it.
items.body: Opening a new reel can void the warranty, and roughness in a new reel may mean a defect. Check the handle fit, the line and the spool first. If it is still noisy, ask the retailer for an exchange. Repairs make sense once the warranty has expired or if you enjoy servicing your own gear.
items.short_zh: 趁商店或保修还管得着，就退换。
items.body_zh: 打开新轮可能导致保修失效，新轮发涩也可能是缺陷。先检查手把安装、线和线杯。如果还有异响，就找零售商换货。保修期过后，或者你喜欢自己保养时，再考虑自己修。

items.question: How can the correct replacement part number be found for a reel?
items.question_zh: 怎样找到轮的正确零件编号？
items.short: Find the exact model number and look up the maker's parts diagram.
items.body: The model is usually printed on the reel's foot or side plate. Makers publish schematics with numbered parts on their websites, and a service center can help. Make sure the series is correct, since similar reels can use different parts. Aftermarket parts sellers often list compatible models too. Keep the diagram handy before you open the reel.
items.short_zh: 找到准确的型号，再查厂家的零件图。
items.body_zh: 型号一般印在轮脚或侧盖上。厂家通常在网站上提供带编号的零件图，维修中心也能帮忙。系列要确认准确，外形相近的轮，零件可能不同。副厂配件商也常常列出兼容型号。打开轮之前，先把零件图准备好。

items.question: How do I measure the handle fitting to find a compatible aftermarket handle?
items.question_zh: 怎样测量手把接口，以找到兼容的副厂手把？
items.short: Check the reel's drive type and shaft size against the handle maker's chart.
items.body: Handles attach in different ways, such as square-drive or threaded, and fittings vary between brands. Remove the existing handle and measure with calipers. Note the model number and look up the compatibility chart from the handle's maker, along with the screw pattern and any retaining plate. Check that the handle length clears the reel's body as well.
items.short_zh: 把轮的传动类型和轴径，与手把厂家的对照表比对。
items.body_zh: 手把的安装方式不同，有方轴、螺纹等，各品牌的接口也不一样。拆下原手把，用卡尺测量。记下型号，查手把厂家的兼容表，也要注意螺丝孔位和固定片。还要确认手把长度不会碰到机身。

items.question: Can a broken rod tip be repaired, and how much does shortening a rod change its action?
items.question_zh: 断掉的竿梢能修吗？竿变短后调性会改变多少？
items.short: A glue-on tip fixes a short break, but the rod gets stiffer and slightly faster.
items.body: A broken tip can be replaced with a glue-on tip from a tackle shop. Choose a tip top of the correct size and fix it with rod-tip adhesive. Losing an inch or two has little effect. Losing several inches makes the rod noticeably stiffer and changes the lure rating and casting feel. Longer breaks need a joint repair or a new section.
items.short_zh: 短距离折断可以粘一个新竿尖，但竿会变硬，调性也会略快。
items.body_zh: 断掉的竿尖可以用渔具店买的粘接式竿尖更换。选尺寸合适的竿尖导环，用竿尖胶粘上。少了一两英寸影响不大。少了几英寸，竿就明显变硬，饵重范围和抛投手感都会变化。断得更长，就要做接口修复或换一节。

items.question: How do I replace a cracked or missing rod guide?
items.question_zh: 导环破裂或脱落后怎样更换？
items.short: Unwrap the old guide, tape on a matching one, and rewrap it with thread and epoxy.
items.body: Cut the old wraps with a sharp blade without scratching the blank. Use a guide of the same size, align it with the others and hold it with tape. Wrap it tightly with rod-wrapping thread and finish with rod epoxy, turning the rod while it dries so it sets evenly. A tackle shop can do this for a small charge if you would rather not.
items.short_zh: 拆掉旧导环，用胶带固定尺寸相同的新导环，再用线绑好并涂环氧胶。
items.body_zh: 用锋利的刀片割开旧绑线，不要划伤竿身。选同样尺寸的导环，和其他导环对齐，用胶带固定。用绑竿线紧紧绕好，涂上竿用环氧胶，干燥时转动竿，让胶均匀定型。不想自己动手，渔具店收费也不高。

items.question: Is it normal for a new rod to break early, and what does a warranty claim usually require?
items.question_zh: 新竿很快就断了正常吗？申请保修通常需要什么？
items.short: It isn't normal, but it happens. Check the warranty terms.
items.body: Most breaks come from impact: a knock against a boat or car door can damage a rod that breaks later. Contact the maker or store with proof of purchase and photos of the break and the model label. Warranty terms vary. Some charge a fee, and others only cover defects for the original owner. Keep your receipts.
items.short_zh: 不算正常，但确实会发生。先看保修条款。
items.body_zh: 多数断竿都和撞击有关，碰到船或车门留下的损伤，可能过一阵子才断。联系厂家或商店，提供购买凭证、断口和型号标签的照片。保修条件各不相同，有的收手续费，有的只对原购买人的制造缺陷负责。收据要留好。

items.question: At what point is a reel not worth repairing?
items.question_zh: 轮坏到什么程度就不值得修了？
items.short: When repair costs come near the price of a similar reel.
items.body: Compare the parts and service cost with what the reel costs new. Bent shafts, stripped gears on a cheap reel or heavy corrosion are usually not worth fixing. A good reel with worn drag washers or bearings is worth repairing, since those parts are cheap. Keep a broken reel for parts if you have others of the same model.
items.short_zh: 修理费接近买一只同级新轮的时候。
items.body_zh: 把配件和维修的费用，和新轮的价格比较。便宜轮的轴弯了、齿轮滑牙，或者严重腐蚀，通常不值得修。好轮只是卸力片或轴承磨损，就值得修，这些零件很便宜。如果有同型号的其他轮，坏轮可以留着当配件。

items.question: Will a spool from one size of a reel fit another size in the same series?
items.question_zh: 同系列中，一个型号的线杯能装到另一个型号上吗？
items.short: Sometimes, but check the maker's parts list.
items.body: Within a series, adjacent sizes such as 2500 and 3000 sometimes share a body. Spool fit depends on the shaft and drag design, so check the schematic for part numbers. Line capacity and casting can change even if it fits, and a mismatched spool can damage the drag or spoil the line lay.
items.short_zh: 有时可以，但要查厂家的零件表。
items.body_zh: 同一系列里，相邻的型号，比如 2500 和 3000，有时共用机身。线杯能不能装，取决于主轴和卸力的设计，要查零件图上的编号。即使装得上，容线量和抛投也可能变化，不匹配的线杯还可能损伤卸力或影响排线。

items.question: Where should oil be used on a reel, and where should grease be used?
items.question_zh: 轮的哪些部位用油，哪些部位用润滑脂？
items.short: Oil goes on fast-spinning, lightly loaded parts. Grease goes on parts that press and slide under load.
items.body: Daiwa lists the handle knob bearings, spinning-reel line roller bearings and baitcaster spool bearings for oil, and grease for parts that contact and move on each other. Abu Garcia also greases the gears and spool shaft. Use a small drop, not a flood. Makers differ, and your reel's manual wins. Daiwa says not to oil internal mechanical parts or the main shaft of a spinning reel, and not to spray penetrating lubricant on or into a reel. Abu Garcia warns against oiling the one-way clutch. Drag washers depend on the material: a 2012 Florida Sportsman article suggested a thin film of grease on Teflon or felt and none on carbon, but check your reel's instructions first.
items.short_zh: 转得快、受力小的部位用油，受力大、互相压紧滑动的部位用润滑脂。
items.body_zh: Daiwa 列出的用油部位是手把旋钮轴承、纺车轮导线轮轴承和水滴轮线杯轴承，互相接触并运动的零件则用润滑脂。Abu Garcia 还给齿轮和线杯轴上润滑脂。每处一小滴就够，不要多上。各厂家说法不完全一样，以你这只轮的说明书为准。Daiwa 说不要给内部机械零件和纺车轮主轴上油，也不要把渗透润滑喷剂喷在轮上或轮内。Abu Garcia 提醒不要给单向离合器上油。卸力片要看材质：2012 年《Florida Sportsman》的文章建议特氟龙或毛毡卸力片抹一层薄脂，碳纤维的不用，但要先看你这只轮的说明。

items.question: How often does a reel need a full cleaning if it is only used in freshwater?
items.question_zh: 如果只在淡水使用，轮多久需要彻底清洁一次？
items.short: At least once a year, more often if you fish a lot.
items.body: Texas Parks and Wildlife says reels need cleaning at least once a year, depending on use. Daiwa's Scandinavian FAQ suggests a thorough service once per season or two for freshwater fishing, and Abu Garcia suggests regular light maintenance monthly. Wipe down the outside after trips, and clean sooner if the reel has been dropped in sand or grit.
items.short_zh: 至少每年一次，钓得多就要更勤。
items.body_zh: 德克萨斯州公园与野生动物部说，渔轮至少每年清洁一次，具体看使用情况。Daiwa 斯堪的纳维亚网站建议淡水使用时，一到两个季节全面保养一次；Abu Garcia 建议每月做一次常规的轻度保养。每次钓完擦一擦外部，如果掉进沙子或沾了沙砾，要提前清洁。

items.question: Can household oils or sprays be used on a reel?
items.question_zh: 家用润滑油或喷剂可以用在轮上吗？
items.short: Not as a rule. Use reel oil and reel grease.
items.body: Household oils may be too thick or may dry out, and some can damage plastics or leave a gummy film. Daiwa doesn't recommend aerosol penetrating sprays directly on or in its reels, though spray on a clean rag can be used to wipe the outside. Reel oil and grease are inexpensive and made for the job. Follow your reel's manual.
items.short_zh: 一般不要。用渔轮专用油和润滑脂。
items.body_zh: 家用油可能太稠或容易干，有些还会损伤塑料或留下黏膜。Daiwa 不建议把气雾型渗透润滑剂直接喷在轮上或轮内，不过可以喷在干净的抹布上擦拭外部。渔轮油和润滑脂都不贵，也是专门为此设计的。按你这只轮的说明书操作。

items.question: How should a baitcaster's spool bearings be cleaned to improve casting?
items.question_zh: 怎样清洁水滴轮的线杯轴承，以改善抛投？
items.short: Remove the spool, clean the bearings and add one small drop of light oil.
items.body: Open the side plate and lift out the spool. Some bearings can be reached in place. Clean dirty bearings with a suitable reel cleaner, let them dry and add a drop of light oil. Abu Garcia describes oiling the spool tensioner bearing and the side plate bearing, and Daiwa's Scandinavian FAQ suggests a drop on the ball bearing for casting noise. Too much oil slows the spool, so don't overdo it, and watch for small parts.
items.short_zh: 取下线杯，清洁轴承，滴一小滴轻质油。
items.body_zh: 打开侧盖，取出线杯。有些轴承不用拆就够得到。脏轴承用合适的渔轮清洁剂洗干净，晾干，再滴一滴轻质油。Abu Garcia 提到给线杯张力轴承和侧盖轴承上油，Daiwa 斯堪的纳维亚网站也建议在抛投有噪音时给滚珠轴承滴一滴油。油太多线杯会变慢，不要过量，也要小心别弄丢小零件。

items.question: How should rods be cleaned and stored between seasons?
items.question_zh: 换季时，竿应该怎样清洁和存放？
items.short: Wash, dry and store them where they can't be hit or bent.
items.body: Wash a dirty rod with warm water and a little mild soap, rinse it and let it dry. Inspect the guides, reel seat and handle. Store rods upright or hanging, out of direct sun and away from car doors and trunk lids. For the reel, back off the drag before storing it.
items.short_zh: 洗净、晾干，存放在碰不到、压不弯的地方。
items.body_zh: 脏了的竿用温水加少量中性皂洗净，冲洗后晾干。检查导环、轮座和手把。竿要竖放或挂起来，避开阳光直射，也要远离车门和后备箱盖。轮存放前要把卸力松开。

items.question: How should tackle be organized so a bank angler can carry only what is needed?
items.question_zh: 岸钓时，怎样整理渔具，才能只带需要的东西？
items.short: Pack one small box for today's water and leave the rest.
items.body: Use a single utility box with only hooks, split shot, a few sinkers and lures for your target fish. Carry pliers and clippers on your body, and keep spare line and backups in the car. A small sling or backpack keeps your hands free. Group lures by type so you can change without opening everything.
items.short_zh: 针对今天的水域装一个小盒，其他的都留下。
items.body_zh: 用一个收纳盒，只放钩、咬铅、几个铅坠和针对目标鱼的饵。钳子和剪线钳带在身上，备用线和备用品放在车上。小斜挎包或背包能腾出双手。饵按类型分组，换的时候不用全部翻开。

items.question: Which features matter most in a fishing backpack that holds standard utility boxes?
items.question_zh: 能放标准收纳盒的钓鱼背包，最重要的特性是什么？
items.short: A pocket that fits your boxes, comfortable straps and weather resistance.
items.body: Measure your utility boxes and compare them with the bag's internal size. Look for padded straps, a stiff base that stands up, easy-to-reach pockets for pliers and a rod holder. Water-resistant fabric and a waterproof bottom protect tackle from damp ground. Zippers get sandy, so look for sturdy ones.
items.short_zh: 放得下收纳盒的隔层、舒服的背带和防水性能。
items.body_zh: 量一下收纳盒，和包的内部尺寸比较。要有带衬垫的背带、能立住的硬底、方便拿钳子的口袋和竿架。防水面料和防水底能让渔具不受地面潮气影响。拉链容易进沙，要选结实的。

items.question: How can hooks and small terminal tackle be kept from rusting in a box?
items.question_zh: 盒子里的鱼钩和小型终端配件，怎样防锈？
items.short: Keep them dry.
items.body: Leave the tackle box open until everything in it is dry, and add a silica gel packet. Don't put saltwater lures back in a box unrinsed, because one salty lure can rust the rest. Keep hooks in their original packets or small sealed containers, and store them somewhere dry rather than in a damp garage or boat.
items.short_zh: 保持干燥。
items.body_zh: 把渔具盒打开，等里面的东西都干了再合上，再放一包硅胶干燥剂。钓过海水的饵没冲洗不要放回盒里，一个带盐的饵就可能让其他的都生锈。钩放在原包装或小密封盒里，存放在干燥处，不要放在潮湿的车库或船上。

items.question: Is a hard tackle box better than a soft bag for a small boat?
items.question_zh: 在小船上，硬质渔具盒比软包更好吗？
items.short: A soft bag often suits a small boat better. A hard box protects better.
items.body: A soft bag with utility boxes inside is lighter, packs into odd spaces and doesn't slide as much. Hard boxes are tougher against knocks and spray and can serve as a seat, but they take up more room. In a kayak or small boat, waterproof bags for electronics and first aid matter more. Use whatever stays secure.
items.short_zh: 小船上软包往往更合适，硬盒的保护性更好。
items.body_zh: 软包装收纳盒更轻，能塞进不规则的空间，也不容易滑动。硬盒更耐撞、防水花，还能当座位，但占地方。在皮划艇或小船上，给电子设备和急救包准备防水袋更重要。哪种能固定住，就用哪种。

items.question: How should chest waders be sized for a larger body?
items.question_zh: 身材较大的人，胸高涉水裤的尺码该怎么选？
items.short: Size by chest and inseam, and check the maker's size chart.
items.body: Use the manufacturer's chart rather than your usual jeans size, and measure chest, waist, inseam and foot. Stout or king sizes have extra room in the torso. Waders should let you sit, squat and climb over logs without tension. Try them with the layers you'll wear. A wading belt is important safety gear whatever your size.
items.short_zh: 按胸围和内裆选尺码，并查厂家的尺码表。
items.body_zh: 按厂家的尺码表来选，不要按平时的牛仔裤尺码，要量胸围、腰围、内裆长和脚长。加肥款的躯干部分更宽松。穿上后要能坐下、蹲下、跨过木头而不紧绷。试穿时穿上你打算穿的衣物。无论什么身材，涉水腰带都是重要的安全装备。

items.question: Where can properly fitting women's waders in extended sizes be found?
items.question_zh: 加大码的女性涉水裤，在哪里能买到合身的？
items.short: Specialty fly shops and women's outdoor brands are the best place to start.
items.body: Look for women's-specific patterns from established wader makers, and compare chest, hip and inseam measurements. Extended sizes aren't always carried in stores, so call fly shops and ask about special orders. Buy from a seller with free returns and check the fit with layers on. Men's waders can work if the measurements match your body.
items.short_zh: 可以先从飞钓专卖店和女性户外品牌找起。
items.body_zh: 选知名涉水裤厂家的女款版型，比较胸围、臀围和内裆长。加大码不一定有现货，可以打电话问飞钓店能否订货。在能免费退货的地方买，穿上打算穿的衣物再试。如果尺寸合适，男款涉水裤也可以穿。

items.question: How much larger should wading boots be than street shoes when worn over stockingfoot waders?
items.question_zh: 穿袜式涉水裤时，涉水靴要比平时的鞋大多少？
items.short: Usually one to two sizes larger.
items.body: The neoprene bootie adds bulk, so boots need extra room. Follow the boot maker's sizing guide and try them on with waders and socks. Your toes shouldn't hit the front going downhill, and too large a boot lets your heel lift, which can lead to falls. Some places restrict felt soles, so confirm the rules before you buy.
items.short_zh: 通常大一到两个尺码。
items.body_zh: 涉水裤的氯丁橡胶袜套有一定厚度，靴子要留出空间。按靴子厂家的尺码指南，穿着涉水裤和袜子试。下坡时脚趾不能顶到前面；靴子太大脚跟会抬起，容易摔倒。有些地方限制毛毡底，买之前先确认。

items.question: Which polarized lens color works best for general freshwater fishing?
items.question_zh: 一般淡水钓鱼，什么颜色的偏光镜片效果最好？
items.short: Brown, amber or copper suits most conditions.
items.body: FishEye's gear page says gray or brown lenses suit most days. Brown or amber raises contrast and works in changing light, while gray keeps colors true in bright sun. Yellow works in low light at dawn and dusk, and mirror coatings help in bright, open water. Being polarized matters most.
items.short_zh: 棕色、琥珀色或铜色适合大多数情况。
items.body_zh: FishEye 的装备页说，灰色或棕色镜片适合多数日子。棕色或琥珀色能提高对比度，适合光线变化的时候；灰色在强光下颜色更真实。黄色适合清晨和黄昏的弱光，镜面涂层适合明亮开阔的水面。最重要的还是要有偏光。

items.question: What should I look for in rain gear for long days on the water?
items.question_zh: 在水上待一整天，雨具要看哪些方面？
items.short: Waterproof-breathable fabric, a good hood and sealed seams.
items.body: Look for a jacket with a hood that turns with your head, cuffs that seal and pockets that are easy to reach. Bib pants work better than waist pants when you sit in a boat. Water-repellent clothes beat jeans, which take a long time to dry. Wear layers underneath, because wind and water of 50 to 60°F can bring on hypothermia, even in spring and fall.
items.short_zh: 防水透气的面料、好用的兜帽和压胶的接缝。
items.body_zh: 选兜帽能随头转动、袖口能收紧、口袋好拿的外套。坐在船上时，背带裤比普通腰带裤好。防水衣物比牛仔裤好，牛仔裤很难干。里面要穿多层，风和 50 到 60°F 的水，即使在春秋也可能导致失温。

items.question: Are fishing gloves worth wearing, and which types still allow knot tying?
items.question_zh: 钓鱼手套值得戴吗？哪些类型戴着还能打结？
items.short: Yes for sun, cold or toothy fish. Fingerless gloves let you tie knots.
items.body: Sun gloves protect the back of the hand during long days. Fingerless or flip-top gloves let you tie knots and feel the line. Neoprene gloves help in cold water, and cut-resistant gloves are useful with toothy fish or when filleting. Wet any glove before handling a fish you plan to release, so you don't strip its slime.
items.short_zh: 防晒、防寒或处理利齿鱼时值得戴。露指手套还能打结。
items.body_zh: 防晒手套能在长时间钓鱼时保护手背。露指或可翻盖的手套能打结，也能感觉线。氯丁橡胶手套适合冷水，防割手套适合处理利齿鱼或片鱼。接触要放流的鱼之前，手套要先打湿，以免蹭掉鱼身上的黏液。

items.question: What makes fishing pliers durable in saltwater?
items.question_zh: 钓鱼钳怎样才能在海水中耐用？
items.short: Corrosion-resistant metal and replaceable cutters.
items.body: Aluminum or titanium bodies resist rust better than ordinary steel, and stainless parts help. Replaceable tungsten-carbide cutters keep cutting braid after a lot of use. A lanyard and sheath help keep them on the boat. Rinse them in fresh water after each trip and oil the pivot.
items.short_zh: 耐腐蚀的金属，以及可更换的剪刃。
items.body_zh: 铝合金或钛合金钳身比普通钢更耐锈，不锈钢零件也有帮助。可更换的碳化钨剪刃，用久了还能剪断编织线。挂绳和钳套能防止掉到水里。每次钓完用淡水冲洗，在转轴上加点油。

items.question: Which landing net material is gentlest on fish that will be released?
items.question_zh: 对要放流的鱼，哪种材质的抄网最温和？
items.short: Soft rubber or coated mesh, without knots.
items.body: A shallow net of fine mesh is easiest on a fish you'll release, and rubber is gentler still. Knotless mesh protects the slime, and Washington's selective gear rules allow only knotless nets to land fish. Avoid coarse nylon, which can damage fins and eyes. Keep the net wet. Hooks also tangle less in rubber.
items.short_zh: 软橡胶或涂胶的无结网。
items.body_zh: 细网眼的浅抄网对放流的鱼最温和，橡胶网更好。无结网能保护鱼身上的黏液，华盛顿州的选择性钓具规则也只允许用无结网。不要用粗糙的尼龙网，可能伤到鱼鳍和鱼眼。网要保持湿润。橡胶网也不容易挂钩。

items.question: How accurate does a portable fish scale need to be?
items.question_zh: 便携鱼秤需要多高的精度？
items.short: For normal fishing, a small error is fine. For records, the scale must meet the record body's rules.
items.body: A good digital scale that reads within a couple of ounces is fine for personal records. Tournaments and official record claims usually require a certified scale, so check their rules. Check the battery and zero the scale before each use. Weigh fish in a wet sling and return them quickly.
items.short_zh: 平时钓鱼，小误差没关系。申报纪录时，秤要符合纪录机构的规定。
items.body_zh: 读数误差在几盎司以内的好电子秤，记录个人成绩就够了。比赛和官方纪录申报通常要求使用经过认证的秤，要查清规则。每次用前检查电池，并把秤归零。用湿的吊带称鱼，称完尽快放回。

items.question: How can a beginner learn to throw a cast net?
items.question_zh: 新手怎样学习抛撒网？
items.short: Start with a small net and practice on land before going to the water.
items.body: A 4 to 5 foot net is easier to learn with. Hold the hand line, load part of the net on your arm and swing it so it opens into a circle. Practice on grass. Watching someone or a short video helps more than reading. Read your state's rules first, since cast nets are limited to certain species, sizes and waters, and they aren't allowed everywhere.
items.short_zh: 先用小网，在陆地上练好再下水。
items.body_zh: 4 到 5 英尺的网比较容易学。握住手绳，把网的一部分搭在手臂上，甩出去让它张开成圆形。先在草地上练。看别人抛或看短视频，比读文字有用。先查州里的规定，撒网在鱼种、网的大小和水域上都有限制，也不是到处都允许。

items.question: Is a premium cooler worth the extra money for fishing trips?
items.question_zh: 钓鱼用的高端保温箱值得多花钱吗？
items.short: It is if you take multi-day trips or often need to keep fish cold for long periods.
items.body: Thick insulated coolers hold ice much longer and survive rough use. For short day trips, a basic cooler with plenty of ice works fine. A slush of ice and water chills fish 4 to 5 times faster than ice alone, and a fisheries handling guide recommends about 2 lb of ice per pound of fish. An older Cornell and New York Sea Grant bulletin called 1 lb of ice per 3 lb of fish usually enough, so the figures vary: carry more in hot weather and on long days. Consider weight and size too, since a heavy cooler is hard to carry to the bank.
items.short_zh: 如果经常多日出行，或者要长时间保冷，就值得。
items.body_zh: 厚壁保温箱保冰时间长得多，也经得起粗放使用。一日短途，普通保温箱加足够的冰就够了。冰水混合物的降温速度是单纯用冰的 4 到 5 倍，渔业处理指南建议每磅鱼用约 2 磅冰。一份较早的 Cornell 和纽约 Sea Grant 手册认为，每 3 磅鱼用 1 磅冰通常就够，各家数字不一样，天热或时间长时要多带。也要考虑重量和大小，太重的保温箱很难带到岸边。

items.question: How is a conventional reel cast differently from a baitcaster?
items.question_zh: 鼓轮和水滴轮的抛投方法有什么不同？
items.short: The thumb control is the same, but a conventional reel usually has a larger, heavier spool and little or no brake.
items.body: Conventional reels are often used with heavier rigs and long, two-handed casts with a soft, rounded stroke. Keep your thumb on the spool throughout the cast and slow it as the rig comes down. A large spool carries more momentum, so overruns can be severe. Set the cast control, practice with moderate power, and add power only when the spool behaves.
items.short_zh: 拇指控制的方法一样，但鼓轮的线杯通常更大更重，刹车很少或没有。
items.body_zh: 鼓轮常用于较重的钓组，用双手做长距离、圆润的抛投。整个抛投过程中拇指都要搭在线杯上，钓组下落时减慢线杯。大线杯惯性大，炸线可能很严重。先调好抛投控制，用中等力量练习，线杯听话了再加力。

items.question: After several fishless trips to the same water, what should be changed first?
items.question_zh: 在同一水域连续几次没有收获，应该先改变什么？
items.short: Change the time or the location before buying new gear.
items.body: Try dawn or dusk, then different depths and other parts of the lake. Check recent fishing reports and ask whether the water holds the fish you are after. Go to a different water for a while to learn what works. Go lighter and quieter and try a small bait. Keep notes on weather, temperature and location.
items.short_zh: 买新装备之前，先换时间或换地方。
items.body_zh: 试试清晨或傍晚，再换不同的水深和湖的其他区域。看看近期的钓况报告，问问这片水域有没有你要钓的鱼。换一片水域钓一段时间，了解什么有效。钓组轻一点，动静小一点，试试小饵。把天气、水温和位置记下来。

items.question: Which casting mistakes limit distance the most?
items.question_zh: 哪些抛投错误最影响距离？
items.short: Stopping too short, releasing late and using too much force.
items.body: Smooth acceleration and a firm stop are what load the rod. Overpowering or snapping can reduce distance and cause tangles. A lure outside the rod's range, an underfilled spool and too much or too little line between the rod tip and the lure also cost distance. Let a lure hang 10 to 18 inches below the tip on a spinning rod, and practice on grass with a target. Where the lure lands tells you what to fix: close in front of you means you let go too late, and high up or behind you means too early.
items.short_zh: 停得太早、出手太晚，以及用力过猛。
items.body_zh: 让竿受力的关键是平顺加速和干脆地停住。用蛮力或猛甩，反而抛得近，还容易缠线。饵超出竿的范围、线杯没上够、竿尖到饵的线太长或太短，都会影响距离。直柄竿让饵垂在竿尖下方 10 到 18 英寸，在草地上对着目标练习。看饵落在哪里就知道该怎么改：落在面前太近，是松手太晚；飞得很高或往身后去，是松手太早。

items.question: What should someone new to fish finders understand first?
items.question_zh: 刚接触探鱼器的人，首先应该了解什么？
items.short: A fish finder shows depth, bottom and what is under the boat, not exactly where to fish.
items.body: Start by learning bottom hardness, depth changes and weeds. Fish show as arches only when the boat is moving. A wide cone means what you see may be off to the side. Practice over an area you know. GPS mapping is as useful as sonar, because contour maps show points and drop-offs.
items.short_zh: 探鱼器显示的是水深、水底和船下的情况，并不能告诉你该在哪里钓。
items.body_zh: 先学会看水底软硬、水深变化和水草。只有船在移动时，鱼才显示成拱形。声呐波束较宽，看到的东西可能在侧面。先在熟悉的水域练习。GPS 地图和声呐一样有用，等深线能显示岬角和陡坎。

items.question: How useful is a castable sonar for someone who fishes only from shore?
items.question_zh: 只在岸上钓鱼的人，可抛投式声呐有多大用处？
items.short: Useful for finding depth and structure within casting range.
items.body: A castable sonar connects to your phone wirelessly. It shows depth, bottom shape and fish, and can build a simple map if you cast in a grid. Its range is limited by the wireless link and how far you can cast. It doesn't replace reading the water. It is a reasonable buy for shore anglers who fish the same waters often, though expect to lose one to a snag eventually.
items.short_zh: 用来了解抛投范围内的水深和地形很有用。
items.body_zh: 可抛投式声呐通过无线连接手机，能显示水深、水底形状和鱼，按网格抛投还能生成简单的地图。范围受无线连接和抛投距离限制。它代替不了读水。对经常在同一片水域岸钓的人来说，值得一买，但迟早可能挂底丢掉一个。

items.question: What screen size and sonar type are enough for a small boat or kayak?
items.question_zh: 小船或皮划艇用多大的屏幕和什么类型的声呐就够了？
items.short: A 5 to 7 inch screen with CHIRP and down imaging.
items.body: A 5-inch screen is enough for a kayak, and a 7-inch suits a small boat if you can see it easily. CHIRP gives clearer target separation, and down imaging shows structure well. GPS with mapping is useful. Side imaging is a nice extra but costs more and needs some speed and depth. Check how the transducer fits before buying.
items.short_zh: 5 到 7 英寸屏幕，带 CHIRP 和下扫成像。
items.body_zh: 皮划艇用 5 英寸屏幕就够了，小船用 7 英寸，只要看得清楚。CHIRP 能更清楚地区分目标，下扫成像能很好地显示水下结构。带地图的 GPS 也很有用。侧扫成像是加分项，但更贵，也需要一定的船速和水深。买之前确认换能器好不好安装。

items.question: How can a fish finder be moved between boats without a permanent installation?
items.question_zh: 不做固定安装的话，怎样让探鱼器在不同的船之间使用？
items.short: Use a portable kit with a battery and a suction or clamp transducer mount.
items.body: Several makers sell portable kits that hold the unit, battery and transducer. A clamp or suction-cup mount attaches the transducer to the transom or gunwale. Check that the transducer sits below the waterline, level and free of bubbles. Bring a charged battery and check the cable length.
items.short_zh: 用便携套件，配电池和吸盘或夹式换能器支架。
items.body_zh: 有几家厂商出售便携套件，把主机、电池和换能器装在一起。用夹子或吸盘把换能器固定在船尾或船舷上。换能器要在水线以下，保持水平，没有气泡干扰。带上充好电的电池，并确认线缆够长。

items.question: How can waypoints be transferred between units?
items.question_zh: 航点怎样在设备之间转移？
items.short: Export them to a memory card or through the maker's app.
items.body: Most units can save waypoints to a microSD card or sync through a mobile app. Between different brands, look for an export format such as GPX. Back up before updating software. Transferred names and icons may not all match, so follow the instructions for your model.
items.short_zh: 导出到存储卡，或者通过厂家的应用同步。
items.body_zh: 多数设备可以把航点存到 microSD 卡，或者通过手机应用同步。在不同品牌之间转移，要找 GPX 这样的通用格式。更新软件前先备份。转移后的名称和图标不一定完全对应，要按你的型号的说明操作。

items.question: Are battery-powered portable fish finders practical?
items.question_zh: 电池供电的便携探鱼器实用吗？
items.short: Yes for kayaks, small boats and ice fishing.
items.body: Sealed lithium batteries last a full day with a small unit and add little weight. Check the unit's power needs before choosing battery capacity, and remember that a bright screen uses more. Cold reduces battery life in winter. Always secure the battery and protect the terminals from water.
items.short_zh: 在皮划艇、小船和冰钓时很实用。
items.body_zh: 密封锂电池给小型设备供电，用一整天没问题，重量也不大。选电池容量之前，先看设备的功耗，屏幕越亮耗电越多。冬天低温会缩短电池寿命。电池一定要固定好，接线端要防水。

items.question: Which features matter most on a kayak?
items.question_zh: 皮划艇上，哪些功能最重要？
items.short: A small screen that's easy to read, GPS and a simple mount.
items.body: Look for a mount that keeps the unit within easy reach without getting in the way of paddling. A scupper-hole transducer mount or a transducer arm works well, and a good waterproof rating matters. Use a small sealed battery in a waterproof box. GPS track-back helps you get back to the launch in poor visibility.
items.short_zh: 好读的小屏幕、GPS 和简单的支架。
items.body_zh: 支架要让设备伸手可及，又不妨碍划桨。排水孔式换能器支架或换能器臂都不错，防水等级也要够高。用小型密封电池，放在防水盒里。GPS 轨迹返回功能，能在能见度差时帮你回到下水点。

items.question: Which features matter for ice fishing?
items.question_zh: 冰钓时，哪些功能重要？
items.short: A flasher or sonar with good target separation, and a battery that handles cold.
items.body: A flasher or ice-ready sonar shows your jig and any fish coming to it in real time, which matters more than mapping. Zoom helps separate fish from the bottom. Look for a portable case with an ice transducer. Keep batteries warm, and check that the ice is safe before anything else.
items.short_zh: 目标分辨率好的闪光探鱼器或声呐，以及耐低温的电池。
items.body_zh: 闪光探鱼器或冰钓声呐能实时显示你的饵和靠近的鱼，这比地图重要。放大功能有助于区分鱼和水底。选带冰钓换能器的便携箱。电池要保温，最重要的是先确认冰面安全。

items.question: How do a fishing kayak and a small jon boat compare for loading, launching and storage?
items.question_zh: 钓鱼皮划艇和小型平底船，在装卸、下水和存放上有什么差别？
items.short: A kayak is easier to carry and store. A jon boat is more stable and carries more.
items.body: A kayak can ride on a car roof and launch from a bank with no ramp. A jon boat usually needs a trailer or truck bed and a ramp or shallow access, but it holds more people and gear and is easy to stand in. Kayaks fit in a garage or on a rack. Many states require registration for boats with motors, and some require it or a launch permit for kayaks too.
items.short_zh: 皮划艇更容易搬运和存放，平底船更稳，装得更多。
items.body_zh: 皮划艇可以放在车顶，不用下水坡道，从岸边就能下水。平底船通常需要拖车或皮卡，还要有坡道或浅水入口，但能载更多人和装备，也方便站立。皮划艇可以放在车库或架子上。很多州要求有发动机的船登记，有些州对皮划艇也要求登记或下水许可。

items.question: Are inflatable boats safe and practical for fishing on small lakes?
items.question_zh: 在小型湖泊上用充气船钓鱼，安全实用吗？
items.short: Good ones can be, if used carefully.
items.body: Choose a boat built for fishing, with multiple air chambers and abrasion-resistant material. Keep hooks in a box and use a landing net rather than a gaff. Wind pushes inflatables around, so watch the forecast and stay close to shore. Everyone needs a life jacket, and a motor may mean registration. Don't exceed the capacity plate.
items.short_zh: 好的充气船可以，但要谨慎使用。
items.body_zh: 选专为钓鱼设计、有多个气室和耐磨材料的船。钩要放在盒子里，用抄网，不要用手钩（gaff）。充气船容易被风吹走，要看好天气预报，靠近岸边。每个人都要有救生衣，装发动机可能需要登记。不要超过额定载重。

items.question: How should a trolling motor be sized for a small boat?
items.question_zh: 小船的电动马达该选多大的推力？
items.short: A common rule of thumb is about 2 pounds of thrust per 100 pounds of loaded boat weight.
items.body: Count the weight of the boat, people, gear and batteries, and add some extra for wind or current. A motor of 30 to 55 lb thrust suits most small jon boats. Use a shaft long enough to keep the prop well below the surface. A deep-cycle battery of proper size with a fuse is essential. Some waters limit motors, so read your state's rules.
items.short_zh: 常见的经验法则是，满载船重每 100 磅约需 2 磅推力。
items.body_zh: 把船、人、装备和电池的重量都算上，有风或水流时再加一些。30 到 55 磅推力能满足多数小型平底船。轴要够长，让螺旋桨深入水面以下。合适容量的深循环电池和保险丝是必需的。有些水域限制发动机，要看所在州的规定。

items.question: How can a trolling motor be diagnosed when it stops working?
items.question_zh: 电动马达不工作时，怎样排查？
items.short: Start with the battery, connections and fuses.
items.body: Measure the battery voltage. Check the terminals for corrosion, then the fuse or circuit breaker. Look for line wrapped around the prop shaft, a common cause of failure, and make sure the prop turns. Test on another battery. If the motor works only at some speeds, suspect the speed switch. Disconnect power before working on the prop.
items.short_zh: 先查电池、接线和保险丝。
items.body_zh: 测量电池电压。看接线端有没有腐蚀，再看保险丝或断路器。检查螺旋桨轴上有没有缠线，这是常见的故障原因，并确认螺旋桨能转动。换一块电池试试。如果只有某些档位工作，多半是调速开关的问题。处理螺旋桨之前要先断电。

items.question: What should a fishing PFD offer that a general one does not?
items.question_zh: 钓鱼专用救生衣应该具备哪些普通救生衣没有的功能？
items.short: Pockets, tool attachment points and more freedom for casting.
items.body: Fishing life jackets are cut for arm movement, often with high backs for kayak seats. Pockets and loops hold pliers and small boxes. Any life jacket must be US Coast Guard approved and fit properly, and it only helps if you wear it. Check the fit by raising your arms while someone pulls up on the shoulders, and keep pockets light.
items.short_zh: 口袋、工具挂点，以及更利于抛投的活动空间。
items.body_zh: 钓鱼救生衣的剪裁便于手臂活动，常有适合皮划艇座椅的高背设计。口袋和挂环可以放钳子和小盒子。任何救生衣都要经美国海岸警卫队认证、合身，穿在身上才有用。检查方法是举起双臂，请别人往上拉肩部。口袋不要装太重。

items.question: What can be done to keep bait alive on a small boat without a built-in livewell?
items.question_zh: 小船上没有内置活饵舱时，怎样让活饵保持存活？
items.short: Use a bucket with an aerator, and keep it cool and out of the sun.
items.body: An aerator helps on hot days, so use one if you can. Keep the bucket in the shade and don't overcrowd it. Keep bait in the water it came from and use it soon. A frozen bottle of dechlorinated water can cool the bucket in summer. Never dump leftover bait into a lake, because it can bring in unwanted animals.
items.short_zh: 用带增氧器的水桶，保持凉爽，避开阳光。
items.body_zh: 天热时增氧器很有帮助，有条件就用。水桶放在阴凉处，鱼不要放太多。饵最好放在它原来的水里，尽快用掉。夏天可以把除氯水冻成冰瓶，放进桶里降温。剩下的活饵绝不要倒进湖里，可能带入有害的物种。

items.question: How should downriggers be chosen and spaced on a small craft?
items.question_zh: 小型船具上的下沉器该怎么选、间距多大？
items.short: Manual downriggers are usually enough, one on each side at the stern.
items.body: Small boats have less space and power, so a manual unit with a short arm is simple and light. Mount it where the boat can take the strain and where lines stay clear. Set lines at different depths and stagger them so they don't cross. Keep weights small, because a heavy weight and a small boat are a poor match. Bring the weights up before moving fast or turning sharply.
items.short_zh: 手动下沉器通常就够了，在船尾两侧各装一个。
items.body_zh: 小船空间和动力都有限，短臂手动款简单又轻。安装在船体能承受拉力、线又不会互相干扰的位置。两根线设在不同的深度，并错开，避免交叉。铅锤不要太重，重铅锤和小船不相配。高速行驶或急转弯之前，先把铅锤收上来。

items.question: What rod length and reel type work best for a very young child?
items.question_zh: 年龄很小的孩子，用多长的竿、什么轮最合适？
items.short: A short rod, under about 5 feet, with a push-button reel.
items.body: The easiest setup for a child is a push-button (spincast) reel on a short rod with a hook, a split shot and a bobber. The closed reel keeps tangles to a minimum, and a child can see the bobber go down. Cane poles work for the youngest children. Choose a rod the child can actually hold, because toy-style rods can be hard to use.
items.short_zh: 5 英尺以内的短竿，配按钮式卡式轮。
items.body_zh: 给孩子最简单的配置，是短竿配卡式轮，再加钩、咬铅和浮漂。封闭的轮很少缠线，孩子也能看到浮漂下沉。年龄最小的孩子可以用手竿。选一根孩子真正拿得住的竿，玩具款的竿可能反而不好用。

items.question: How can a group trip with children of very different ages stay safe and manageable?
items.question_zh: 带年龄差别很大的一群孩子去钓鱼，怎样保证安全又便于管理？
items.short: Keep adults close, space out the casting areas and keep the trip short.
items.body: Have one adult for every one or two young children, and give older children a small job such as baiting hooks. Spread out to at least one rod's length between anglers, and remind everyone to look behind them before casting. Pinch the barbs down on the hooks. Children near deep water need life jackets that fit. Bring snacks and stop while it's still fun.
items.short_zh: 大人不要离得太远，分开抛投的位置，时间不要太长。
items.body_zh: 每一两个小孩子配一个大人，给大一点的孩子分配小任务，比如挂饵。大家分散站开，相邻的人至少隔一根竿的距离，提醒每个人抛投前看看身后。把钩的倒刺压平。在深水附近，孩子要穿合身的救生衣。带上零食，趁着还开心就结束。

items.question: Where can a left-handed child find a suitable starter reel?
items.question_zh: 左撇子孩子可以在哪里找到合适的入门轮？
items.short: Most spinning reels have a handle that can be switched to the other side.
items.body: Spinning reels usually let you unscrew the handle and move it. Many push-button reels are also made for either hand or have a reversible handle, so check the packaging. Let the child try reeling with either hand, because a left-handed child may prefer to hold the rod in the left hand and reel with the right, or the other way round.
items.short_zh: 多数纺车轮的手把都可以换到另一边。
items.body_zh: 纺车轮通常可以拧下手把换边。很多卡式轮也能左右手通用，或者手把可以换向，看包装说明就行。让孩子两只手都试试，左撇子孩子可能喜欢左手握竿、右手摇轮，也可能正好相反。

items.question: Is handling lead sinkers a health concern, and are non-lead weights worth using?
items.question_zh: 接触铅坠有健康风险吗？无铅坠值得使用吗？
items.short: The main risk is lead getting into your mouth, so a few habits help. Non-lead weights are worth using if you can.
items.body: Illinois and Salt Lake County health agencies both say to wash with soap and water after handling sinkers, and Illinois adds after cleaning out a tackle box. Alcohol hand sanitizer doesn't remove lead. Never put a sinker in your mouth or bite split shot closed; use pliers. Keep tackle away from children, who are more vulnerable. Making your own sinkers is a bigger hazard, because melting lead gives off fumes and leaves dust on surfaces. We found no official figure for the risk of ordinary handling. Non-lead weights in tin, bismuth, steel or tungsten are sold, and they also spare birds that swallow lost sinkers. Vermont bars lead sinkers of half an ounce or less, and New York no longer allows small ones to be sold.
items.short_zh: 主要风险是铅进入嘴里，几个习惯就有帮助。条件允许的话，无铅坠值得用。
items.body_zh: 伊利诺伊州和盐湖县的卫生部门都提醒，接触铅坠后要用肥皂和水洗手，伊利诺伊州还提到清理渔具盒之后也要洗。含酒精的免洗洗手液去不掉铅。不要把铅坠放进嘴里，也不要用牙咬合咬铅，要用钳子。不要让孩子玩渔具，孩子更容易受铅伤害。自己熔铅做坠的风险更大，熔铅会产生烟雾，还会在物体表面留下粉尘。我们没有找到官方对普通接触风险的量化结论。市面上有锡、铋、钢或钨的无铅坠，还能避免鸟类误吞丢失的铅坠。佛蒙特州禁止使用半盎司及以下的铅坠，纽约州也不再允许出售小型铅坠。

items.question: What are the real pros and cons of barbless hooks?
items.question_zh: 无倒刺钩实际的优缺点是什么？
items.short: They come out more easily, but a fish can shake off more often if the line goes slack.
items.body: Pinching down a barb makes the hook quicker to take out, and kinder if it ever ends up in your own skin. You will lose a few more fish, so keep steady pressure on them. Some waters require barbless hooks. Washington counts a barb that has been filed off or pinched down as barbless.
items.short_zh: 取钩更容易，但线一松，鱼也更容易脱钩。
items.body_zh: 把倒刺压平后，取钩更快，万一钩到自己的皮肤也好处理。代价是多跑一点鱼，所以要保持稳定的拉力。有些水域要求用无倒刺钩。华盛顿州规定，倒刺锉掉或压平的钩就算无倒刺。

items.question: What fishing equipment can help an angler who has the use of only one hand?
items.question_zh: 只能用一只手的钓鱼人，有哪些装备可以帮上忙？
items.short: Rod holders, electric reels and one-handed tools.
items.body: A chest or belt rod holder keeps the rod steady while you reel with one hand. Battery-powered reels can help, as can a rod mounted on a wheelchair or a stand. Spring-loaded pliers and one-handed line clippers are useful, and some groups provide adaptive equipment for free or at low cost. Local disability sports groups and rehabilitation services can advise on the right solution.
items.short_zh: 竿架、电动轮和单手工具。
items.body_zh: 胸前或腰间的竿架能稳住竿，用一只手摇轮。电动轮也有帮助，还可以把竿固定在轮椅或支架上。带弹簧的钳子和单手剪线钳很实用，有些团体免费或低价提供辅助装备。当地的残障运动团体和康复机构，可以帮忙找到合适的方案。

items.question: What blade length suits small panfish compared with larger fish?
items.question_zh: 片小型淡水鱼和片较大的鱼，分别适合多长的刀刃？
items.short: About 4 to 6 inches for panfish, 7 to 9 inches for larger fish.
items.body: A short, flexible blade follows the ribs of a bluegill or crappie easily. A longer one lets you make a single, smooth cut on bass, walleye or catfish. Very large fish may need a 10-inch blade or a stiffer knife.
items.short_zh: 小型淡水鱼用 4 到 6 英寸，较大的鱼用 7 到 9 英寸。
items.body_zh: 短而有弹性的刀刃，能轻松贴着蓝鳃太阳鱼或莓鲈的肋骨走。长一些的刀刃，可以在鲈鱼、大眼梭鲈或鲶鱼身上一刀划下去。特别大的鱼可能要用 10 英寸的刀，或者更硬的刀。

items.question: Is an electric fillet knife worth using for large batches of fish?
items.question_zh: 处理大量鱼时，电动片鱼刀值得用吗？
items.short: Yes, if you clean lots of fish, especially panfish.
items.body: An electric knife cuts through fish and ribs faster and reduces hand fatigue. You'll lose a little more meat at first, and it needs an outlet or battery. With small numbers of fish a manual knife is fine. Keep it clean and dry, and be careful, because the blades cut quickly.
items.short_zh: 如果要处理很多鱼，尤其是小型淡水鱼，就值得。
items.body_zh: 电动刀切鱼和肋骨更快，手也不容易累。刚开始会多损失一点肉，也需要插座或电池。鱼不多时，手动刀就够了。用后保持清洁干燥，操作时要小心，刀刃切得很快。

items.question: Which sharpener is easiest for someone with no sharpening experience?
items.question_zh: 没有磨刀经验的人，哪种磨刀器最容易上手？
items.short: A pull-through sharpener or a guided system.
items.body: Pull-through sharpeners hold the correct angle for you and are quick to use, though they remove more metal. A guided rod or clamp system gives a better edge but takes longer to set up. Keep the knife sharp, because a dull blade is more dangerous and can slip.
items.short_zh: 拉式磨刀器或带导向的磨刀系统。
items.body_zh: 拉式磨刀器能自动保持正确的角度，用起来快，不过磨掉的金属也多。带导杆或夹具的系统磨得更好，但设置要花些时间。刀要保持锋利，钝刀更危险，也容易打滑。

items.question: How should a folding fillet knife be cleaned so it stays hygienic?
items.question_zh: 折叠片鱼刀应该怎样清洁才能保持卫生？
items.short: Open it fully and wash it with hot, soapy water.
items.body: Scrub the blade, the pivot area and inside the handle with a small brush. Rinse and dry it fully, then add a drop of food-safe oil at the pivot. Fish residue can hide inside, so wash it as soon as you can after use, and don't store it damp. Sanitize it before using it on food, and keep raw fish away from other food.
items.short_zh: 完全打开，用热肥皂水清洗。
items.body_zh: 用小刷子刷洗刀刃、转轴和手柄内侧。冲干净并彻底擦干，再在转轴上滴一滴食品级油。鱼的残渣容易藏在里面，所以用完要尽快清洗，不要湿着存放。用来处理食物之前要消毒，生鱼也要和其他食物分开。

items.question: How can I check whether a lure with several treble hooks is legal where I fish?
items.question_zh: 怎样查证带多个三本钩的饵，在我钓鱼的地方是否合法？
items.short: Read your state's gear definitions and the special rules for that water.
items.body: Look in your state's fishing regulations for the definition of a hook, a lure and any artificial-only or single-hook waters, then read the special rule for that lake or river. Definitions differ: Connecticut counts each point as a hook, Michigan counts a treble on a manufactured lure as one hook, and Washington's selective gear rules require single-point barbless hooks. If you can't tell, call the state agency before fishing.
items.short_zh: 看本州对钓具的定义，以及该水域的特别规定。
items.body_zh: 在本州的钓鱼规定里，查钩和拟饵的定义，以及只许拟饵或单钩的水域，再看那个湖或河的特别规定。各州定义不同：康涅狄格州每个钩尖算一个钩，密歇根州把商品拟饵上的三本钩算作一个钩，华盛顿州的选择性钓具规则要求单尖无倒刺钩。如果看不明白，钓之前打电话问州主管机构。

items.question: If a water body allows only single hooks, how may a lure be modified to comply?
items.question_zh: 如果某水域只允许单钩，饵可以怎样改装才符合规定？
items.short: Usually by replacing each treble with a single-point hook, but read your state's definition first.
items.body: Washington defines a single-point hook as one with only one point, so doubles and trebles don't qualify. Its selective gear rules allow up to three single-point barbless hooks and no bait, and a barb counts as removed if it is filed off or pinched down. Virginia treats a treble with two points removed as a single-point hook, so cutting points may work there, but don't assume that elsewhere. Hook counts vary too: Connecticut counts each point as a hook, while Michigan counts a treble on a manufactured lure as one hook. Split-ring pliers make the swap easy. A single hook is usually lighter than a treble and can change how the lure swims, so test it first. The rule for that specific water is the one that counts.
items.short_zh: 通常是把每个三本钩换成单钩，但要先看本州的定义。
items.body_zh: 华盛顿州把单钩（single point hook）定义为只有一个钩尖的钩，双钩和三本钩都不算。该州的选择性钓具规则（selective gear rules）允许最多三个单尖无倒刺钩，并且禁止用天然饵；倒刺锉掉或压平就算无倒刺。弗吉尼亚州把去掉两个钩尖的三本钩视为单钩，所以在那里剪钩尖可能可行，但不要默认别处也这样。钩数的算法也不同：康涅狄格州每个钩尖算一个钩，密歇根州则把商品拟饵上的三本钩算作一个钩。用开环钳换钩很方便。单钩通常比三本钩轻，可能改变饵的游姿，最好先试一下。最终以该水域的具体规定为准。

items.question: How can I check that a rod, reel and line are suited to each other as a complete setup?
items.question_zh: 怎样检查竿、轮和线作为一整套是否彼此合适？
items.short: Compare the printed ratings, then check balance and line fit.
items.body: The line should fall within the rod's rating and the reel's capacity, and the lure weight within the rod's lure rating. Reel size should balance the rod, so mount it and see whether the tip dives. Spinning reels go on spinning rods and casting reels on casting rods. Make a few casts and check that the drag slips before the rod reaches its limit.
items.short_zh: 比较竿和轮上印的标称，再检查平衡和线是否合适。
items.body_zh: 线要在竿的线号范围和轮的容线量之内，饵重要在竿的饵重标称之内。轮的大小要和竿平衡，装上后看竿尖是否下沉。纺车轮配直柄竿，水滴轮配枪柄竿。抛几次，确认卸力在竿到达极限之前就会滑动。

items.question: What are the common signs that a factory combo is poor value?
items.question_zh: 哪些常见迹象说明一款原厂套装性价比不高？
items.short: A rough or loose reel, poor guides and a reel that doesn't match the rod.
items.body: Turn the handle: grinding or looseness is a bad sign. Check that the guides are straight and properly wrapped. A reel sold already filled may have sat on a shelf for a long time, so the line may come off in coils. Replacing line is cheap, but a bad reel isn't worth buying.
items.short_zh: 轮发涩或松动、导环差，以及轮和竿不匹配。
items.body_zh: 转转手把，有摩擦感或松动就不是好兆头。看导环是否直、绑线是否规整。原厂上好线的轮，可能在货架上放了很久，线放出来会一圈圈卷着。换线花不了多少钱，但轮不好就不值得买。

items.question: When is a factory combo a better buy than a rod and reel chosen separately?
items.question_zh: 什么情况下原厂套装比分别选竿和轮更划算？
items.short: For a first outfit, a child's outfit or a spare rod.
items.body: A combo saves money when you aren't yet sure what you'll use. Buying separately wins when you know what you want, because you can match the rod to a technique and choose a better reel. A combo also suits travel or a spare, and some premium combos are sold at a discount, which can be good value. The rod and reel in a combo are already matched, and many come spooled with line.
items.short_zh: 第一套、孩子用的，或者备用竿的时候。
items.body_zh: 还不确定要用什么时，套装省钱。知道自己要什么时，分开买更好，竿可以按钓法选，轮也能选更好的。旅行或备用也适合套装，有些高端套装打折时也很划算。组合套装的竿和轮已经配好，很多还绕好了线。

items.question: How many rods does someone need to cover light, medium and heavy techniques?
items.question_zh: 要覆盖轻、中、重几类钓法，需要几根竿？
items.short: Two or three.
items.body: A light spinning rod for panfish and trout, a medium spinning rod for general use and a medium-heavy casting rod for heavier lures cover most freshwater fishing. One rod can do a lot, so a second makes sense only when the first can't handle what you want to fish. Extras are mainly for saving time or for specialized methods.
items.short_zh: 两到三根。
items.body_zh: 一根轻型直柄竿钓小型淡水鱼和鳟鱼，一根中等硬度直柄竿作通用，一根中硬枪柄竿用重饵，大多数淡水钓法就都覆盖了。一根竿能做很多事，只有第一根应付不了时，才需要第二根。再多的竿，主要是为了省时间或用于专门的钓法。

items.question: How do I work out what is missing from my current setup for a new technique?
items.question_zh: 想尝试新钓法时，怎样判断现有配置还缺什么？
items.short: List what the technique needs and compare it with what you own.
items.body: Write down the rod power and length, line and terminal tackle the technique requires. Can your current rod cast the lure, and is its action right? Often you can start with your current rod and new terminal tackle. Try the technique before buying a specialist rod, and ask a shop for the minimum you'd need.
items.short_zh: 列出这种钓法需要什么，再和手头的装备对照。
items.body_zh: 写下这种钓法需要的竿硬度、长度、线和终端配件。现在的竿能抛这个饵吗？调性合适吗？很多时候，用现有的竿加新的终端配件就能开始。买专用竿之前先试试这种钓法，也可以问渔具店最少需要买什么。

items.question: How much gear is too much for a single outing?
items.question_zh: 一次出门带多少装备算太多？
items.short: If you can't carry it easily or reach it quickly, it's too much.
items.body: On the bank, one or two rods and a small box are usually enough, and more gear means more tangles and less fishing time. In a boat, limit rods to the methods you'll actually use and keep the deck clear, since gear underfoot is a safety problem. If you didn't use something in the last few trips, leave it at home.
items.short_zh: 带不动、拿不快，就是太多了。
items.body_zh: 岸钓时，一两根竿加一个小盒通常就够了，装备越多，缠线越多，钓鱼的时间越少。在船上，只带真正会用到的钓法的竿，甲板要保持通畅，脚下堆东西不安全。最近几次都没用过的东西，就留在家里。

items.question: What makes a complete setup under $100 worth buying?
items.question_zh: 低于 100 美元的整套配置，怎样才算值得买？
items.short: A reel with a smooth drag, and a rod that suits your fishing.
items.body: Check that the reel turns without grinding, that the drag gives line smoothly, and that the rod's ratings suit the lures you will use. Buy the combo and spend the rest on line and basic tackle. Don't pay more for extra bearings or flashy finishes.
items.short_zh: 轮的卸力要顺滑，竿要适合你的钓法。
items.body_zh: 确认轮转动时没有摩擦感，卸力出线平顺，竿的标称适合你要用的饵。买好套装，其余的钱用来买线和基础配件。不要为更多的轴承或花哨的外观多花钱。

items.question: What should a complete setup costing $200 to under $500 deliver?
items.question_zh: 200 美元至不足 500 美元的整套配置，应该达到什么水平？
items.short: Light weight, a reliable drag and a rod matched closely to one technique.
items.body: At this price you can choose each part for a specific method. Expect a reel that stays smooth over years, a rod with good sensitivity and a warranty with a clear process. Put the money where the method needs it: feel for bottom lures, durability and drag for heavy cover. Don't forget quality line.
items.short_zh: 重量轻，卸力可靠，竿能和某种钓法精确匹配。
items.body_zh: 这个价位可以针对具体钓法来选每个部件。轮要能多年保持顺滑，竿的灵敏度要好，保修流程要清楚。钱要花在钓法最需要的地方：贴底的饵看重手感，重障碍区看重耐用性和卸力。也别忘了好线。

items.question: What changes in gear when moving from still lakes to flowing rivers?
items.question_zh: 从静水湖泊换到流动的河流时，装备要做哪些改变？
items.short: You usually need heavier weights, slightly longer rods and thin line that cuts the current.
items.body: Thin line drags less in current. Use enough weight to reach the bottom, keep a low profile, and fish eddies and the slack water behind rocks and log jams. Longer rods help steer drifts. Wear a life jacket if you wade in strong current, and take care below dams, where the water is swift and changes fast.
items.short_zh: 通常要用更重的铅、稍长的竿，以及能切开水流的细线。
items.body_zh: 细线在水流中的阻力小。铅的重量要够到底，身姿放低，重点钓回水和岩石、倒木后面的缓流。长竿有助于控制漂流。在急流中涉水要穿救生衣。水坝下方水流很急，变化也快，要特别小心。

items.question: Which lure colors stand out best in stained or muddy water?
items.question_zh: 在混浊或泥色水体中，哪些饵的颜色最显眼？
items.short: Bright colors in stained water, dark colors in muddy water.
items.body: In stained water with a few inches of visibility, chartreuse soft plastics, bright lipless crankbaits and gold or copper blades stand out. In muddy water with an inch or two of visibility, use dark colors and vibration: bladed swim jigs, rattling crankbaits and Colorado-blade spinnerbaits.
items.short_zh: 微浑的水用亮色，泥水用深色。
items.body_zh: 能见度只有几英寸的浑水里，荧光黄绿的软饵、亮色无唇 crankbait，以及金色或铜色叶片比较显眼。能见度只有一两英寸的泥水里，要用深色加振动：带叶片的游泳铅头钩、带响珠的 crankbait 和科罗拉多叶片的 spinnerbait。

items.question: What is a simple setup for walking small creeks?
items.question_zh: 沿着小溪走钓，有什么简单的配置？
items.short: A short light spinning rod, a small reel and a chest pack of small lures.
items.body: A 5 to 6 foot rod is easy to carry through brush. Use 4 to 6 lb line with small inline spinners, small jigs or a worm on a No. 10 hook. Carry pliers, clippers and a few split shot. Walk upstream and fish quietly. Stream banks are often private, so learn the access rules first, and wear shoes that grip slippery rocks.
items.short_zh: 短的轻型直柄竿、小轮，再加一个放小饵的胸包。
items.body_zh: 5 到 6 英尺的竿在灌木丛中好拿。用 4 到 6 磅线，配小旋转亮片、小铅头钩，或者 10 号钩挂蚯蚓。带上钳子、剪线钳和几粒咬铅。往上游走，保持安静。溪岸常常是私人土地，先弄清能不能进入，并穿防滑的鞋。

items.question: What should change for fishing brackish water?
items.question_zh: 在半咸水钓鱼，应该作出哪些调整？
items.short: Treat it like salt water for gear care, and check which rules apply.
items.body: Salt levels vary, but brackish water still corrodes hooks and reels, so rinse your gear the same way. You may meet both freshwater and saltwater fish, and lures for each can work. Whether you need a freshwater or a saltwater license, and where the boundary lies, varies by state, so check your state's map or regulations.
items.short_zh: 保养按海水来，并查清适用哪些规定。
items.body_zh: 盐度有高有低，但半咸水照样会腐蚀钩和轮，所以要用同样的方式冲洗。这里可能有淡水鱼也有海水鱼，两边的饵都可能有效。需要淡水证还是海水证、分界线在哪里，各州不同，要查本州的地图或规定。

items.question: Which items should a bank angler carry on a long walk along the shore?
items.question_zh: 沿岸长距离走钓时，应该随身带哪些东西？
items.short: Travel light: a small box, pliers, water and a phone.
items.body: Bring a rod or two, a small utility box, pliers and clippers, sun protection, insect repellent, water and snacks. Wear sturdy shoes. Carry a phone in a waterproof pouch and tell someone where you're going. A small trash bag lets you pack out line and litter. Keep your license with you.
items.short_zh: 轻装上路：一个小盒、钳子、水和手机。
items.body_zh: 带一两根竿、一个小收纳盒、钳子和剪线钳、防晒用品、驱虫剂、水和零食。穿结实的鞋。手机放在防水袋里，告诉别人你要去哪里。带一个小垃圾袋，把线和垃圾带走。钓鱼证要随身带。

items.question: Can one setup work reasonably in both saltwater and freshwater?
items.question_zh: 一套配置能在海水和淡水中都用得还不错吗？
items.short: Yes, with a saltwater-rated reel and some extra care.
items.body: A 7-foot medium spinning rod and a 3000 or 4000 reel the maker rates for salt works well in both. Rinse your gear with fresh water after salt trips, and use corrosion-resistant hooks in salt. Clean, drain and dry your gear between different waters. For heavy surf or very large fish you'll need dedicated gear.
items.short_zh: 可以，但轮要能用于海水，也要多花点心思保养。
items.body_zh: 7 英尺的中等硬度直柄竿，配厂家标明可用于海水的 3000 或 4000 号轮，在两种水域都好用。钓完海水用淡水冲洗，海水里用耐腐蚀的钩。换水域时要清洁、排水、晾干。遇到大浪或很大的鱼，就要用专门的装备了。

items.question: When a beginner catches nothing, which three things are most worth changing first?
items.question_zh: 新手钓不到鱼时，最值得先改变的三件事是什么？
items.short: Change the spot first, then the depth, then the size of your bait, one at a time.
items.body: Spot: if you are casting into open water, move to something fish use, such as weed edges, docks, fallen trees or a drop-off. Depth: under a bobber, the bait should hang just above the weeds or bottom, so adjust it a little each time. Size: a smaller hook, less bait and the smallest bobber that floats it can bring more bites. If nothing changes, check the basics. Stay quiet on the bank, keep your shadow off the water, and try early morning or evening.
items.short_zh: 先换位置，再换水深，最后换饵的大小，一次只改一项。
items.body_zh: 位置：如果你一直往开阔水面抛，就换到鱼会待的地方，比如水草边缘、码头、倒伏的树木或陡坎。水深：用浮漂时，饵应该悬在水草或水底的上方一点，每次调整一点。大小：换小一点的钩，少挂点饵，用能浮住饵的最小浮漂，咬口可能会多起来。如果还是没有变化，再检查基本功：岸上保持安静，别让影子落到水面上，换到清晨或傍晚试试。

items.question: How long should I stay in one spot before moving?
items.question_zh: 在一个位置待多久就应该换地方？
items.short: About 15 to 30 minutes without a bite is a sensible limit, and less with lures.
items.body: FishEye's catfish guide says to move after 15 minutes without a bite, and the stocked-trout guide says to reel in and recast after about 10. Bait left for catfish may need longer to draw fish by smell. With lures, a few casts to each likely spot is enough. If you find fish, stay. On water you don't know, it usually pays to move and look for them. Federal and South Carolina beginner guides give much the same numbers: 10 to 15 minutes for panfish, and about 15 for bait on the bottom.
items.short_zh: 没有咬口时，15 到 30 分钟是比较合理的上限，用拟饵时更短。
items.body_zh: FishEye 的鲶鱼指南说，15 分钟没咬口就换地方；放流鳟指南说，大约 10 分钟就收线检查再抛。钓鲶鱼时饵要靠气味吸引鱼，可能需要等久一点。用拟饵时，每个可能的位置抛几次就够了。找到鱼就留下。在不熟悉的水域，通常多走动、找鱼更有效。联邦和南卡的入门指南给的数字也差不多：小型淡水鱼 10 到 15 分钟，水底钓饵约 15 分钟。

items.question: How can I tell whether there are simply no fish in the water I am fishing?
items.question_zh: 怎样判断我钓的这片水域是不是根本没有鱼？
items.short: Check whether others catch fish there, and what the state says about that water.
items.body: State agencies publish stocking records and surveys, and a local shop or other anglers can tell you what is there. Look for signs of life: baitfish, surface rings and birds hunting. Very shallow ponds can lose fish in hot summers or harsh winters, but a water being entirely empty is rare. Shallow, weedy water can also run low on oxygen at night, when plants use it up. Try a small hook with a piece of worm, and if nothing takes it, try a different spot.
items.short_zh: 看看别人在那里能不能钓到鱼，再查州政府对这片水域的资料。
items.body_zh: 州主管机构会公布放流记录和调查结果，当地渔具店和其他钓鱼的人也能告诉你水里有什么。观察有没有生命迹象：饵鱼、水面涟漪、捕食的鸟。很浅的池塘在酷暑或严冬可能会死很多鱼，但完全没有鱼的情况很少。水浅草多的地方，夜里水草会消耗氧气，水中可能缺氧。用小钩挂一小段蚯蚓试试，如果没有任何动静，就换个位置。

items.question: How many trips is it normal to make before catching a first fish?
items.question_zh: 钓到第一条鱼之前，去几次算正常？
items.short: It varies, and a few trips is common.
items.body: There is no standard number. Someone fishing a stocked pond with worms may catch fish the first day, and someone casting lures from a busy bank may take several trips. Improve the odds by fishing for bluegill with small pieces of worm, in spring or summer, at dawn or dusk. Panfish feed through most of the day, so if a spot gives no bites in 10 to 15 minutes, try another. Ask a local shop about stocked waters.
items.short_zh: 因人而异，去几次才钓到很常见。
items.body_zh: 没有标准次数。在放流池塘用蚯蚓钓，可能第一天就有收获；在人多的岸边抛拟饵，可能要去好几次。想提高机会，就在春夏的清晨或傍晚，用小段蚯蚓钓蓝鳃太阳鱼。小型淡水鱼一天中大部分时间都会咬口，一个地方 10 到 15 分钟没动静，就换个位置。问问当地渔具店哪里有放流的水域。

items.question: Why do I catch only tiny fish, and what would help me catch larger ones?
items.question_zh: 为什么我只钓到小鱼？怎样才能钓到大一点的鱼？
items.short: Small fish are usually the most numerous and the first to bite. Try a bigger bait and a different spot.
items.body: A small hook and bait attract everything. A bigger bait on a larger hook is harder for small fish to take. Bigger fish are warier and often hold in deeper water or tight against cover, and they tend to feed at dawn and dusk. Some ponds simply hold stunted fish, so a different water may be the real answer.
items.short_zh: 小鱼数量最多，也最先咬。试试大一点的饵，换个位置。
items.body_zh: 小钩小饵什么鱼都能吸引。饵和钩大一些，小鱼就很难吃进去。大鱼更警觉，常待在更深的水里或紧贴障碍物，也多在清晨和傍晚觅食。有些池塘的鱼就是长不大，这时换一片水域才是办法。

items.question: Why might fish be jumping all around me and still ignore my bait?
items.question_zh: 为什么鱼在我周围跳来跳去，却不理我的饵？
items.short: They may be feeding on something specific, or jumping for reasons unrelated to food.
items.body: Fish that jump may be taking insects at the surface. Carp and some other fish jump for reasons that aren't fully clear, and they may not be feeding at all. Try a small bait near the surface and look at what insects are around. If fish are rising, a small fly or a tiny bait under a float is often better than bait on the bottom.
items.short_zh: 它们可能在吃某种特定的东西，也可能跳起来和进食无关。
items.body_zh: 鱼跳起来可能是在吃水面的昆虫。鲤鱼和一些其他的鱼跳跃的原因并不完全清楚，可能根本不是在进食。试试在水面附近放小饵，看看周围有什么昆虫。如果鱼在水面吃食，小毛钩或浮漂下的小饵，常常比水底的饵更有效。

items.question: What is a fish doing when I feel small taps on the line, and how should I respond?
items.question_zh: 线上传来轻微的点动时，鱼在做什么？我应该怎么应对？
items.short: Small taps usually mean a fish is mouthing the bait or a small fish is pecking at it. The hook may not be in its mouth yet.
items.body: Reel up any slack so the line is just tight. Then wait for a steadier pull or for the bobber to go under before setting the hook. Don't wait long once it pulls, because a fish that swallows the bait is hard to release. With a lure, treat a tap or sudden slack as a bite and set right away, since a fish spits out plastic quickly. If the taps continue and the bait keeps disappearing, the hook is probably too big for those fish: go down a size, use less bait and thread it on. With a circle hook, don't jerk. Reel steadily until you feel weight.
items.short_zh: 轻微的点动通常是鱼在试探饵，或者小鱼在啄饵，钩不一定已经进嘴。
items.body_zh: 先收掉松线，让线刚好绷直。等出现更持续的拉力，或者浮漂沉下去，再提竿；但出现拉力后不要等太久，鱼把饵吞深了就很难放流。用拟饵时，轻点或线突然变松都要当作咬钩，马上提竿，因为鱼吐掉软饵很快。如果点动不断、饵却总是没了，很可能是钩对这些鱼来说太大，换小一号，少挂点饵，把饵穿牢。用圆形钩时不要猛提，匀速收线，感觉到重量就行。

items.question: How long should I wait before setting the hook when using live bait?
items.question_zh: 用活饵时，要等多久才提竿？
items.short: Usually only a moment, once the bobber goes under or the fish starts to pull.
items.body: When the bobber goes under, a fish has the bait: reel up the slack and set the hook. Given time, a fish swallows the bait, which is hard on one you mean to release. There are exceptions. With a walleye on a slip-sinker rig, let line run for several seconds, reel until tight, then set. With a circle hook, don't jerk at all.
items.short_zh: 通常只要等一下，浮漂沉下去或鱼开始拉线就可以提竿。
items.body_zh: 浮漂沉下去，就说明鱼已经吃了饵：收掉松线，提竿。等太久，鱼会把饵吞下去，不利于放流。也有例外。用游动铅钓组钓大眼梭鲈时，要让线跑几秒钟，收紧后再提竿。用圆形钩时，完全不要猛提。

items.question: How does the hook set differ between lures and bait?
items.question_zh: 用拟饵和用天然饵，提竿方式有什么不同？
items.short: With lures, set right away and firmly. With bait, let the fish take it first.
items.body: A fish spits out a lure quickly once it senses it isn't food. With single-hook lures such as plastic worms and jigs, sweep the rod firmly. With treble-hooked crankbaits, a steady sweep works better than a hard jerk. With bait, wait for a pull, then lift. Reel up the slack first in every case. Circle hooks need only a steady pull.
items.short_zh: 用拟饵要马上有力地提竿，用天然饵要等鱼吃进去。
items.body_zh: 鱼发现拟饵不是食物，很快就会吐掉。软虫和铅头钩这类单钩饵，要有力地扫竿。带三本钩的 crankbait，平稳地扫竿比猛拉好。用天然饵时，等到有拉力再抬竿。无论哪种，都要先收掉松线。圆形钩只需要平稳地拉紧。

items.question: How can I stop small fish from stealing bait without hooking up?
items.question_zh: 怎样防止小鱼偷吃饵却钓不到？
items.short: Use a smaller hook and less bait, threaded on.
items.body: Try a long-shanked No. 6 or 8 hook for panfish. Use a piece of nightcrawler rather than a whole one, and run the hook through it more than once so little hangs free. A lighter rig lets a fish pull the bobber down without feeling much. Set the hook sooner, with the slack reeled up first. Change one thing at a time.
items.short_zh: 用小一点的钩，少挂点饵，把饵穿牢。
items.body_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼时，试试长柄的 6 号或 8 号钩。用一段蚯蚓，不要整条，钩多穿几次，少留一点晃动的部分。钓组轻一些，鱼拉浮漂时感觉不到多少阻力。提竿早一点，并且先收掉松线。一次只改变一项。

items.question: How hard should I set the hook on trout compared with bass?
items.question_zh: 钓鳟鱼和钓鲈鱼，提竿力度分别应该多大？
items.short: Gently on trout, firmly on bass.
items.body: Trout and panfish have small, soft mouths, and too hard a jerk can break light line. Under a bobber, a lift just strong enough to move the bobber is plenty. Big fish and big hooks need more force. For bass on a Texas rig, a firm sweep is needed to drive the hook through the plastic.
items.short_zh: 钓鳟鱼要轻，钓鲈鱼要有力。
items.body_zh: 鳟鱼和小型淡水鱼嘴小而软，用力太猛可能扯断细线。用浮漂时，抬竿的力量能带动浮漂就够了。大鱼和大钩需要更大的力。用德州钓组钓鲈鱼时，要有力地扫竿，钩才能穿过软饵。

items.question: What can I do to cast very light lures farther?
items.question_zh: 怎样把很轻的饵抛得更远？
items.short: Use thinner line, a softer rod and a well-filled spool.
items.body: The lure has to bend the rod, so use a light or ultralight rod. Mono of 2 to 4 lb or thin braid creates less drag. Fill the spool to just below the rim. A smooth motion works better than force, and casting with the wind behind you helps. A small split shot or a casting float adds weight where rules allow.
items.short_zh: 用细线、软一点的竿，线杯要上足。
items.body_zh: 饵要能把竿压弯，所以用轻或超轻竿。2 到 4 磅尼龙线或细编织线阻力小。线上到杯沿下方一点。动作平顺比用力更有效，顺风抛也有帮助。在规定允许的情况下，加一粒小咬铅或抛投浮漂，可以增加重量。

items.question: What signs show that a lure has touched bottom?
items.question_zh: 有哪些迹象说明饵已经触底？
items.short: The line goes slack, or you feel a tap.
items.body: Watch the line as the lure sinks. When it stops moving or goes slack, the lure has landed, and you may also feel a small tap. Braid and a sensitive rod make this easier. Counting while it sinks helps you get back to the same depth. If you can't tell, switch to a heavier weight.
items.short_zh: 线突然变松，或者手上感到轻轻一点。
items.body_zh: 饵下沉时盯住线。线不再走，或者松下来，饵就到底了，有时手上还能感到轻轻一点。编织线和灵敏的竿更容易察觉。下沉时数秒，下次就能回到同样的水深。如果判断不出来，就换重一点的铅。

items.question: How do I decide how fast to reel a lure?
items.question_zh: 怎样决定收线速度？
items.short: Start with the speed the lure needs, then vary it until fish respond.
items.body: A spinnerbait needs enough speed to keep its blade turning, and a crankbait has a speed where it wobbles best. If fish are active near the surface, reel faster. If they are near the bottom or the water is cold, slow down. Try a steady retrieve, then add pauses, and remember what worked.
items.short_zh: 先按饵需要的速度收线，再变换速度，直到鱼有反应。
items.body_zh: spinnerbait 要够快，叶片才能转起来；crankbait 有一个摆动最好的速度。鱼在水面附近活跃时，收快一些；鱼靠近水底或水温低时，放慢。先匀速收线，再加入停顿，记住什么方式有效。

items.question: How should my retrieve change in cold water?
items.question_zh: 水温低时，收线方式应该怎样调整？
items.short: Slow down and fish closer to the bottom.
items.body: In cold water, use small lures, light line and a slow retrieve near the bottom. Fish use less energy in cold water and are less willing to chase. Pause longer between movements. Midday can be better, when the shallows have warmed slightly.
items.short_zh: 放慢速度，贴近水底钓。
items.body_zh: 水温低时，用小饵、细线，贴近水底慢慢收。冷水中鱼消耗的能量少，不太愿意追逐。动作之间停得久一点。中午可能更好，那时浅水区会稍微暖一些。

items.question: When fishing a bait under a float, should I let it sit still or move it slowly?
items.question_zh: 用浮漂钓天然饵时，应该让它静止，还是慢慢移动？
items.short: Let it sit at first, then move it a little.
items.body: Let the bait settle so fish can find it. If nothing happens after a few minutes, twitch the float or reel in a foot. Live bait moves on its own and needs less help, while dead bait benefits from movement. With a small jig under a float, shake the float gently. Check and rebait regularly.
items.short_zh: 先让它静止，然后稍微动一动。
items.body_zh: 先让饵稳定下来，鱼才能发现它。几分钟没动静，就抖一下浮漂，或者收回一英尺。活饵自己会动，不用多管；死饵动一动更好。浮漂下挂小铅头钩时，可以轻轻抖动浮漂。要定期检查并换饵。

items.question: What should I look for on arriving at an unfamiliar pond?
items.question_zh: 到了一个陌生的池塘，应该观察什么？
items.short: Walk the bank quietly before you cast and look for shelter, shade, food and the rules.
items.body: Good places to start are weed edges and lily pads, fallen trees, docks, overhanging brush, a bank that drops off quickly and anywhere water flows in. Rings on the surface or scattering small fish show where fish are feeding. Spots farthest from the parking lot and path get less pressure. Cast along the bank rather than straight out, because fish often hold close to it. Read any posted signs, which may say whether fishing is allowed, which rules apply and whether there's an advisory about eating the fish.
items.short_zh: 下竿前先安静地沿岸走一圈，看哪里有遮蔽、阴凉和食物，也看看现场规定。
items.body_zh: 可以先从这些地方开始：水草边缘和睡莲叶、倒伏的树木、码头、垂到水面的灌木、岸边陡然变深的位置，以及有水流入的地方。水面的涟漪或四散的小鱼，说明那里有鱼在觅食。离停车场和步道最远的地方受到的打扰少。沿着岸边平行抛投，不要一味往中间抛，鱼常常贴着岸。也要看现场的告示牌，上面可能写着能不能钓、适用什么规定，以及这里的鱼有没有食用提示。

items.question: What do anglers mean by structure and cover, and why do they matter?
items.question_zh: 钓鱼人说的结构和掩体是什么意思？为什么重要？
items.short: Structure is the shape of the bottom. Cover is anything fish can hide under.
items.body: Points, drop-offs and humps are structure. Weeds, docks, logs and rocks are cover. Cover gives fish shelter, shade and food, and structure gives them routes between shallow and deep water. The best chances are where the two meet.
items.short_zh: 结构是水底的形状，掩体是鱼可以藏身的东西。
items.body_zh: 岬角、陡坎和水下土丘属于结构。水草、码头、倒木和岩石属于掩体。掩体给鱼提供遮蔽、阴凉和食物，结构则是鱼往返深浅水的通道。两者相遇的地方，机会最大。

items.question: How can I tell whether a small stream holds fish?
items.question_zh: 怎样判断一条小溪里有没有鱼？
items.short: Look for cold, clean, flowing water with deep pools and insect life.
items.body: Turn over a few rocks in the riffles to check for insects. Look for pools, undercut banks and shade. Approach quietly and watch for shadows or rises. State maps or surveys show which streams are stocked or hold wild trout. Hot, shallow streams with no pools hold fewer fish.
items.short_zh: 看水是否清凉、流动，有没有深潭和水生昆虫。
items.body_zh: 在急滩翻几块石头，看看有没有昆虫。找深潭、被淘空的岸边和阴凉的地方。安静地靠近，留意鱼影或水面的吃食涟漪。州政府的地图或调查，能告诉你哪些溪流有放流或野生鳟鱼。水又热又浅、没有深潭的溪流，鱼会少很多。

items.question: How should a large lake with little visible cover be approached?
items.question_zh: 可见掩体很少的大湖，应该从哪里入手？
items.short: Look for structure, windblown shorelines and inflows.
items.body: Use a map or fish finder to find points, drop-offs and creek channels. Fish the windblown shoreline, where wind pushes warm water and food against the bank. Where a creek enters, it brings food. Follow birds and baitfish. Cover water with moving lures until you find fish, then slow down. In summer, find the thermocline.
items.short_zh: 找水下结构、迎风的岸线和入水口。
items.body_zh: 用地图或探鱼器找岬角、陡坎和溪道。钓迎风的岸线，风会把暖水和食物推向岸边。溪流入湖的地方带来食物。跟着鸟和饵鱼走。先用靠收线游动的饵搜索水域，找到鱼再放慢。夏天要找温跃层。

items.question: Where do fish usually hold below a dam or in a river's current?
items.question_zh: 在水坝下方或河流水流中，鱼通常待在什么位置？
items.short: In slower water next to fast water.
items.body: Fish hold in seams where two currents meet, in eddies, behind rocks and at drop-offs, where they can rest and watch food pass. Below a dam the water is swift and changes fast, and it can rise quickly when gates open. Stay out of signed safety zones and wear a life jacket. Some rules restrict fishing right below dams.
items.short_zh: 在紧挨急流的缓流里。
items.body_zh: 鱼常待在两股水流交汇的流线、回水、岩石后面和陡坎处，既能休息，又能等食物漂过来。水坝下方水流很急，变化也快，开闸时水位可能迅速上涨。不要进入标示的安全区，要穿救生衣。有些规定限制在坝下钓鱼。

items.question: Which parts of a small pond are worth casting to first?
items.question_zh: 小池塘的哪些位置值得先抛？
items.short: The corners near cover, the dam and anywhere water flows in.
