items.body: Cast along weed edges and around docks, fallen trees and shade. Dams usually have the deepest water, and inlets bring food. Banks facing the wind collect food and warm water. Cast parallel to the bank before casting across the middle.
items.short_zh: 靠近掩体的角落、水坝，以及有水流入的地方。
items.body_zh: 沿水草边缘、码头、倒木和阴凉处抛。水坝附近通常最深，入水口带来食物。迎风的岸边会聚集食物和暖水。先沿岸边平行抛，再往中间抛。

items.question: Where should I fish in a river when the water is low and clear?
items.question_zh: 河水又少又清时，应该钓哪里？
items.short: Deep pools, shaded banks and the heads of runs.
items.body: Low water concentrates fish in pools and deeper pockets. They are easily spooked, so stay low, use lighter line and small lures or bait, and fish early and late. Approach from downstream. Trout in warm, low water are stressed, so don't fish for them when it is 70°F or warmer.
items.short_zh: 深潭、有阴凉的岸边，以及顺流段的上端。
items.body_zh: 水位低时，鱼集中在深潭和较深的水窝里。这时鱼很容易受惊，要压低身子，用细线和小饵，选清晨和傍晚钓。从下游靠近。低水位的温水会让鳟鱼处于应激状态，水温 70°F 或以上时不要钓它们。

items.question: Which handful of lures should a beginner buy first?
items.question_zh: 新手应该先买哪几种饵？
items.short: A small jig with soft plastics, an inline spinner, a spinnerbait and a crankbait.
items.body: Small inline spinners of 1/16 to 1/8 ounce and jig heads with curly-tail grubs catch many kinds of fish. Add one spinnerbait and a shallow crankbait for bass. Crankbaits are among the most straightforward lures for a beginner. Buy two colors, one natural and one bright.
items.short_zh: 小铅头钩配软饵、旋转亮片、spinnerbait 和 crankbait。
items.body_zh: 1/16 到 1/8 盎司的小旋转亮片，以及铅头钩配卷尾软饵，能钓很多种鱼。钓鲈鱼再加一个 spinnerbait 和一个浅潜 crankbait。crankbait 是新手最容易上手的饵之一。买两种颜色，一种自然色，一种亮色。

items.question: Are bulk lure kits a good way to start, or is it better to buy a few individual lures?
items.question_zh: 用大套装入门好，还是单独买几个饵更好？
items.short: Buying a few individual lures is usually better.
items.body: Bulk kits look like good value, but many of the lures are poor quality or don't suit your fish, and the hooks may be weak. Five well-chosen lures teach you more. Kits can be fun for kids or as spares. If you buy one, replace weak hooks and try each lure in clear water to see how it moves.
items.short_zh: 通常单独买几个更好。
items.body_zh: 大套装看起来划算，但很多饵质量差，或者不适合你钓的鱼，钩也可能很软。五个选得好的饵，能让你学到更多。套装给孩子玩或当备用还可以。如果买了，就把软钩换掉，并把每个饵放到清水里看看怎么动。

items.question: Is there a simple rule for matching lure color to water clarity and light?
items.question_zh: 有没有简单的规则，可以根据水色和光线选择饵的颜色？
items.short: Natural colors in clear water, bright colors in stained water and dark colors in muddy water.
items.body: Use natural or silver colors in clear water. In stained water, chartreuse and gold or copper blades show up well. In muddy water, use dark colors with vibration. Don't obsess over it, because depth and speed often matter more than color.
items.short_zh: 清水用自然色，微浑的水用亮色，泥水用深色。
items.body_zh: 清水里用自然色或银色。微浑的水里，荧光黄绿色和金色或铜色叶片比较显眼。泥水里用深色加振动。不必过于纠结，水深和速度常常比颜色更重要。

items.question: Is there a simple chart for matching lure weight to line strength?
items.question_zh: 有没有简单的对照表，可以把饵重和线的强度对应起来？
items.short: Use the ranges printed on your rod as the chart.
items.body: As a rough guide, use 1/32 to 1/8 ounce on 2 to 6 lb line, 1/8 to 3/8 ounce on 6 to 10 lb, 1/4 to 3/4 ounce on 8 to 15 lb, and 3/8 to 1 ounce on 12 to 20 lb. Lighter line casts a light lure farther, and heavy line makes it harder. Stay within the rod's rating.
items.short_zh: 竿上印的范围就是你的对照表。
items.body_zh: 大致来说：2 到 6 磅线用 1/32 到 1/8 盎司，6 到 10 磅线用 1/8 到 3/8 盎司，8 到 15 磅线用 1/4 到 3/4 盎司，12 到 20 磅线用 3/8 到 1 盎司。线越细，轻饵抛得越远；线粗了就难抛。不要超出竿的标称范围。

items.question: Why do experienced anglers often move away from using worms, and is that necessary?
items.question_zh: 为什么有经验的钓鱼人常常不再用蚯蚓？真的有必要吗？
items.short: Mostly for the challenge or for convenience. It isn't necessary.
items.body: Lures let you cover more water and can target bigger predators, and working a lure is engaging. Bait fishing can also hook fish deeply. But nearly every freshwater game fish eats worms, so they remain among the most effective baits. Use whatever you enjoy, and check that bait is allowed where you fish.
items.short_zh: 主要是为了挑战或方便，并不是必须的。
items.body_zh: 拟饵能搜索更大的水域，也能针对更大的掠食鱼，操作拟饵本身也有乐趣。天然饵也可能让鱼吞钩。但几乎所有淡水游钓鱼都吃蚯蚓，它仍然是最有效的饵之一。喜欢什么就用什么，并确认当地允许用天然饵。

items.question: Does a spoon need bait added to the hook?
items.question_zh: 勺形亮片的钩子上需要再挂饵吗？
items.short: Not usually.
items.body: A spoon's wobble and flash do the work, and adding bait can spoil the action and twist your line. Ice fishing is the exception, where a small spoon is often jigged with bait on it. Where it's allowed, a small piece of worm on the treble can help with slow trout.
items.short_zh: 通常不需要。
items.body_zh: 勺形亮片靠摆动和闪光起作用，加饵可能破坏动作，还会造成线扭。冰钓是例外，小勺片常常挂着饵上下抖动。在规定允许时，钓反应慢的鳟鱼，可以在三本钩上挂一小段蚯蚓。

items.question: How should a chatterbait feel when it is working correctly?
items.question_zh: chatterbait 工作正常时，手上应该是什么感觉？
items.short: A steady, strong thumping through the rod.
items.body: A bladed jig vibrates with a hard, pulsing action you can feel in the rod. If the thump stops, the blade has probably picked up weeds or fouled. Speed up if it rolls, and slow down if it runs erratically. A bulky trailer can cut the vibration, so try a narrower one if it doesn't thump.
items.short_zh: 竿上传来稳定而有力的振动。
items.body_zh: bladed jig 的振动强而有节奏，能从竿上感觉到。振动突然消失，多半是叶片挂了水草或被缠住。饵翻滚时加快速度，游动不稳时放慢速度。尾饵太大可能削弱振动，感觉不到振动时，换一个细一点的。

items.question: How is a swimbait's action affected by rigging it on a jig head instead of a pegged Texas rig?
items.question_zh: swimbait 用铅头钩，和用固定铅的德州钓组相比，动作有什么变化？
items.short: A jig head keeps it tracking straight at a steady depth. A weighted weedless hook lets it come through cover.
items.body: On a jig head the hook is exposed and the weight is forward, so the tail kicks steadily and hook-ups are good. Rigged weedless with a pegged weight, the body may swim with a slight roll and the hook is buried, which suits cover but can reduce hook-ups. Use a jig head in open water and rig weedless around grass or wood.
items.short_zh: 铅头钩能让它直线游动、水层稳定，带配重的防挂钩能穿过障碍物。
items.body_zh: 用铅头钩时，钩尖外露，重量在前，尾部摆动稳定，中鱼率也好。用固定铅的防挂挂法，饵身可能略微翻滚，钩尖埋在里面，适合障碍区，但中鱼率可能下降。开阔水域用铅头钩，水草或木头附近用防挂挂法。

items.question: Should a trailer be added to a spinnerbait?
items.question_zh: spinnerbait 需要加尾饵吗？
items.short: It is optional, but a small trailer adds bulk and action.
items.body: A small curly-tail or paddle-tail can add a fuller profile or slow the fall. Use a trailer hook if fish are nipping at the skirt. A large trailer can make the lure roll and spoil the blade action, so keep it simple at first.
items.short_zh: 可加可不加，小尾饵能增加体积和动作。
items.body_zh: 小型卷尾或桨尾软饵，能让饵的轮廓更饱满，或者减慢下落。如果鱼只咬裙边，就加一个拖钩。尾饵太大，饵会翻滚，叶片动作也会变差，所以一开始简单点就好。

items.question: Can a crawler harness be cast and retrieved, or does it need trolling?
items.question_zh: 蚯蚓串钩可以抛投后收线，还是必须拖钓？
items.short: It can be cast, but it works best moving slowly.
items.body: A crawler harness has blades and hooks on a leader, with a sinker ahead of it. You can cast it and reel slowly enough to keep the blade turning. Trolling or drifting keeps it at a steady speed and depth, so it is more effective from a boat. From shore, retrieve it slowly along the bottom and pause often.
items.short_zh: 可以抛投，但慢速移动时效果最好。
items.body_zh: 蚯蚓串钩是在前导上装叶片和钩，前面加铅坠。可以抛出去，慢慢收线，让叶片转起来。拖钓或漂钓能保持稳定的速度和水深，所以在船上更有效。岸钓时，贴着水底慢慢收，多停顿。

items.question: How do I keep inline spinners from twisting my line?
items.question_zh: 怎样防止旋转亮片让线扭起来？
items.short: Use a small swivel ahead of the spinner.
items.body: A ball-bearing swivel about a foot above the lure reduces twist, and an off-center keel weight between the line and the leader does the same job. Keep the retrieve steady, check that the blade spins freely and replace a bent shaft. If the line starts curling, remove the lure and let the line trail in current or out across a lawn, then wind it on under tension.
items.short_zh: 在旋转亮片前面加一个小转环。
items.body_zh: 在饵上方约一英尺处加一个滚珠转环，可以减少线扭，在主线和前导之间加一个偏心防绕铅也有同样的效果。收线要匀速，确认叶片转动灵活，轴弯了要更换。线开始卷曲时，取下饵，让线在水流中拖一下，或者拉开铺在草地上，再带着张力收回去。

items.question: How should worms be stored at home so they stay alive without causing a smell?
items.question_zh: 蚯蚓在家里怎样存放，才能保持存活又没有异味？
items.short: Keep them cool in damp bedding, in a refrigerator or another cool spot.
items.body: Kept cool, worms last up to a month. Use a container with air holes and damp, not wet, peat or shredded newspaper. Dead worms cause the smell, so remove them. Keep them below room temperature but above freezing. Never dump leftover bait or bedding into a lake.
items.short_zh: 放在潮湿的垫料里，保持低温，放在冰箱或阴凉处。
items.body_zh: 保持低温，蚯蚓能活一个月左右。用有透气孔的容器，放潮湿但不滴水的泥炭或碎报纸。异味来自死蚯蚓，要及时挑出来。温度要低于室温，但不能结冰。剩下的饵和垫料绝不要倒进湖里。

items.question: How can minnows be kept alive during a cold-weather outing?
items.question_zh: 天冷外出时，怎样让小鱼饵保持存活？
items.short: Use an insulated bucket, keep the water from freezing and don't overcrowd it.
items.body: Cold water holds oxygen well, so the main risks are freezing and rough handling. Keep the bucket out of the wind and scoop out ice. Don't overcrowd it, and use them soon. Keep them in the water they came from, and if you top up, use spring water or dechlorinated tap water, not lake water.
items.short_zh: 用保温桶，别让水结冰，鱼也不要放太多。
items.body_zh: 冷水含氧量高，主要的风险是结冰和操作太粗。水桶放在避风处，把冰捞出来。鱼不要放太多，要尽快用掉。最好用它们原来的水，需要加水时，用泉水或除氯的自来水，不要用湖水。

items.question: How should a worm be threaded on a hook for panfish compared with catfish?
items.question_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼和钓鲶鱼，蚯蚓分别应该怎么挂钩？
items.short: Use a small piece threaded on for panfish, and a whole worm or a gob for catfish.
items.body: On a small hook use pieces, with the point pushed into the end so the bait doesn't slide off. On a large hook, run the hook through the worm, slide it up the shank and thread it several more times, leaving the tail free to wiggle. Keep the point exposed enough to hook a fish. Leave no more than about an inch hanging below the hook, or fish will nip it off without touching the point.
items.short_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼挂一小段穿牢，钓鲶鱼挂整条或一团。
items.body_zh: 小钩用小段，钩尖从一端扎进去，饵就不容易滑掉。大钩先把蚯蚓穿上，推到钩柄上，再穿几次，让尾部能自由摆动。钩尖要露出足够的部分，才能钩住鱼。钩子下方垂下的部分不要超过约一英寸，否则鱼只会把它咬掉，碰不到钩尖。

items.question: Is cut bait better than live bait, and for which fish?
items.question_zh: 切块饵比活饵好吗？对哪些鱼是这样？
items.short: Cut bait is excellent for catfish, especially blue catfish, while live bait suits flatheads and many predators.
items.body: Gizzard and threadfin shad, live or cut, are the top bait for blue catfish, stripers and hybrids. Cut bait releases oil and scent, which helps fish that hunt by smell. Flathead catfish prefer live fish, and trout and bass respond better to something moving. Some states restrict which baitfish you may use, so check first.
items.short_zh: 切块饵很适合钓鲶鱼，尤其是蓝鲶；活饵适合平头鲶和很多掠食鱼。
items.body_zh: 砂囊鲱和线鳍鲱，不管是活的还是切块，都是钓蓝鲶、条纹鲈及其杂交种的首选。切块饵会释放油脂和气味，对靠嗅觉捕食的鱼很有帮助。平头鲶更喜欢活鱼，鳟鱼和鲈鱼对会动的东西反应更好。有些州限制可用的饵鱼种类，要先查清。

items.question: Can leftover cut bait be salted and saved for another trip?
items.question_zh: 用剩的切块饵可以用盐腌后留到下次吗？
items.short: Yes, if the bait was fresh and legal to keep.
items.body: Salt draws out moisture and firms the bait. Pack it in a container with plenty of coarse salt, and refrigerate or freeze it, away from food. Salted bait doesn't give off scent the way fresh bait does, but it lasts longer. Use fresh when you can, and don't carry leftover bait to waters where rules prohibit it.
items.short_zh: 可以，前提是饵够新鲜，而且规定允许保留。
items.body_zh: 盐能吸走水分，让饵变硬。放进容器，加足量粗盐，冷藏或冷冻，并和食物分开。盐腌的饵气味不如新鲜的，但保存时间长。能用新鲜的就用新鲜的，规定禁止的水域，不要带剩饵过去。

items.question: How are salmon eggs put on a hook and kept from falling off?
items.question_zh: 鲑鱼卵怎样挂上钩，才不容易掉？
items.short: Thread a single egg on a small hook, or tie several in a spawn sac.
items.body: Slip a single egg over a small, short-shank hook of size 10 to 16 and cover the point. Cured eggs are firmer and hold on better. For larger fish, tie a dime-sized sac of eggs in mesh. Cast gently, since eggs come off on hard casts, and check local rules on using eggs.
items.short_zh: 小钩挂一粒，或者把几粒包成卵袋。
items.body_zh: 把一粒鱼卵套在 10 到 16 号的短柄小钩上，盖住钩尖。经过腌制的鱼卵更结实，挂得更牢。钓大一些的鱼，用网纱包成一角硬币大小的卵袋。抛投要轻，用力太猛鱼卵会掉。有些地方对使用鱼卵有规定，要先了解。

items.question: Which common kitchen foods work as bait, and for which fish?
items.question_zh: 哪些常见的厨房食物可以做饵？分别适合什么鱼？
items.short: Corn, bread, hot dogs, cheese, shrimp and chicken liver all work.
items.body: Channel catfish take chicken liver, hot dogs, cheese and shrimp. Carp take canned corn and bread. Stocked trout take corn and cheese. Panfish will take a small ball of bread. Some trout waters ban corn, so check first, and don't leave bait behind.
items.short_zh: 玉米、面包、热狗肠、奶酪、虾和鸡肝都可以。
items.body_zh: 斑点叉尾鮰吃鸡肝、热狗肠、奶酪和虾。鲤鱼吃罐头玉米和面包。放流鳟吃玉米和奶酪。小型淡水鱼吃小面包球。有些鳟鱼水域禁止用玉米，要先查清，也不要把饵留在现场。

items.question: What is the simplest way to rig a soft plastic worm for a first try?
items.question_zh: 第一次尝试时，最简单的软虫挂法是什么？
items.short: A wacky rig, or a small plastic on a jig head.
items.body: For a wacky rig, put an O-ring around the middle of a 4-inch stick worm and run a size 1/0 circle or octopus hook through the ring, with no weight. Or thread a plastic grub on a 1/8-ounce jig head. Both are simple. A Texas rig takes a little more practice but is better for weeds and snags.
items.short_zh: 怀基钓组，或者铅头钩配小软饵。
items.body_zh: 怀基钓组是在 4 英寸棒虫中间套一个 O 形圈，用 1/0 的圆形钩或章鱼钩穿过圈，不加铅。或者把卷尾软饵穿在 1/8 盎司铅头钩上。两种都很简单。德州钓组要多练一下，但在水草和障碍物多的地方更好用。

items.question: When should a Texas rig be chosen over a wacky rig?
items.question_zh: 什么时候应该选德州钓组，而不是怀基钓组？
items.short: In weeds and wood, or when you need to reach the bottom quickly.
items.body: A Texas rig hides the hook and slides through cover. It can also be heavier, so it reaches the bottom and casts well in wind. A wacky rig has an exposed hook and falls slowly, which suits open water and fish that won't chase.
items.short_zh: 在水草和木头附近，或者需要快速到底时。
items.body_zh: 德州钓组把钩藏起来，可以穿过障碍物。它也可以加重，所以能快速到底，有风时也好抛。怀基钓组的钩尖外露，下落很慢，适合开阔水域和不愿追逐的鱼。

items.question: Can a wacky rig be fished well on spinning gear?
items.question_zh: 用纺车轮能把怀基钓组钓好吗？
items.short: Yes. It is one of the best techniques for spinning gear.
items.body: A light, unweighted worm casts best on a medium or medium-light spinning rod with 8 to 10 lb fluorocarbon, or braid with a leader. Let it sink on slack line and watch the line, because a bite can show as a tap there before you feel it.
items.short_zh: 能。这是最适合纺车轮的钓法之一。
items.body_zh: 轻而不加铅的软虫，用中等或中轻硬度的直柄竿最好抛，配 8 到 10 磅碳线，或编织线加前导。让它带着松线下沉，并盯住线，咬口可能先在线上表现为一下轻点，手上还没感觉。

items.question: Do soft plastics harm fish if they are swallowed?
items.question_zh: 软饵被鱼吞下后，会伤害鱼吗？
items.short: They can. The evidence points to more harm in trout than in bass.
items.body: In a 2009 laboratory study, brook trout that ate soft plastic baits suffered blockages and lost substantial weight even with plenty of food. A 2018 study found that largemouth bass could usually bring plastics back up within a few days. Surveys of wild fish have found plastics in a small share of stomachs, and the wider effect on lakes is unclear. Replace torn baits before they fall off, and don't throw used plastics in the water.
items.short_zh: 可能会。现有证据显示，对鳟鱼的危害比对鲈鱼大。
items.body_zh: 2009 年的一项实验室研究中，吃下软饵的溪红点鲑出现了消化道阻塞，即使食物充足，体重也明显下降。2018 年的研究发现，大口黑鲈通常能在几天内把软饵吐出来。对野生鱼的调查发现，胃里有软饵的只占一小部分，对整个湖泊的影响还不清楚。破了的饵要在掉下去之前换掉，用过的软饵不要扔到水里。

items.question: How can I get the strong smell of scented soft plastics off my hands?
items.question_zh: 怎样去除手上带气味软饵的浓烈味道？
items.short: Wash with soap, or try lemon juice or baking soda.
items.body: Dish soap and warm water are a good first step. Lemon juice, vinegar or a paste of baking soda can help with strong smells. Keep a small towel for scented baits and wash your hands before eating. Don't use strong solvents on your skin.
items.short_zh: 用肥皂洗，或者试试柠檬汁、小苏打。
items.body_zh: 先用洗洁精和温水洗。气味很重时，柠檬汁、白醋或小苏打糊都有帮助。准备一条小毛巾专门用来擦有气味的饵，吃东西前要洗手。不要用强溶剂擦皮肤。

items.question: Which single fly is the most forgiving for a beginner to start with?
items.question_zh: 新手用哪一种毛钩最不容易出错？
items.short: A Woolly Bugger.
items.body: It sinks, moves on its own and imitates many foods, so it catches trout, bass and panfish. You don't need a perfect natural drift: just cast and strip it back slowly. A size 8 or 10 is a good start.
items.short_zh: Woolly Bugger。
items.body_zh: 它会下沉，自身就有动作，能模仿很多食物，鳟鱼、鲈鱼和小型淡水鱼都吃。不需要完美的自然漂流，抛出去慢慢拉回来就行。8 号或 10 号是不错的起点。

items.question: Is a strike indicator needed when stripping a streamer?
items.question_zh: 拉动 streamer 时，需要咬口指示器吗？
items.short: No. You'll feel the strike through the line.
items.body: Indicators are mainly for nymphs, where they set the depth and show subtle takes. When you strip a streamer, keep the rod tip low and the line tight, and a fish will pull the line in your hand.
items.short_zh: 不需要。咬口能从线上感觉到。
items.body_zh: 咬口指示器主要用于若虫毛钩，用来定水深和显示细微的咬口。拉动 streamer 时，竿尖压低、线绷紧，鱼一咬，手上的线就会被拉动。

items.question: How should loose fly line be managed while stripping?
items.question_zh: 拉线时，散开的飞钓线应该怎样处理？
items.short: Let it fall in loose coils on the ground, in the water or into a stripping basket.
items.body: Strip with your line hand and pinch the line against the grip with a finger of your rod hand. On a bank, clear your standing area of sticks and weeds. In moving water, the line drifts behind you. A stripping basket helps in wind or waves. Check for tangles before casting.
items.short_zh: 让它松散地落在地上、水里或收线篮里。
items.body_zh: 用拉线的手拉线，用握竿手的手指把线压在竿把上。在岸上，把站立处的树枝和杂草清理干净。在流水中，线会漂到身后。有风或有浪时，收线篮很有用。抛投前检查有没有缠绕。

items.question: Can fly gear catch bass in a small pond?
items.question_zh: 飞钓装备能在小池塘钓鲈鱼吗？
items.short: Yes. A 6 to 8 weight rod with poppers and streamers works well.
items.body: A 4, 5 or 6 weight suits trout-sized flies. Bass flies are larger and catch more air, so a 7 or 8 weight casts them more easily. Poppers near cover at dawn and dusk are fun, and streamers or crayfish patterns work in deeper water. A 6 weight can handle smaller flies.
items.short_zh: 能。6 到 8 号飞钓竿配 popper 和 streamer 效果不错。
items.body_zh: 4、5、6 号竿适合鳟鱼大小的毛钩。钓鲈鱼的毛钩更大、风阻也大，用 7 号或 8 号竿更好抛。清晨和傍晚在掩体附近用 popper 很有趣，深一点的水用 streamer 或螯虾毛钩。6 号竿可以用较小的毛钩。

items.question: How do I know what hook size to use for the fish I want to catch?
items.question_zh: 怎样知道要钓的鱼该用多大的钩？
items.short: Match it to the fish's mouth. When in doubt, go smaller.
items.body: Typical sizes are No. 4 to 8 for bluegill, No. 2 to 6 for crappie, No. 2 to 4/0 for bass and No. 1 to 6/0 for catfish, depending on the size of the fish. Use thin wire for small fish and light hook sets, and heavier wire for catfish and big fish, which can straighten a thin hook. For small baits, crappie hooks can go down to No. 8 or 10.
items.short_zh: 按鱼嘴的大小来选，拿不准就选小的。
items.body_zh: 常见的号数：蓝鳃太阳鱼 4 到 8 号，莓鲈 2 到 6 号，鲈鱼 2 号到 4/0，鲶鱼按大小用 1 号到 6/0。小鱼和轻提竿用细条钩，鲶鱼和大鱼要用粗条钩，大鱼能把细钩拉直。用小饵时，钓莓鲈的钩可以小到 8 号或 10 号。

items.question: Are expensive hooks worth it compared with inexpensive ones?
items.question_zh: 和便宜的钩相比，贵的钩值得买吗？
items.short: They often stay sharp and resist bending better, so yes for the hooks that matter most.
items.body: A sharp, strong hook is what connects you to the fish. For bait fishing for panfish, budget hooks are fine if they are sharp. For lures and larger fish, better hooks are a cheap upgrade. Test the point on your fingernail and replace it when dull. Buying good hooks for your main lures costs far less than a lost fish.
items.short_zh: 它们通常更耐磨、更不容易变形，所以关键的地方值得用。
items.body_zh: 钩够锋利、够结实，才能真正挂住鱼。钓小型淡水鱼，用天然饵时，便宜的钩只要锋利就行。用拟饵或钓较大的鱼，换好钩花不了多少钱。在指甲上试试钩尖，钝了就换。给常用的饵配好钩，比跑掉一条鱼便宜得多。

items.question: What is the simplest way to remove a hook from a fish?
items.question_zh: 把钩从鱼嘴里取出来，最简单的方法是什么？
items.short: Use pliers or a hook remover and back it out the way it went in.
items.body: Hold the shank with pliers, turn the hook upside down and back it out, ideally with the fish in the water. Wet your hands first and keep your fingers away from the gills. If the hook is deep, cut the line. Pinching the barb down makes it quicker.
items.short_zh: 用钳子或摘钩器，按进去的方向退出来。
items.body_zh: 用钳子夹住钩柄，把钩翻过来退出去，最好让鱼留在水里操作。先把手打湿，手指不要碰鱼鳃。钩得很深就剪线。把倒刺压平，取钩更快。

items.question: If a fish has swallowed the hook, is it better to cut the line or try to remove it?
items.question_zh: 鱼把钩吞下去了，是剪断线好，还是尝试取出来好？
items.short: Cut the line near the mouth and let the fish go with the hook in place.
items.body: Digging for a deep hook does more harm than leaving it. A hook left in place may rust, dissolve or work its way out over time, although not every fish survives. Don't jerk the line to break it off. A hook in the lip is different: hold the shank with pliers or a hook remover and back it out the way it went in, ideally with the fish still in the water. To reduce deep hooking, set the hook soon after the bite. If the fish is legal to keep and you want it, keeping it is also a reasonable choice.
items.short_zh: 尽量贴近鱼嘴剪断线，把钩留在鱼身上放流。
items.body_zh: 硬抠深钩造成的伤害，比把钩留下更大。留在鱼体内的钩子可能会生锈、分解或自行脱落，不过并不是每条鱼都能活下来。不要猛拽线把它扯断。钩在嘴唇上就不一样了：用钳子或摘钩器夹住钩柄，按进去的方向退出来，最好让鱼留在水里操作。想减少吞钩，咬钩后要尽快提竿。如果这条鱼按规定可以留，而你也想留，留下来也是合理的选择。

items.question: Where should an assist hook be attached on a jig?
items.question_zh: 辅助钩应该装在铅头钩的什么位置？
items.short: Near the top of the jig, tied to the line ring or a split ring.
items.body: On a metal jig, the assist hook hangs from a solid ring at the jig's head on a short cord. The cord should be short enough that the hook can't tangle with the jig. Attach it with a split ring. On soft plastics, a stinger hook goes behind the main hook on a short piece of line.
items.short_zh: 装在铅头钩靠上的位置，连在线环或开环上。
items.body_zh: 金属铁板的辅助钩，用短绳挂在头部的实心环上。绳子要够短，钩才不会和铁板缠在一起。用开环连接。软饵用的拖钩，用一小段线接在主钩后面。

items.question: Does filing down a barb make much difference?
items.question_zh: 把倒刺锉平有多大区别？
items.short: Yes. It makes hooks easier to remove and costs you only a few fish.
items.body: With steady pressure you will lose only a few more fish. Filing removes the barb and pinching flattens it, and both work. Check for sharp edges afterward. Washington counts a barb that has been filed off or pinched down as barbless.
items.short_zh: 区别明显：取钩更容易，也只会多跑几条鱼。
items.body_zh: 只要保持稳定的拉力，只会多跑几条鱼。锉掉倒刺或用钳子压平都可以。处理后检查一下有没有锋利的毛边。华盛顿州把倒刺锉掉或压平的钩算作无倒刺。

items.question: Why do I need a sinker at all if the hook and bait already sink?
items.question_zh: 钩和饵本身就会下沉，为什么还需要铅坠？
items.short: The hook and bait sink too slowly and can't hold depth in wind or current.
items.body: A small weight gets the bait down faster and lets you cast. Often one or two split shot about 6 to 12 inches above the hook are enough. Without weight the bait may drift up or be carried off. Use as little as will do the job. An unweighted bait falls naturally and can be better when fish are shallow.
items.short_zh: 钩和饵下沉太慢，在有风或有水流时也保持不住水深。
items.body_zh: 小小的重量能让饵沉得更快，也更容易抛。常常在钩子上方约 6 到 12 英寸处夹一两粒咬铅就够了。没有铅坠，饵可能漂起来或被水冲走。够用就好，不要多加。鱼在浅水时，不加铅的饵下落更自然，效果可能更好。

items.question: When should I use split shot, and when should I use a swivel?
items.question_zh: 什么时候用咬铅，什么时候用转环？
items.short: Split shot adds weight. A swivel connects lines or stops twist.
items.body: Split shot pinches onto the line to sink a bait, and suits bobber rigs and light baits. A barrel swivel joins the main line to a leader, stops a sliding sinker and reduces twist with spinning lures. You can use them together.
items.short_zh: 咬铅用来加重，转环用来连接线或防止线扭。
items.body_zh: 咬铅夹在线上，让饵下沉，适合浮漂钓组和轻的饵。桶形转环连接主线和前导，挡住游动铅，也能减少旋转饵造成的线扭。两者可以一起用。

items.question: Do snaps and swivels reduce sensitivity or scare fish?
items.question_zh: 别针和转环会降低灵敏度或吓到鱼吗？
items.short: Slightly, mainly in clear water or with small lures.
items.body: Trout see well in clear water, so keep the rig small and avoid big snaps and swivels. A snap can also weaken a crankbait's action, so tie straight to lures when you can. Small black swivels are less noticeable, and in murky water they make little difference.
items.short_zh: 有一点影响，主要是在清水里或用小饵时。
items.body_zh: 鳟鱼在清水里视力很好，钓组要小，不要用大别针和大转环。别针也可能削弱 crankbait 的动作，所以能直接绑就直接绑。黑色小转环不太显眼，在浑水里差别很小。

items.question: How is a bobber tied on, and how is the depth set?
items.question_zh: 浮漂怎样绑上去？水深怎样设定？
items.short: A clip-on bobber just clips to the line, and its distance from the hook sets the depth. A slip bobber uses a stop on the line.
items.body: To attach a clip-on, press the button on top to push out a small wire hook at the bottom, catch the line and let go, then press the bottom and do the same at the top. Slide it along the line to change depth. This works to about the length of your rod, since more line below the bobber is hard to cast. For deeper water use a slip bobber. Put a bobber stop on the line, then a bead, then the bobber, then tie on the hook and add split shot. After the cast, line runs through the bobber until the stop reaches the bead. Move the stop to change depth. Start with the bait just above the weeds or bottom. For bluegill, 1 to 3 feet below the bobber is a common start.
items.short_zh: 夹式浮漂直接夹在线上，它到钩的距离就是水深。活动浮漂靠线上的止挡来定水深。
items.body_zh: 安装夹式浮漂时，按下顶部按钮，底部会伸出一个小钢丝钩，钩住线后松手；再按底部，在顶部同样操作。沿线移动浮漂就能改水深。这种方法的深度大约不超过竿长，浮漂下面的线再长就很难抛了。水更深时用活动浮漂：先把止挡穿到线上，再穿小珠，再穿浮漂，然后绑钩、加咬铅。抛出后线会从浮漂里穿过，直到止挡碰到小珠。移动止挡就能改水深。开始时让饵悬在水草或水底的上方一点。钓蓝鳃太阳鱼时，浮漂下面 1 到 3 英尺是常见的起点。

items.question: If bluegill feed near the bottom, why would I use a bobber?
items.question_zh: 如果蓝鳃太阳鱼在底层觅食，为什么还要用浮漂？
items.short: To keep the bait just above the bottom and show you bites.
items.body: A bobber keeps the bait up off the bottom, so there are fewer snags, and you can see it go down. Set the depth so the bait hangs just above the bottom. If bluegill are deeper than a fixed bobber can reach, use a slip bobber.
items.short_zh: 为了让饵悬在水底上方一点，同时让你看到咬口。
items.body_zh: 浮漂能让饵离开水底，减少挂底，也能看到它下沉。把水深调到饵刚好悬在水底上方。如果蓝鳃太阳鱼待得比固定浮漂能到的还深，就用活动浮漂。

items.question: In what situations is a three-way rig useful?
items.question_zh: 三向钓组在什么情况下有用？
items.short: When you need a bait to hold just above the bottom in current.
items.body: A three-way swivel has one eye to your main line, one to a sinker on a short dropper and one to a longer leader with a hook or lure. It is useful for drifting or trolling over deep water or rivers for salmon, catfish and striped bass. If the sinker snags, only the dropper breaks, so use lighter line for it.
items.short_zh: 需要让饵在水流中悬在水底上方时。
items.body_zh: 三向转环的一端接主线，一端接短脑线和铅坠，另一端接较长的前导和钩或饵。在深水或河流中漂钓或拖钓鲑鱼、鲶鱼和条纹鲈时很有用。铅坠挂底时只断短脑线，所以短脑线要用细一点的。

items.question: What are the advantages of a plain weighted bottom rig over a feeder?
items.question_zh: 底钓组用普通铅坠，比用投饵笼有什么优势？
items.short: It's simpler, casts better and needs less gear.
items.body: A feeder is a cage that releases bait around your hook, which attracts fish but adds weight and snags. A plain sinker suits quick, mobile fishing and rocky bottoms. Feeders work best on still water for carp and bream, when you want to build up a feeding area. Chumming is restricted in some waters, so check first.
items.short_zh: 更简单，更好抛，需要的装备也少。
items.body_zh: 投饵笼会在钩周围释放饵料，能吸引鱼，但增加了重量，也更容易挂底。普通铅坠适合快速移动的钓法和石质水底。投饵笼最适合静水中钓鲤鱼和欧鳊，用来建立窝点。有些水域限制打窝，要先查清。

items.question: Which knots should a beginner learn first?
items.question_zh: 新手应该先学哪几个结？
items.short: Learn three: the palomar, the improved clinch and the arbor knot.
items.body: The palomar ties a hook or lure to braid or mono and is easy to get right. It's awkward with lures that carry several hooks, because the whole lure has to pass through the loop. The improved clinch is the other standard knot for tying hooks and lures to monofilament. The arbor knot fixes new line to the reel. Add a surgeon's knot when you start joining a leader to the main line. Whatever you tie, wet it before tightening, pull it snug, and leave a little tag end. A badly tied knot can cost half the line's strength or more, while a good one keeps over 90 percent.
items.short_zh: 先学三个：帕洛马结、改良克林奇结和线杯结。
items.body_zh: 帕洛马结（palomar）可以把钩或饵绑在编织线或尼龙线上，容易打对。绑带多个钩的饵时不方便，因为整个饵都要从线圈里穿过去。改良克林奇结（improved clinch）是用尼龙线绑钩和饵的另一个标准结。线杯结（arbor knot）用来把新线固定在轮上。开始接前导线时，再学外科结（surgeon's knot）。无论打什么结，收紧前都要润湿，拉紧后留一点线头。结打得不好，线的强度可能损失一半甚至更多；打得好的结能保留 90% 以上。

items.question: Is an improved clinch knot safe to use with braid?
items.question_zh: 改良克林奇结可以安全地用于编织线吗？
items.short: Not really. It tends to slip.
items.body: The improved clinch is the go-to knot for monofilament, but braid is slick and can slip in knots meant for mono. Use a palomar with braid, and test any knot with a firm pull before you cast.
items.short_zh: 不太安全，容易滑脱。
items.body_zh: 改良克林奇结是尼龙线的常用结，但编织线很滑，在给尼龙线设计的结里可能打滑。编织线要用帕洛马结，任何结在抛投前都要用力拉一下测试。

items.question: What makes line fail at the point where a weight is attached?
items.question_zh: 线在连接铅坠的位置断裂，通常是什么原因？
items.short: Pinching, sharp edges and friction from a sliding weight.
items.body: Split shot pinched too tight can nick the line, and dragging it along the line damages it too. A sliding sinker wears line just above the swivel. Rubber-core sinkers or a small bead help protect the line and knots. Pinch shot with pliers, never your teeth. Inspect and retie often. Some sinkers still contain lead, which is another reason to keep them out of your mouth.
items.short_zh: 夹得太紧、边缘锋利，以及游动铅的摩擦。
items.body_zh: 咬铅夹得太紧可能划伤线，沿线拖动也会造成损伤。游动铅会磨损转环上方的线。胶芯铅坠或加一粒小珠，有助于保护线和结。用钳子夹咬铅，绝不要用牙咬。要经常检查、重新绑。有些铅坠含铅，这也是不能用嘴咬的原因。

items.question: How can leaders be retied quickly on the water?
items.question_zh: 在水上怎样快速重新绑前导线？
items.short: Use a swivel or a pre-tied leader.
items.body: Pre-tie several leaders at home and keep them on small spools or in a leader wallet. A small swivel at the end of the main line lets you tie on a new leader in seconds. Learn one fast line-to-line knot, such as a surgeon's knot. Cut back any damaged line first.
items.short_zh: 用转环，或者提前绑好的前导。
items.body_zh: 在家提前绑好几条前导，绕在小线轴上或放进前导夹里。主线末端接一个小转环，几秒钟就能换上新前导。学会一种快速的线对线结，比如外科结。先把受损的线剪掉。

items.question: Why does an FG knot slip, and how can that be prevented?
items.question_zh: FG 结为什么会滑脱？怎样预防？
items.short: Usually too few wraps or not enough tension on the braid.
items.body: The braid grips the leader by friction, so it needs consistent tight wraps, typically about 15 to 20 alternating wraps. Keep the braid under tension as you wrap, finish with several half hitches, and pull firmly on both lines to seat it. Wetting helps. Test it with a firm pull before fishing.
items.short_zh: 通常是圈数不够，或者绕编织线时张力不足。
items.body_zh: FG 结靠编织线和前导之间的摩擦力抓紧，所以要绕得紧而均匀，一般交替绕 15 到 20 圈。绕的时候保持编织线的张力，最后打几个半结，再用力拉两条线让结收紧。润湿有帮助。下水前用力拉一下测试。

items.question: Should a beginner start with braid or monofilament?
items.question_zh: 新手应该从编织线开始，还是从尼龙线开始？
items.short: Monofilament.
items.body: It is cheap, easy to tie and doesn't need a leader. For most freshwater fishing, use 6 to 10 lb. Braid's thin line and special knots are harder for a beginner to manage. Try braid later, when you want more feel.
items.short_zh: 尼龙线。
items.body_zh: 它便宜、好打结，也不需要前导。多数淡水钓用 6 到 10 磅。编织线很细，还要用专门的结，新手不容易打理。等想要更好的手感时，再试编织线。

items.question: What do the different line ratings on my rod and reel mean, and which one applies?
items.question_zh: 竿和轮上的不同线标称分别是什么意思？应该以哪个为准？
items.short: The rod rating shows what it is built for. The reel rating shows how much line fits.
items.body: A rod rated 6 to 12 lb works best within that range. A reel may say 10/120, meaning about 120 yards of 10 lb line fit. Use a line within the rod's range and enough of it to fill the reel. If they differ, the rod is the main limit. The rod's length, action and line rating are printed just above the handle.
items.short_zh: 竿的标称说明它的设计范围，轮的标称说明能装多少线。
items.body_zh: 标 6 到 12 磅的竿，在这个范围内效果最好。轮上可能写 10/120，意思是大约能装 120 码 10 磅的线。线要在竿的范围内，量也要够把轮上满。两者不一致时，主要以竿为准。竿的长度、调性和线号，都印在手把上方。

items.question: How do I put new line on a spinning reel without creating twist?
items.question_zh: 怎样给纺车轮上新线而不产生线扭？
items.short: Let the line come off the supply spool the same way it goes on, with some tension.
items.body: Open the bail and tie the line to the spool with an arbor knot, then close the bail. Lay the supply spool flat on the floor with the label up. Reel a few turns while pinching the line between your fingers. If the line twists when you let it go slack, flip the spool over. Stop about 1/16 to 1/8 inch below the rim.
items.short_zh: 让线从大卷上出来的方向和上到轮上的方向一致，并保持张力。
items.body_zh: 打开线臂，用线杯结把线绑在线杯上，再合上线臂。把线卷平放在地上，标签朝上。用手指捏住线，摇几圈。线松下来时如果扭在一起，就把线卷翻个面。上到离杯沿约 1/16 到 1/8 英寸时停下。

items.question: How much line is enough on a reel?
items.question_zh: 轮上有多少线才够？
items.short: Fill it nearly to the rim. You rarely need all of it.
items.body: On a spinning reel, stop about 1/16 to 1/8 inch below the rim. A spincast reel is full at about 100 yards. For most freshwater fish, 100 yards is plenty, though a strong fish that can run needs more. Replace line when it has dropped well below the rim, because casting gets worse.
items.short_zh: 上到接近杯沿就行，很少会用到全部。
items.body_zh: 纺车轮上到离杯沿约 1/16 到 1/8 英寸。卡式轮大约 100 码就满了。多数淡水鱼，100 码足够；力量大、会跑远的鱼则需要更多。线面明显低于杯沿时要换线，否则抛投会变差。

items.question: When a spool is not full enough, is it better to add backing or replace the line?
items.question_zh: 线杯上的线不够满时，是加底线好，还是换线好？
items.short: Replace the line if it is old or damaged. Otherwise add backing underneath.
items.body: Adding line on top of the old line needs a knot that snags when casting. Instead, take the line off, tie on some cheap backing and put your line back on. If the old line is over a year old, replace it. Mono backing also helps braid grip the spool.
items.short_zh: 线旧了或有损伤就换，否则在下面加底线。
items.body_zh: 直接在旧线上接新线，线结抛投时会挂导环。正确的做法是把线放出来，先绑上便宜的底线，再把原来的线上回去。旧线用了一年以上，就直接换。尼龙底线也能让编织线不打滑。

items.question: How long should a leader be, and do I need one at all?
items.question_zh: 前导线应该多长？到底需不需要？
items.short: Two to six feet when you need one. Many mono setups don't need one at all.
items.body: With mono and simple baits you can tie straight to the hook. A leader helps with braid, in clear water or near rocks. A catfish bottom rig uses about 18 inches to 2 feet, and a stocked-trout rig 18 to 24 inches.
items.short_zh: 需要时两到六英尺，很多尼龙线配置根本不需要。
items.body_zh: 用尼龙线和简单的饵，可以直接绑钩。用编织线、水很清或靠近岩石时，前导线才有帮助。钓鲶鱼的底钓组大约用 18 英寸到 2 英尺，钓放流鳟的钓组用 18 到 24 英寸。

items.question: Does heat or sunlight weaken fishing line?
items.question_zh: 高温或阳光会让钓鱼线变弱吗？
items.short: Yes. Sunlight and heat weaken all line over time.
items.body: Sunlight weakens all line, and old mono turns brittle. Store rods and spools out of direct sun and out of hot cars. Replace your line every year, and check the last few feet on each trip.
items.short_zh: 会。日晒和高温会让所有的线逐渐变弱。
items.body_zh: 阳光会让所有的线变弱，旧尼龙线还会变脆。竿和线卷要避开阳光直射，也不要放在闷热的车里。每年换一次线，每次出门都要检查最后几英尺。

items.question: Why does line sometimes come out from under the spool or tangle at the bottom of the reel?
items.question_zh: 为什么线有时会从线杯下方跑出来，或缠在轮的底部？
items.short: Usually loose line loops under the spool when the bail closes with slack.
items.body: On a spinning reel, slack line can slip behind the spool and wrap around the shaft. Close the bail by hand, keep tension on the line after casting and don't overfill. After each cast, turn the handle until the reel clicks, so loose line doesn't pile up. If it has wrapped, take off the spool and unwind the loops.
items.short_zh: 通常是线臂合上时线是松的，松线圈跑到线杯下面了。
items.body_zh: 纺车轮的松线可能滑到线杯后面，缠在主轴上。用手合上线臂，抛投后保持线的张力，不要上太满。每次抛完，转动手把直到听到咔哒声，松线就不会堆积。如果已经缠上了，取下线杯，把线圈解开。

items.question: Which line should I use for saltwater inshore fishing?
items.question_zh: 近岸海钓应该用什么线？
items.short: 10 to 20 lb braid with a fluorocarbon leader, or 10 to 20 lb mono.
items.body: Saltwater fishing calls for 10 to 20 lb line. Braid casts well and its sensitivity helps. Use a heavier leader near oysters and pilings, about 15 to 30 lb. Mono stretches, which helps beginners, and it costs less. Rinse your gear with fresh water afterward.
items.short_zh: 10 到 20 磅编织线加碳线前导，或者 10 到 20 磅尼龙线。
items.body_zh: 海水钓用 10 到 20 磅的线。编织线好抛，也灵敏。靠近牡蛎和桥桩时，用 15 到 30 磅的粗前导。尼龙线有弹性，对新手更友好，也更便宜。钓完用淡水冲洗装备。

items.question: Should I switch to braid for heavy weeds?
items.question_zh: 水草很多时，应该换成编织线吗？
items.short: Yes, if you are fishing in or around thick weeds.
items.body: Thin, strong braid cuts through vegetation and lets you pull a fish out. FishEye's largemouth guide uses 65 lb braid or stronger in thick or matted weeds, on a heavier rod. Tie it directly with a palomar knot. With mono you will lose more fish and lures.
items.short_zh: 是的，如果你在茂密的水草里或附近钓鱼。
items.body_zh: 细而强的编织线能切开水草，也能把鱼拉出来。FishEye 的大口黑鲈指南在茂密或成片的水草区，用 65 磅或更强的编织线，配更硬的竿。用帕洛马结直接绑。用尼龙线会跑更多鱼，也丢更多饵。

items.question: What do rod weight and rod action mean in plain terms?
items.question_zh: 用通俗的话来说，竿的硬度和调性是什么意思？
items.short: Weight, or power, is how hard it is to bend. Action is where it bends.
items.body: A light rod bends easily and suits small fish and lures. A heavy rod needs more force and suits big fish and heavy lures. A fast-action rod bends near the tip, and a slow rod bends down toward the handle. The label lists both.
items.short_zh: 硬度是竿有多难弯，调性是竿在哪里弯。
items.body_zh: 软一点的竿容易弯，适合小鱼和小饵。硬竿要用更大的力才弯，适合大鱼和重饵。快调的竿在靠近竿尖的地方弯，慢调的竿一直弯到靠近手把。标签上两项都有。

items.question: Is it risky to cast a lure heavier or lighter than the rod's rated range?
items.question_zh: 抛投比竿标称范围更重或更轻的饵，有风险吗？
items.short: Heavier can be risky. Lighter just casts poorly.
items.body: A lure a little over the limit usually casts sluggishly. Well over it can break the rod, especially if you snap it. A lure below the range won't bend the rod and won't go far. Stay within the printed range.
items.short_zh: 过重有风险，过轻只是抛不好。
items.body_zh: 略微超过上限的饵，通常只是抛起来发闷。超出很多就可能把竿弄断，猛甩时尤其如此。低于下限的饵压不弯竿，也抛不远。不要超出竿上印的范围。

items.question: How long should a first rod be for a person of average height?
items.question_zh: 身高中等的人，第一根竿应该多长？
items.short: About 5½ to 6½ feet. A 7-foot rod adds some casting distance.
items.body: For a first rod, a medium-light of 5½ to 6½ feet suits most people. A 6 to 7 foot medium-light or medium rod handles most lake fishing. Shorter is easier for children, and a longer rod casts farther but can be a nuisance near trees. An Irish beginner handbook lists longer rods, about 2.2 to 3.6 meters, which suit float and shore fishing.
items.short_zh: 大约 5½ 到 6½ 英尺，7 英尺的竿能抛得更远一些。
items.body_zh: 第一根竿，5½ 到 6½ 英尺的中轻硬度适合多数人。6 到 7 英尺的中轻或中等硬度竿，能应付大多数湖泊钓。孩子用短一点的更方便。长竿抛得远，但在树多的地方碍事。爱尔兰的入门手册列的竿更长，约 2.2 到 3.6 米，适合浮漂钓和岸钓。

items.question: How can I tell whether a rod is too long for a bank lined with trees and brush?
items.question_zh: 岸边有很多树木和灌丛时，怎样判断竿是否太长？
items.short: If you can't make a normal cast without hitting branches, it's too long.
items.body: Try a sidearm cast or a bow-and-arrow cast using a short length of line. A rod of 5 to 6 feet is easier on overgrown banks. Look behind you before every cast. If a long rod keeps catching, it is better to walk to a more open spot.
items.short_zh: 如果正常抛投总碰到树枝，就是太长了。
items.body_zh: 试试侧抛，或者用短线做弓箭式抛投。在长满灌木的岸边，5 到 6 英尺的竿更好用。每次抛投前看看身后。长竿总是挂东西，就走到开阔一点的地方。

items.question: How can I separate rod sections that are stuck together?
items.question_zh: 竿的两节卡住分不开时怎么办？
items.short: Twist gently while pulling straight apart, with two people if needed.
items.body: Grip near the joint on both sides. Two people can each hold both sections, with one hand on each side of the joint, and pull in opposite directions, which reduces bending stress. Don't use pliers or bend the rod. Clean and lightly wax the joint afterward.
items.short_zh: 轻轻转动，同时直着拔开，必要时两个人一起。
items.body_zh: 双手握在接口两侧。两个人可以各自一手握一节，一起朝相反的方向拉，这样可以减少弯曲应力。不要用钳子，也不要把竿弄弯。拔开后清洁接口，并抹一点蜡。

items.question: How should rods and reels be carried safely in a car?
items.question_zh: 竿和轮放在车里怎样运输才安全？
items.short: Inside the vehicle, in a tube or rod sock, away from doors.
items.body: Most rods are broken in car doors, trunk lids and tailgates, or by being stepped on. Separate multi-piece rods, and remove hooks or secure them to a hook keeper. Don't leave reels and soft plastics in a hot car. Use a roof carrier only if it is made for rods, and secure it.
items.short_zh: 放在车内，装进竿管或竿袋，远离车门。
items.body_zh: 大多数竿是被车门、后备箱盖、尾门夹断的，或者被踩断的。多节竿要拆开，钩要取下或挂在挂钩器上。轮和软饵不要留在闷热的车里。车顶架只有专门为竿设计的才能用，并且要固定好。

items.question: Does a more expensive rod actually help a beginner catch more fish?
items.question_zh: 更贵的竿真的能帮新手钓到更多鱼吗？
items.short: Not much.
items.body: A beginner's catch depends more on location, bait and fishing at the right time. A better rod feels nicer, but a decent inexpensive combo with fresh line catches fish too. Spend extra once you know what you are missing.
items.short_zh: 帮助不大。
items.body_zh: 新手能钓到多少鱼，更取决于位置、饵和时间。好竿手感更好，但一套不错的平价套装加新线，照样能钓到鱼。等你知道自己缺什么时，再多花钱。

items.question: What is a reasonable first rod and reel for under $50?
items.question_zh: 低于 50 美元，合理的第一套竿轮是什么？
items.short: A spincast or spinning combo with a medium-light rod.
items.body: Look for a rod of 5½ to 6½ feet and a reel with 6 to 10 lb line. A composite rod is harder to break. Check that the reel turns smoothly and the drag works. That combination catches panfish, small bass and stocked trout.
items.short_zh: 卡式轮或纺车轮套装，配中轻硬度的竿。
items.body_zh: 选 5½ 到 6½ 英尺的竿，轮上 6 到 10 磅的线。复合材料竿不容易断。确认轮转动顺畅，卸力正常。这样一套能钓小型淡水鱼、小鲈鱼和放流鳟。

items.question: For a beginner, what does $100 to under $200 buy that a $50 combo does not?
items.question_zh: 对新手来说，100 美元至不足 200 美元能买到哪些 50 美元套装没有的东西？
items.short: A lighter rod, and a smoother reel with a more reliable drag.
items.body: You get better guides, better sensitivity and a rod closer to a specific use, and a smoother drag saves fish. A beginner doesn't need this to catch fish, but gear at this level lasts longer and is more pleasant to use. Consider spending part of it on a net, a license and a life jacket.
items.short_zh: 更轻的竿，更顺滑、卸力更可靠的轮。
items.body_zh: 导环更好，灵敏度更高，竿也更接近特定用途，顺滑的卸力还能少跑鱼。新手不用这些也能钓到鱼，但这个价位的装备更耐用，用起来也更舒服。可以考虑分出一部分钱买抄网、钓鱼证和救生衣。

items.question: What should the drag be set to, and how can it be tested at home?
items.question_zh: 卸力应该调到多大？在家里怎样测试？
items.short: Set it to slip well before the line can break: a third to a half of the line's rating, starting at the low end.
items.body: On 20 lb line that's about 7 to 10 lb. To test it at home, tie the line to a spring scale or fish scale, have someone hold it, lift the rod as if fighting a fish, and read the scale when line starts to slip. Without a scale, pull line straight off the reel: it should come off smoothly under firm pressure, not in jerks. If it pours out easily, tighten; if it won't move, loosen. With braid, pull against pliers or a pencil, because it cuts fingers. Too loose is the safer mistake. Back the drag off before storing the reel.
items.short_zh: 让卸力在线断之前就开始滑动：设在线标称强度的三分之一到一半，先从低的一端开始。
items.body_zh: 20 磅的线大约是 7 到 10 磅。在家测试时，把线绑在弹簧秤或鱼秤上，请人拿住，像搏鱼一样抬起竿，看线开始滑出时的读数。没有秤的话，直接从轮上把线拉出来：用力拉时应该平稳出线，不会一顿一顿。太容易拉出就拧紧，拉不动就松开。编织线会割手，要绕在钳子或铅笔上拉。宁松勿紧。存放前把卸力松开。

items.question: What does the anti-reverse switch do?
items.question_zh: 反转开关有什么作用？
items.short: It stops the handle from turning backward.
items.body: With it on, the reel can only turn forward, and line leaves only through the drag. With it off, the handle can spin backward to give line by hand. Keep it on for most fishing. Many modern reels have no switch at all.
items.short_zh: 它防止手把反转。
items.body_zh: 打开时，轮只能向前转，线只能通过卸力放出。关闭时，手把可以反转，用手放线。多数情况下保持打开。很多现代渔轮根本没有这个开关。

items.question: Why will the bail not flip back or stay open?
items.question_zh: 为什么线臂翻不回来，或者打开后保持不住？
items.short: The bail spring or trip mechanism may be dirty, worn or broken.
items.body: Clean out sand or old grease, then add a drop of oil at the bail pivots, which Abu Garcia lists as oiling points. A worn spring can stop it staying open, and a bent wire can stop it closing. Replacement bail springs are inexpensive, so look for a parts diagram. On a cheap reel it may not be worth repairing.
items.short_zh: 线臂弹簧或翻转机构可能脏了、磨损了或坏了。
items.body_zh: 清除沙子和旧润滑脂，然后在线臂转轴上滴一滴油，Abu Garcia 把这两处列为上油点。弹簧磨损，线臂可能打开后保持不住；钢丝弯了，线臂可能翻不回来。线臂弹簧很便宜，可以查零件图。便宜的轮可能不值得修。

items.question: Which hand should turn the handle, and does it matter?
items.question_zh: 应该用哪只手摇轮？这有影响吗？
items.short: It matters little. Use whichever feels natural.
items.body: Most right-handers reel with their left hand on spinning gear, so the strong hand holds the rod for casting and hook sets, with no need to swap after the cast. Most spinning reels can be switched to either side, and casting reels come in left and right models. Try both.
items.short_zh: 影响不大，哪只手顺手就用哪只。
items.body_zh: 用纺车轮时，多数惯用右手的人用左手摇，力气大的手负责握竿、抛投和提竿，抛完也不用换手。多数纺车轮的手把可以换边，水滴轮也有左手和右手款。两种都试试。

items.question: How difficult is it to switch from a spinning reel to a baitcaster?
items.question_zh: 从纺车轮换到水滴轮有多难？
items.short: It takes a few sessions of practice, and a few backlashes.
items.body: Baitcasting is an acquired skill. Set the brake high, use a 3/8 to 1/2 ounce lure and practice short casts on grass. Lift your thumb as the rod comes forward and put it back on the spool as the lure lands, because the spool keeps spinning after the lure stops.
items.short_zh: 练几次就行，炸几次线也难免。
items.body_zh: 水滴轮抛投需要练习。刹车调高，用 3/8 到 1/2 盎司的饵，在草地上练短距离抛投。竿向前送时抬起拇指，饵落下时把拇指按回线杯，因为饵停了线杯还在转。

items.question: How do I recover from a backlash that is several layers deep?
items.question_zh: 炸线缠了好几层，怎样解开？
items.short: Don't yank. Free the spool, pull off what comes easily, then pin the tangle and crank to loosen the deep loops.
items.body: Press the thumb bar so the spool turns freely and gently pull line out until it stops. Press your thumb hard on the tangle, turn the handle a few times to pin it, then release and pull again. A stuck loop deep in the tangle often comes free this way. Repeat as needed. If one loop still holds, lift it out with your fingers or something blunt like a toothpick, working from the top layer down. Avoid sharp tools and hard pulling, which can nick or kink the line. Cut out any badly kinked section. Then raise the brakes and spool tension a little and make a few soft casts.
items.short_zh: 不要硬拉。先让线杯自由转动，把能拉出的线拉出来，再压住线团摇几圈，松动深处的线圈。
items.body_zh: 按下拇指杆让线杯自由转动，轻轻拉线，拉到卡住为止。用拇指用力压住线团，摇几圈手把把它压住，松开后再拉。卡在深处的线圈常常就这样出来了，可以重复几次。如果还有一个线圈卡着，就用手指或牙签这类不尖的工具，从最上层开始挑开。不要用尖的工具，也不要用力拽，线被划伤或折出死弯后强度会下降。折痕严重的一段要剪掉。弄好后把刹车和线杯张力调高一点，先轻抛几次。

items.question: Why does line pile up unevenly on my spinning reel spool?
items.question_zh: 为什么线在纺车轮线杯上堆得不均匀？
items.short: The line lay is off, or line is going on loose.
items.body: Some unevenness is normal, but a build-up at the front or back can often be corrected with shims behind the spool on some reels. Loose line piles up too, so keep tension on it. Check that the line roller spins, since a stuck roller adds twist. A worn oscillation gear is a rarer cause.
items.short_zh: 排线不正，或者上线时太松。
items.body_zh: 轻微不均匀是正常的；如果线堆在前面或后面，有些轮可以在线杯后面加减垫片来调整。线太松也会堆积，所以要保持张力。检查导线轮能不能转，卡住的导线轮会加重线扭。往复齿轮磨损是比较少见的原因。

items.question: What happens to a reel that goes unused for a few years?
items.question_zh: 几年没用的轮会怎么样？
items.short: Grease thickens, the drag can stick and the line goes bad.
items.body: A drag left tight flattens its washers and no longer works smoothly, and old mono turns brittle. Strip off the line, clean and lubricate the reel lightly, and test the drag. Check for corrosion from damp storage.
items.short_zh: 润滑脂会变稠，卸力可能卡住，线也会变质。
items.body_zh: 卸力长期拧紧，卸力片会被压平，就不顺滑了；旧尼龙线也会变脆。把线全部换掉，清洁并少量润滑，测试卸力。再看看有没有潮湿造成的腐蚀。

items.question: What are the first steps to take in the week before a first fishing trip?
items.question_zh: 第一次钓鱼前的一周，应该先做哪些准备？
items.short: Get a license if you need one, find a place, ready your gear and practice casting.
items.body: Three things come first: somewhere to go, a license if you need one, and the rules for that water. Look for a stocked pond or a public fishing area. Put on fresh line if the old line is worn, and practice casting in a yard with a practice weight. Check the weather the day before and tell someone where you're going.
items.short_zh: 需要的话先办钓鱼证，找好地方，准备好装备，并练习抛投。
items.body_zh: 先解决三件事：去哪里、需不需要钓鱼证、那片水域有什么规定。找一个放流池塘或公共钓鱼区。旧线磨损了就换新线，在院子里用练习坠练抛投。前一天看看天气，告诉别人你要去哪里。

items.question: Should I use a relative's old gear to start or buy something new?
items.question_zh: 入门时用长辈的旧装备好，还是买新的？
items.short: Use it, if it works.
items.body: Old rods are often fine. Replace old line first, check the guides for cracks and test the drag. Soft plastics may have melted and hooks may be rusty, so replace those, and clean and oil the reel. If the reel is too rough to use, a simple new combo doesn't cost much. Ask your relative to come along, which is worth more than any gear.
items.short_zh: 如果还能用，就用。
items.body_zh: 旧竿常常没问题。先换掉旧线，检查导环有没有裂纹，试试卸力。软饵可能熔了，钩可能生锈了，这些要换，轮也要清洁上油。轮太涩没法用的话，买一套简单的新套装也花不了多少钱。请长辈一起去，这比什么装备都值。

items.question: What are good books or other resources for learning fishing from the beginning?
items.question_zh: 从零开始学钓鱼，有哪些好书或其他学习资料？
items.short: Start with your state agency's learn-to-fish pages.
items.body: State agencies publish free guides, and many run classes and loaner programs. Take Me Fishing has beginner material. Public libraries have classic how-to books, and videos are useful for knots and casting. Local clubs and tackle shops can point you to nearby waters. FishEye's handbook also covers the basics.
items.short_zh: 先看所在州主管机构的学钓鱼页面。
items.body_zh: 各州主管机构会发布免费指南，很多还有培训班和渔具借用项目。Take Me Fishing 有面向新手的内容。公共图书馆有经典的入门书，学打结和抛投看视频很有用。当地俱乐部和渔具店能告诉你附近有哪些水域。FishEye 的手册也讲了基础知识。

items.question: What can be practiced at home during the off-season?
items.question_zh: 休钓季在家可以练习什么？
items.short: Knots, casting in a yard and reel care.
items.body: Practice the palomar and improved clinch until you can tie them without looking. Cast with a practice plug or a lure with the hooks removed, never a hooked lure, and aim at a hoop 10 to 20 feet away. Clean reels, replace old line and organize your tackle. Read about your local waters and make a plan for spring. If you're interested, tying flies is another winter skill.
items.short_zh: 打结、在院子里练抛投，以及保养渔轮。
items.body_zh: 练帕洛马结和改良克林奇结，练到不用看也能打。用练习塞或摘掉钩子的拟饵练，不要用带钩的饵，在 10 到 20 英尺外放一个呼啦圈当目标。清洁渔轮，换掉旧线，整理渔具。了解一下当地的水域，做好春天的计划。如果有兴趣，绑毛钩也是冬天可以学的技能。

items.question: Should I go out targeting one species or just try to catch whatever bites?
items.question_zh: 出门时应该专门钓一种鱼，还是什么咬钩就钓什么？
items.short: Catch whatever bites at first, especially panfish.
items.body: A small hook and a worm give you the most bites and teach you how fish behave. Bluegill are curious and not picky, which makes them a great first fish. After a few trips, choose one kind of fish and learn when and where it feeds. That focus will teach you faster than changing gear all the time.
items.short_zh: 一开始什么咬钩就钓什么，尤其是小型淡水鱼。
items.body_zh: 小钩加蚯蚓咬口最多，也能让你了解鱼的习性。蓝鳃太阳鱼好奇心强，不挑食，很适合作为第一种鱼。去过几次之后，选一种鱼，了解它什么时候在哪里觅食。这样专注，比不停换装备学得更快。

items.question: Is it worth hiring a guide once as a beginner?
items.question_zh: 作为新手，请一次向导值得吗？
items.short: Yes, if your budget allows it.
items.body: A half day on the water teaches you knots, casting, reading water and what the local fish want. Tell the guide you are a beginner and want to learn, and ask to fish in a simple way that you can repeat. Ask what is included. A guide saves the most time on big or unfamiliar water, where finding the fish is the hard part. If your budget is tight, look for free state classes, clubs or a free fishing day. Some states also lend rods and reels free at parks.
items.short_zh: 值得，只要预算允许。
items.body_zh: 半天的时间，能学到打结、抛投、读水，以及当地的鱼喜欢什么。告诉向导你是新手、想学东西，请对方用你以后能照着做的简单方法。问清楚包含哪些内容。在大水面或陌生水域，最难的是找到鱼，请向导最省时间。预算紧的话，可以找州政府的免费课程、俱乐部或免费钓鱼日。有些州还会在公园免费出借钓竿和渔轮。

items.question: If I have only about $100 to spend, how should it be divided?
items.question_zh: 如果我只有大约 100 美元，应该怎么分配？
items.short: About $40 to $60 for a combo, and the rest on tackle, license and bait.
items.body: A simple spinning combo is enough. Spend about $10 to $15 on hooks, split shot and bobbers, and keep money for your license, which varies by state, as well as bait and a small tackle box. If you'll be on or near deep water, a life jacket comes first.
items.short_zh: 大约 40 到 60 美元买套装，其余用于配件、钓鱼证和饵。
items.body_zh: 一套简单的纺车轮套装就够了。钩、咬铅和浮漂花 10 到 15 美元，剩下的留给钓鱼证（各州价格不同）、饵和小渔具盒。如果要在深水上或靠近深水，先买救生衣。

items.question: Which body features are most useful for telling similar fish apart?
items.question_zh: 身体的哪些特征，最有助于区分相似的鱼？
items.short: Mouth size, fin shape, markings and the tail.
items.body: Check whether the jaw goes past the eye, how many dorsal fins there are, the shape of the tail and the position of bars or spots. Close the mouth when you check the jaw. For catfish, look at the tail and the anal fin. Color changes with the water, so don't rely on it.
items.short_zh: 嘴的大小、鳍的形状、斑纹和尾巴。
items.body_zh: 看上颌是否超过眼睛，背鳍有几个，尾巴什么形状，竖纹或斑点在什么位置。看上颌时要把鱼嘴合上。鲶鱼要看尾巴和臀鳍。颜色会随水质变化，不要单靠颜色判断。

items.question: How can I tell a largemouth bass from a smallmouth bass?
items.question_zh: 怎样区分大口黑鲈和小口黑鲈？
items.short: Look at the jaw and the side markings.
items.body: With the mouth closed, a largemouth's jaw reaches well past the back of the eye, while a smallmouth's reaches about the back edge and never past it. Largemouth have a dark horizontal stripe, and smallmouth have vertical bars. A smallmouth's two dorsal fins are connected.
items.short_zh: 看上颌和体侧的斑纹。
items.body_zh: 鱼嘴合上时，大口黑鲈的上颌远远超过眼睛后缘，小口黑鲈只到眼睛后缘，绝不会超过。大口黑鲈体侧有一条深色横纹，小口黑鲈是竖纹。小口黑鲈的两个背鳍是相连的。

items.question: How can sunfish species such as bluegill and redear be told apart?
items.question_zh: 蓝鳃太阳鱼和红耳太阳鱼这类太阳鱼怎样区分？
items.short: Look at the ear flap and the pectoral fins.
items.body: A bluegill has a black spot at the back of the dorsal fin, vertical bars, a small mouth and a flexible black ear flap. A redear has a red or orange edge on a short ear flap and long, pointed pectoral fins. A green sunfish has a large mouth and turquoise spots.
items.short_zh: 看鳃盖后的耳状突和胸鳍。
items.body_zh: 蓝鳃太阳鱼背鳍后部有一个黑斑，体侧有竖纹，嘴小，耳状突是可弯曲的黑色。红耳太阳鱼的耳状突较短，边缘是红色或橙色，胸鳍长而尖。绿太阳鱼嘴大，有青绿色斑点。

items.question: How can I tell a crappie from other panfish?
items.question_zh: 怎样把莓鲈和其他小型淡水鱼区分开？
items.short: A silvery, deep body and a larger mouth than a bluegill.
items.body: Crappie are silvery and deep-bodied. White crappie have vertical bars and 5 to 6 dorsal spines, and black crappie have irregular blotches and 7 to 8 spines. Bluegill have a black ear flap and a small mouth. Count the spines if you need to be sure, as rules can differ between kinds of fish.
items.short_zh: 银色、体高，嘴比蓝鳃太阳鱼大。
items.body_zh: 莓鲈身体银色、较高。白莓鲈有竖纹，背鳍硬棘 5 到 6 根；黑莓鲈是不规则的斑块，硬棘 7 到 8 根。蓝鳃太阳鱼有黑色耳状突，嘴小。需要确认时就数硬棘，不同的鱼规定可能不同。

items.question: What photos should I take of a fish so that others can identify it before I release it?
items.question_zh: 放流之前，应该拍哪些照片，别人才能帮忙辨认？
items.short: A clear side view, plus the mouth and tail if you can.
items.body: Have your camera ready first, and leave the fish in the water until you are ready to shoot. Take one side view with the fins open and one close-up of the head with the mouth closed, and include the tail. Keep the fish out of the water no longer than you can hold your breath. Note the place and the length.
items.short_zh: 一张清晰的侧面照，能拍的话再加嘴和尾巴。
items.body_zh: 先把相机准备好，尽量让鱼待在水里。拍一张鳍张开的侧面照，一张鱼嘴合上的头部特写，也要拍到尾巴。鱼离水的时间不要超过你能憋气的时间。记下地点和长度。

items.question: Why does it matter to identify a fish correctly before keeping it?
items.question_zh: 留鱼之前，为什么必须正确辨认？
items.short: Because limits, seasons and legal protection depend on the kind of fish.
items.body: Length and bag limits apply by kind of fish, and some fish are protected altogether. A mistake can mean breaking the law or harming a rare fish. Steelhead may have separate rules from rainbow trout even though they are the same species, and eating advisories also vary by kind of fish. If you are unsure, release it.
items.short_zh: 因为限额、禁渔期和法律保护都取决于鱼的种类。
items.body_zh: 长度和数量限制是按鱼的种类规定的，有些鱼完全受保护。认错可能违法，也可能伤害稀有的鱼。硬头鳟和虹鳟是同一物种，规定却可能不同，食用建议也按鱼种而异。拿不准就放掉。

items.question: What is the simplest bass approach for a beginner on a small pond?
items.question_zh: 在小池塘，新手钓鲈鱼最简单的方法是什么？
items.short: A plastic grub or worm near cover.
items.body: A good beginner setup is a medium-action spinning rod, 6 to 8 lb line and a plastic grub on a 1/8 to 1/4 ounce jig head. Cast along weed edges and docks, let it sink, then lift it slowly and let it fall again. Topwater lures work best early in the morning and toward dark.
items.short_zh: 在掩体附近用软胶卷尾或软虫。
items.body_zh: 新手可以用中等调性的直柄竿，配 6 到 8 磅线和 1/8 到 1/4 盎司铅头钩加软胶卷尾。沿水草边缘和码头抛，让它下沉，再慢慢抬竿，让饵再次下落。清晨和傍晚用水面饵效果最好。

items.question: How does smallmouth fishing differ from largemouth fishing?
items.question_zh: 钓小口黑鲈和钓大口黑鲈有什么不同？
items.short: Smallmouth prefer rock and current. Largemouth prefer weeds and cover.
items.body: Smallmouth are found around rocky shoals, points and river riffles, and they often take tubes, Ned rigs and crayfish imitations. Largemouth hold near logs, weeds and docks, and you may need heavier gear. FishEye's guides list 8 to 10 lb mono for smallmouth and 15 lb or more for a Texas rig in cover.
items.short_zh: 小口黑鲈喜欢岩石和水流，大口黑鲈喜欢水草和掩体。
items.body_zh: 小口黑鲈常在岩石浅滩、岬角和河流急滩附近，常吃管状软饵、内德钓组和模仿螯虾的饵。大口黑鲈待在倒木、水草和码头附近，可能需要更重的装备。FishEye 的指南里，钓小口黑鲈用 8 到 10 磅尼龙线，在障碍区用德州钓组钓大口黑鲈用 15 磅或更粗的线。

items.question: At what water temperature do bass become noticeably less active?
items.question_zh: 水温低到多少，鲈鱼的活跃度会明显下降？
items.short: Below about 50°F, and activity slows further as it drops.
items.body: Bass fishing is often best with the water at 60 to 75°F. There is no exact cutoff, as bass in northern lakes are adapted to cold. Below about 50°F, expect a slow bite and use small lures near the bottom, moving slowly. Bass can also slow down in very hot water.
items.short_zh: 低于大约 50°F 时，水温越低越不活跃。
items.body_zh: 水温 60 到 75°F 时，鲈鱼通常最好钓。没有准确的分界线，北方湖泊的鲈鱼更适应低温。低于约 50°F 时，咬口会变少，要用小饵贴底慢慢收。水温很高时，鲈鱼也可能不活跃。

items.question: What should I change when bass follow a lure but do not take it?
items.question_zh: 鲈鱼跟着饵却不咬时，应该改变什么？
items.short: Change the speed, the size or the direction.
items.body: Try a short pause or a sudden twitch right at the boat or bank. Go smaller or switch color. Steer the lure in a figure 8 at the end of the retrieve. If the fish are near the bottom, slow down and go smaller. Make another cast with a soft plastic after the follow, but avoid casting at the same fish over and over.
items.short_zh: 改变速度、大小或方向。
items.body_zh: 在船边或岸边突然停一下，或者猛抖一下。换小一点的饵或换颜色。收线结束时，让饵画个“8”字。鱼靠近水底时，放慢并换小饵。鱼跟过之后，可以用软饵再抛一次，但不要对着同一条鱼反复抛。

items.question: What simple setup works for stocked trout in a lake?
items.question_zh: 在湖里钓放流鳟，什么简单配置有效？
items.short: A light rod, 4 to 8 lb line and a small hook with dough bait, corn or worm.
items.body: A simple bottom rig is a 1/8-ounce sinker, a swivel, 18 to 24 inches of 4 lb leader and a No. 6 or 8 hook with floating bait. Or hang the bait under a small bobber. Small spinners and spoons work too. Arrive early on stocking day, and check that corn and bait are allowed.
items.short_zh: 轻竿、4 到 8 磅线，小钩挂面饵、玉米或蚯蚓。
items.body_zh: 简单的底钓组是：1/8 盎司铅坠、转环、18 到 24 英寸的 4 磅前导，加 6 号或 8 号钩和浮性饵。也可以把饵挂在小浮漂下面。小旋转亮片和勺形亮片也有效。放流日早点到，并确认当地允许用玉米和天然饵。

items.question: How does fishing a small stream for trout differ from fishing a lake?
items.question_zh: 在小溪钓鳟鱼和在湖里钓有什么不同？
items.short: Stream trout wait in the current for food, so you cast upstream and let the bait drift.
items.body: Walk up quietly from below, cast upstream and let the bait drift back. Trout face upstream, so approach from behind them, and use small, light gear. In a lake, trout cruise, and you usually fish bait at a set depth or troll. Stream trout are usually wilder and more easily spooked.
items.short_zh: 溪流鳟鱼在水流里等食物，所以要往上游抛，让饵漂下来。
items.body_zh: 从下游悄悄靠近，往上游抛，让饵漂回来。鳟鱼头朝上游，所以要从它身后接近，并使用轻小的钓组。在湖里，鳟鱼四处游动，通常用固定水深的天然饵或拖钓。溪流鳟鱼一般更野，也更容易受惊。

items.question: What size of lure is too large for small stocked trout?
items.question_zh: 对体型较小的放流鳟，多大的饵就算太大？
items.short: Over about 1/4 ounce is usually too big.
items.body: FishEye's guide lists small inline spinners of 1/16 to 1/8 ounce and small spoons. Stocked trout average 10 to 12 inches in Texas and have small mouths. A larger lure can still draw strikes, but more fish hook poorly. If fish follow but don't bite, go smaller.
items.short_zh: 超过大约 1/4 盎司，通常就太大了。
items.body_zh: FishEye 的指南列的是 1/16 到 1/8 盎司的小旋转亮片和小勺形亮片。德州的放流鳟平均 10 到 12 英寸，嘴也小。大一点的饵仍可能引来攻击，但不容易钩牢。鱼跟着不咬，就换小的。

items.question: Can beads be fished effectively in still water?
items.question_zh: 珠子饵在静水中也能有效使用吗？
items.short: Sometimes, but they are mainly used in moving water.
items.body: Beads imitate fish eggs drifting in current, and they work best in streams when fish are spawning. In still water, a bead under a float can catch stocked trout or fish near inflows, but other baits usually do better. Some waters restrict beads, so read the local rules.
items.short_zh: 有时可以，但主要用于流水。
items.body_zh: 珠子饵模仿在水流中漂动的鱼卵，在鱼产卵时的溪流中效果最好。静水里，把珠子挂在浮漂下，可以钓放流鳟或入水口附近的鱼，但其他饵通常更好。有些水域限制用珠子饵，要看当地规定。

items.question: What setup should a beginner use for steelhead in winter?
items.question_zh: 冬季钓硬头鳟，新手应该用什么配置？
items.short: An 8 to 10 foot spinning rod with 6 to 12 lb line and a float.
items.body: Float fishing lets the bait drift a long way without snagging. Use enough split shot to sink about three quarters of the float, with a spawn sac or artificial egg. In winter, look in deep pools and slower water. Wading in winter is risky: wear studded boots and a life jacket, and fish with a friend.
items.short_zh: 8 到 10 英尺的直柄竿，配 6 到 12 磅线和浮漂。
items.body_zh: 浮漂能让饵漂很远而不挂底。咬铅的量要让浮漂沉下约四分之三，饵用卵袋或人工鱼卵。冬天重点找深潭和缓流。冬季涉水有风险，要穿带钉的靴子和救生衣，并结伴去。

items.question: What is the simplest effective bottom rig for catfish from the bank?
items.question_zh: 在岸边钓鲶鱼，最简单有效的底钓组是什么？
items.short: An egg sinker, a swivel, a short leader and a bait hook.
items.body: Thread the line through a 1/4 to 1/2 ounce egg sinker, tie on a barrel swivel, add an 18-inch leader and a No. 4 or 6 hook. Let it sit on the bottom and reel the line tight. For larger catfish, use a 1 ounce sinker, a 2-foot leader and a 4/0 to 6/0 hook.
items.short_zh: 橄榄铅、转环、短前导和饵钩。
items.body_zh: 线穿过 1/4 到 1/2 盎司的橄榄铅，绑上桶形转环，接 18 英寸前导和 4 号或 6 号钩。让饵停在水底，把线收紧。钓大一些的鲶鱼，用 1 盎司铅、2 英尺前导和 4/0 到 6/0 的钩。

items.question: Which baits are most dependable for pond catfish?
items.question_zh: 钓池塘鲶鱼，哪些饵最可靠？
items.short: Nightcrawlers, chicken liver, shrimp, stink bait and cut hot dogs.
items.body: Channel catfish find food by taste and smell and take non-living baits readily. Soft baits tear off the hook, so run the hook through several times, or use a small treble hook where it's allowed. If you get no bite in 15 minutes, move to a new spot.
items.short_zh: 蚯蚓、鸡肝、虾、臭饵和切段的热狗肠。
items.body_zh: 斑点叉尾鮰靠味觉和嗅觉觅食，很愿意吃不会动的饵。软饵容易从钩上掉，要多穿几次，规定允许时可以用小三本钩。15 分钟没有咬口，就换地方。

items.question: How can catfish be landed safely at night?
items.question_zh: 夜间怎样安全地把鲶鱼弄上岸？
items.short: Use a headlamp and a net, and watch the spines.
items.body: Catfish have stiff, barbed spines in the dorsal and both side fins. Hold one from behind, with your hand over its back and behind those fins, or use pliers and a grip. Take out hooks with pliers rather than fingers. Keep rods where you won't trip, stay back from the edge, and wear a life jacket on steep banks.
items.short_zh: 戴头灯，用抄网，小心硬棘。
items.body_zh: 鲶鱼的背鳍和两侧胸鳍都有带倒刺的硬棘。要从后面抓，手放在鱼背上、这些鳍的后方，或者用钳子和握鱼器。取钩用钳子，不要用手指。竿要放在不会绊倒人的地方，离岸边远一点，陡岸要穿救生衣。

items.question: How is carp fishing with corn set up, and how much bait should go in the water?
items.question_zh: 用玉米钓鲤鱼怎样设置？应该往水里投多少饵？
items.short: A simple bottom rig with corn on a size 4 to 8 hook. Feed a few handfuls.
items.body: Use an egg sinker, a barrel swivel, a short leader and a size 4 to 8 hook covered with corn. Toss in a few handfuls of corn, and add more every half hour to an hour. Set the drag properly, because carp make long runs, and land them with a net. Chumming isn't allowed everywhere, so confirm it first.
items.short_zh: 简单的底钓组，4 到 8 号钩挂玉米，再撒几把窝料。
items.body_zh: 用橄榄铅、桶形转环、短前导和 4 到 8 号钩，把玉米挂满钩。撒几把玉米，每半小时到一小时再补一些。卸力要调好，鲤鱼会长距离冲刺，用抄网收鱼。打窝前先确认当地允许。

items.question: Does a float rig or a bottom rig work better for carp?
items.question_zh: 钓鲤鱼用浮漂钓组好，还是底钓组好？
items.short: A bottom rig is usually better.
items.body: Carp feed mostly on the bottom and find baits by smell, and they rarely hit lures. A float rig can work in shallow water when carp are feeding at or near the surface, and it shows bites well. Start on the bottom.
items.short_zh: 通常底钓组更好。
items.body_zh: 鲤鱼主要在水底觅食，靠嗅觉找饵，很少咬拟饵。鲤鱼在水面或靠近水面进食时，浅水用浮漂钓组也可以，咬口也看得清楚。先从底钓开始。

items.question: How can crappie be located when they are not near the bank?
items.question_zh: 莓鲈不在岸边时，怎样找到它们？
items.short: Look in deeper water around brush and timber, or over open water.
items.body: Crappie hang over open water in summer and move deeper than 15 feet after spring, often around standing timber and brush. Use a slip bobber set 6 to 10 feet deep, or a small jig. A fish finder helps, and bridges and docks are worth trying. Once you find one, stay, since they school.
items.short_zh: 到更深的水里找，看树枝和立木周围，或者开阔水域。
items.body_zh: 夏天莓鲈常悬在开阔水域，春季过后会到 15 英尺以下，常在立木和树枝丛周围。用活动浮漂设到 6 到 10 英尺，或者用小铅头钩。探鱼器有帮助，桥和码头也值得试。莓鲈成群活动，找到一条就留下来。

items.question: What small bait is most reliable for bluegill?
items.question_zh: 钓蓝鳃太阳鱼，什么小饵最可靠？
items.short: A small piece of worm on a small hook is the most dependable start.
items.body: Bluegill have small mouths and eat mostly insects and larvae. Crickets and mealworms work well too, and a lively cricket is especially good for bigger bluegill in summer and late fall. Use a size 6 to 10 hook with only enough bait to cover it, plus one split shot and the smallest bobber that floats the rig. Set the bobber 1 to 3 feet above the bait to start. If you would rather not rebait, try a small soft-plastic grub on a tiny jig under a slip bobber.
items.short_zh: 小钩挂一小段蚯蚓，是最稳妥的开始。
items.body_zh: 蓝鳃太阳鱼嘴小，主要吃昆虫和幼虫。蟋蟀和黄粉虫也很好，活泼的蟋蟀在夏天和晚秋对大一点的蓝鳃太阳鱼尤其有效。用 6 到 10 号的钩，饵盖住钩就够了，加一粒咬铅，用能浮住钓组的最小浮漂，开始时放在饵上方 1 到 3 英尺。不想反复换饵的话，可以在活动浮漂下用小铅头钩挂小软饵。

items.question: How should perch be kept fresh in cold weather during a day of fishing?
items.question_zh: 天冷钓一整天时，河鲈应该怎样保鲜？
items.short: Keep them cold and out of the sun, on ice or snow.
items.body: Get fish into a cooler with ice soon after they are caught. In cold weather, a bucket outside may be enough, but don't let fish warm up in a heated shelter or freeze and thaw repeatedly. Gutting removes a source of bacteria and lets them chill faster. Remember that fish on a stringer count as kept.
items.short_zh: 保持低温，避开阳光，放在冰或雪上。
items.body_zh: 钓上来后尽快放进加冰的保温箱。天冷时，放在外面的桶里也许就够了，但不要让鱼在有暖气的棚里回温，也不要反复冻融。去内脏可以去掉细菌来源，降温也更快。记住，串在鱼串上的鱼算作已留取。

items.question: Is a wire leader necessary for a beginner targeting pike?
items.question_zh: 新手钓白斑狗鱼，必须用钢丝前导吗？
items.short: A bite-proof leader is needed. Wire is the simplest.
items.body: FishEye's guide uses a foot-long steel or fluorocarbon leader, because teeth can cut through ordinary line. Buy ready-made leaders with a snap. Heavy fluorocarbon works, but wire is more secure. Bring long pliers too. Irish and German fisheries material treats a steel leader of at least about 30 cm as standard for pike. Throw away any wire leader with a kink.
items.short_zh: 需要防咬前导，钢丝最简单。
items.body_zh: FishEye 的指南用一英尺长的钢丝或碳线前导，因为鱼牙能切断普通的线。买现成带别针的前导就行。粗碳线也可以，但钢丝更保险。也要带长柄钳。爱尔兰和德国的官方资料把至少约 30 厘米的钢丝前导当作钓白斑狗鱼的标准配置。钢丝前导一旦打折就要换掉。

items.question: What is a straightforward way to start fishing for walleye?
items.question_zh: 开始钓大眼梭鲈，有什么直接的方法？
items.short: A jig and minnow near the bottom, early or late in the day.
items.body: Use a 1/8 to 3/8 ounce jig tipped with a minnow on a medium spinning rod with 6 to 10 lb line. Fish at first and last light around points and reefs. Or use a slip bobber with a leech or nightcrawler. Walleye openers vary, so look up your state's season.
items.short_zh: 清晨或傍晚，在水底用铅头钩挂小鱼。
items.body_zh: 用 1/8 到 3/8 盎司铅头钩挂小鱼，配中等硬度直柄竿和 6 到 10 磅线。清晨和傍晚在岬角和礁石附近钓。也可以用活动浮漂挂水蛭或蚯蚓。大眼梭鲈的开钓日各地不同，出发前要看所在州的规定。

items.question: How is float fishing for salmon set up in a large river?
items.question_zh: 在大河中用浮漂钓鲑鱼，怎样设置？
items.short: A long rod, a float, split shot and roe or another bait under it.
items.body: Use a rod of 10 to 13 feet with about 15 lb main line and a float, with enough shot to sink about three quarters of it. Below that goes a leader of 8 to 12 lb fluorocarbon with a hook and roe. Set the depth so the bait drifts just off the bottom, and mend the line so the float leads. Some rivers restrict weights and hooks, so read the rules.
items.short_zh: 长竿、浮漂、咬铅，下面挂鱼卵或其他饵。
items.body_zh: 用 10 到 13 英尺的竿，主线约 15 磅，加浮漂和足以压沉约四分之三浮漂的咬铅，再接 8 到 12 磅碳线前导，挂钩和鱼卵。水深调到饵刚好在水底上方漂动，并及时修线，让浮漂走在前面。查好规定，有些河流限制铅坠和钩。

items.question: How does a striped bass approach differ between a river and the coast?
items.question_zh: 在河流和沿海钓条纹鲈，方法有什么不同？
items.short: In rivers, fish current edges and bait. On the coast, follow tides and baitfish.
items.body: In rivers, stripers hold along current edges, in deep holes and near bridges, and live or cut bait drifted with a sinker works. On the coast, fish moving tides around inlets, sandbars and rocks with swimming plugs, bucktails or bait. Birds diving on baitfish are a good sign. Check size limits and circle-hook rules. In Connecticut, for example, stripers use large rivers in spring and fall and estuaries and bays in summer, so the season tells you where to start.
items.short_zh: 河里钓水流边缘，用天然饵；沿海要跟着潮水和饵鱼走。
items.body_zh: 在河里，条纹鲈常在水流边缘、深坑和桥边，用铅坠带活饵或切块饵漂流很有效。在沿海，趁潮水流动时，到入海口、沙洲和岩石附近，用游泳型硬饵、鹿毛钩或天然饵。鸟群俯冲饵鱼是好信号。查好尺寸限制和圆形钩的规定。比如在康涅狄格，条纹鲈春秋在大河，夏天在河口和海湾，所以先看季节再决定去哪里。

items.question: Is heavy rain a good or bad time to go fishing?
items.question_zh: 下大雨时去钓鱼，是好时机还是坏时机？
items.short: Light rain can be excellent. Heavy rain with lightning is dangerous.
items.body: Cloud and rain cut the light and wash insects in, which can make fish feed. After heavy rain, rivers may rise and turn muddy, so fish near slack water. If you can hear thunder, get off the water, and wait 30 minutes after the last thunder before going back. Graphite rods conduct electricity, so don't hold one up in a storm or near power lines.
items.short_zh: 小雨可能很好，带闪电的大雨很危险。
items.body_zh: 云和雨让光线变弱，也把昆虫冲进水里，鱼可能因此进食。大雨之后，河水可能上涨、变浑，要到缓流处钓。听到雷声就离开水边，最后一声雷过后等 30 分钟再回去。碳素竿导电，雷雨时或高压线附近不要举竿。

items.question: How sensitive are fish to small changes in water temperature?
items.question_zh: 鱼对水温的小幅变化有多敏感？
items.short: Quite sensitive, especially near spawning or in cold water.
items.body: Fish don't regulate their body temperature, so water temperature controls their activity. Spawning starts at certain temperatures: largemouth at about 60°F and crappie at 60 to 70°F, though South Carolina's guide puts largemouth at 65 to 75°F, so these vary by region. A few degrees of warming in spring can bring fish shallow, and a sudden drop after a front can slow fishing. As a rough guide, cold-water fish such as trout do best at 40 to 60°F, cool-water fish such as walleye and pike at 55 to 75°F, and warm-water fish such as bluegill and largemouth at 65 to 80°F.
items.short_zh: 相当敏感，产卵前后和冷水时尤其如此。
items.body_zh: 鱼不能调节自己的体温，所以水温决定了它们的活跃程度。产卵要到一定的水温才开始：大口黑鲈约 60°F，莓鲈 60 到 70°F；不过南卡的指南把大口黑鲈写成 65 到 75°F，各地会有差别。春天水温升几度，鱼就可能到浅水来；锋面过后水温骤降，鱼可能变得不爱咬钩。大致来说，鳟这类冷水鱼最适应 40 到 60°F，大眼梭鲈、白斑狗鱼这类温凉水鱼是 55 到 75°F，蓝鳃太阳鱼和大口黑鲈这类暖水鱼是 65 到 80°F。

items.question: How can anything be caught in winter in a small lake that is not frozen?
items.question_zh: 冬天在没有结冰的小湖里，怎样才能钓到鱼？
items.short: Fish slowly, deep and small, in the warmest part of the day.
items.body: In winter most fish go deep. Use small lures, light line and a slow retrieve near the bottom. Channels and the deepest parts of the lake hold fish, and midday sun warms the shallows. Stocked trout stay active in winter, so check your state's stocking schedule.
items.short_zh: 在一天最暖的时候，慢慢地钓深水，用小饵。
items.body_zh: 冬天多数鱼都到深水去了。用小饵、细线，贴底慢慢收。水道和湖的最深处有鱼，中午的太阳会让浅水暖和一点。放流鳟在冬天也很活跃，可以查查本州的放流时间表。

items.question: In midsummer, when surface water is at its warmest, where do fish usually go?
items.question_zh: 盛夏水面温度最高的时候，鱼通常会去哪里？
items.short: Most go somewhere cooler or shadier, but not usually to the very bottom.
items.body: In lakes deeper than about 10 feet, summer layers form: warm water on top, a band called the thermocline where temperature drops fast, and cold water below that runs short of oxygen by midsummer. Many fish hold just above the thermocline, about 5 feet down in murky lakes and 16 feet or more in clear ones. Shade matters too: docks, thick weeds and overhanging trees hold fish through the heat. In shallow ponds with no cool layer, early morning and evening are your best chances. Trout need the coldest water and shouldn't be targeted once streams warm up.
items.short_zh: 多数鱼会去更凉或更阴的地方，但通常不会沉到最底。
items.body_zh: 水深超过约 10 英尺的湖，夏天会分层：上面是暖水，中间是水温快速下降的温跃层，下面的冷水到盛夏会缺氧。很多鱼待在温跃层上方，浑水湖里大约 5 英尺深，清水湖里 16 英尺或更深。阴凉也很重要，最热的时候，码头、密集的水草和垂到水面的树下都有鱼。没有冷水层的浅池塘，最好抓住清晨和傍晚。鳟鱼最需要冷水，溪流变暖之后就不要再钓了。

items.question: Is there evidence that solunar tables help on inland waters?
items.question_zh: 月相钓鱼表对内陆水域有帮助，有证据吗？
items.short: The evidence is limited and doesn't show a reliable effect.
items.body: A 2023 study of recreational trout fisheries in North America found no significant link between catch rate and solunar values, moon phase or moon illumination, while air temperature predicted catches better. In-Fisherman reported a Texas bass data set of 2,500 trips with somewhat higher catch rates in some solunar periods: 0.95 bass per hour against an overall 0.85. That comes to a couple of extra bass in a long day. Time of day, weather and location are safer things to plan around.
items.short_zh: 证据有限，没有显示出可靠的效果。
items.body_zh: 2023 年一项针对北美休闲鳟鱼渔场的研究发现，渔获率和 solunar 数值、月相、月光亮度都没有显著关系，气温的预测效果反而更好。In-Fisherman 报道过一组 2,500 次出钓的德州鲈鱼数据，某些 solunar 时段的渔获率略高，每小时 0.95 条，总体是 0.85 条，放到一整天也就多钓一两条。按时段、天气和位置来安排，更可靠。

items.question: What is the benefit of fishing at dawn compared with midday?
items.question_zh: 清晨钓鱼和中午钓鱼相比，有什么好处？
items.short: Low light makes many fish easier to catch.
items.body: Low light is prime time for many fish, and bass take topwater lures best early in the morning and toward dark. In summer, dawn is also cooler. In cold months, midday can be better, when the shallows have warmed. Timing matters less for panfish, which feed through most of the day, than for trout and bass.
items.short_zh: 光线弱的时候，很多鱼更容易钓。
items.body_zh: 对很多鱼来说，弱光时段是黄金时间，鲈鱼在清晨和傍晚最爱咬水面饵。夏天清晨也更凉快。天冷的月份，中午浅水回暖后，反而可能更好。对小型淡水鱼来说时间没那么重要，它们一天大部分时候都会吃，鳟和鲈更看时段。

items.question: How can I find legal places to fish after moving to a new area?
items.question_zh: 搬到新地方后，怎样找到可以合法钓鱼的地点？
items.short: Start with your state agency's where-to-fish pages.
items.body: State agencies list public lakes, stocked ponds and access points. City and county parks and public land maps are worth a look too. FishEye shows lakes near you and what is known about access. Read posted rules, and get the owner's permission for private water.
items.short_zh: 先看所在州主管机构的钓鱼地点页面。
items.body_zh: 各州主管机构都会列出公共湖泊、放流池塘和下水点。也可以查城市和县的公园，以及公共土地地图。FishEye 能显示你附近的湖泊和已知的进入信息。看清现场的规定，私人水域要取得业主许可。

items.question: Which free sources show public access to lakes and rivers?
items.question_zh: 哪些免费的资料可以查到湖泊和河流的公共通道？
items.short: State agency maps, and federal maps such as PAD-US.
items.body: State fish and wildlife agencies publish boat ramps and public fishing areas. The US Geological Survey's PAD-US data shows public lands, and Forest Service and National Park Service maps are free. County parcel maps help you avoid private land. Stream-access laws differ by state, so don't assume a stream bank is open.
items.short_zh: 州政府的地图，以及 PAD-US 等联邦地图。
items.body_zh: 各州的鱼类和野生动物机构会公布下水坡道和公共钓鱼区。美国地质调查局的 PAD-US 数据显示公共土地，林务局和国家公园管理局的地图也是免费的。查县里的地块地图，可以避开私人土地。各州的溪流通行法律不同，不要以为溪岸都能进入。

items.question: How close is too close when someone is already fishing a spot?
items.question_zh: 别人已经在某处钓鱼时，离多近算太近？
items.short: If they could reach your line with a normal cast, you're too close.
items.body: Give other anglers room. Don't wade or cast in front of someone, and leave space for their back cast. Stay at least a long cast away, and farther on small water. If in doubt, ask. On a stream, go around them and get back in well upstream.
items.short_zh: 如果对方正常一抛就能碰到你的线，就是太近了。
items.body_zh: 给别人留足空间。不要在别人前面涉水或抛投，要留出对方后抛的位置。至少隔一个长抛的距离，小水域还要更远。拿不准就问一声。在溪流上，要绕过去，到上游远一点的地方再下水。

items.question: What should I know before fishing a new area?
items.question_zh: 在一个新区域钓鱼前，应该了解什么？
items.short: The license, the local rules, access and safety.
items.body: Check whether you need a state license and any local permits. Look up seasons, size and bag limits, and bait rules. Find out what is public and what is private. Check the forecast and water conditions, and tell someone your plan. Clean your boat and gear when you arrive and when you leave.
items.short_zh: 钓鱼证、当地规定、进入权限和安全。
items.body_zh: 查清楚需不需要州钓鱼证和当地许可。了解禁渔期、尺寸和数量限制，以及饵的规定。弄清哪里是公共的，哪里是私人的。看好天气预报和水情，告诉别人你的计划。到达和离开时都要清洁船和装备。

items.question: Why are people reluctant to share exact fishing spots online?
items.question_zh: 为什么人们不愿意在网上分享确切的钓点？
items.short: Because spots can get crowded and the fish overfished.
items.body: A good spot shared widely can see much more pressure, which can hurt small or fragile fisheries, and landowners may close access if too many people come. People also see a spot as a reward for their effort. If you want help, ask general questions about water types or areas, and be discreet with exact locations yourself.
items.short_zh: 因为钓点可能变得拥挤，鱼也可能被钓得过多。
items.body_zh: 好钓点传开后，压力会大很多，可能伤害规模小或脆弱的鱼群；人太多，土地主人也可能禁止进入。对很多人来说，钓点也是自己花工夫换来的回报。想请教的话，问问水域类型或大致区域，自己也要谨慎公开确切位置。

items.question: How can I meet other people to fish with?
items.question_zh: 怎样认识一起钓鱼的人？
items.short: Join a local club or a state-run class.
items.body: Fishing clubs, conservation groups such as Trout Unlimited and B.A.S.S. Nation clubs, and tackle shop events are good places to begin. State agencies and parks run free events. Online groups can help, but meet in public places and tell someone. Offer to carry gear and split costs.
items.short_zh: 加入当地俱乐部，或者参加州政府办的课程。
items.body_zh: 钓鱼俱乐部、Trout Unlimited 这样的保护组织、B.A.S.S. Nation 的俱乐部，以及渔具店的活动，都是不错的起点。州机构和公园也有免费活动。网上的群组也有帮助，但见面要选公共场所，并告诉别人。主动帮忙拿装备，分摊费用。

items.question: Why do tides matter when fishing saltwater, and which stage is best?
items.question_zh: 海钓为什么要看潮汐？哪个潮段最好？
items.short: Moving water brings food. The hours around a high or low are often best.
items.body: Water movement carries baitfish, shrimp and crabs, and predators feed at those times. There is no single best stage: a rising tide brings fish onto flats, and a falling tide drains bait out of creeks. Check a local tide table. Slack water usually slows fishing. Take care with strong currents and with water rising behind you. Stronger spring tides around the full and new moon often fish better for species such as European bass.
items.short_zh: 流动的水带来食物，高潮或低潮前后的几小时往往最好。
items.body_zh: 水流会带动饵鱼、虾和蟹，掠食鱼也在这时觅食。没有哪个潮段永远最好：涨潮时鱼上到浅滩，退潮时饵料被带出小河道。查当地的潮汐表。平潮时一般不太好钓。要小心强水流，也要留意身后涨上来的水。满月和新月前后的大潮，对欧洲海鲈这类鱼往往更好。

items.question: What is the simplest rig for fishing from a pier?
items.question_zh: 在栈桥上钓鱼，最简单的钓组是什么？
items.short: A bottom rig with a sinker and one or two hooks.
items.body: Use a pre-tied two-hook rig or a single hook with a sliding sinker, with bait such as shrimp or cut fish. Pre-tied rigs usually have a swivel at the top and a snap at the bottom for the sinker. Fish right against the pilings, and use a heavier leader where pilings rub the line. Read the pier's rules before you start.
items.short_zh: 带铅坠和一两个钩的底钓组。
items.body_zh: 用现成的双钩钓组，或者单钩加游动铅，挂虾或切块鱼。现成的钓组通常上端是转环，下端有挂铅坠的别针。紧贴桥桩钓，桥桩会磨线的地方要用粗一些的前导。开钓前看看栈桥的规定。

items.question: What rod length is manageable for a shorter person fishing from the beach?
items.question_zh: 身材较矮的人在海滩钓鱼，多长的竿比较好驾驭？
items.short: About 7 to 9 feet.
items.body: An 11-foot rod is hard for a shorter person to handle, particularly with heavy weights. A 7 to 9 foot rod still casts beyond the first trough on most beaches, and a lighter rod and smaller reel are easier to use all day. Practice casting with a lighter weight first. You often don't need the full distance anyway: South Carolina's guide notes that some of the best water is a slough just off the beach, which lighter tackle reaches easily.
items.short_zh: 大约 7 到 9 英尺。
items.body_zh: 11 英尺的竿，个子不高的人很难驾驭，用重铅时更是如此。7 到 9 英尺的竿，在多数海滩也能抛过第一道水沟；竿轻一点、轮小一点，用一整天也更轻松。先用轻一点的铅练习抛投。很多时候也用不着抛那么远：南卡的指南提到，最好的钓点常常就是紧贴海滩的深水沟，轻一点的装备完全够得着。

items.question: Can a spinning reel be used in both freshwater and saltwater?
