items.question_zh: 同一只纺车轮可以同时用于淡水和海水吗？
items.short: Yes, with care after salt.
items.body: Rinse it gently with tap water after each salt trip, let it air-dry and apply a lubricant suitable for salt water. A reel the maker rates for salt lasts longer. Never store a salty reel. Clean, drain and dry your gear before moving between waters.
items.short_zh: 可以，但钓完海水要好好保养。
items.body_zh: 每次钓完海水，用自来水轻轻冲洗，晾干，再涂上适合海水的润滑剂。厂家标明可用于海水的轮寿命更长。带盐的轮绝不能直接收起来。换水域之前，要清洁、排水、晾干装备。

items.question: What should a first-time surf angler bring?
items.question_zh: 第一次海滩投钓的人应该带什么？
items.short: Rod and reel, sinkers, rigs, bait, a sand spike, pliers and sun protection.
items.body: Also bring a bucket, a towel, water, a knife and a license if you need one. Check tide tables and rip current warnings, and stay out of the water if the waves are dangerous. Keep your reel off the sand, and rinse your gear with fresh water afterward.
items.short_zh: 竿和轮、铅坠、钓组、饵、沙地插竿器、钳子和防晒用品。
items.body_zh: 还要带水桶、毛巾、饮用水、小刀，需要的话带上钓鱼证。查好潮汐表和离岸流警告，浪大时不要下水。轮不要放在沙子上，钓完用淡水冲洗装备。

items.question: How can I judge whether ice is thick enough to walk on?
items.question_zh: 怎样判断冰层够不够厚，能不能走上去？
items.short: You can't judge it by eye. Test it with holes as you walk out, and measure.
items.body: For new, clear ice, stay off anything under 4 inches; Pennsylvania's chart asks for 5 inches to fish on foot. White ice is about half as strong, and so is slushy ice, so double those numbers. Ice over moving water is weaker, so stay off rivers and away from where streams enter or leave a lake. No ice is guaranteed safe, and state agencies don't check it for you, so ask locally. Never go alone. Carry ice picks and a rope, wear a life jacket, and spread out rather than crowding one spot.
items.short_zh: 靠眼睛判断不了。边走边打测试孔，实际量厚度。
items.body_zh: 新形成的透明冰，不足 4 英寸就不要上去；宾夕法尼亚州的标准要求徒步冰钓至少 5 英寸。白冰的强度约为透明冰的一半，泥状冰也差不多，遇到这两种要把数字翻倍。流动水面上的冰更弱，不要到河面上去，也要远离溪流流入或流出湖泊的地方。没有哪块冰是保证安全的，州政府也不会替你检查，要向当地人打听。不要单独去。带上冰锥和绳子，穿救生衣，大家分散开，不要聚在一处。

items.question: What minimum equipment is needed for a first ice-fishing trip?
items.question_zh: 第一次冰钓，最少需要哪些装备？
items.short: A license, a short rod, a bucket, an auger or spud bar, and ice safety gear.
items.body: A 4 to 6 inch hole is fine for panfish. Carry ice picks and a rope, wear a life jacket, add boot cleats and dress in layers without cotton. Never go alone, and test the ice as you walk out from shore.
items.short_zh: 钓鱼证、短竿、水桶、冰钻或冰镐，以及冰上安全装备。
items.body_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼，4 到 6 英寸的冰洞就够了。带上冰锥和绳子，穿救生衣，鞋上加防滑钉，穿多层不含棉的衣服。不要单独去，从岸边往外走时要边走边测试冰面。

items.question: Which baits are most effective through the ice for panfish?
items.question_zh: 冰钓小型淡水鱼，哪些饵最有效？
items.short: Wax worms, mealworms and small minnows.
items.body: Use wax worms, mealworms or other small larvae on tiny jigs or spoons of 1/64 to 1/16 ounce with 2 to 4 lb line. Jig gently, because too much movement scares perch off. Watch for the rod tip to twitch or the line to go slack.
items.short_zh: 蜡虫、黄粉虫和小鱼。
items.body_zh: 在 1/64 到 1/16 盎司的小铅头钩或小勺片上，挂蜡虫、黄粉虫或其他小型幼虫，配 2 到 4 磅线。抖动要轻，动作太大会把河鲈吓跑。留意竿尖轻抖或线突然变松。

items.question: Do I need a licence if I only catch and release?
items.question_zh: 如果只是钓了放流，也需要钓鱼证吗？
items.short: Assume yes unless your state says otherwise. License rules generally cover the act of fishing, not whether you keep the fish.
items.body: Texas requires a license for anyone who takes or attempts to take fish in its public waters. California requires one to take fish and defines take to include attempting to catch them. Planning to release the fish doesn't exempt you in either state. Exemptions depend on things like age, free fishing days and certain waters. Texas state parks, California's Free Fishing Days and public ocean piers, and private ponds in Georgia are examples. Rules differ by state, so check your state's agency page before you go.
items.short_zh: 除非你所在的州明确说不用，否则就当作需要持证。钓鱼证的规定通常针对钓鱼这个行为，不看你留不留鱼。
items.body_zh: 德克萨斯州要求，在公共水域捕捞或试图捕捞鱼类的人都要持证。加利福尼亚州要求捕捞（take）时持证，并把 take 定义为包括试图捕捉。在这两个州，打算放流并不能免证。豁免通常看年龄、免费钓鱼日和特定水域，例如德州的州立公园、加州的免费钓鱼日和海边公共栈桥、佐治亚州的私人池塘。各州规定不同，出发前请查本州主管机构的页面。

items.question: Can I bring someone with me who does not have a licence?
items.question_zh: 可以带一个没有钓鱼证的人一起吗？
items.short: Usually yes, if they only watch, but don't let them fish or help until you have checked.
items.body: Rules on helpers vary. Georgia says anyone helping an angler, for example by netting a fish, must be licensed too, and Texas defines fishing as taking or attempting to take aquatic life by any means. Children below the license age can fish without one in many states. Check the rules for your state before someone without a license holds a rod or helps land a fish.
items.short_zh: 如果对方只是看，通常可以；但在查清之前，不要让对方钓鱼或帮忙。
items.body_zh: 各州对帮忙者的规定不同。佐治亚州规定，帮忙的人，比如帮忙抄鱼的人，也要持证；德克萨斯州把钓鱼定义为以任何方式捕捉或试图捕捉水生动物。很多州低于持证年龄的孩子不用证也能钓。没有钓鱼证的人拿竿或帮忙收鱼之前，要先查清本州规定。

items.question: Does a digital copy of a fishing licence on a phone count?
items.question_zh: 手机里的电子版钓鱼证算数吗？
items.short: Sometimes. The accepted form depends on the state, so a photo that works in one state can be invalid in another.
items.body: Texas accepts an electronic copy, including a photo or the emailed receipt, for activities that don't need tags or physical stamps. California requires its CDFW License App, says pictures and screenshots are not valid, still requires physical report cards, and treats a dead battery as no excuse. Wisconsin accepts the agency's PDF on a device for inland waters but not for boundary or outlying waters. Alaska allows a signed electronic copy, or a picture of your signed license, on your phone. Check your own state's page, and carry paper or a backup battery if you are unsure.
items.short_zh: 有时算。可接受的形式各州不同，在这个州有效的照片，到另一个州可能无效。
items.body_zh: 德州接受电子副本，包括照片或购证邮件，前提是这项活动不需要标签或实体印花。加州必须用 CDFW License App 出示，明确说照片和截图无效，报告卡仍须是实体的，手机没电也不能作为理由。威斯康星州在内陆水域接受官方 PDF 在设备上出示，但在边界水域和外围水域（boundary or outlying waters）不接受。阿拉斯加允许把签过名的电子版，或已签名执照的照片存在手机里。请查本州的页面，拿不准时带上纸质证或备用电源。

items.question: Do undersized fish count toward a daily limit?
items.question_zh: 尺寸不足的鱼计入每日限额吗？
items.short: Generally not if released right away, but it depends on the state.
items.body: In Texas, fish caught and immediately released aren't considered to be in possession, while fish on a stringer or in a cooler, livewell or bucket count and must meet length and bag limits. Georgia says any fish shorter than the minimum must go back. Keeping an undersized fish, even briefly on a stringer, can be a violation, so check your state's rules.
items.short_zh: 如果马上放掉，一般不算，但要看各州的规定。
items.body_zh: 在德克萨斯州，钓上后马上放掉的鱼不算持有；放在鱼串、保温箱、活鱼舱或水桶里的鱼都算，必须符合长度和数量限制。佐治亚州规定，短于最小长度的鱼必须放回。尺寸不足的鱼哪怕只在鱼串上放一会儿，也可能违规，要查清本州的规定。

items.question: How do bag limits apply to a group fishing together?
items.question_zh: 一群人一起钓鱼时，限额怎样计算？
items.short: Usually each person has their own limit, and catches can't be pooled.
items.body: Connecticut's saltwater guide says the limit is individual and that a group can't pool its landings. Three anglers under a 3-fish limit don't get 9 fish between them: each stops at 3. Georgia's limits are per person too, and each angler should keep fish on a separate stringer or in a separate creel. Some states may treat this differently, so check yours.
items.short_zh: 通常每人有自己的限额，渔获不能合并计算。
items.body_zh: 康涅狄格州海水钓鱼指南说，限额按个人计算，一群人不能合并计算：三个人在每人 3 条的限额下，并不是合起来 9 条随便分，每人到 3 条就要停。佐治亚州的限额也是按人计算，每个人的鱼要放在各自的鱼串或鱼篓里。有些州的规定可能不同，要查本州的。

items.question: How can I find out which rivers are open and which methods are allowed?
items.question_zh: 怎样查到哪些河流开放、哪些方法允许使用？
items.short: Read your state's fishing regulations for that water.
items.body: State agencies publish regulations by kind of fish and by water, often with an interactive map, as California does. Read the general rules first, then any special rules for your water. Check season dates, gear limits and hook rules. Emergency closures happen, so look at the agency's news page before going.
items.short_zh: 查本州针对那片水域的钓鱼规定。
items.body_zh: 各州主管机构都会按鱼种和水域发布规定，常常还有互动地图，加州就是这样。先读通用规定，再读你那片水域的特别规定。看清开放日期、钓具限制和钩的规定。紧急关闭时有发生，出发前看看主管机构的公告页面。

items.question: What are the usual penalties for fishing with no licence?
items.question_zh: 没有钓鱼证钓鱼，通常会受到什么处罚？
items.short: It depends on the state, but expect a fine and possibly points or lost privileges.
items.body: Texas lists fines from $25 to $500 for a Class C offense, rising to $500 to $4,000 or jail for Class A. Its page doesn't say which class applies to fishing without a license. South Carolina gives 6 points for fishing without a proper license on its inland system, and privileges are suspended at 18 points. New Jersey revokes sporting licenses for at least two years after a second fish or wildlife violation within five years. Buying a license costs far less.
items.short_zh: 各州不同，一般会被罚款，还可能被记分或失去资格。
items.body_zh: 德克萨斯州列出的罚款，C 级违法 25 到 500 美元，A 级 500 到 4,000 美元或监禁，但页面没有说无证钓鱼属于哪一级。南卡罗来纳州在内陆积分制中，无证钓鱼记 6 分，满 18 分暂停资格。新泽西州规定，五年内第二次违反鱼类或野生动物法规，运动狩猎和钓鱼资格至少吊销两年。买一张钓鱼证便宜得多。

items.question: Where can I find a plain explanation of fishing regulations?
items.question_zh: 在哪里能找到通俗易懂的钓鱼法规说明？
items.short: Your state agency's fishing pages and its regulation guide.
items.body: Most agencies publish a summary guide each year, online and in print, and they answer questions by phone. eRegulations hosts guides for many states. FishEye shows license and link information for each state. When sources disagree, the agency's official text is the authority.
items.short_zh: 所在州主管机构的钓鱼页面和规定手册。
items.body_zh: 多数主管机构每年都会发布规定摘要，有网络版和纸质版，也可以打电话询问。eRegulations 上有很多州的指南。FishEye 按州列出了钓鱼证信息和链接。说法不一致时，以主管机构的官方文本为准。

items.question: Do children need a licence?
items.question_zh: 儿童需要钓鱼证吗？
items.short: Often not, but the starting age depends on the state.
items.body: In FishEye's state data, the age a resident needs a license runs from 10 in Arizona up to 18. The most common age is 16, in 30 of 51 jurisdictions (the 50 states and DC). Five states start at 12 and five at 18. Hawaii's entry gives no age. Non-residents usually follow the same age, with exceptions: in Alaska residents need one from 18 and non-residents from 16. A child without a license may still need a stamp or report card: California requires report cards for steelhead or sturgeon at any age. An adult who helps may need a license too, as Georgia requires of anyone assisting an angler. Check the state's page before the trip.
items.short_zh: 很多时候不需要，但起始年龄各州不同。
items.body_zh: 按 FishEye 现有的各州数据，居民需要持证的起始年龄从亚利桑那州的 10 岁到 18 岁不等，最常见的是 16 岁，在 51 个辖区（50 个州和华盛顿特区）中占 30 个。另有五个州从 12 岁开始，五个州从 18 岁开始。夏威夷的条目没有写年龄。非居民一般相同，也有例外：阿拉斯加居民 18 岁起需要，非居民 16 岁起需要。孩子不用证，也可能需要印花或报告卡，加州钓硬头鳟或鲟鱼时，无论年龄都要报告卡。帮忙的大人可能也要持证，佐治亚州就要求协助钓鱼的人有证。出发前请查该州的页面。

items.question: What counts as residency for a resident licence after moving to a new state?
items.question_zh: 搬到新的州之后，什么情况才算居民钓鱼证的居住资格？
items.short: Commonly six months of living in the state, but the test differs by state.
items.body: Texas requires more than six months of continuous residence right before buying. New Jersey requires an established principal residence for at least the previous six months. North Carolina accepts six months of residence, or 60 days of domicile with intent to stay permanently, and says residency can be established in only one state. Active military and, in some states, students have separate rules. If you have just moved, buy a non-resident license until you qualify, or call the agency.
items.short_zh: 常见的要求是在该州居住满六个月，但各州标准不同。
items.body_zh: 德克萨斯州要求购买前连续居住超过六个月。新泽西州要求此前至少六个月在该州有固定主要住所。北卡罗来纳州接受居住满六个月，或者定居 60 天并打算长期居住，并规定只能在一个州确立居住资格。现役军人有单独的规定，有些州对学生也有规定。刚搬过去的话，符合条件之前买非居民钓鱼证，或者打电话问主管机构。

items.question: What handling steps give a released fish the best chance of surviving?
items.question_zh: 哪些操作最能提高放流鱼的存活机会？
items.short: Land it quickly, keep it wet and get it back fast.
items.body: Wet your hands first so you don't strip its protective slime, and keep fingers away from the eyes and gills. Keep it out of the water no longer than you can hold your own breath, about 20 to 30 seconds. Back the hook out with pliers, ideally in the water; if it's deep, cut the line. Hold a small fish, under about 5 lb, by the lower jaw, and support a big one horizontally with both hands. If it's tired, face it into the current and support it until it swims away. In still water, hold it with both hands and move it gently in a figure 8 until it can swim off strongly. Water of 70°F and warmer is hard on trout and other coldwater fish, so avoid fishing for them then. Bring fish up slowly from deep water so they can adjust to the pressure change.
items.short_zh: 把鱼快速收上来，保持湿润，尽快放回去。
items.body_zh: 先把手打湿，以免蹭掉鱼身上起保护作用的黏液，手指不要碰鱼眼和鱼鳃。鱼离水的时间不要超过你能憋气的时间，大约 20 到 30 秒。用钳子把钩退出来，最好在水里操作；钩得很深就剪断线。约 5 磅以下的小鱼可以握住下颌，大鱼要用双手水平托住。鱼没力气时，让它头朝水流，托住它，等它自己游走。在静水里，双手托住轻轻画 8 字，等它能有力地游走再放手。70°F 及以上的水温对鳟鱼等冷水鱼很不利，这时尽量不要钓它们。从深水拉鱼要慢，让它适应压力变化。

items.question: How should different fish be held so they are not injured?
items.question_zh: 不同的鱼应该怎样握持，才不会受伤？
items.short: Support large fish horizontally, and stay away from the gills.
items.body: Hold a small fish, under about 5 lb, by the lower jaw, and support a big one horizontally with two hands. Bass, crappie and small catfish can be held by the lower lip. Hold walleye, pike, gar and big trout over the back of the head. Hold a catfish from behind its spines. Never hang a large fish straight up by the jaw, because its weight can tear organs and dislocate the spine. Most saltwater fish have sharp teeth, so keep your fingers out of their mouths.
items.short_zh: 大鱼要水平托住，手不要碰鱼鳃。
items.body_zh: 约 5 磅以下的小鱼可以握住下颌，大鱼要用双手水平托住。鲈鱼、莓鲈和小鲶鱼可以握下唇。大眼梭鲈、白斑狗鱼、雀鳝和大鳟鱼，要从头后方的背部握住。鲶鱼要从硬棘后方握住。不要把大鱼竖着提起来，自身重量可能拉伤内脏，甚至让脊椎脱位。海水鱼大多牙齿锋利，手指不要伸进鱼嘴。

items.question: Should a bleeding fish still be released?
items.question_zh: 流血的鱼还应该放流吗？
items.short: Usually yes, unless it's legal to keep and you plan to eat it.
items.body: A little bleeding from the jaw is common, and such fish often survive. Heavy bleeding from the gills is more serious. If the fish is legal to keep, keeping it for food is reasonable. Otherwise cut the line if it is hooked deep, handle it gently and revive it in the water. Texas makes it illegal to leave edible fish to die without intending to keep them.
items.short_zh: 通常还是放，除非可以合法留下，而且你打算吃。
items.body_zh: 嘴部轻微流血很常见，这样的鱼常常能活下来。鳃部大量流血就严重得多。如果这条鱼可以合法留下，留作食用也是合理的。否则，钩得深就剪线，轻轻处理，在水里帮它恢复。德州规定，不打算留用却让可食用的鱼死掉是违法的。

items.question: Why might barbless hooks lead to more fish falling off, and how can that be reduced?
items.question_zh: 为什么用无倒刺钩可能更容易脱钩？怎样减少这种情况？
items.short: Nothing holds the hook if the line goes slack.
items.body: A fish comes off easily when the line goes slack, so keep steady pressure, keep the rod tip up with a bend in it, and use a net. With a barbless hook you'll lose a few more fish, but it comes out more quickly.
items.short_zh: 线一松，就没有东西能把钩留在鱼嘴里了。
items.body_zh: 线松的时候，鱼很容易脱钩，所以要保持稳定的拉力，竿尖抬高、保持弯曲，并用抄网。用无倒刺钩会多跑几条鱼，但取钩更快。

items.question: Do fish feel pain when hooked?
items.question_zh: 鱼被钩住时会感到疼痛吗？
items.short: Scientists disagree. Fish clearly detect injury, but whether they feel it as pain is still debated.
items.body: Researchers such as Lynne Sneddon argue that the evidence shows fish feel pain. Others, drawing on a 2014 review by James Rose, argue that fish are unlikely to, and use the word nociception to separate detecting harm from feeling it. Robert Arlinghaus calls himself a fish pain skeptic but a fish welfare advocate, which is a practical place to stand: land fish quickly, keep them wet and remove hooks gently.
items.short_zh: 科学界尚有分歧。鱼显然能察觉到伤害，但它们是否感觉到“疼痛”仍有争议。
items.body_zh: Lynne Sneddon 等研究者认为，证据表明鱼能感到疼痛。另一些人依据 James Rose 2014 年的综述，认为鱼不太可能有疼痛体验，并用“伤害感受”这个词，把察觉伤害和感受疼痛区分开。Robert Arlinghaus 说自己是“对鱼痛存疑、但支持鱼类福利”，这是很实际的立场：快速收鱼，保持湿润，轻轻取钩。

items.question: Are gloves helpful or harmful when handling fish to be released?
items.question_zh: 持握要放流的鱼时，戴手套有帮助还是有害？
items.short: Wet cloth or rubber is fine. Dry, rough gloves remove slime.
items.body: Wet your hands, or use a wet rag or glove, and don't rub off the slime, which protects the fish from infection. Rough or dry cotton gloves can remove slime and scales. Gloves help with toothy fish or spiny fins, so wet them first.
items.short_zh: 湿布或橡胶手套没问题，干燥粗糙的手套会蹭掉黏液。
items.body_zh: 把手打湿，或者用湿布、湿手套，不要蹭掉鱼身上的黏液，它能保护鱼不被感染。粗糙或干燥的棉手套会蹭掉黏液和鳞片。处理利齿鱼或带硬棘的鱼时手套有用，但要先打湿。

items.question: What is the quickest and most humane way to kill a fish?
items.question_zh: 杀鱼最快、最人道的方法是什么？
items.short: A sharp blow to the head, or a spike into the brain.
items.body: A sharp blow to the head stuns the fish, and a spike pushed into the skull just above the eyes kills it and slows spoilage. Then bleed it while the heart still pumps, by cutting through the gills or the artery at the tail. Leave it in water for about 5 to 10 minutes, until the blood stops, then put it on ice. An older saltwater handling bulletin allows 10 to 20 minutes and says cold, clean water changed often works best.
items.short_zh: 猛击头部，或者用尖锥刺入大脑。
items.body_zh: 猛击头部能让鱼失去知觉，把尖锥刺入眼睛上方的头骨，能把鱼杀死，也能减缓变质。然后趁心脏还在跳动放血，切开鳃或尾部动脉。放在水里 5 到 10 分钟，直到不再出血，再放到冰上。一份较早的海鱼处理手册建议放 10 到 20 分钟，并说用干净的冷水、勤换水效果最好。

items.question: Is it always necessary to bleed and gut a fish right away?
items.question_zh: 鱼一定要马上放血和去内脏吗？
items.short: No. It improves quality but is optional.
items.body: Bleeding gives better-looking, better-tasting meat that chills faster, but it is optional. Gutting removes a source of bacteria and also helps the fish chill. What matters most is getting it on ice quickly. Mind the length rules, since some states don't allow filleting before you finally land your catch.
items.short_zh: 不一定。这样做能提高品质，但可以不做。
items.body_zh: 放血后鱼肉更好看、更好吃，降温也更快，但不是必须的。去内脏可以去掉细菌来源，也有助于降温。最重要的是尽快放到冰上。有长度限制的鱼要注意，有些州不允许在最终上岸之前片鱼。

items.question: Is a live well or an ice slurry better for keeping fish fresh until I get home?
items.question_zh: 回家之前保鲜，活鱼舱好还是冰水混合物好？
items.short: An ice slurry is better for fish you'll eat.
items.body: A slush of ice and water chills fish 4 to 5 times faster than ice alone. In warm water, fish in a livewell or on a stringer die quickly. Livewells work for short times or for fish you might release. Fish you plan to eat should go on ice straight away. A stringer also prolongs the struggle, which hurts the meat, and warm water spoils fish sooner, so use one only in cool water and only until you reach ice.
items.short_zh: 要吃的鱼，用冰水混合物更好。
items.body_zh: 冰水混合物的降温速度是单纯用冰的 4 到 5 倍。水温高时，活鱼舱或鱼串上的鱼很快就会死。活鱼舱适合短时间存放，或者可能放流的鱼。打算吃的鱼，要马上放到冰上。鱼串还会延长鱼的挣扎，影响肉质，水温高时鱼也坏得更快，所以只在凉水里短时间用，到有冰的地方就换。

items.question: If I puncture the guts while filleting, is the meat spoiled?
items.question_zh: 片鱼时不小心划破内脏，鱼肉就坏了吗？
items.short: Not usually. Rinse it quickly and keep it cold.
items.body: Gut contents can carry bacteria, so rinse the fillet in clean, cold water right away and trim any part that was contaminated. A burst gall bladder is different: bile spoils the taste of any meat it touches and is hard to wash off, so cut that part away. If a bad smell remains, or the fish has been left warm, throw it out. Clean the knife and board, keep the fillet cold, and cook it to 145°F.
items.short_zh: 通常不会。尽快冲洗，并保持低温。
items.body_zh: 内脏里的东西可能带有细菌，所以要马上用干净的冷水冲洗鱼片，并切掉沾到的部分。胆囊破了情况不同：胆汁沾到的肉会变味，很难洗掉，要把沾到的部分切掉。如果还有异味，或者鱼在温热的环境里放了很久，就扔掉。把刀和砧板洗干净，鱼片要保持低温，烹饪到 145°F。

items.question: How can I learn to fillet a fish if I am squeamish?
items.question_zh: 如果我怕血腥，怎样学会片鱼？
items.short: Start with a fish that's already cold and a sharp knife, and follow a video or a friend.
items.body: Chill the fish so it's firm, and use gloves if it helps; cut-resistant ones are safer while you learn. Wash slime off your hands and the knife handle so the blade can't slip. Work on a clean board in a calm place, and start with easy fish such as bass or trout. A friend or a fish-cleaning station helps. It gets easier with practice. If it doesn't, ask a shop or butcher to clean it, or release what you catch.
items.short_zh: 从已经冰过的鱼和一把锋利的刀开始，跟着视频或朋友学。
items.body_zh: 把鱼冰一下，让鱼肉变硬，需要的话可以戴手套，学的时候戴防割手套更安全。把手上和刀柄上的黏液洗掉，防止刀打滑。在安静的地方，用干净的砧板操作，先从鲈鱼或鳟鱼这类容易的鱼开始。有朋友带或者有处理鱼的台子更好。多练几次就习惯了。实在不行，请店家或肉铺帮忙，或者把鱼放掉。

items.question: How much locally caught fish is safe to eat, and how do I read a state advisory?
items.question_zh: 在当地钓到的鱼吃多少才安全？州政府的食用建议怎样看？
items.short: There is no single safe amount. It depends on the water, the species, the fish's size and who is eating it.
items.body: All 50 states, and some territories and tribes, issue advice on local waters, mostly because of mercury, PFAS, PCBs and DDT. Look for signs at the water, then check your state's health or environmental agency. EPA lists contacts for each state. In an advisory, find the waterbody, then the species and size, then your group. Limits are strictest for people who are pregnant, may become pregnant or are nursing, and for children. In Texas, a consumption ban means you may not keep fish from that area, though catch and release stays legal. An advisory recommends limiting how much you eat. A water that isn't listed hasn't been shown to be clean.
items.short_zh: 没有统一的安全食用量，要看水域、鱼种、鱼的大小和谁来吃。
items.body_zh: 全部 50 个州以及部分领地和部落都发布本地水域的食用建议，主要针对汞、PFAS、多氯联苯和滴滴涕。先看水边的告示牌，再查本州的卫生或环境机构，EPA 有各州的联系方式。读建议时，先找水域，再找鱼种和大小，最后找你所属的人群。孕妇、可能怀孕的女性、哺乳期女性和儿童的限制最严。在德州，食用禁令意味着不能留这片水域的鱼，但钓获放流仍然合法。食用建议则是提醒限制食用量。水域不在名单上，并不代表那里的鱼没有问题。

items.question: What is a sensible minimum size for keeping a fish to eat?
items.question_zh: 留鱼食用时，合理的最小尺寸是多少？
items.short: At least the legal minimum, and big enough to be worth cleaning.
items.body: Legal minimums come first. Beyond that, keep what is worth the effort: a bluegill of around 7 to 8 inches, a crappie of 9 or more, or a trout of 10 or more are common preferences. Smaller panfish can be scaled and cooked whole. Keep only what you will eat, and release large breeding fish where you can.
items.short_zh: 至少达到法定最小尺寸，并且大到值得处理。
items.body_zh: 首先要符合法定最小尺寸。在此之上，留下值得花工夫的鱼：蓝鳃太阳鱼 7 到 8 英寸、莓鲈 9 英寸以上、鳟鱼 10 英寸以上，都是常见的偏好。小一点的小型淡水鱼可以刮鳞后整条烹饪。只留吃得完的，尽量放掉大型的繁殖鱼。

items.question: Which essential tools are needed for cleaning fish at the water?
items.question_zh: 在水边处理鱼，必需哪些工具？
items.short: A sharp fillet knife, a board, a bucket, a cooler with ice and gloves.
items.body: Also bring a scaler or spoon, and catfish pliers if you need them. Some states don't allow filleting before you finally land your catch, so confirm that you may clean fish at the water. Use cleaning stations where they exist, and dispose of waste properly rather than in the lake.
items.short_zh: 锋利的片鱼刀、砧板、水桶、加冰的保温箱和手套。
items.body_zh: 还要带刮鳞器或勺子，需要的话带鲶鱼剥皮钳。有些州不允许在最终上岸之前片鱼，要先确认能不能在水边处理。有处理鱼的台子就用台子，废弃物要妥善处理，不要扔进湖里。

items.question: How can a bank angler adapt to fishing from a boat for the first time?
items.question_zh: 习惯岸钓的人第一次在船上钓鱼，应该怎样适应？
items.short: Move slowly, sit down to cast and keep your gear tidy.
items.body: Wear a life jacket and step into the center of the boat. Cast sideways or low, and watch for other people's hooks. Anchor or drift to hold position, and use a shorter rod if needed. Keep a small box close, and cast toward the bank or structure. If someone falls in, reach with an oar or rope and bring them back over the stern, not the side.
items.short_zh: 动作放慢，坐着抛投，保持装备整齐。
items.body_zh: 穿上救生衣，上船时踩在船中间。侧抛或低抛，小心别人的钩。用锚或漂流来保持位置，必要时用短一点的竿。小渔具盒放在手边，朝岸边或水下结构抛投。如果有人落水，用桨或绳子去够，从船尾拉上来，不要从船舷。

items.question: How do I read the display on a basic fish finder?
items.question_zh: 基础探鱼器的屏幕怎么看？
items.short: The top line is the surface, the thick band is the bottom, and arcs in between may be fish.
items.body: Time scrolls from right to left. A hard bottom shows as a thick, bright band, and weeds look like fuzzy vertical shapes rising from the bottom. Fish often show as arches when the boat is moving, and as lines or dots when it is still. A fuzzy line in midwater in summer is often the thermocline.
items.short_zh: 最上面的线是水面，粗带是水底，中间的弧线可能是鱼。
items.body_zh: 画面从右向左滚动。硬底显示为又粗又亮的带子，水草像从水底长出来的模糊竖条。船在移动时，鱼常显示成拱形；船静止时，则是线或点。夏天水中间的一条模糊线，常常是温跃层。

items.question: How much should I tip on a party boat or with a private guide?
items.question_zh: 在共享钓鱼船或私人向导那里，小费给多少合适？
items.short: In the US, about 15 to 20 percent of the trip cost is common.
items.body: Tip in cash to the deckhand on party boats, since they do much of the work and rely on tips. With a private guide, 15 to 20 percent is a common starting point, and more for excellent service. Customs vary by region and country, so ask the operator if you are unsure.
items.short_zh: 在美国，常见的是行程费用的 15% 到 20%。
items.body_zh: 在共享钓鱼船上，用现金给甲板员，他们做了大部分工作，也靠小费收入。私人向导一般从 15% 到 20% 起，服务特别好可以多给。各地和各国的习惯不同，拿不准就问经营者。

items.question: How do I avoid breaking a rod tip when landing a fish in a kayak?
items.question_zh: 在皮划艇上收鱼时，怎样避免折断竿梢？
items.short: Keep some line out and use a net.
items.body: Reel in only until there is about a rod's length of line out. Hold the rod out to the side or behind you and net the fish. Don't lift by the line, which can break the tip. Avoid lifting the rod too high, and ease the drag slightly as a big fish comes near.
items.short_zh: 留一些线在外面，用抄网。
items.body_zh: 收线时，留出大约一个竿长的线。把竿伸到一侧或身后，用抄网抄鱼。不要靠线把鱼提起来，那样可能把竿尖拉断。竿不要抬得太高，大鱼靠近时把卸力稍微调松。

items.question: Which small boat or kayak suits two people for a first try?
items.question_zh: 第一次尝试时，哪种小船或皮划艇适合两个人？
items.short: A stable jon boat or a wide tandem kayak.
items.body: A flat-bottom jon boat of about 12 to 14 feet is stable and roomy for two. A sit-on-top tandem kayak is cheaper, but the two paddlers must coordinate. Check the capacity plate and have a life jacket for everyone. Rent first to see what suits you, and check whether your state requires registration.
items.short_zh: 稳定的平底船，或者较宽的双人皮划艇。
items.body_zh: 12 到 14 英尺的平底船，稳定，两个人也宽敞。坐顶式双人皮划艇便宜一些，但两个人要配合。看清额定载重，每个人都要有救生衣。先租来试试，看什么适合自己，所在州是否要求登记，也要问清楚。

items.question: How can a fish finder be powered on a small craft with no electrical system?
items.question_zh: 小型船具没有配电系统时，探鱼器可以怎样供电？
items.short: Use a small sealed rechargeable battery.
items.body: A 12-volt sealed battery of about 7 to 12 amp-hours runs most small fish finders for a day. Put a fuse close to the battery, keep it in a dry box and protect the terminals. Portable units often come with their own battery kits.
items.short_zh: 用小型密封充电电池。
items.body_zh: 7 到 12 安时的 12 伏密封电池，能让多数小型探鱼器用一整天。保险丝要靠近电池，电池放在干燥的盒子里，接线端要有防护。便携款常常自带电池套件。

items.question: What gear works best for a first outing with young children?
items.question_zh: 第一次带小孩子钓鱼，什么装备最合适？
items.short: A short push-button rod, a bobber and worms.
items.body: A push-button reel on a short rod with a hook, a split shot and a bobber catches most fish, and the closed cover keeps tangles to a minimum. A child can see the bobber go down. Worms stay on the hook and most fish eat them. A life jacket that fits now is a must near deep water.
items.short_zh: 按钮式短竿、浮漂和蚯蚓。
items.body_zh: 短竿配卡式轮，加钩、咬铅和浮漂，能钓到大多数鱼，封闭的外壳也很少缠线。孩子能看到浮漂下沉。蚯蚓挂得牢，多数鱼都吃。在深水附近，一定要穿现在就合身的救生衣。

items.question: How can a trip with kids be kept short, safe and enjoyable?
items.question_zh: 带孩子钓鱼，怎样既简短、安全又有趣？
items.short: An hour or two is plenty, and stop while it's still fun.
items.body: Make the trip about the child, not your own fishing. Lines will tangle and hooks need baiting. Bring snacks, drinks, hats, sunglasses, sunscreen, bug spray and spare clothes, and a small net for insects to fill the time between bites. Let them help decide where to fish.
items.short_zh: 一两个小时就够了，趁还开心时结束。
items.body_zh: 这一趟是为了孩子，不是为了自己钓鱼。线会缠，饵要帮着挂。带上零食、饮料、帽子、太阳镜、防晒霜、驱虫剂和备用衣物，再带一个小网捞昆虫，打发没有咬口的时间。让孩子一起决定在哪里钓。

items.question: Which fish and places give children the best chance of quick bites?
items.question_zh: 哪些鱼和地点最能让孩子很快有咬钩？
items.short: Bluegill in a stocked pond, or from a dock.
items.body: Bluegill are curious and not picky, so a piece of worm under a small bobber is the easiest start. Community ponds are often stocked, and spring and summer mornings and evenings are good times. Docks and piers are easy for kids, but they need life jackets near deep water.
items.short_zh: 放流池塘里的蓝鳃太阳鱼，或者在码头上钓。
items.body_zh: 蓝鳃太阳鱼好奇心强，不挑食，小浮漂下挂一小段蚯蚓最容易上手。社区池塘常有放流，春夏的清晨和傍晚是好时机。码头和栈桥对孩子很方便，但在深水附近要穿救生衣。

items.question: How can fishing be adapted for someone who is legally blind?
items.question_zh: 怎样让法定失明的人也能钓鱼？
items.short: Rely on touch and sound, and fish with a sighted partner.
items.body: A rod with a sensitive tip and braid carry bites well, and bells or electronic bite alarms give sound cues. Fish from a safe spot with a railing, with a sighted partner to help with casting direction and handling. Tie knots by feel or use snap connectors. Some states have license exemptions for people who are blind, such as Arizona for residents, so check with the agency.
items.short_zh: 依靠触觉和声音，并和视力正常的同伴一起钓。
items.body_zh: 灵敏的竿尖加编织线能很好地传递咬口，铃铛或电子咬口报警器能提供声音提示。选有栏杆的安全位置，请视力正常的同伴帮忙确定抛投方向和处理鱼。凭手感打结，或者用快速别针连接。有些州对盲人有钓鱼证豁免，比如亚利桑那州的居民，可以问主管机构。

items.question: What should be in a beginner's tackle box?
items.question_zh: 新手的渔具盒里应该放什么？
items.short: Hooks, split shot, bobbers, pliers, clippers and a few lures.
items.body: A beginner's kit is small: a pack of No. 6 to 8 hooks, a few split shot, two or three bobbers and needle-nose pliers. Add swivels, a few jigs and a small first-aid kit. Keep it dry, and leave the box open until everything is dry.
items.short_zh: 钩、咬铅、浮漂、钳子、剪线钳和几个拟饵。
items.body_zh: 新手的装备很简单：一包 6 到 8 号钩、几粒咬铅、两三个浮漂和尖嘴钳。再加转环、几个铅头钩和一个小急救包。保持干燥，渔具盒要等里面都干了再合上。

items.question: How essential is a landing net when starting out?
items.question_zh: 刚开始钓鱼时，抄网有多必要？
items.short: Optional for panfish, useful for trout and bigger fish.
items.body: A landing net lands more fish, because grabbing a fish by hand or dragging it up the bank is when the line breaks or the hook pulls out. For panfish it is optional, and for trout you should bring one. A shallow net of fine mesh is easiest on a fish you'll release.
items.short_zh: 钓小型淡水鱼可有可无，钓鳟鱼和大鱼很有用。
items.body_zh: 用抄网能少跑鱼，用手抓鱼或把鱼拖上岸时，最容易断线或脱钩。钓小型淡水鱼可有可无，钓鳟鱼就要带。细网眼的浅抄网对要放流的鱼最温和。

items.question: How useful are polarized sunglasses for a beginner?
items.question_zh: 偏光太阳镜对新手有多大用处？
items.short: Very useful, and they protect your eyes.
items.body: Polarized lenses cut the glare so you can see into the water, including weeds, fish and drop-offs. Sunglasses also guard your eyes against a stray hook. Gray or brown lenses suit most days.
items.short_zh: 很有用，还能保护眼睛。
items.body_zh: 偏光镜片能消除反光，让你看到水下的水草、鱼和陡坎。太阳镜也能防止钩伤到眼睛。灰色或棕色镜片适合多数日子。

items.question: Do I need split-ring pliers, or can I do without them?
items.question_zh: 我需要开环钳吗，还是可以不用？
items.short: You can do without them at first.
items.body: You need them only when changing hooks on lures. They make the job much easier and protect your nails. Needle-nose pliers cover most other tasks. Buy a pair when you begin changing treble hooks.
items.short_zh: 一开始可以不用。
items.body_zh: 只有在换饵上的钩时才需要。有了它，这件事会轻松很多，也不伤指甲。其他多数工作，尖嘴钳都能应付。开始换三本钩时，再买一把。

items.question: How can soft baits and leaders be stored so they do not tangle or bend?
items.question_zh: 软饵和前导线怎样存放才不会缠绕或变形？
items.short: Keep soft baits flat in their original bags and leaders on small spools.
items.body: Put each kind of soft plastic in its own factory bag and keep the bags somewhere cool. Wind leaders onto small spools or keep them in a leader wallet, labeled with their strength. Keep them out of sunlight, and replace any that are nicked.
items.short_zh: 软饵平放在原包装里，前导线绕在小线轴上。
items.body_zh: 不同的软饵要分开，放在原包装里，远离高温。前导线绕在小线轴上，或者放进前导夹，并标明磅数。避开阳光，有划痕的就换掉。

items.question: Do regular sneakers fit inside hip waders?
items.question_zh: 普通运动鞋能穿进及腰涉水靴里吗？
items.short: Usually not. Hip waders have built-in boots.
items.body: Most hip waders are boot-foot: you slip your foot into a built-in boot and wear socks rather than shoes. Stockingfoot waders need separate wading boots. Size boot-foot waders to allow for thick socks. Sneakers are fine for fishing from the bank.
items.short_zh: 通常不行。及腰涉水靴自带靴子。
items.body_zh: 多数及腰涉水靴都是连靴式，脚直接伸进靴子里，穿袜子，不穿鞋。袜式涉水裤才需要另配涉水靴。连靴式要按穿厚袜子的尺寸选。在岸上钓鱼，穿运动鞋就可以。

items.question: My rod tip broke: should I repair it, shorten it or replace the rod?
items.question_zh: 竿梢断了，应该修理、截短，还是换竿？
items.short: Glue on a new tip if it's a short break. Replace a cheap rod if the break is long.
items.body: A broken tip can be replaced with a glue-on tip from a tackle shop. Check the warranty first, because a new rod may be covered. If you lose only an inch or two, the rod still fishes well. If the break is long, the action changes a lot, and a cheap rod is better replaced.
items.short_zh: 断得短就粘一个新竿尖，断得长、竿又便宜就换一根。
items.body_zh: 断掉的竿尖可以用渔具店买的粘接式竿尖更换。先看保修，新竿可能在保修范围内。如果只少了一两英寸，还能很好地使用。断得太长，调性会变化很大，便宜的竿不如换一根。

items.question: How do I fix a bail that stopped working after cleaning?
items.question_zh: 清洁之后线臂不工作了，怎样修？
items.short: A spring or part is probably misplaced.
items.body: Compare your reel with the parts diagram, and check that the bail spring is seated and facing the right way. Check the trip lever, and look for small parts that may have fallen out. Reassemble slowly in the order of the diagram. If a part is missing, contact the maker for a replacement.
items.short_zh: 很可能是弹簧或零件装错了位置。
items.body_zh: 和零件图对照，确认线臂弹簧装到位、方向正确。检查翻转杆，看看有没有小零件掉了。按零件图的顺序慢慢装回去。少了零件的话，联系厂家补购。

items.question: What lubricant should be used for a reel that sticks?
items.question_zh: 轮发涩时，应该用什么润滑剂？
items.short: Reel oil on the moving points, and reel grease on the gears.
items.body: A reel that sticks often has dried grease or grit, so clean it first. Daiwa recommends oil for handle knob and line roller bearings and grease for parts that contact and move on each other. It doesn't recommend aerosol penetrating sprays directly on or in its reels. Follow your reel's manual.
items.short_zh: 活动点用渔轮油，齿轮用渔轮润滑脂。
items.body_zh: 轮发涩常常是因为润滑脂干了或进了沙子，要先清洁。Daiwa 建议手把旋钮和导线轮轴承用油，互相接触并运动的零件用润滑脂，不建议把气雾型渗透喷剂直接喷在轮上或轮内。按你这只轮的说明书操作。

items.question: Why does the handle on a new combo look loose or crooked, and is that normal?
items.question_zh: 新套装的手把看起来松动或歪斜，这正常吗？
items.short: It often just needs tightening, but a wobble that stays isn't normal.
items.body: Many reels have a handle that screws on at the side, so check that it is fully seated and turned the right way. A handle turned backward can come off. A cheap combo may have a little play, but if the handle is bent or keeps wobbling, exchange it.
items.short_zh: 常常只要拧紧就好，但一直晃动就不正常了。
items.body_zh: 很多轮的手把是从侧面拧上去的，要确认完全到位、方向正确。手把反着转，可能会掉下来。便宜的套装可能有一点旷量，但如果手把弯了或一直晃动，就要换货。
